  • Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously.

title: AI Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history, and the demand has created an infrastructure gap: we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry still relies on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect delivers a step change in system-level performance.

The Role

We build infrastructure for frontier AI, and we use AI to build it. Every team at OLIX works with AI tools, coding harnesses, models and agents, and we intend to use them more. We are hiring an AI Security Engineer to make that adoption safe without slowing it down.

You will map our AI footprint, secure our agents and their identities, protect our compute infrastructure, and build the controls that stop our IP and data leaving through AI systems. You will give teams a fast path to adopt new tools and make AI security measurable. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with the freedom to define AI security at OLIX from the ground up.

Responsibilities

  • Map the AI footprint: build and maintain the inventory of AI tools, models, agents and data flows across the company.

  • Secure agents: give every agent a managed identity, least-privilege access, logged actions and the right human approvals.

  • Build controls against AI threats: prompt injection, data leakage, model and package supply chain, unsafe agent actions and shadow AI.

  • Secure AI infrastructure: harden the cloud compute our teams use to build and run AI workloads.

  • Make AI security measurable: run our ISO 42001 self-assessment and feed AI security events into our SIEM.

  • Enable safe adoption: review new AI tools within days and publish the guardrails teams need.

Skills and experience

  • 5 or more years in security engineering, application security or cloud security, with at least 2 years securing AI or ML systems, LLM applications or agents.

  • Hands-on knowledge of LLM-specific threats and their mitigations.

  • Experience securing agentic systems: tool permissions, MCP servers, credentials and human approval steps.

  • AWS security experience and identity experience, ideally Okta.

  • Software engineering in Python or TypeScript.

  • Daily use of AI coding tools and agents in your own work.

  • Nice to have: experience with ISO 42001 or the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, or in a hardware or deep-tech company.

Compensation and equity

  • Competitive salary: commensurate with your experience, skills and location.

  • Equity and ownership: meaningful stock options.

  • Proximity bonus: an annual Living-Local Bonus if you live within 20 minutes of the office.

  • Retirement benefits: employer-contributed retirement plans.

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates' eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.

Mach Zukunftstechnologien zu Deinem Projekt und Deiner Expertise!

Die Epotronic GmbH ist spezialisiert auf den Vertrieb von Industriedrohnen wie DJI, Roboterhunden von Astrall Dynamics oder Pudu Robotics, sowie hochmodernen Vermessungs- und SLAM-Scannern von EMLID, Matterport, GreenValley oder XGRIDS. Außerdem sind wir Vertragspartner von Bentley Systems, BricsCAD, HESAI und vielen weiteren renommierten Herstellern und Weltmarktführern – ZUKUNFTSSICHERHEIT garantiert!

Da viele unserer Kunden aus der Bauwirtschaft unsere Hardware nutzen, um daraus CAD- und BIM-Modelle zu erstellen, fehlt uns genau hier dein Know-how: Wir suchen unser fehlendes Puzzleteil – einen vertriebsstarken Technikexperten, der die Sprache der Bauzeichner und Vermessungsingenieure spricht.

Zu unseren Kunden zählen internationale Großkonzerne, die Bundesrepublik, Behörden, Universitäten, aber auch SMEs, KMUs und selbstständige gewerbetreibende.

Der Erfolg gehört dir: Lege den Grundstein für ein überdurchschnittliches Einkommen in deinem Wissens- oder Erfahrungsbereich. Unser Umsatz stieg von 2 Mio. € im Jahr 2021 auf 9 Mio. € im Jahr 2023. Wir führen derzeit über 30 Hersteller in unserem Sortiment mit stark steigender Tendenz.

Du hast dein Studium in Geodäsie, Geoinformatik oder Geographie abgeschlossen und willst Messtechnik nicht nur aus der Vorlesung kennen? Bei uns hast du jede Woche neue Hardware in der Hand, löst echte Probleme beim Kunden und arbeitest parallel in einem Forschungsprojekt mit. Wir sind ein kleines, eigenfinanziertes Team ohne Investoren im Hintergrund – kurze Wege, viel Verantwortung und ein Arbeitstag, der garantiert nicht langweilig wird.

Wenn es dir wichtig ist, deine Tage frei gestalten zu können und mit Menschen zusammenzuarbeiten, auf die du dich täglich freust, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

  • Starke interne Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

  • Regelmäßige Produktschulungen durch unsere Hersteller

  • Einblicke in einen Geschäftsbereich, der als Datenlieferant für die KI-Industrie gilt

  • Einstieg in den Zukunftsmarkt Robotik

  • Teilnahme an einem stark wachsenden Marktumfeld mit professionellem Wettbewerb

Aufgaben - Was erwartet dich?

  • Laserscanning & Photogrammetrie: Du begleitest Kundenprojekte von der Datenerfassung mit Drohnen-LiDAR, mobilen SLAM-Scannern bis zur Auswertung von Punktwolken, Orthofotos und 3D-Modellen.

  • Troubleshooting beim Kunden: Du analysierst technische Probleme remote oder vor Ort und bringst Systeme, Workflows und Daten wieder zum Laufen.

  • Kommunikation mit den Herstellern: Du bist technischer Ansprechpartner für unsere Hersteller, eröffnest und verfolgst Support-Fälle und gibst Feedback aus der Praxis weiter – meist auf Englisch.

  • RMA-Abwicklung: Du kümmerst dich um Reparatur- und Garantiefälle, von der Fehlerdiagnose über die Abstimmung mit dem Hersteller bis zur Rückmeldung an den Kunden.

  • Demos & Schulungen: Du führst Testmessungen und Produktvorführungen durch und unterstützt bei Kundenschulungen, z. B. zu DJI Terra oder LiDAR-Workflows.

  • Vertriebliche Unterstützung: Du berätst Interessenten technisch, bereitest Demodaten auf und begleitest den Vertrieb bei Terminen und auf Messen.

  • Forschungsprojekt: Du arbeitest in einem geförderten Forschungsprojekt mit Hochschulpartnern mit – von der Planung von Messkampagnen bis zu Genauigkeitsanalysen und Dokumentation.

Qualifikation - Was solltest du mitbringen?

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium M.Sc. oder Diplom der Geodäsie, Vermessung, Geodäsie, Geoinformatik oder Geomatik, Geospatial Technologies oder Applied Geoinformatics, Geographie mit Schwerpunkt Fernerkundung, GIS oder Photogrammetrie, Vergleichbare Studiengänge, z. B. Bauingenieurwesen mit Vermessungsschwerpunkt

  • Praxishintergrund: Erste praktische Erfahrung mit Laserscanning und/oder Photogrammetrie, z. B. aus Studienprojekten, deiner Abschlussarbeit oder einem Werkstudentenjob

  • Praxishintergrund: Erfahrung mit Laserscanning und/oder Photogrammetrie, z. B. aus Studienprojekten, deiner Abschlussarbeit oder einem Werkstudentenjob

  • Dein Know-how:

  • Sicheres Verständnis von Koordinatensystemen, Georeferenzierung, GNSS/RTK und Genauigkeitsbetrachtungen

  • Routine mit Punktwolken- und GIS-Software (z. B. CloudCompare, QGIS); Skripting-Kenntnisse, etwa in Python, sind ein Plus

  • (Hobby) Drohnenerfahrungen o.ä. sind von Vorteil – alles Weitere bringen wir dir bei.

  • Arbeitsweise: Eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Ruhe beim Troubleshooting und Freude am Kontakt mit Kunden und Herstellern. Offenheit für vertriebliche Themen.

  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundeneinsätze und Führerschein Klasse B

  • Sprachen: Deutsch C2-Niveau und Englisch mindestens C1-Niveau

Benefits - Was bieten wir dir?

  • Praxis und Forschung in einem Job: Du arbeitest an echten Kundenprojekten und gleichzeitig wissenschaftlich mit Hochschulpartnern.

  • Zukunftstechnologien: Du arbeitest mit Drohnen, LiDAR-Sensoren und 3D-Scannern der weltweiten Marktführer bevor sie auf dem Markt sind. Du bist die europäische Speerspitze dieser Technologien.

  • Weiterbildung: Interne Einarbeitung und regelmäßige Produktschulungen direkt bei den Herstellern.

  • Verantwortung von Anfang an: Ein kleines Team, kurze Wege und viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Solange Arbeit und Ergebnis stimmen, ist bei uns fast alles möglich.

  • Freiheit & Flexibilität: Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, flexible Gestaltung deiner Arbeitstage (mobiles Arbeiten 1-2 mal wöchentlich) und Kernarbeitszeiten rund um die Mittagspause.

  • Extras: Zusätzliche Urlaubstage, ein leistungsabhängiger Gehaltsbestandteil mit Bonussystem, Fahrzeugpool und Mitarbeiterrabatte.

  • Netzwerk: Du lernst Hersteller, Hochschulen und Kunden aus Bau, Industrie und Behörden kennen und baust dir ein starkes Netzwerk in einer schnell wachsenden Branche auf.

  • Unbegrenztes Potenzial: Ein stark wachsendes Marktumfeld (Umsatzsteigerung von 2 Mio. € auf 9 Mio. € in zwei Jahren) und ein ungedeckeltes, erfolgsorientiertes Gehaltsmodell.

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Schritt?
Wir brauchen kein Standard-Anschreiben. Schick uns dein CV und eine moderne, schlagfertige Bewerbung (E-Mail / Nachricht) mit mindestens einem starken Argument für deine Kompetenzen oder (d)einer kurzen Vision, wie du (d)ein erstes Projekt bei uns angehen würdest.

title: Application Security Lead
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The AppSec team sits inside Cyber Security and owns secure development across a large, GitHub-based engineering organisation shipping payments software in AWS and Kubernetes.

What the role owns:

- Threat modelling (STRIDE) embedded in the Architecture Review Board, so engineering designs keep moving

- Application vulnerability management: triage, prioritisation, SLA tracking and escalation across code, dependencies, IaC and APIs, with AppSec accountable for closure

- Remediation tracking for penetration test and bug bounty findings

- Security reviews of AI tooling and MCP integrations before they are approved for use: tool permissions, data egress, prompt injection and credential handling

- Ownership of the tooling: SonarCloud, GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL, Dependabot, secret scanning), 42Crunch for API specs, Claude Security for AI-driven vulnerability discovery and fixes, and the internally built PR security gates

Who we are looking for:

A hands-on AppSec lead who has run a small function before and can hold their own with senior engineers.

Must have:

- 7+ years in security, at least 4 in application or product security, including leading or running an AppSec function (team of 2 to 4)

- Threat modelling of cloud-native services, done personally and at pace, not just facilitated - Reads code well enough to judge a finding in at least two of .NET, Go, Python and TypeScript

- Hands-on with GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL, Dependabot) and SonarCloud or SonarQube, including tuning and false-positive management

- Vulnerability management at scale: SLAs, prioritisation, escalation, and the engineering relationships that make remediation happen

- AWS and Kubernetes security fundamentals; API security - Can run security reviews of AI tooling, agents and MCP integrations, covering tool permissions, data egress, prompt injection and credential handling

- Experience in a PCI DSS or otherwise regulated environment; payments or fintech preferred

Nice to have:

- AI-assisted code review with Claude Security or similar, and securing AI-generated code and AI-powered services

- 42Crunch; Azure alongside AWS

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Architecture Internship Dutch | March 2027 (2)
descriptionHtml:
Geef je carrière een vliegende start

MVRDV is een wereldwijd gerenommeerd architectuur- en stedenbouwkundig bureau met het hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en kantoren in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. MVRDV werd in 1993 opgericht door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries en zet zich in voor het ontwerpen van innovatieve, maatschappelijk verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft.

Als stagiair bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 200 professionals uit ruim 40 verschillende landen. Je doet praktijkervaring op in baanbrekende projecten, werkt samen met toonaangevende architecten en verlegt de grenzen van ontwerp en innovatie. Ben jij gepassioneerd over architectuur en wil je leren in een dynamische en creatieve omgeving? Dan horen we graag van je.

Let op: We verzoeken recruitmentbureaus vriendelijk om geen ongevraagde kandidaten of profielen voor deze vacature aan te leveren. Wij verzorgen het wervingsproces intern en accepteren geen voorwaarden of vergoedingen met betrekking tot ongevraagde doorverwijzingen.

Sollicitatieprocedure

  1. Je kunt je sollicitatie indienen vanaf nu tot en met 16 november 2026.

  2. De gesprekken vinden plaats tussen 23 november en 11 december 2026.

  3. Succesvolle kandidaten starten op 1 maart 2027.

Belangrijk: Om in aanmerking te komen voor deze stage moet je gedurende de volledige stageperiode, van 1 maart 2027 tot en met 31 augustus 2027, ingeschreven blijven staan aan een daarvoor in aanmerking komende opleiding aan een universiteit of hogeschool.

Over het Design Collective

Het Design Collective van MVRDV is verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen van innovatieve en duurzame gebouwen en constructies. We werken aan een breed scala aan projecten, van kleinschalige woningbouw tot grootschalige commerciële en culturele complexen. Bekijk enkele voorbeelden van onze projecten op: https://www.mvrdv.com/projects.

Het Design Collective richt zich op projecten in de volgende regio’s:

  • Nederland

  • Azië

  • DACH-regio

  • Franstalige landen

  • Noord-Amerika

  • Centraal- en Oost-Europa

  • Taiwan

  • Midden-Oosten

Over de functie

Als Architectuurstagiair bij MVRDV kom je terecht in een dynamische omgeving waar gedurfde ideeën en snel schakelen dagelijks centraal staan. Je wordt begeleid door internationaal vooraanstaande ontwerpers bij projecten en prijsvragen en levert een bijdrage aan ambitieuze concepten, gedetailleerde tekeningen en indrukwekkende visualisaties.

Afhankelijk van jouw profiel en ervaring word je gekoppeld aan specifieke projecten, regio’s en/of projecttypen.

Dit is een uitstekende kans om je vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen, je creativiteit uit te dagen en een realistisch beeld te krijgen van het werken aan de voorhoede van de architectuur.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Assisteren bij de ontwikkeling van concepten en ontwerpvoorstellen.

  • Maken van tekeningen, diagrammen en 3D-modellen.

  • Ontwikkelen van visualisaties en presentatiemateriaal voor prijsvragen en opdrachtgevers.

  • Deelnemen aan teamoverleggen en ontwerpbesprekingen.

  • Onderzoek doen naar materialen, locatieomstandigheden en architectonische referenties.

Wat bieden wij?

Leren van marktleiders

Word onderdeel van een wereldwijd, ambitieus en optimistisch team dat werkt aan architectonische en stedenbouwkundige vraagstukken over de hele wereld. Je werkt samen met professionals uit verschillende disciplines, van ontwerp tot business support.

Stagevergoeding

Je ontvangt een aantrekkelijke stagevergoeding van €1.100 per maand, plus een vergoeding voor je woon-werkverkeer (via een NS-Business Card of kilometervergoeding).

Een levendige werkcultuur

Ervaar een dynamische en internationale werkomgeving met regelmatige excursies, feesten en teamactiviteiten, waaronder deelname aan de Rotterdam Marathon en andere sportevenementen.

Gezond en actief blijven

Geniet van betaalbare vegetarische lunches op kantoor (€4,30 per dag), een ruime bijdrage aan je Urban Sports Club-abonnement en toegang tot OpenUp, ons platform voor mentaal welzijn.

Een inspirerende werkplek

Werk vanuit ons kantoor in de levendige Rotterdamse wijk Blaak, op loopafstand van station Rotterdam Blaak. Een inspirerende omgeving in het hart van de stad.


Wij zijn op zoek naar een fulltime architectuurstagiair (40 uur per week) die van 1 maart 2027 tot en met 31 augustus 2027 bij ons op kantoor komt werken (5 dagen per week op locatie) voor een uitdagende stageperiode van 6 maanden.

Meer specifiek zoeken wij studenten met:

  • Sterke ontwerp- en CAD-vaardigheden.

  • Goede beheersing van Adobe Suite en sterke 2D- en 3D-visualisatievaardigheden (vermeld in je sollicitatie duidelijk je ervaring met de verschillende softwareprogramma’s).

  • Het vermogen om goed samen te werken in internationale teams.

  • Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van de Engelse taal; aanvullende talen zijn een pré.

  • Werkgerechtigdheid in Nederland (bijvoorbeeld door EU-burgerschap, een Nederlandse verblijfsvergunning of een Working Holiday-visum). Indien van toepassing kan MVRDV ondersteuning bieden bij de visumaanvraag voor niet-EU-burgers. Dit is afhankelijk van het voldoen aan alle vereisten van de Nederlandse Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND). Zorg er daarom voor dat je de juiste gegevens invult in je sollicitatie.

  • Gedurende de volledige stageperiode ingeschreven staan als student (een bewijs van inschrijving is vereist).

Sluit je bij ons aan en doe waardevolle praktijkervaring op in een dynamische en collaboratieve werkomgeving, waar jouw ideeën ertoe doen en jouw ontwikkeling wordt gestimuleerd, of je nu werkzaam bent in design, communicatie, HR, finance of een andere discipline.

Wij kijken ernaar uit je in ons team te verwelkomen!

title: OT Solution Architect (m/w/d) – Batteriespeicher
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Ohne Speicher keine Energiewende.

ju:niz Energy entwickelt, baut und betreibt netzdienliche Batteriegroßspeicher. Unsere Anlagen schaffen die Flexibilität, die ein Stromsystem mit erneuerbaren Energien braucht.
Ein Batteriespeicher verbindet unterschiedliche technische Systeme. Ob daraus eine zuverlässig steuerbare Anlage wird, entscheidet sich an ihrem Zusammenspiel. Genau hier setzt deine Arbeit als OT Solution Architect an: Du gestaltest die OT-Architektur, verbindest Automatisierung, Steuerung und Datenkommunikation und begleitest die Umsetzung mit unseren Spezialisten und Technologiepartnern.

Dabei reicht dein Blick über das einzelne Projekt hinaus. Du entwickelst Standards, mit denen sich weitere Speicher konsistent in unsere OT-Landschaft integrieren lassen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwirfst die digitale Gesamtarchitektur neuer Batteriespeicheranlagen und legst fest, wie sich diese in unsere bestehende OT-Landschaft einfügen.
  • SPS, SCADA, Energiemanagementsysteme und Historian führst du zu einem abgestimmten Systemkonzept zusammen. Dabei definierst du Schnittstellen und das Zusammenspiel der Komponenten.
  • Für den Einsatz von IEC 61850 und OPC UA entwickelst du Architekturvorgaben und stellst ihre konsistente Anwendung sicher.
  • Gemeinsam mit Lieferanten und Integratoren überführst du Konzepte in technische Lösungen. Du steuerst ihre Beiträge fachlich und prüfst, ob die Ergebnisse unseren Anforderungen entsprechen.
  • Architekturvorlagen und standardisierte Anbindungskonzepte entwickelst du weiter, damit bewährte Lösungen für zusätzliche Anlagen nutzbar werden.
  • Mit dem Digital OT Lead sowie unseren Cloud-, EMS- und SPS-Spezialisten stimmst du Architekturentscheidungen ab und klärst technische Abhängigkeiten.
  • Bei Lieferantenausschreibungen formulierst du Anforderungen an Systeme und Schnittstellen. Deine Entscheidungen dokumentierst du so, dass sie für Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung nachvollziehbar bleiben.

Dein Profil

  • Ein Studium der Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik oder Informatik beziehungsweise eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet deine fachliche Grundlage.
  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung mit der Architektur industrieller Automatisierungs- oder Energieanlagen und kannst erklären, weshalb du bestimmte Systemkonzepte und Schnittstellen gewählt hast.
  • Mit IEC 61850 und OPC UA sowie SCADA- und Energiemanagementsystemen kennst du dich fundiert aus. Du verstehst sowohl die einzelnen Komponenten als auch ihr Zusammenspiel.
  • Lieferanten und Integratoren hast du bereits fachlich gesteuert. Technische Konzepte kannst du hinterfragen und die Qualität ihrer Umsetzung beurteilen.
  • Erfahrung mit Batteriespeichern ist willkommen. Ebenso interessant ist deine Expertise aus anderen industriellen Automatisierungs- oder Energieanlagen.
  • Komplexe Zusammenhänge strukturierst du verständlich. Architekturentscheidungen begründest du nachvollziehbar und vertrittst sie im Austausch mit internen und externen Fachleuten.
  • Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch mindestens auf C2-Niveau und sehr sicher auf Englisch. Für die Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Team bist du jede Woche zwei bis drei Tage in Aschheim bei München präsent.

Warum wir?

  • Deine Architektur wird umgesetzt: Du begleitest den Weg vom Konzept bis zur Anlagenintegration und erlebst, wie sich deine Entscheidungen in der technischen Umsetzung bewähren.
  • Gute Lösungen wirken über ein Projekt hinaus: Deine Standards schaffen die Grundlage für die Anbindung weiterer Speicher. Du kannst damit wiederkehrende Integrationsaufgaben nachhaltig verbessern.
  • Du gestaltest das Zusammenspiel: Die Rolle verbindet Steuerung, Energiemanagement und Datenkommunikation und bietet dir Raum für systemübergreifende Architekturarbeit.

title: Associate AI Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary : Associate AI Deployment Strategist

 

As an Associate AI Deployment Strategist, you will support the adoption and deployment of Mistral’s AI solutions, working closely with customers and internal teams to bridge the gap between strategic vision and practical implementation. This role is ideal for early-career professionals eager to learn, grow, and contribute to transformative AI projects in a collaborative environment.

 

You will assist in designing AI roadmaps, collaborating with the Solution team to deliver solutions, and ensuring smooth transitions from presales to postsales. Your work will directly contribute to customer success, helping turn AI potential into real-world impact.

 

What you will do

 

Strategic Discovery & Vision Setting

• Assist in executive-level workshops to identify business challenges and opportunities where Mistral’s AI can drive improvements.

• Support the creation of AI adoption roadmaps, helping articulate the “art of the possible” and a clear path to value.

• Collaborate with Account Executives to develop business cases and align solutions with customer objectives.

 

AI Solution Design & Deployment

• Contribute to the design and deployment of end-to-end AI solutions, integrating Mistral’s models and platform into customer workflows.

• Prototype and deploy AI solutions, ensuring scalability and impact under supervision.

• Executing pilot projects and proofs-of-value, demonstrating the potential of our technology.

 

Value Realization & Customer Success

• Support customers in their AI strategy, helping them maximize the value of their investment in Mistral.

• Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) tied to business outcomes and assist in communicating progress to stakeholders.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Act as a liaison between customers and Mistral’s internal teams, gathering feedback to influence product and research roadmaps.

• Travel (~30-60%) to foster deep client relationships and support on-site deployment.

  

About you

 

• 1 to 2 years in a client-facing strategic role (e.g., management consulting, value engineering, or technical sales). To note, we also accept fresh graduates that have gained relevant experience through internships and work study programs.

• You hold a degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, etc.)

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to structure challenges into actionable solutions.

• Effective communication skills to engage with stakeholders at various levels.

• Strong technical knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science

• Hands-on experience prototyping proofs-of-concept (Python, JavaScript, or similar)

• Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a collaborative environment.

  

Why this role matters

 

You will play a key role in supporting how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact. By collaborating with the Applied AI team, you’ll help turn strategic visions into production-ready solutions, contributing to Mistral’s growth and customer success. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact in the AI industry.

  

Hiring Process

 

• Talent Acquisition screening call

• 30min Hiring Manager Interview

• 45min Business Acumen Interview 

• 60min Technical Deep Dive on LLMs

• Panel (Home Prep & Restitution)

• 30min Value Talk

• Reference check

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

  • Create an Open environment by finding the perfect balance between the fulfillment of our people and the satisfaction of our clients, all built on mutual trust.

  About the Opportunity L’Oréal International Distribution (LID) is a premier global media planning and activation account spanning 30+ markets across Europe, MENA, and Sub-Saharan Africa. In 2027, the account is relocating its core planning engine from London to Paris to work in direct, daily proximity with client leadership. Within this transformed setup, we are hiring an Implementation Planning Associate Director to lead the Luxe division (Lifestyle & Couture). This is the largest and most prestigious portfolio on the account, driving seven of the agency's nine biggest annual brand launches—including iconic houses such as Mugler, Azzaro, Maison Margiela, Ralph Lauren, and YSL Beauty. Sitting in Paris at the client’s table, you will own Luxe planning end-to-end, mentor incoming Planning Managers, and direct our specialized offshore activation desks in Delhi to deliver flawless, high-impact campaigns.   Key Responsibilities

 1. Strategic Media Planning & "Big-Bet" Launch Delivery
  • Own the Luxe Media Blueprint: Architect, review, and sign off full-funnel media plans across 30 markets, ensuring channel mix, audience segmentation, budget allocation, and phasing match L'Oréal's distinct campaign grading tiers.
  • Lead Flagship Product Launches: Deliver the division's seven big-bet H1 launches, translating central creative ideas and brand ambitions into tailored, high-performing local market executions.
  • Full-Funnel & Retail Media Synergy: Integrate digital and offline touchpoints seamlessly, collaborating with the Amazon Ads Director and local commerce specialists to capture luxury e-commerce demand.
2. Directing Activation & Operational Rigour (Delhi Hub)
  • Offshore Leadership: Serve as the primary briefing and delivery authority for our dedicated activation desks in Delhi (Programmatic, Paid Social, and Search).
  • QA & Execution Standards: Establish strict QA workflows, SLAs, and performance benchmarks to continuously reduce error rates, improve trafficking speed, and optimize live pacing.
  • Post-Campaign Excellence: Ensure robust reporting, actionable insight generation, and post-campaign reviews are delivered back to brand teams on time.
3. Client Leadership & Partnership
  • Brand Team Trusted Advisor: Act as the daily, strategic planning partner for Luxe brand directors, divisional marketing leads, and key stakeholders.
  • Presenting & Challenging: Lead client-facing plan presentations, expertly taking feedback, challenging assumptions with data, and setting clear parameters on feasibility and budget trade-offs.
  • Unified Account Front: Collaborate daily with the Implementation Planning Director and the Client Leadership in Paris to ensure consistent, premium client satisfaction.
4. Team Management & Upskilling
  • Line Management: Directly manage and develop the Paris-based Global Planning Managers, training them to take autonomous ownership of Tier 2 campaigns.
  • Cross-Agency Collaboration: Partner closely with peer Associate Director, as well as Strategy, Analytics, and local market WPP teams, to share operational best practices.
What We Are Looking For   Non-Negotiable Requirements
  • 5+ years of digital media planning experience within a media agency, with proven multi-market / international account experience.
  • End-to-End Planning Craft: Demonstrated ability to build sophisticated media plans from scratch: audience sizing, channel selection, cross-market budget splits, flighting, and measurement frameworks.
  • Advanced Data Literacy: Advanced Excel skills and comfort handling multi-currency, multi-market plans.
  • People Leadership: Experience line-managing and developing at least one media planner or executive.
  • Client Command: High level of confidence presenting directly to brand teams, fielding unscripted questions, and negotiating plan revisions.
  • Languages & Location: Fluent English is mandatory. Must be currently based in Paris or actively relocating.
Preferred & Functional Skills
  • Category Affinity: Prior experience planning for Luxury, Fragrance, Beauty, or Fashion brands is a strong advantage.
  • Omnichannel Breadth: Working knowledge of retail media (Amazon Ads, e-retailers) and high-impact offline media formats.
  • Bilingual English / French: Highly beneficial for building fluid daily relationships on-site with Parisian brand managers.
Why Join This Team?
  • Prestige Brand Portfolio: Guide the media voice of globally admired couture and fragrance houses across 30 diverse markets in Europe, MENA, and Sub-Saharan Africa.
  • High-Visibility Paris Seat: Be part of a newly minted central hub in Paris, enjoying direct client exposure while supported by scaled offshore execution desks.
  • Build the Function: Work alongside a newly appointed Director to shape team culture, processes, and delivery standards from day one.
  Life at WPP Media and its Benefits Our commitment to shaping the future of media is manifested by active support for the professional development of our talents, helping them reach their full potential. This approach is accompanied by a responsible vision in our media investment strategies, thus reflecting our dual priority: valuing our employees while adopting sustainable practices in our sector. WPP Media employees have privileged access to WPP Media's and WPP's international networks, allowing them to develop their passions, expand their professional network, and stay at the forefront of innovations in marketing and advertising. We have vast and varied resources available to our employees; our company actively cultivates the inclusion of talents from all backgrounds. The successes and expertise of the teams are regularly highlighted during unifying events that also punctuate key moments of the year, thus strengthening our collaborative and diverse corporate culture. Our benefits include:

title: Associate Principal/Cybersecurity & Incident Response (Forensic Services practice)
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

Learn more about our work by reviewing our Services and Industries on our website.

Position Overview

CRA’s Forensic Services practice supports companies’ commitment to integrity by assisting them and their counsel in independently responding to allegations of fraud, waste, abuse, misconduct, and non-compliance. We are noted for deploying cross-trained teams of forensic professionals to assist our clients in gaining deeper insights and greater value more quickly. We provide accounting and forensic services as well as cybercrime investigation services.

As an experienced leader in the forensic & cyber investigations space, your responsibilities as an Associate Principal may include (but are not limited to):

  • Lead security and privacy investigations for CRA clients, in preparation of, and in response to, data security matters, which may include ongoing breach detection, threat analysis, incident response and malware analysis;
  • Perform forensic analysis of digital information using standard computer forensics and evidence handling techniques and computer forensics tools;
  • Serve as primary point of contact for clients with regard to all incident response activities including malicious code, unauthorized access, and inappropriate usage;
  • Supervise project team execution by leading quality assurance efforts and overseeing work product;
  • Improve the ability of the incident response team to react to incidents by evaluating and implementing new tools and processes;
  • Maintain effective relationships with local, state and federal law enforcement agencies to assist in criminal matters;
  • Create, lead, and maintain leveraged team environment that is positioned for continued success and expansion by actively recruiting and retaining employees, and managing team morale;
  • Participate in and leading business development efforts by building relationships with current and potential clients, drafting and presenting proposals, participating in pitches, and demonstrating firm capabilities to potential clients;
  • Provide technical assessment/audit and guidance to clients on the adequacy of cyber security controls in accordance with cybersecurity frameworks that are included in one or more of the following - NIST CSF 2.0, HIPAA, ISO 27001 and 27002, SOC2, NERC-CIP, 
  • Assist with team recruiting and training efforts as needed;
  • Work at the direction of counsel on investigations.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field is preferred but can be waived with sufficient experience;
  • 7-10+ years’ experience in cyber intrusion investigation, digital forensics or incident response analysis;
  • Ability to effectively lead teams, prioritize multiple projects and meet timely deadlines;
  • Experience in a hands-on technical role functioning as an testifying expert, incident responder, network forensic analyst or malware analyst;
  • Experience leading data analytics engagements and managing the execution of technology-based best practices;
  • Working knowledge of computer hardware components, operating systems, file systems, computer networks, e-mail systems, mobile devices, IT security or incident response;
  • Deep knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, design, traffic flow, protocols, sessions), operating systems (Windows / *nix) and web technologies;
  • Willing and able to travel for client projects.

To Apply

To be considered for a position in the United Kingdom, we require the following:

  • CV/Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Cover letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.

If you are interested in applying for one of our international locations, please visit our Careers site to view and apply for available jobs.

Career Growth and Benefits 

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including a commitment to ongoing formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with research and analysis skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently ask that individuals spend 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to a client's location), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Backend Engineer - Partner Flow
descriptionHtml:
Backend Engineer - Partner Flow Team

Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join the Partner Flow team.

This role is a chance to shape how thousands of small businesses find their way to iwoca. You'll join the team that owns iwoca's partner integrations — the Lending API and embedded flows that let third-party platforms, from major banks to fintechs, offer iwoca loans inside their own customer journeys. You'll own projects, collaborate with stakeholders, and design robust systems to deliver important functionality and measurably improve the experience for our partners and customers.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca partners with a variety of third-party platforms, ranging from large banks and comparison sites to small fintechs that serve SME customers. These partners use iwoca’s Lending API to embed iwoca loans into their own customer journey. Partnerships are an important and fast-growing source of customers for iwoca.

The Partner Flow team builds new features and optimises existing flows to provide the best possible experience for iwoca's partners and the customers they refer to us. The team’s responsibilities include:

  • Continually improving our Lending API and other developer tools, so that partners can integrate with iwoca quickly and easily.

  • Adding new functionality to facilitate deeper integrations and ensure iwoca is the best embedded finance provider on the market.

  • Improving the conversion rate of customers who come to us through partners - streamlining the journey, running RCTs (randomised control trials) and building models alongside our embedded data scientist to find what works.

The team is made up of three engineers, a data scientist plus a team lead, working closely with an internal team of commercial stakeholders. This role is one of two new engineering hires as we grow the team to meet our ambition.

Partner Flow is remote/hybrid-friendly, meeting up for team days in the office once or twice a month, but not on a fixed schedule. They work in an Agile fashion with two-week sprints and a daily standup.

The role

You’ll work on challenging projects all over iwoca’s codebase - anywhere there are improvements to be made for partners and partner-referred customers. You’ll be encouraged to bring your own ideas and take responsibility for areas of functionality.

Autonomy:

  • Own features and projects from scoping and design through to production.

  • Collaborate with other engineers to meet the team’s goals, whilst being trusted to define your own solutions and work independently on your part of the problem.

  • Design and maintain robust, flexible, and maintainable systems to ensure scalability and fast-paced development.

Impact:

  • Deliver new functionality critical to onboarding important new partners.

  • Run experiments (RCTs) and optimise the funnel to measurably improve how partner-referred customers convert.

  • Leave code, docs, and processes in better shape than you found them.

Purpose and product thinking:

  • Work on systems that genuinely help businesses get the funding they need.

  • Collaborate with our partners and internal stakeholders to design effective solutions.

  • Use data to make decisions, uncover insights, and refine strategies.

AI:

  • We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change.

  • We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Experience designing and building scalable back-end systems, ideally in Python.

  • Experience working with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, with an understanding of performance and maintainability considerations.

  • Experience building and maintaining APIs that are easy to use, reliable, and well-documented.

  • Experience managing projects end to end, from understanding business problems to designing and delivering technical solutions.

title: Billing Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is scaling fast – new enterprise customers, new products, new markets. The Billing Operations Specialist is the person who makes sure every deal that closes is reflected correctly in our systems.

This is an operational ownership role, sitting at the intersection of Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Engineering – responsible for the full billing lifecycle of our enterprise accounts, from provisioning a new customer on day one to cleanly closing out a churned account. You'll resolve discrepancies before customers notice them, catch configuration drift before it becomes a revenue problem, and build the processes that make billing feel invisible to everyone else. You'll also work on projects and programs that evolve the sophistication of our billing processes and our tooling, and help with things like pricing migrations and other critical efforts.

The ideal person is someone who is obsessive about accuracy and automation, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and energized (not frustrated) by the complexity of managing billing at scale across thousands of accounts.

Provisioning

  • Translate closed-won deals from Salesforce into correctly configured subscriptions in our billing platforms, such as Stripe – pricing plan, billing interval, contract start date, trial periods, discounts

  • Own the reconciliation between executed order forms and what's been requested for provisioning; work with Sales and Legal to resolve any gaps

  • Partner with Engineering to identify automation opportunities and build guardrails that make provisioning faster and more accurate over time

Subscription & account management

  • Process mid-cycle changes and manage renewal mechanics – upgrades, downgrades, seat changes, plan switches, and so on.

  • Handle offboarding cleanly: close subscriptions, issue final invoices or credits, ensure no residual billing

  • Resolve invoice discrepancies raised by customers or flagged by the Customer Success team – incorrect amounts, missing credits, misapplied discounts

Revenue integrity

  • Run periodic audits of active subscriptions to verify billing matches contracted terms

  • Identify and remediate ghost subscriptions, duplicate customers, and orphaned invoices

  • Support month-end and quarter-end close by reconciling billing platforms with Finance's records

  • Surface pricing or configuration anomalies to relevant teams.

Requirements

Must-have

  • 2-5 years in billing operations, revenue operations, finance operations or a similar role supporting B2B or enterprise customers (adjust the range for level)

  • Hands-on experience with a subscription billing platform, ideally Stripe Billing or similar (Chargebee, Zuora, Recurly), including subscriptions, invoices, credits, coupons and billing intervals

  • Experience turning closed-won deals and order forms into correct billing configurations (pricing plan, start date, trial, discounts)

  • Strong attention to detail and a record of catching discrepancies before customers do

  • Can read a contract or order form and spot gaps against what was requested for provisioning

  • Experience reconciling billing data to finance records, including supporting month-end or quarter-end close

  • Comfort working with Salesforce (or another CRM) as the source of truth for deals

  • Clear written communication and ability to work across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal and Engineering

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and with managing a high volume of accounts without losing track

Strong plus

  • Experience with usage-based or hybrid pricing

  • Familiarity with SQL, spreadsheets at scale (pivots, lookups), or BI tools, for audits and reconciliation

  • Experience building automation or scripts, or partnering with Engineering on guardrails (APIs, webhooks, no-code tools)

  • Experience running subscription audits, such as finding ghost subscriptions, duplicate customers and orphaned invoices

  • Experience with pricing migrations or billing-system migrations

  • Exposure to ASC 606 or revenue recognition basics

  • Experience with a quote-to-cash stack (CPQ, contract management, ERP such as NetSuite)

  • Experience at a high-growth SaaS or AI company

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States or Europe.

title: Business intelligence ontwikkelaar
descriptionHtml:
Data omzetten in inzichten waar onze organisatie echt mee verder kan. Dat is waar jij als business intelligence ontwikkelaar bij HeinenoordZicht Groep voor zorgt. Je bouwt mee aan een toekomstbestendig datawarehouse en draagt bij aan de verdere professionalisering van een recent gefuseerde organisatie. Je denkt actief mee over AI-toepassingen en helpt de organisatie betere beslissingen te nemen op basis van betrouwbare data. Dit doe je vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Den Bosch en vanuit huis.

Jouw baan als business intelligence ontwikkelaar:

Als business intelligence ontwikkelaar werk je op het snijvlak van data, techniek en business. Je beheert en ontwikkelt ons datawarehouse en maakt een vertaling van de informatiestrategie van HeinenoordZicht Groep naar praktische BI-oplossingen. Verder denk je graag gevraagd en ongevraagd mee over mogelijkheden op het gebied van data en hoe je deze het beste voor onze organisatie kunt gebruiken.

Je staat in nauw contact met de business om hun behoeften op te halen als het gaat om informatievoorziening. Je begrijpt als geen ander hoe onze bedrijfsprocessen werken en hoe je deze kunt omzetten naar slimme technische oplossingen en bruikbare stuurinformatie. Met jouw expertise en analytisch inzicht, krijgt de business de juiste informatie aangeleverd om hun klanten uitstekend te bedienen. Bijvoorbeeld in de vorm van rapportages en dashboards.

De functie van business intelligence ontwikkelaar combineert architectuur, ontwikkeling, beheer en advisering. Je werkt samen met gebruikers, projectleiders, management en externe specialisten. title: Business Operations Manager

Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

The Business Operations Manager works directly with the VP of Seller Operations to define, prioritise, and deliver strategic initiatives that improve how Motorway operates, grows, and delivers value to our sellers.

This is a high-impact, dynamic leadership role focused on solving critical operational and commercial problems across the entire seller journey. You will be responsible for defining and managing the implementation of initiatives that improve the end-to-end seller experience, launching new solutions, and optimising existing processes. You will combine deep analytical thinking with robust program management to drive conversion, improve customer experience, reduce operational costs, and increase automation across the business.

title: Cell Culture Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

We're expanding our protein expression into mammalian cell culture, for example in CHO and HEK cells. Our mammalian expression volume is growing fast. We're looking for a Cell Culture Engineer who has spent years growing and transfecting mammalian cells and knows what to do when a run goes wrong.

You'll work alongside our production and mammalian cell teams as a hands-on expert in the cell culture lab. You'll keep cultures healthy and on schedule, run transfections and expressions, and be the person the team turns to when yields drop or cells misbehave. This is a hands-on role, not a management role.

What You'll Do

  • Run mammalian expression. Maintain, expand, and passage cell lines, and run transfections and expressions on a production schedule.

  • Troubleshoot. When viability, growth, or yield falls off, find the cause and fix it.

  • Own the cell bank. Thaw, freeze, and track cell stocks, and protect the lines from contamination and drift.

  • Optimize conditions. Test culture and transfection conditions, and turn what works into the standard protocol.

  • Scale with automation. Work with our automation team to move cell handling onto liquid handlers as volume grows.

  • Hand off clean material. Deliver harvests ready for purification and downstream assays.

  • Keep the lab running. Look after incubators, biosafety cabinets, and cell counters, and keep the BSL-2 space organized and compliant.

  • Write SOPs and train. Document protocols that others can follow, and train the team on aseptic technique and our cell culture workflows.

What We're Looking For

  • Extensive hands-on experience with common mammalian model cell lines, for example CHO and HEK, including transfection and expression.

  • BSc / MSc in biotechnology, cell biology, or a relevant field.

  • A troubleshooting track record. You've rescued failing cultures and expressions and can explain what went wrong and why.

  • Flawless aseptic technique and experience working under BSL-2 conditions.

  • Experience with high-throughput formats: multi-well plates and many conditions in parallel, not only flasks.

  • Experience with liquid handlers is a plus.

  • Experience with antibody or Fc-fusion production is a plus.

  • Organized and precise. You track every stock, passage, and transfection, and you follow protocols exactly.

  • You use AI tools effectively and with discernment. We use them across the company and expect you to check, edit, and stand behind what they produce, not pass along unreviewed output.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift. Cells don't keep office hours, so you plan around them.

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

Vos missions

Créer et développer le marché du pôle

  • Construire la cartographie du marché : groupes hôteliers, chaînes, hôtels indépendants haut de gamme, résidences de tourisme, spas, centres wellness, entreprises souhaitant équiper leurs locaux.
  • Identifier les décideurs réels : direction générale, direction technique, direction des opérations, asset managers, responsables de l'expérience client.
  • Aller chercher les projets par prospection directe, LinkedIn, réseau personnel, salons et recommandations.
  • Contribuer à la construction de l'offre du pôle : arguments, références, cas d'usage.

Développer les partenariats et la prescription — le levier le plus puissant du poste

  • Identifier, approcher et signer des partenariats avec les prescripteurs du marché : architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, bureaux d'études, équipementiers wellness et spa, groupes et franchises.
  • Construire des accords donnant-donnant, où KT Groupe apporte des marchés à ses partenaires et réciproquement.
  • Faire référencer KT Groupe comme constructeur et aménageur auprès des partenaires.
  • Entretenir la relation dans la durée : un partenariat signé et non animé ne produit rien.

Conduire le cycle de vente de bout en bout

  • Qualifier les demandes entrantes et les opportunités sortantes, mener la découverte, préparer les briefs de chiffrage pour la direction technique.
  • Présenter la proposition, négocier et signer.
  • Rester l'interlocuteur unique du premier contact jusqu'à la signature — un principe de maison chez KT Groupe.

Préparer et exploiter les salons

  • Constituer en amont le pipeline de rendez-vous du salon Meeting Hôtellerie de mars 2027.
  • Assurer un suivi post-salon aussi rigoureux que la préparation.

Tenir la rigueur commerciale

  • Tenir le CRM à jour, réagir vite aux demandes entrantes, participer à la réunion commerciale hebdomadaire.
  • Documenter vos process au fur et à mesure, pour permettre la délégation future.

Vos compétences

Nous n'attendons pas un CV type. Trois chemins peuvent mener à ce poste, et nous arbitrerons en fonction des candidatures reçues :

  • Confirmé du secteur — hôtellerie, spa, wellness, équipement hôtelier, agencement d'hôtels. Vous apportez un carnet d'adresses immédiatement activable.
  • Confirmé B2B, autre secteur — vente de projets à panier élevé (BTP, agencement, mobilier professionnel, équipement, retail, énergie). Vous apportez une méthode de vente éprouvée sur cycle long et une culture du chiffre.
  • Junior à fort potentiel — deux à trois ans d'expérience commerciale, forte envie, pas encore le réseau. Vous apportez de l'énergie et une capacité à vous former sans habitudes à défaire.

Le socle commun, non négociable

  • Vente B2B de projets à cycle long et à panier élevé, à partir de 150 000 €.
  • Capacité à ouvrir un compte à froid, sans lead entrant et sans introduction.
  • Aptitude à lire un besoin d'aménagement, comprendre un plan et dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs techniques.
  • Rigueur dans la tenue d'un CRM et dans le suivi des engagements pris.
  • Qualité de l'écrit professionnel : une proposition mal écrite décrédibilise un projet à 200 000 €.
  • Anglais professionnel apprécié ; permis B et disponibilité pour des déplacements réguliers.

Votre savoir-être

  • Le goût de la chasse : vous ne dépendez pas des leads qu'on vous donne.
  • Une posture de conseil : vous aidez un investisseur à réussir un projet, vous ne vendez pas des travaux.
  • De l'exigence et de la fiabilité : ce que vous annoncez, vous le tenez.
  • De la tenue dans la durée : un cycle de vente de 3 à 4 mois demande de la constance.
  • Une ambition assumée : la part variable est déplafonnée, elle est faite pour ceux qui veulent aller la chercher.

Avantages

Une rémunération pensée pour la performance

Le principe est simple et assumé : un fixe qui sécurise, un variable sans plafond qui récompense la performance réelle.

  • Un fixe mensuel selon expérience et valeur apportée.
  • Une prime versée à la signature de chaque projet de construction ou de rénovation, proportionnelle et non plafonnée.
  • Une prime à la signature d'un partenariat structurant, franchise ou groupe.
  • Une commission sur les marchés que vous apportez, selon les règles en vigueur dans l'entreprise.

Le fixe couvre vos besoins. Le variable, lui, n'a pas de plafond : une personne performante gagne significativement plus que son fixe.

Des moyens et un vrai accompagnement

  • Ordinateur, téléphone, accès CRM, outils de prospection, budget de déplacement, participation aux salons professionnels.
  • Une formation interne : méthode commerciale propriétaire, formation à l'équipement sportif et à l'agencement par le pôle fitness, immersion chantier.
  • Un plan d'intégration structuré sur 90 jours (immersion, structuration, transformation, pilotage), avec des points de situation réguliers avec la direction.
  • Une évolution possible vers responsable du développement du pôle, dès lors qu'une équipe se constitue sous votre responsabilité.

Notre état d'esprit

Chez KT Groupe, la transparence n'est pas affichée, elle est pratiquée : on dit les choses, y compris quand elles sont difficiles, les chiffres sont partagés. On ne compte pas ses efforts quand un projet est en jeu — et on ne compte pas non plus la reconnaissance. Le niveau d'exigence est élevé sur la qualité livrée, chacun assume ses sujets jusqu'au bout, les décisions se prennent vite. On va sur les chantiers, on voit les sites, on rencontre les clients : rien ne se décide uniquement depuis un bureau.

Ce poste n'est pas un poste confortable. Le marché est entièrement à créer, et le premier semestre demande une vraie tolérance à l'incertitude : pas de portefeuille, pas de leads fournis, un rythme de montée en puissance qui dépend largement de vous. Pendant la phase de démarrage du pôle, vous apporterez aussi un renfort ponctuel et cadré dans le temps sur la qualification téléphonique des demandes entrantes du pôle fitness — sans que cela remette en cause votre responsabilité pleine sur votre propre pôle.

Si vous cherchez la sécurité d'un portefeuille existant, ce poste n'est pas pour vous. Si vous voulez construire quelque chose et être payé à la hauteur de ce que vous construisez, la suite est pour vous.

title: Clinic Area Lead, North & Midlands
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne.

In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave.

As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care.

Role Purpose

As the Clinic Area Lead, you will be accountable for bringing Neko Health’s operating model, culture, and member first standards to life across an existing portfolio of clinics in Birmingham and Manchester, as well as future clinics outside of London.

This role sits at the intersection of leadership, execution, and local adaptation, ensuring that global ways of working translate into consistently high quality experiences on the ground, while continuing to mature and evolve as we scale.

Reporting to the Country Manager, UK, you will own regional performance end to end, from new site readiness through sustained multi-site operations. You will act as the cultural and operational anchor for Neko Health in Birmingham and Manchester, setting expectations, building capability, and reinforcing how clinics lead, operate, and serve members.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Continue embedding Neko Health’s operating model across the Birmingham and Manchester clinics, focusing on strong leadership behaviours, cultural norms, and consistent execution rather than net-new process design. Ensure global standards are understood, embraced and brought to life in day-to-day clinic operations.

  • Lead the successful local adoption of existing playbooks and standards, tailoring them thoughtfully to local regulations, team dynamics, and member expectations while preserving the integrity of Neko’s global member experience.

  • Create strong clinic level leadership capability by coaching managers and clinical leads on how to translate standards into practice: setting clear expectations, reinforcing accountability, and role modelling a member first mindset.

  • Establish clear performance rhythms (metrics, reviews, feedback loops) that reinforce behaviours, surface issues early, and continuously improve both team effectiveness and the member experience.

  • Partner closely with the Country Manager, UK and central teams to ensure the global operating model works in practice locally, identifying where light adaptation is required and driving disciplined, high quality implementation at scale.

Clinic & Member Experience

  • Ensure each clinic consistently delivers a seamless, premium member experience aligned with Neko Health's service standards and brand promise.

  • Lead regional initiatives to elevate service quality based on member feedback, NPS insights, and frontline observations, iterating playbooks in real time as you learn.

  • Foster a hospitality-driven culture where empathy, professionalism, and precision define every member interaction, and where that culture is embedded through training, not just expectation.

  • Oversee the physical and experiential standards of all clinics, ensuring consistency in ambiance, cleanliness, and overall presentation across a growing portfolio.

Medical Quality & Compliance

  • Partner with Clinic Leads and Quality team to build and uphold Neko's clinical quality standards in the UK context, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements from the ground up.

  • Drive continuous improvement in medical delivery and inspection readiness across all sites, establishing audit-ready documentation and escalation protocols.

  • Serve as the bridge between clinic operations and the Medical Excellence team, ensuring best practices are embedded regionally through structured processes rather than informal norms.

Operational & Financial Performance

  • Own regional operational KPIs and full P&L accountability, and continue building the financial frameworks alongside the clinics themselves.

  • Oversee workforce planning and staffing models in collaboration with central teams, building hiring profiles, ramp plans, and scheduling logic suited to Birmingham and Manchester’s demand patterns.

  • Contribute to regional business strategy, including network optimisation, market expansion planning, and new clinic launches.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Recruit, onboard, lead, and coach a team of Clinic Leads and Lead Operators across all assigned clinics.

  • Build a strong culture of accountability, communication, and collaboration across distributed teams from day one, establishing the norms and rituals that will define how the Birmingham and Manchester team works.

  • Act as the primary regional liaison between clinic teams and central functions, including Customer Support, Facilities, Workforce Planning, People Operations, Talent Acquisition, and Demand Planning.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience in a senior operational leadership role (Area Director, Regional Director, District Leader, General Manager or equivalent) within a premium, consumer facing, multi-site environment such as premium healthcare adjacent, wellness, fitness or technology enabled services with physical operations/stores.

  • Demonstrated success implementing and embedding established operating models, standards, and playbooks across multiple locations, driving adoption through leadership, coaching, and accountability rather than documentation alone.

  • Strong track record leading clinic level or site level leaders, with the ability to build capability, reinforce culture, and translate standards into consistent day to day execution.

  • Proven financial and operational acumen, including ownership of regional KPIs, budgets, and P&L performance in a scaling context.

  • Ability to balance strategic perspective with hands on execution, particularly during periods of growth, new site openings, and organisational change.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence operating in a matrixed, fast moving organisation across central and regional teams.

  • Comfort leading through ambiguity and change, with a bias toward action, continuous improvement, and disciplined execution.

  • Ability to be based onsite in Birmingham and Manchester clinics 4 days a week, including regular travel between Manchester and Birmingham as well as any future clinic locations across the UK that are added to your remit.

About titles at Neko

We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so the title on this posting may differ from your internal title. We’ll be open about the scope and level of the role throughout the process, so you know exactly what you’d be taking on.
