title: Director, Strategic Growth Sales (Financial Services)
descriptionHtml:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About The Role

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, driven, and accomplished Strategic Account Sales Director, focused on developing and executing an enterprise growth strategy across EMEA, in partnership with a global sales team devoted to our largest global client relationships in the Financial Services market. This role is responsible for hiring, managing and developing the Strategic AEs in EMEA that will be selling to our Strategic Clients across the region. 

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of relevant sales experience with a B2B SaaS solutions and a customer network in the Financial Services market (buy side and sell side). 5+ years of prior management experience. You understand the nuances of the EMEA market for Financial Services.
  • Proven leader. You are someone who inspires confidence and motivates both internal teams and clients to drive towards common goals.
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales targets as a seller, and a proven track record of managing teams that exceed sales targets; we maintain a team of top sales performers and a great winning culture. Reputation for consistently delivering results and setting the example for work ethic, initiative, enthusiasm, and commitment.
  • Excellent at building C Level and Senior business relationships with clients. You build trust and credibility with key stakeholders, decision-makers and influencers and are focused on creating long term partnerships with the client.
  • Strong Consultative Selling skills. Ability to listen actively, ask insightful questions, and uncover the real needs of the client, becoming a trusted partner. Use your knowledge of the industry, competitive environment, and client experiences to identify trends and stay ahead of customer needs.
  • Manage the EMEA Team to Success. You will steer the EMEA team members, who are responsible for coordinating with their Strategic Lead, as well as NAMER and APAC counterparts, towards a common goal. You are responsible for ensuring they hit their revenue targets and KPIs.
  • Tailored management approach across different sellers with different levels of experience. You will flex your skills to match what is required for each individual and situation.
  • Stay connected to the Sr. Directors and Strategic Leads to make sure you are operating with the same expectations, helping your reports with the execution of their broader goals and strategies for the local segments of their accounts. You are a the regional expert on these accounts and thought partner in setting the strategy.
  • Oversee a long term account strategy, with short and medium term execution plans, layering a transactional sales motion with an enterprise mindset and focus. Guide the team to where each one of these selling motions is most appropriate.
  • Partner with cross functional leaders across Global Customer Success, Sales Development and Product Specialist teams to deliver strong growth across a defined client base.
  • Strong ability to develop rapport with new people, and to maintain relationships, combined with a positive, outgoing personality.
  • Outstanding communicator, whether in presentations or casual conversations, and can convey value propositions clearly across all levels of an organization.
  • Able to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms.
  • Able to travel to clients on a regular basis.

What You'll Do

  • You are the CEO of your business, managing an EMEA team aligned to our Global Strategic clients, which include firms in public and private markets across the buy and sell side. EMEA will partner with Pod Members in APAC and NAMER to achieve a common goal, driving deals forward and delivering on a shared revenue target.
  • Sell with your team. You are the Regional Manager, elevating the sales dialogue and strategy with C-Level peers across our clients.
  • Develop strong internal relationships, garnering buy in from those you partner with and marshaling resources to deliver on revenue outcomes.
  • Coordinate with your team to forecast accurately and develop the necessary pipeline to meet and exceed goals.
  • Partner closely with our marketing team to expand brand awareness.
  • Work closely with our Customer Success team to ensure client engagement.
  • Communicate insights on the EMEA market and client product needs to sales, product management, content, and product marketing to help us continually enhance our products.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Einkauf Werkstudent (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und knapp

Als Online-Supermarkt ist das Herzstück unseres Businesses natürlich die Picnic App. Das Einkauf Team sorgt dafür, dass unsere digitalen Regale in allen 6 Regionen perfekt mit lokalen Produkten ausgestattet sind.

Als WerkstudentIn bist du das operative Rückgrat unseres Teams. Mit logischem Denken und smarten Automatisierungstools machst du unsere Prozesse jeden Tag ein Stückchen besser. Du arbeitest eng mit Category, Brand und cross-funktionalen Teams zusammen, um Lieferengpässe zu lösen, Daten zu checken und dafür zu sorgen, dass unsere App für die KundInnen immer perfekt gepflegt ist.

Das erwartet dich

  • Artikelerstellung & Onboarding: Du übernimmst die Anlage und Erstellung neuer Produkte im System und stellst sicher, dass alle notwendigen Informationen vom ersten Tag an korrekt und für unsere KundInnen bereit sind.
  • Tool-Support & Validierung: Du begleitest die Einführung und Nutzung unseres neuen Automatisierungstools. Als wichtige Instanz für die Qualitätskontrolle hinterfragst du Prozesse kritisch und stellst sicher, dass die Systemausgaben korrekt sind. 
  • Produkt-Performance-Monitoring: Du behältst Verkaufs- und Bestandsanomalien genau im Auge. Wenn ein Top-Priority-Artikel sich nicht verkauft oder als nicht verfügbar angezeigt wird, tauchst du ins System ein, um die Ursache zu finden, damit unsere digitalen Regale immer den maximalen Umsatz erzielen.
  • Content- & Storefront-Optimierung: Wenn unvollständige Produktpräsentationen den Verkauf hemmen, reagierst du schnell und taktisch – z. B. durch das schnelle Beheben von fehlenden Produktfotos oder unvollständigen Artikelinfos in der App.
  • Lieferkette & Inbound-Abstimmung: Du unterstützt das Team bei täglichen kommerziellen Fragen zur Lieferkette und klärst Probleme bei der Produktanlieferung, um einen reibungslosen Ablauf in deinen Kategorien zu garantieren.
  • Teamarbeit: Du bietest starke operative Unterstützung über verschiedene Prioritätsstufen hinweg und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit dem gesamten Category-Team, um die täglichen Aufgaben optimal zu balancieren.

Das bringst du mit

  • Fortgeschrittenes Bachelorstudium oder aktuell im Master in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, E-Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Volkswirtschaftslehre oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • Ein scharfes Auge fürs Detail, starkes logisches Denkvermögen und eine natürliche Neugier, um hinter die Kulissen zu blicken und operative Rätsel zu lösen.
  • Exzellente organisatorische Fähigkeiten, eine proaktive Einstellung zur Übernahme von Verantwortung und Routine im Umgang mit täglichen Arbeitsabläufen.
  • Eine echte Affinität für die Lebensmittelbranche und Begeisterung für die Arbeit mit neuer Software Systemen.
  • Zeit, unser Team für 16 - 20 Stunden pro Woche zu unterstützen.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte mit uns durch: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Verpflegung: Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittagessen in unserem Büro, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Ein moderner Workspace: Unser neu renoviertes Büro ist auf Zusammenarbeit ausgelegt und bietet dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie 30 Urlaubstage (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche).
  • Wohlbefinden & Gleichgewicht: Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp. Und dank unseres hundefreundlichen Büros ist dein vierbeiniger Begleiter nach Absprache willkommen.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit - inklusive Laptop sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und unsere Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Als WerkstudentIn verdienst du 14,75 €/Std. (Bachelor) bzw. 15,50 €/Std. (Master) und sammelst spannende Praxiserfahrung.

Schick uns deine Bewerbung gern auf Englisch, wenn du schon eine englische Version parat hast.

title: Elektriker (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Chipindustrie – von Anfang an!

Deine Rolle bei Black Semiconductor

Bei Black Semiconductor entwickeln wir eine neue Generation der Halbleitertechnologie. Mit unserer ersten Produktionsanlage FabOne in Aachen schaffen wir die Grundlage für die Chipfertigung der Zukunft.

Dafür suchen wir dich! Als Elektriker*in wirst du Teil unseres Facility-Teams und unterstützt den Aufbau, die Inbetriebnahme und den Betrieb der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau, Installation und Inbetriebnahme der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage.

  • Wartung, Prüfung und Instandhaltung elektrischer Anlagen und Niederspannungssysteme.

  • Fehlersuche und Störungsbehebung an elektrischen Installationen und Steuerstromkreisen.

  • Lesen und Interpretieren von Stromlauf-, Schalt- und Verdrahtungsplänen.

  • Mitarbeit bei der Inbetriebnahme und Weiterentwicklung unserer Gebäudeautomation (FMCS), einschließlich Steuerungs- und Visualisierungssystemen.

  • Koordination und Unterstützung externer Elektrofachfirmen sowie Sicherstellung einer fachgerechten und sicheren Ausführung.

  • Unterstützung bei elektrischen Prüfungen, technischer Dokumentation und Materialbeschaffung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Energie- und Gebäudetechnik oder eine vergleichbare elektrotechnische Qualifikation.

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Elektroinstallation, Instandhaltung oder Betriebstechnik.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in der Elektrotechnik und Freude an praktischer Fehlersuche und Problemlösung.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Stromlauf- und Schaltplänen.

  • Grundkenntnisse der relevanten elektrotechnischen Vorschriften und Sicherheitsbestimmungen.

  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team.

  • Sehr Gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Unsere Arbeitskultur

Menschen stehen über Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität entscheidend. Wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst – und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance ein, in der berufliche Aufgaben sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind auf den Menschen ausgerichtet und ermöglichen es dir, dich auf das Wesentliche zu konzentrieren.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial steht für uns an erster Stelle. Wir bieten dir die Freiheit und Eigenverantwortung, nachhaltige Veränderungen zu bewirken, und fördern deine Entwicklung durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in deine berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Dein Wohlbefinden hat für uns höchste Priorität. Wir bieten dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit hervorragenden Versicherungsleistungen, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge und virtuellen Aktienoptionen – für deine mentale, körperliche und finanzielle Gesundheit. Deine Sicherheit und Zufriedenheit liegen uns heute und in Zukunft am Herzen.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion bilden die Grundpfeiler unserer Unternehmenskultur. Wir fördern Offenheit und schaffen ein Umfeld, das von Vertrauen und gegenseitigem Respekt geprägt ist. Individualität ist unsere gemeinsame Stärke und treibt Innovation und Fortschritt voran.

Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen qualifizierter Menschen unabhängig von ihrer Herkunft und ihrem persönlichen Hintergrund. Wir schaffen ein inklusives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und persönliche Entwicklung großgeschrieben werden. Werde Teil unseres Unternehmens und gestalte mit uns den Wandel in der Halbleiterindustrie.

title: Embedded Automotive Platforms, Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Production Software sits within Vehicle SW Engineering and builds the core software infrastructure that lets self-driving models interface with vehicles, be tested, and run safely in production. As part of a team restructure, this role is a high-impact opportunity to help define foundational components and engineering practices as the team scales to roughly 5–6 engineers. You will work on mission-critical, performance-sensitive systems that sit between advanced ML models and embedded/vehicle platforms, with the opportunity to specialise in mapping/navigation, filtering/diagnostics, or control/inference while still collaborating across domains.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Build and maintain core C++/Python software components that interface with autonomy models and vehicle/embedded systems.

  • Develop infrastructure to communicate with, run, and test self-driving capabilities, separate from ML model development.

  • Own reliability and performance of key systems across Linux-based environments, and contribute to tooling and diagnostics for testing and validation.

  • Partner with the wider org, distributed across London, Israel, and the US, to integrate changes and support releases.

  • Depending on the specific role, focus primarily on one domain area: localisation/navigation/mapping, filtering/diagnostics, or control/inference.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Design, build, and maintain core C++/Python software components that interface self-driving models with vehicle and embedded systems.

  • Build and run infrastructure to communicate with, run, and test self-driving capabilities, kept separate from ML model development itself.

  • Own the reliability and performance of key systems across Linux-based environments, and build tooling and diagnostics for testing and validation.

  • Partner with the wider org, distributed across London, Israel, and the US, to integrate changes, resolve cross-team issues, and support releases.

  • Specialise in one domain area, depending on the role, such as localisation/navigation/mapping, filtering/diagnostics, or control/inference, while

 

🙌 You should apply if

  • Exceptional C++ proficiency, with a track record of writing performance-sensitive, production-quality code.

  • Strong Python skills for tooling, integration, and/or test infrastructure.

  • Solid Linux experience, including development, debugging, and operating in Linux environments.

  • Embedded systems familiarity, with experience interfacing software with hardware or vehicle systems.

  • Automotive experience is a strong plus, but not required.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Programming and hiring manager interview; 1.5 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Systems & domain-specific interviews; 3 hours total)

  • Final interview: Mission & values alignment (45 mins).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Embedded Software Engineer – Wireless Systems
descriptionHtml:
You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure – ultimately saving the lives of thousands?

You want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems?

Join CDDS to push the limits of wireless communication and build dependable connectivity for our next-generation counter-drone systems.

CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones (Mavics, FPV racers and fast fixed wings). Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while effectively countering unauthorized or threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments.

Tasks

You mission

We are looking for an exceptional Embedded Software Engineer – Wireless Systems to take ownership of the software connecting our ground stations and drone platforms.

Our requirements go beyond what standard radio products offer. You will dig into existing software and firmware, understand the assumptions behind their design, and rework them to meet our needs. This requires someone who can navigate unfamiliar code, reason across software and hardware boundaries, and turn elusive failures into understood, tested solutions.

You will work closely with our RF/electrical and software engineers, with the autonomy to make architectural decisions and the responsibility to prove them in the field. We are looking for technical depth, curiosity, and the persistence to follow a problem through - from its first symptom to a reliable fix.

Core Responsibilities

  • Investigate, modify, and extend existing radio software and firmware beyond their standard functionality.

  • Develop and maintain embedded communication software across ground stations, radio equipment, and onboard systems.

  • Diagnose complex failures across firmware, networking, operating systems, and hardware interfaces, working closely with our RF/electrical engineer.

  • Improve communication reliability, latency, throughput, connection establishment, and recovery from interruptions.

  • Build diagnostic tools, logging, and automated tests that make failures reproducible and improvements measurable.

  • Own software integration and validation, from controlled lab experiments to real-world field testing.

  • Maintain our modifications to supplier code, document architectural decisions, and work with suppliers to resolve platform limitations.

Requirements

Your Profile

You combine strong software fundamentals with hands-on engineering judgment. You are comfortable working with incomplete documentation, questioning existing implementations, and designing experiments to establish why a system fails.

  • Strong professional experience developing and debugging embedded software in C and/or C++.

  • Demonstrated ability to understand and substantially modify complex existing codebases, such as vendor firmware, drivers, or communication stacks.

  • Hands-on experience with embedded Linux and/or RTOS-based systems.

  • Strong understanding of networking and communication protocols, including IP and serial interfaces.

  • Experience investigating concurrency, timing, buffering, and resource constraints in embedded systems.

  • A systematic approach to debugging, using tools such as debuggers, packet captures, and runtime traces.

  • Proficiency in Python for diagnostics, tooling, and test automation.

  • Ability to take ownership of an open-ended technical problem and carry it through implementation, testing, and field validation.

  • MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated engineering experience.

Nice-to-Have

  • 5 years experience developing or adapting software for wireless communication systems or radio modems.

  • Experience with networking (routing, bridging, filtering) and Linux administration.

  • Familiarity with flight controller firmware (e.g. PX4, ArduPilot, Betaflight, iNav) and communication protocols (e.g. uXRCE-DDS, MAVLink, MSP).

Benefits

Why CDDS

  • Direct impact on a mission-critical technology shaping Europe’s security landscape.

  • Fast-moving startup environment with high ownership and substantial technical responsibility.

  • Work with a highly technical, ambitious, and hands-on team.

  • Real-world testing, deployments, and customer demonstrations.

  • Attractive compensation.

Details

Location: Zürich Hardbrücke, on-site
Start date: ASAP
Environment: High-impact deep-tech startup working on real deployments

If you are interested in the position, please apply via the application form.

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The role

We’re hiring a Security Engineering Lead to build and lead our security engineering team, reporting to the Head of Platform.

You’ll manage engineers working across product and platform security, set a clear direction for the function and help us grow our product security capability. You’ll join a small team with both specialisms already represented and shape how it develops.

Our product security engineers work alongside Product Engineering teams, contributing to planning, design, code and delivery. They report to you for technical development, performance and career progression. You’ll stay close enough to their work to support them well, even when you are not part of their day-to-day team.

You’ll bring experience as a security engineer and as a people manager. You should be able to challenge a design, reason through a threat model and help an engineer find a practical solution. You’ll also need to make choices about where we invest, build relationships across engineering and explain security priorities in terms of customer and business risk.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop our product and platform security engineers through regular feedback, coaching, clear expectations and fair performance assessment.

  • Build a focused security engineering strategy and roadmap, informed by our products, engineering plans and the risks that matter most.

  • Grow the team thoughtfully, identifying capability gaps and taking responsibility for hiring and onboarding.

  • Agree sustained product security placements with engineering leaders, with clear priorities, useful feedback and a strong connection to the security team.

  • Help teams build security into architecture and implementation, including access control, tenant isolation, confidential data handling and AI systems.

  • Work with Platform Engineering to make secure infrastructure and delivery practices easy to adopt, using shared controls and automation where they help.

  • Stay involved in important technical decisions through design and code reviews, investigations and selective implementation.

  • Help engineers raise concerns and resolve disagreements constructively. Make material risks and trade-offs clear to the leaders accountable for the decision.

  • Partner with IT and Information Security on shared risks, incident response and assurance requirements.

  • Measure whether our approach reduces meaningful risk and helps engineers deliver securely. Use what we learn to improve it.


What we’re looking for

  • A background in hands-on security engineering, with strong product or application security experience.

  • Demonstrated line management experience: developing engineers, giving difficult feedback, assessing performance and supporting career progression.

  • Experience supporting engineers whose daily work happens within other teams, or comparable evidence of managing effectively without observing all their work directly.

  • Current technical judgement across secure software design, threat modelling, authentication, authorisation and protection of sensitive data.

  • Enough cloud and platform security breadth to guide specialists and make sound decisions across both areas.

  • Experience setting priorities and securing support for security improvements across engineering teams.

  • The ability to explain risk clearly, offer workable options and make proportionate recommendations under uncertainty.

  • A collaborative approach that helps product and platform engineers own the security of the systems they build.

You should be comfortable reading and reviewing production code and discussing implementation choices. The role combines technical leadership with people management and responsibility for building the function.


Useful experience

  • Working with AWS, backend services, infrastructure as code and automated delivery.

  • Securing multi-tenant products, confidential customer data or AI-enabled systems.

  • Building or improving a small security engineering team in a growing organisation.

  • Introducing secure patterns or tooling that engineers adopted and continued to use.

We value evidence of sound judgement and useful outcomes. You do not need experience with every technology we use.

What success looks like

During your first months, you’ll understand the team’s strengths, our main risks and how security work gets done. You’ll agree development plans with the engineers and establish clear working relationships with Product Engineering, Platform and Information Security.

Over the following months, you’ll put a prioritised roadmap and a workable embedded model in place. Teams should involve security earlier in important decisions, engineers should have useful technical support, and the highest-priority improvements should have clear owners and delivery capacity.

As the function grows, we’ll look for evidence of better protection for customers, adoption of secure engineering practices and a team whose engineers are developing in their roles.

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Engineering Manager (w/m/d) Robotics Tooling
descriptionHtml:
Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in einem Team, das das gesamte Tooling-Ökosystem verantwortet, mit dem unsere Jungheinrich Robotics Lösungen über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg implementiert, betrieben, unterstützt und kontinuierlich verbessert werden. Von der Inbetriebnahme eines Fahrzeugs vor Ort bis hin zur Ferndiagnose von Problemen einer gesamten Flotte stellst du gemeinsam mit deinem Team sicher, dass unsere Robotiksysteme über alle Robotikprodukte und zukünftigen Fahrzeuggenerationen hinweg effizient und skalierbar ausgeliefert, betrieben und unterstützt werden können.

Du arbeitest dabei in drei zentralen Bereichen:

  • Du entwickelst unser Onsite Tooling weiter und ermöglichst damit eine effiziente Implementierung, Inbetriebnahme und Durchführung von Serviceaktivitäten über unser HMI und unseren Environment Editor.
  • Du entwickelst unser Remote Tooling als Teil unserer Robotics Cloud weiter und ermöglichst damit Diagnose, Flottenmanagement, Monitoring und Support aus der Ferne.
  • Du gestaltest unsere Remote-Access-Lösungen und stellst einen sicheren und skalierbaren Zugriff auf unsere Robotiksysteme sicher, wann immer dieser erforderlich ist.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Product Manager für Robotics Tooling zusammen. Während der Product Manager den Fokus stärker auf das Was und Warum legt, ergänzt du diese Perspektive um das Wie und Wann.

  • Du verantwortest die technische Ausrichtung unseres Toolings, das eine schnelle Implementierung, effiziente Serviceprozesse, den Flottenbetrieb, Ferndiagnosen und eine hohe Systemverfügbarkeit ermöglicht
  • Du gestaltest ein skalierbares Tooling-Ökosystem, das über verschiedene Roboterfamilien, Kundeninstallationen und Supportorganisationen hinweg eingesetzt werden kann
  • Du führst und entwickelst ein Team aus internen und externen Software Engineers und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem sich Mitarbeitende weiterentwickeln, erfolgreich arbeiten und wirkungsvolle Lösungen liefern können
  • Du definierst, steuerst und verfolgst gemeinsam mit dem Product Manager die vereinbarte Roadmap und stellst deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung sicher
  • Du baust starke Partnerschaften mit Product Management, Vehicle Engineering, Service, Operations und IT auf, um ein integriertes Tooling-Ökosystem zu realisieren
  • Du verbesserst kontinuierlich die User Experience für Inbetriebnahme- und Servicetechniker:innen, Supportteams und unsere Kunden
  • Du gestaltest die Strategie und Umsetzung sicherer Remote-Access-Lösungen und bringst dabei betriebliche Effizienz, Sicherheitsanforderungen und Kundenbedürfnisse in Einklang
  • Du förderst die Weiterentwicklung und Leistungsfähigkeit deines Teams durch Engagement, Coaching, individuelle Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung
  • Du treibst Engineering Excellence durch agile Arbeitsweisen, qualitativ hochwertige Softwareentwicklung und moderne Engineering-Standards voran

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Führung von Software-Engineering-Teams in agilen Produktentwicklungsumgebungen mit.
  • Du verfügst über einen starken Software-Engineering-Hintergrund und praktische technische Erfahrung.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Coaching von Engineers mit und unterstützt sie aktiv in ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung in den Bereichen Robotik, Automatisierung, Embedded Systems oder vergleichbaren technischen Bereichen mit.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Frontend-Anwendungen und nutzerorientierter Software.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und wirkungsvoll und bringst unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf gemeinsame Ziele zusammen.
  • Du begeisterst dich dafür, reale Herausforderungen mithilfe von Technologie zu lösen.
  • Du arbeitest überwiegend vor Ort, weshalb du idealerweise in München oder der näheren Umgebung wohnst.
  • Das ist ein Plus:
    • Du bringst Erfahrung mit Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI) mit.
    • Du kennst die Abläufe rund um die Implementierung, den Service oder den Betrieb von Robotern.
    • Du bringst Erfahrung mit Monitoring-, Observability- oder Remote-Diagnostics-Lösungen mit.
    • Du kennst dich mit Networking, Infrastruktur, Security oder Remote-Access-Konzepten aus.
    • Du bringst Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden oder operativen Teams im Feld mit.

Was wir bieten

  • Spitzentechnologie: Als Pioniere der Robotik sind wir in der Lage, ohne Schienen und Leitlinien zu navigieren und zu manipulieren, und bieten Lösungen für Prozesse, die noch nie jemand zuvor automatisieren konnte!
  • Team: Wir sind ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten. Du wirst in einem Team mit sehr smarten, bescheidenen, kooperativen und fleißigen Menschen arbeiten.
  • Kultur: Sei einfach Du selbst! Werde Teil eines dynamischen, innovativenund vielfältigen Teams, das Zusammenarbeit über Hierarchie stellt. Um innovativ zu sein, muss man ab und zu scheitern – wir lernen und verbessern uns ständig.
  • Arbeitsplatz: Unser Büro befindet sich in der Nähe der S‑Bahn-Station „Hirschgarten“. Wir arbeiten in einem Büro im Loft-Stil mit toller Ausstattung, eigener Werkstatt und Testbereich.
  • Vollverpflegung: Du hast keine Lust, darüber nachzudenken, was du morgen zu Mittag essen willst, geschweige denn, es vorzubereiten? Zum Glück verwöhnt uns unser französischer Koch jeden Tag mit einem frisch gekochten kostenlosen Mittagessen! Und als Sahnehäubchen gibt es einen gefüllten Kühlschrank mit Getränken, frischem Obst und natürlich Kaffee!
  • Flexibilitä t: Flexibilität wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Unser hybrides Arbeitsmodell für Positionen, bei denen Anwesenheit verzichtbar ist, trägt zu einer gesunden Work-Life-Balance bei.
  • Benefits: Wir bieten attraktive Urlaubs‑, Wellpass‑,Gesundheits- und Vergütungsleistungen. Erfahre hier mehr über unsere aktuellen Benefits.

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 %? Kein Problem. Wir wissen, dass die besten Talente nicht immer jeden Punkt einer Stellenanzeige mitbringen. Wenn Du Dich für Robotik begeisterst und die Zukunft der Automatisierung mitgestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht ist genau diese Position der richtige nächste Schritt für Dich oder eine andere spannende Gelegenheit bei Jungheinrich Robotics.

Für uns bei Jungheinrich Robotics ist die Förderung der Inklusion sehr wichtig. Wir sind daher bestrebt, ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Kandidaten zu schaffen und bieten allen qualifizierten Bewerbern unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Alter, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Kultur oder Bildung gleiche Chancen. Wenn Du gewisse Anpassungen benötigst, um den Rekruitingprozess für Dich zugänglich zu machen, werden wir unser Bestes tun, um Dir entgegenzukommen. Sprich uns gerne darauf an!

title: Facilities Readiness Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The role

As Facilities Readiness Lead, you will set the standard for when a Volta facility is ready to receive network and compute. You will own the readiness criteria and release process that every DSX site uses to hand space over for installation and turn-up.

This is an expert-level individual contributor role. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover, you will set direction across construction, commissioning, operations and deployment teams, and your recommendation will decide whether an area is released, conditionally released or held.

What you will do

Readiness standard

  • Own Volta's global facilities readiness standard: criteria, evidence, approvals and release process by building, hall or zone.

  • Set the governance for readiness decisions and exceptions across all sites.

  • Set requirements for access, safety, fire protection, housekeeping and temporary arrangements in live and phased sites.

Release decisions

  • Recommend release, conditional release or deferral to delivery leadership, and escalate readiness risks early.

  • Align readiness with GPU deployment, network delivery and turn-up dates.

  • Make sure asset information, drawings and operating instructions reach receiving teams.

Improvement

  • Use deployment lessons to evolve the standard.

What we are looking for

  • Expert-level experience in data centre construction, commissioning, facilities engineering or technical handover, typically 9 to 12 years.

  • A track record setting readiness or acceptance processes across multiple sites or teams.

  • Strong understanding of power, cooling, controls and physical infrastructure dependencies.

  • Sound judgement on readiness risk and confidence making release calls with senior stakeholders.

  • Ability to drive multiple disciplines to closure without direct authority.

Nice to have

  • Releasing facilities for high-density GPU installations.

  • Phased delivery in live or partially operational sites.

  • Repeatable acceptance processes across a portfolio.

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

  • Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary

  • Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success

  • Retirement/pension contributions

  • Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits

  • Generous number of vacation days each year

Additional Information

Background Checks

All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.

Equal Opportunity

Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and make employment decisions based on skills, qualifications, experience and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Accessibility

Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at

Candidate Privacy Notice

By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. Your data will be shared only with those involved in the hiring process and will not be used for unrelated purposes. For details, see our Recruitment & Candidate Privacy Notice.

Note to Recruitment Agencies

Volta does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited submissions, including those sent directly to hiring managers or employees, will be treated as the property of Volta. No agency fees will be payable unless a valid, signed recruitment agreement is in place, and the agency has been specifically engaged for the relevant vacancy.

title: Filialleiter / Stellvertretender Filialleiter (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mitfahren kann jeder. Du willst vorne fahren?
Dann übernimm bei uns eine Filiale. Du führst deine Crew aus bis zu 8 Leuten und kümmerst dich um über 3.000 Artikel. Dazu kommen jede Menge Kunden, die mit dem richtigen Rad nach Hause rollen wollen. Ob du leitest oder erstmal stellvertrittst, finden wir zusammen raus.

Über uns

Wir sind Little John Bikes. Bei uns dreht sich alles ums Rad, vom Stadtflitzer bis zum E-Bike. Wir sind bodenständig, reden Klartext und lachen gern. Und unsere Branche nimmt gerade richtig Fahrt auf.

Was du von uns bekommst

  • Geld, das sich lohnt: hohes Grundgehalt plus Ertragsprovision für deine Leistung und die deiner Crew.
  • Unbefristeter Vertrag. Punkt.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub, ab 55 sogar 32.
  • Weihnachten und Silvester frei. Jedes Jahr.
  • Arbeitszeitkonto: Im Sommer gibst du Gas, im Winter nimmst du dir die Zeit zurück. Über das Jahr passt's.
  • Einarbeitung in einer Patenfiliale. Keiner schmeißt dich ins kalte Wasser.
  • Dein Weg zum Meister: Du bist Zweiradmechatroniker-Geselle? Wir fördern dich bis zum Zweiradmechanikermeister.
  • Weiterbildung und Persönlichkeitsentwicklung, damit du als Führungskraft wächst.

  • 30 % Rabatt für dich, das ganze Jahr.
  • Dienstrad-Leasing. Wär ja auch komisch, wenn nicht.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
  • Empfehlungsprämie: Du holst gute Leute in die Crew, wir sagen Danke.
  • Produkte, die Spaß machen: E-Bikes und hochwertige Räder in einer Branche mit Zukunft.


Was du bei uns bewegst

Leitung oder Stellvertretung? Das klären wir im Gespräch. Du leitest schon eine Filiale? Top. Du warst bisher Stellvertretung oder erfahrener Verkäufer und willst den nächsten Schritt machen? Auch top. Entweder übernimmst du direkt die Leitung, oder du startest als Stellvertretung und wächst rein.

  • Du führst und motivierst deine Crew aus bis zu 8 Mitarbeitern. Als Filialleitung trägst du die Verantwortung. Als Stellvertretung unterstützt du und springst ein.
  • Du planst die Abläufe, von der Sortimentspflege bis zum Einsatzplan.
  • Du hältst über 3.000 Artikel in Schuss.
  • Du stehst selbst auf der Fläche, berätst Kunden und machst den Deal klar.
  • Du hast die Zahlen im Blick und bringst deine Filiale nach vorn.
  • Du bist da, wenn's mal hakt. Für deine Crew und für die Kunden.


Was du mitbringst

Must-haves

  • Erfahrung im Einzelhandel.
  • Führungserfahrung als Filialleitung oder Stellvertretung. Oder richtig Lust auf deinen ersten Schritt in die Führung.
  • Du behältst den Überblick. Auch im Juli, wenn der Laden brummt.
  • Du redest gern mit Menschen und bringst den Abschluss sicher nach Hause.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und steckst andere mit deiner Energie an.
  • Empathie und eine gesunde Portion Humor. Muss ja.
  • Flexibilität in der Saison.


Nice-to-haves

  • Handelserfahrung aus Fahrrad, Auto, Möbel, Mode oder Schuhe.
  • Fahrradwissen. Hilft, ist aber kein Muss.
  • Werkstatt-Background als Zweiradmechatroniker-Geselle. Einige unserer Filialleiter haben genau so angefangen und machen bei uns ihren Meister.


Klingt nach deinem Ding?

Dann schnapp dir den Lenker und bewirb dich. Kein Anschreiben, kein Bewerbungs-Blabla. Dein Lebenslauf reicht.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Agile Robots SE is an innovative company with a clear mission: bringing intelligent robotic solutions to our customers. We combine the latest technology in the field of AI with powerful robotic systems — from industrial robot arms and mobile manipulators to humanoids — to solve tasks that classical automation cannot address.

At the heart of our offering is a versatile software platform for orchestrating complex robotic systems. It allows efficient customization for specific customer requirements: configuring systems, developing reusable skills, parameterizing processes, and executing tasks reliably in production. Learned models — from perception to end-to-end policies — are a core part of this platform.

Our solutions are deployed with international customers across a wide range of industries. Seamless integration and scalable deployment are at the core of our mission.

We are looking for a passionate Forward Deployed AI Engineer to bring state-of-the-art robot learning and computer vision models into real production environments. In this role, you will train, fine-tune, and deploy AI models directly on customer robots — from Vision-Language-Action models and diffusion policies to perception and grasp generation networks. You will become a trusted technical partner, turning customer challenges into robust, data-driven robotics applications. The role is based in Munich, Germany.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy, fine-tune, and evaluate AI models on real robotic systems at customer sites — including Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, diffusion policies, and other end-to-end learned policies
  • Adapt and train perception models for robotic applications, e.g. object detection, segmentation, and pose estimation based on YOLO, SAM, vision transformers, and self-supervised backbones such as DINOv2
  • Integrate and tune grasp generation models (e.g., GraspNet, Dex-Net, Contact-GraspNet) for bin picking and manipulation tasks
  • Build data pipelines for customer deployments: demonstration and teleoperation recording, dataset curation, annotation, training runs, and systematic evaluation of model performance
  • Bring models into production: optimize inference, deploy on edge and embedded hardware, and integrate models into our robotic software platform
  • Work closely with customers to understand technical requirements and translate them into robust, AI-driven robotics applications
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve model, software, and system integration issues both remotely and on-site
  • Travel to international customer sites for workshops, deployments, training, and technical support (up to 40% travel)

Essential Skills

  • Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience
  • Minimum of four years of professional experience in machine learning, AI for robotics, or computer vision
  • Hands-on experience working with real robots — robot arms, mobile manipulators, grippers, cameras, and sensors — not only in simulation
  • Proven experience with end-to-end learned models for robotics (e.g., VLAs, diffusion policies, imitation or reinforcement learning policies), covering training, fine-tuning, and deployment
  • Strong programming skills in both Python and C++
  • Solid command of machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and the full model lifecycle: data curation, training, evaluation, and deployment
  • Experience with modern computer vision models such as YOLO, SAM, vision transformers, and self-supervised backbones (e.g., DINOv2, CLIP)
  • Experience with learned grasp generation for manipulation (e.g., GraspNet, Dex-Net, or comparable approaches)
  • Good understanding of robot (inverse) kinematics, coordinate transformations, and hand-eye calibration
  • Experience working in Linux environments
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt quickly in customer environments
  • Fluency in English

Beneficial Skills

  • Experience with large-scale demonstration data collection, teleoperation setups, and sim-to-real transfer
  • Experience with robot learning simulation frameworks (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab, MuJoCo, Gazebo)
  • Good understanding of classical computer vision (e.g., OpenCV, PCL, camera calibration, point cloud processing)
  • Experience optimizing inference (e.g., TensorRT, ONNX, quantization) and deploying on NVIDIA embedded platforms (e.g., Jetson Orin, AGX, Xavier)
  • Experience with MLOps tooling: experiment tracking, dataset versioning, and continuous training or evaluation pipelines
  • Publications or open-source contributions in robot learning, manipulation, or computer vision
  • Familiarity with industrial automation environments (e.g., PLCs, EtherCAT, OPC UA)

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

descriptionHtml:

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with life sciences organizations to deploy production AI systems across scientific and operational workflows. We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to lead end-to-end deployments of our models inside life sciences organizations and research institutions, focusing on workflows across discovery, clinical development, submissions, and scientific operations. You will work with customers who are experts in their domains, translating data, infrastructure, and workflow constraints into production systems and helping define how frontier models can be applied in regulated environments.

You will measure success through production adoption, workflow impact, and eval loops that define workflow-specific benchmarks, acceptance criteria, and launch evidence for production use. You’ll work closely with Business, Research, Platform/Product, Engineering, and Security/GRC, using deployment learnings to improve both customer systems and the product and model roadmaps supporting them.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 30% is required.

  • Design evals that measure model and system quality against workflow-specific scientific benchmarks and acceptance criteria.

  • Use evaluation results, error analysis, and deployment learning to improve model selection, system design, and product feedback.

  • Bring 6+ years of software, ML/AI, or deployment engineering experience with customer-facing ownership in biotech, pharma, clinical research, scientific software, or adjacent technical domains.

  • Have owned customer GenAI deployments end-to-end from scoping through production adoption.

title: Full Stack Analytics - Digital Unit Sports (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
LE CONTEXTE

Depuis plus de 50 ans, grâce à ses produits innovants et fort de sa culture reposant sur l’accessibilité, Decathlon ne cesse de réinventer le marché du sport.

Notre mission : rendre durablement les plaisirs et les bienfaits du sport accessibles au plus grand nombre.

Aujourd’hui, nous tirons parti de cette culture de l’innovation et de notre expertise digitale pour qu’un public plus large puisse bénéficier des plaisirs du sport et ce, à l’aide de la technologie. 
Nous créons de nouvelles expériences pour les sportives et sportifs – coaching virtuel, programmes de fidélité, expériences intelligentes en magasin, offres de produits neufs et d’occasion, mais aussi services de location d’une large gamme de produits Decathlon et de partenaires. Notre objectif : créer un écosystème digital de produits et services.

La Digital Unit Sports est au cœur de la transformation et de l’innovation de Décathlon car elle sert les équipes Décathlon en charge de la construction de notre offre globale de produits, de la conception des produits et de leur commercialisation . Saviez-vous que 80% des produits vendus en magasins sont conçus et développés par Decathlon ? Une belle responsabilité !

Tu rejoindras la PIC (Product Info & Content) Data team qui est composée de Data Scientists, Fullstack Analytics, ML engineer et Data & AI PM. 

L’objectif de l’équipe est d'obtenir une information produit et un contenu de qualité supérieure à grande échelle grâce à l'IA et à l'analytics. (#Product content at scale)

En tant que Full Stack Analytics, tu gèreras de A à Z un projet analytics, en combinant les expertises de l'Analytics Engineering, de la Business Intelligence (BI) et de la Data Analysis pour maximiser la valeur de nos données produits.

VOS RESPONSABILITÉS

En tant que Full stack Analytics au sein de l'équipe PIC , vous aurez l'occasion de :

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les PM, Machine Learning Engineer et Data Scientist pour identifier les opportunités d'impact business, exploiter les données pour quantifier les résultats et participer à la planification de la stratégie et de la feuille de route Analytics de l'équipe.
  • Modéliser et industrialiser (Analytics Engineering- 60%) : Concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données et des modèles de données propres, documentés et optimisés dans notre data lakehouse.
  • Piloter la Business Intelligence (BI - 30%) : Concevoir des tableaux de bord et des applications analytiques interactives, percutants et self-service pour permettre aux équipes métiers et produits de piloter leur activité en autonomie.
  • Délivrer des analyses d'impact (Data Analysis - 10%) : Explorer les données pour identifier des opportunités business, définir des indicateurs clés de performance (KPIs) pertinents et réaliser des analyses approfondies pour guider la stratégie de l'offre globale de produits.
  • Garantir la fiabilité : Mettre en place des tests de qualité de données, du monitoring sur la fraîcheur des données et documenter chaque sujets. 

L’environnement technique

  • Langages : SQL (expert), Python
  • Transformation & Orchestration : dbt, Airflow, Astro 
  • Data Platform : Databricks , Spark/PySpark , Cloud (AWS / GCP )
  • Restitution & BI : Tableau, Streamlit
  • CI/CD & Bonnes pratiques : Git, GitHub actions , Docker

CE DONT VOUS AUREZ BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

  • Expérience : Vous avez au moins 3 à 4 ans d'expérience sur un rôle combinant l'analyse de données, la BI et l'ingénierie analytique, idéalement sur des cas d'usage à grande échelle.
  • Maîtrise technique : Le SQL n'a aucun secret pour vous. Vous maîtrisez les concepts de modélisation de données (Kimball, Data Vault, etc.), l'utilisation de dbt, et vous avez une bonne maîtrise de Python pour l'analyse de données.
  • Aisance relationnelle : Vous êtes un excellent communicant, capable de vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes face à des interlocuteurs multidisciplinaires (équipes métiers, produit, gouvernance).
  • Langues : Vous maîtrisez l’Anglais (contexte international) et pouvez parler en français (conversationnel).
  • Culture & Humain : Vous êtes particulièrement sensible à l’impact de la pratique du sport pour les valeurs qu'elle transmet dans la vie en équipe! Vous avez envie de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif (#Tech4Good).

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • 2 jours de télétravail par semaine ;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, certifications techniques dès la première année, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;
  • Package de rémunération (participation des employés aux actions de l'entreprise, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

descriptionHtml:

  • Strong engineering discipline: automation and tooling with GitHub, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), testing, linting (ESLint), and structured review processes. Experience working with cloud and scalable environments (AWS).

About you

  • You have 3+ years of experience with Ruby on Rails and React with TypeScript.

  • You're pragmatic and autonomous, able to take a feature from design to production.

  • You have strong SQL skills and experience with complex analytical queries (Snowflake is a plus)

  • You're comfortable working with REST APIs and distributed systems

  • You embrace modern development practices: testing, code reviews, CI/CD

  • You have strong communication skills and enjoy working closely with Product teams

  • You are fluent in English. Proficiency in French is an asset

  • You are based in the CET/CEST timezone ± 2h (for team collaboration)

title: Full Stack Engineer, AI systems
descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer - AI Systems to build the product layer that turns these capabilities into usable, production-grade workflows. This includes designing how agents operate, fail, recover, and deliver consistent value to users.

 

Focus

  • Build end-to-end product features across frontend, backend, and AI integrations

  • Design agent workflows that handle planning, tool use, failure, and recovery across multiple steps.

  • Integrate LLMs, memory, and external tools into systems that behave reliably under real-world conditions

  • Design real-time AI interactions with streaming, partial results, and tight latency constraints

  • Improve system reliability, observability, and fallback mechanisms

  • Collaborate closely with ML, backend, and product teams to ship features end-to-end

  • Continuously iterate based on real usage and failure modes

 

Ideal Experiences

  • Strong experience in full stack engineering (frontend + backend)

  • Solid understanding of system design and API architecture

  • Experience working with LLMs, RAG systems, or AI-powered applications

  • Ability to handle ambiguity and make pragmatic engineering decisions

  • Strong ownership - able to take features from idea to production

  • Comfort working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements

 

Outcomes

  • Own and ship AI-native product features that move beyond chat into persistent, goal-driven workflows

  • Design and deploy agent workflows that reliably complete multi-step tasks across tools and sessions

  • Reduce latency and improve responsiveness of AI interactions while maintaining output quality

  • Build robust fallback and recovery mechanisms for LLM and tool failures in production environments

  • Improve the success rate and reliability of AI-driven workflows through iteration, evaluation, and monitoring

  • Establish patterns and abstractions for integrating LLMs, memory, and external tools into scalable product systems

  • Contribute to a product experience where AI feels proactive, consistent, and dependable over time

 

Tech Stack

  • Next.js

  • Python

  • NodeJs

  • Pytorch

  • OpenAI / Anthropic / open-source LLMs

  • SQl & noSQL

  • Kubernetes

  • Docker

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: General Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before.

We are the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals health than ever.

The traction speaks for itself: one of Europe's top 100 AI startups with a team of 70 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 2.5M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London.

This is a rare chance to join a rocket ship at exactly the right moment and we are looking for exceptional people to help us fly it.

In this role, you will:

  • Be Lupa's first in-house legal hire, building the legal function from scratch and owning everything from commercial contracts to regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions

  • Own and negotiate all commercial agreements including enterprise SaaS contracts, partner deals, vendor agreements, and everything in between, moving at the pace the business demands

  • Lead data privacy and security compliance across UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and US state privacy laws as we expand internationally

  • Navigate the regulatory landscape for AI-powered clinical tools in veterinary and adjacent healthcare markets across the UK, EU, and US

  • Support the board and leadership on corporate governance, equity matters, and future fundraising processes

  • Manage employment law across an increasingly international team including UK, US, and other jurisdictions as we scale

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure our AI features are built and deployed compliantly, from data handling to clinical liability

  • Own IP strategy, protecting what we build and making sure we are not infringing on what others have built

  • Build relationships with external counsel and manage those relationships commercially and strategically

Your background looks something like:

  • Qualified solicitor or barrister with 7+ years PQE. English and Welsh qualification essential, US bar admission a strong advantage

  • Significant experience in technology, SaaS, or digital health law, ideally with in-house experience at a high-growth startup or scale-up

  • Deep knowledge of data privacy law including UK/EU GDPR and experience operationalising compliance in a product-led company

  • Commercial contract experience at pace. You have negotiated complex enterprise deals and know how to move quickly without creating unnecessary risk

  • Exposure to regulatory frameworks for AI or health tech products (nice to have)

  • Experience supporting a fundraising process at Series A, B, or beyond (nice to have)

  • Background at a top-tier law firm before moving in-house (nice to have)

As a person, you:

  • Are a pragmatic, commercially minded lawyer. Your job is to help the business move fast safely, not to find reasons to slow things down

  • Are comfortable being the only lawyer in the room and making confident calls with incomplete information

  • Build trust quickly across a business, from engineers who need a quick data handling answer to the CEO who needs a board-ready governance opinion

  • Are genuinely excited by the intersection of AI, health tech, and regulation. This space is moving fast and you want to be at the front of it

  • Are excited to work in-person from our Paddington, London HQ

  • Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic

What does success look like in 6 months?

  • The legal function exists. Contracts are standardised, compliance frameworks are in place, and the business is no longer making it up as it goes

  • You are a trusted voice at the leadership table, pulled into strategic decisions early rather than brought in to review at the end

  • The US expansion has legal infrastructure behind it. Entity structure, contracts, employment, and privacy are all covered

title: GIS Product Engineer II – ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps
descriptionHtml:
Overview

Bring your enthusiasm and talents to Esri, creating industry leading ArcGIS products. The ArcGIS Maps SDKs allow developers to build modern mapping applications for mobile and desktop platforms, with 2D and 3D data visualisation, and online or offline access. This is a fantastic opportunity to join the product development team and support the delivery of regular, high-quality releases in a collaborative and dynamic environment.  

Help us improve our cross-platform GIS software libraries, built on the latest compilers and C++ standards, and create sample apps, developer documentation, and developer outreach.  

Esri has a Relocation Assistance Program and can provide support with relocating to the Cardiff area for this position. Check out more details of the Esri R&D Center – Cardiff!

Responsibilities

  • Apply curious, independent thought, and attention to detail to explore and understand the challenges that ArcGIS users face and provide usable, informative feedback on user experience
  • Understand the customer, who are software developers, gathering requirements and use cases that translate into actionable code and doc improvements 
  • Build rich and varied GIS datasets and maps, sample applications and articles that can be used to highlight product capabilities, explain APIs and guide user (developer) practices
  • Work with your development team, and teams across Esri, to design, create, and validate the newest datasets and GIS workflows to support field mapping, data collection, spatial analysis and verify the functionality meets user workflows and is consistent with Esri ecosystem
  • Describe GIS best practices and demonstrate how to apply these GIS workflows in internal team meetings, on product forums and websites, with customers, at Esri events, or in publications like the ArcGIS Blog
  • Document technical topics and concepts, and produce developer-focused product documentation
  • Learn about and collaborate in SDK environments (such as Kotlin, Qt, C#, Swift, Flutter, Python), to explore issues, investigate problems, and design and prototype enhancements 
  • Build focused test code to represent complex situations for investigation and regression testing
  • Administer, automate, and manage online and database GIS systems and services to support the development of new product features and ongoing product releases

Requirements

  • 2+ years of GIS experience (such as modeling, analyzing, or presenting geospatial data in a scientific, engineering, governmental, or post graduate academic environment)
  • Proficiency with mapping, spatial data or GIS platforms such as ArcGIS or QGIS 
  • Strong problem-solving and analytic skills
  • Proven initiative and creativity to find ways to explore, investigate, test and validate software behavior
  • Excellent communication and team collaboration skills 
  • Experience of, and interest in, scripting or coding to appreciate our developer users' challenges and to communicate effectively with the development team
  • Bachelor’s degree in GIS, geography, computer science, engineering, or related field
  • Existing work authorisation for the United Kingdom

Recommended Qualifications

  • Experience and passion for working with cartography, mapping or geospatial data 
  • Interest in or knowledge of layout, typography, and fonts for international text
  • Proven experience of user communication and education such as having been responsible for product documentation, blogs, written or video tutorials, presentations
  • Familiarity using version control systems such as Git, for documentation and code 
  • Familiarity with some of the scripting or coding languages which our SDKs target, and which we use for automation, such as using Kotlin, Qt, .Net, Swift, Flutter, Typescript or Python
  • Master’s degree in GIS, computer science, engineering, or related field 

Base salary is one component of our total rewards strategy. Compensation decisions and the base range for this role take into account many factors including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.
