title: Global Head of Customer Success
descriptionHtml:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

As Global Head of Customer Success, you will:

  • Lead customer success across all our markets, with the UK, Poland and Germany as the largest.

  • Lead a global client success team of around 15 people, with 3–6 direct reports

  • Harmonise our customer success function globally: one model, one set of standards and one way of measuring outcomes, applied with judgement to each market.

  • Own the post-sale experience for customers across Singu and its group businesses.

  • Shape how the customer success organisation is structured, whether by geography, industry or contract size, and the role of country leads within it.

  • Report to the Chief Customer Officer and work closely with your peers in Sales, Professional Services, Support and the Executive Leadership Team.

Your first priorities:

  • Own the organisational design of client success and the operations that support it.

  • Implement repeatable, scalable processes that create predictable outcomes.

  • Harmonise the client experience across all teams involved in the client journey.

Responsibilities:

  • Define, own, and execute a single global customer success strategy and operating model.

  • Build on Singu’s market leading position and continue to deliver elite performance on GRR, NRR, Churn, and NPS.

  • Lead and develop customer success leaders and teams across markets, including country and segment leads who also manage their own customer portfolios.

  • Establish and monitor consistent global KPIs for retention, expansion, customer health and satisfaction.

  • Own the customer lifecycle (onboarding, adoption, renewal and upsell) and drive targeted initiatives to reduce churn and grow customer lifetime value.

  • Manage relationships with strategic and high-value customers and act as the escalation point for complex situations.

  • Partner with Sales on smooth handovers and joint account planning for growth.

  • Work with Product and Delivery to prioritise customer feedback and influence roadmap decisions.

  • Design and implement scalable processes, playbooks and tooling.

  • Report to the CCO and senior leadership on customer health, revenue risks and growth opportunities across all markets.

  • Forecast renewal and expansion revenue globally and contribute to commercial planning.

What success looks like

You will be measured by movement in customer outcomes:

  • One function. A consistent customer success model, metrics and ways of working across all markets.

  • Retention. Stronger gross and net revenue retention, with renewals secured on time and on clear evidence of value.

  • Early risk visibility. Fewer surprise cancellations, with at-risk accounts identified early and supported by an owned recovery plan.

  • Adoption. Deeper and broader use of the products customers have bought, measured consistently across markets and segments.

  • Time to value. Shorter time from contract signature to the outcome the customer bought the solution for.

  • Customer advocacy. Improving NPS and CSAT, and a growing base of customers willing to act as references and champions.

  • Key measures. Gross revenue retention (GRR), net revenue retention (NRR), logo churn and renewal forecast accuracy, supported by health score coverage, product adoption, success plan coverage, NPS and the number of referenceable customers.

What you will build and own:

  • A global customer success model that scales. Clear segmentation and coverage, a clear owner and plan for every customer, and a shared definition of “great” at every stage of the lifecycle.

  • A strong customer success leadership layer. Country leads, segment leads and CSMs with clear standards for account planning, customer reviews and renewal preparation, and the commercial judgement to apply them.

  • A health and adoption framework that drives action. A shared view of customer health combining usage, engagement, support experience and sentiment, with scores that trigger action rather than sit in a dashboard.

  • A retention and advocacy engine. Disciplined, predictable renewals with early engagement and evidence of value, and a pool of customers ready to share their success.

How you will work:

  • Hybrid, from our London, Kraków or Warsaw office, 3 days a week.

  • In close, day-to-day collaboration with your direct reports, the Chief Customer Officer, and the Executive Leadership Team.

  • In partnership with Sales, Professional Services, Support, and Product.

  • As the voice of the customer inside Singu, challenging constructively where something gets in the way of customer value.

  • Balancing common global standards with what each market and customer group genuinely needs.

What we are looking for

Ideally, you can show the baseline you inherited, the changes you made and the measurable result that followed.

Must have:

  • Customer success leadership in a B2B SaaS business, with a track record of improving gross or net revenue retention and reducing churn.

  • Experience leading customer success across countries, including leading through other leaders.

  • Designed segmentation, coverage, lifecycle and health-scoring models that teams actually use.

  • Practical experience of onboarding, driving product adoption and shortening time to value.

  • Experience harmonising across countries, products or acquired businesses without over-standardising.

  • Credibility with senior customer stakeholders and confidence leading executive business reviews.

  • Ability to turn customer insight into a point of view and secure action from Sales, Professional Services, Support, and Product.

  • University degree level education.

  • English at C1 level or above.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in proptech, real estate or facilities management.

  • Track record of working in Private Equity backed software businesses.

  • Polish or German language skills.

Why join SINGU:

  • Competitive salary based on your experience and location.

  • The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing international SaaS company shaping the future of real estate operations.

  • A role with real ownership and operational impact, where your work directly supports the efficiency of the entire organization.

  • A collaborative and international environment, working with teams across multiple countries.

  • The chance to improve and build processes in a scaling organization.

  • A supportive culture built on adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace.

We're looking for exceptional people who want to help build a category-defining company, operating with high urgency and taking real ownership to help shape the future of AI.

The role

This is an opportunity to support across Encord's entire growth function: from our billboards or campaigns on X, to our exec dinners, founder PR or flagship annual summit.

In a single week you might organize our booth at a robotics conference, run a monthly dinner with executives at companies we most want to meet and uncover a gap in our LLM ranking and ship new content to improve it. You'll have a founder-mentality, move with relentless urgency, and own outcomes rather than tasks.

If you want to start a company one day, or already have, this is a chance to experience a hyper-growth GTM function from 0 to 1. You'll see up close how a category-defining company gets built and get as much scope as you can handle (as fast as you can earn it). Our team is small and we all roll up our sleeves, from packing hundreds of swag boxes, to cold outbounding a famous podcast to book our founders an interview.

Some of what you could own in your first months:

  • Growth hacks: test scrappy, creative ways to get in front of the AI leaders at companies we most want to work with; obsess about finding out what's actually working and doubling down

  • Content distribution: help put Encord on the map, from understanding where our market spends time online/IRL to helping create and distribute high-value content that reflects our leadership in the space

  • Conferences: prep and run our presence at large conferences, from booking meetings ahead of time to working the booth and following up with leads

  • A bold IRL launch: help take an out-of-home campaign or stunt in New York or SF from idea to street, from sourcing locations to capturing the content once it's live

  • Executive dinners: own the guest list, venue and follow-up for dinners with the AI teams at the companies we most want to work with

  • Customer stories: turn customer wins into case studies, videos and posts that our GTM team can use to communicate the value of Encord

What you'll do

  • Support the team across Encord's entire growth function: events, launches, paid and organic campaigns, outbound and content

  • Become the Encord product and customer expert - you'll know our customers by name, deeply understand why leading AI teams choose Encord and how to accelerate our growth

  • Execute exceptionally well, including on the details that make things great: logistics, vendors, timelines and run-of-show

  • Take full ownership of projects as you prove yourself, coming up with your own ideas for how Encord can grow and executing on them

  • Write and ship wide-ranging media formats: social posts that resonate with our market, press releases to announce a big launch, outbound emails to book meetings, video scripts or podcast outlines

  • Examine the performance of what you deliver, track results and proactively identify what's working/not working (and quickly adapt)

Who we're looking for

  • 1–3 years in a high-velocity environment: starting a company as a founder, top-tier banking or investing, early hire at a hyper-growth startup, or similar. Exceptional new grads will be considered

  • High-agency and founder-mentality: you have a strong sense of self-initiative and often find a creative solution around obstacles where others get stuck

  • Eager for a non-linear growth path (and driven to put in the work needed to achieve it)

  • Customer-centric and sales-focused: you want to deeply understand how our business works, why our customers choose Encord and what makes a 'great' Encord customer; you want to learn to speak the language of our market and be respected by customers/prospects, have them on speed-dial

  • Ruthlessly focused on results: you internalize our north start metrics and goals, and refuse to spend time on 'vanity' tasks or initiatives that don't help us make progress

  • You want to roll up your sleeves: you know most of the work required to grow a company is not glamorous, and you deeply care to do a great job on every sub-component required to get to the result

  • You're curious, and always hunting for, new avenues for growth: you want to find new S curves for the company and can juggle 'always on' with bold new bets

  • Evidence that you make things happen: events, projects, campaigns, or businesses you drove yourself

Why Encord

  • Generational opportunity to shape how AI will develop in the real-world

  • Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a hyper-growth startup

  • Clear, accelerated growth opportunities as the company scales rapidly

  • Strong in-person culture in our East Village (NY - just launched), Jackson Square (SF) and Soho (London) offices: +4 days/week

  • Daily team lunches & dinners

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

  • US employees: 18 paid vacation days plus US public holidays

  • UK employees: 25 paid vacation days plus bank holidays

  • Frequent travel opportunities across the U.S., London, and Europe

  • Bi-annual company offsites & monthly socials

Operating principles

High agency

You see something broken, you fix it or find the person who can. We celebrate the people who solve 90% of a problem before anyone asks.

Build with care & urgency

We bear-hug the customer. Former founders and people from fast-moving, high-stakes environments thrive here.

Self-aware & hungry

We stay warm, self-aware, and genuinely hungry. We elevate our peers, and ego doesn't last long.

Invent in real time

We move toward the ambiguity. We’re pragmatic, resourceful, energized by the fact that there's no playbook.

If you're looking to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who push you to be better, we'd love to meet you.

title: Head of Compliance Monitoring
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

As Head of Compliance Monitoring, you'll own Zable's risk-based compliance monitoring programme and lead the team that delivers it. You'll provide independent second line assurance that the business meets its legal and regulatory obligations, and evidence the outcomes customers actually receive rather than the processes behind them.

You'll report to the Head of Compliance (SMF 16, Compliance Oversight) and deputise for them, including at Board meetings and sub-committees. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who has built a second line monitoring function in a UK FCA regulated consumer credit firm and wants the autonomy to shape one in a fast-growing fintech. The role is not itself a Senior Manager Function.

What you’ll be doing/impact on objectives

  • Own the compliance monitoring plan and methodology, refreshing it annually and in-year in response to emerging risks, regulatory change, MI, complaints and FCA publications

  • Maintain a monitoring universe covering PRIN and the Consumer Duty, CONC, SYSC, DISP, SMCR, MCOB, the Consumer Credit Act, financial promotions and UK GDPR

  • Scope and deliver thematic and BAU reviews across the customer journey, including affordability (CONC 5), financial promotions (CONC 3), arrears and forbearance (CONC 7), vulnerability, fees and charges and complaints handling (DISP)

  • Test the design and operating effectiveness of first line controls, and provide second line assurance over first line quality assurance

  • Issue clear, evidence-based reports setting out findings, root cause, risk ratings and owned actions, then track remediation to closure and validate that it worked

  • Escalate actual or potential customer harm promptly, and assess it for redress and for notification to the FCA under Principle 11 and SUP 15

  • Produce monitoring MI for the Head of Compliance, executive management and the Board, and present it at committees

  • Support FCA supervisory engagement, information requests and skilled person (s166) reviews, and coordinate coverage with Internal Audit, Risk and first line QA

  • Bring data protection into scope, testing UK GDPR and DPA 2018 compliance alongside the Data Protection Officer

  • Lead, coach and develop the compliance monitoring team, planning resource against the plan and building capability through data, analytics and better tooling

What we’re looking for

  • Demonstrable compliance monitoring experience within a UK FCA regulated firm, including designing, owning and delivering a risk-based compliance monitoring programme

  • Experience of leading, managing and developing a team

  • Consumer credit experience, with a strong working knowledge of CONC and the Consumer Credit Act

  • Strong working knowledge of the FCA Handbook, in particular PRIN and the Consumer Duty, SYSC, DISP and SMCR, and of FCA expectations of a second line monitoring function

  • Data protection knowledge, covering the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018

  • Ability to write clear, concise, evidence-based reports and to present findings credibly to senior management, the Board and its committees

  • Sound judgement and personal resilience, with the independence and confidence to challenge the business constructively and to escalate where necessary

  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to deliver a plan across competing priorities

Highly desirable

  • Internal audit experience gained in a third line function, and/or a relevant professional qualification (for example IIA, ICA or CISI)

  • Secured lending experience, from either a second or third line perspective, including knowledge of MCOB

 

Interview process

  • Screening stage: a 15 minute remote cognitive exercise and a 30 minute interview with the Talent Partner

  • 40 minute interview with a Compliance Business Partner (remote)

  • Final onsite interview:

    • 45minute interview with the Head of Compliance

    • 30 minute interviews with CRO

    • 30 minute interview with a product MD

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

title: Head of Digital Platform & Data
descriptionHtml:

Our technology partner network spans leading battery research institutes. PHENOGY is an environmentally and socially conscious enterprise. We are committed to fostering prosperity for the people and our planet, ensuring sustainable growth – starting in the area of our greatest expertise and impact: energy storage solutions.

Operating at the intersection of clean energy and industrial IoT, you will lead the digital ecosystem for our Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) from the gateway upward—connecting Edge/Gateway → Cloud Infrastructure → APIs → Monitoring/NOC → Customer Applications & Data Platforms. Working in close alignment with our Embedded Systems lead, Product, Cybersecurity, Operations, and Quality teams, you will turn complex energy and regulatory requirements into scalable, high-availability software and data platforms.

What You Will Own & Lead

  • Platform & Data Strategy: Define our technology roadmap, sourcing model (in-house vs. external), and application/data architecture. Establish clear boundaries, data models, APIs, and technical standards from the gateway layer through edge computing, cloud services, data pipelines, and customer/Battery Passport platforms.
  • Engineering, DevOps & Quality: Lead internal engineers and external partners. Govern the full software lifecycle—from requirements and Git workflows to automated CI/CD pipelines, environment segregation, release/rollback procedures, and end-of-life decommissioning. Champion automated testing (unit, integration, performance, regression) and proactively manage technical debt.

Oversee secure coding, secrets/certificate management, SBOMs, open-source licensing, vulnerability remediation (SAST/DAST/SCA), and penetration testing across our edge and cloud stack in alignment with ISO/IEC 27001, IEC 62443, NIST SSDF, OWASP, NIS2, and the EU Cyber Resilience Act.

  • Executive Governance & IT Alignment: Hold decision-making authority over digital platform architecture, tech stacks, repositories, CI/CD, and technical debt. Partner closely with the Head of IT to maintain a clear boundary between product software and enterprise IT while jointly governing shared domains (IAM, cloud infrastructure, networking, incident response, and disaster recovery).

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, IT, or a related technical field.
  • Leadership & Strategy: Proven track record leading software/data teams, complex engineering programs, and external development vendors, translating business goals into clear roadmaps and architectural decisions.
  • Modern Cloud, API & Data Tech: Deep expertise in cloud-native software architecture, data pipelines/telemetry processing, integration patterns, REST/streaming APIs, DevOps, CI/CD automation, and full-lifecycle release management.
  • Security Mindset: Strong command of secure software engineering practices, vulnerability management, and risk-based decision-making.
  • Communication: Ability to bridge deep technical execution with executive stakeholder alignment—balancing speed, cost, quality, and operational risk.

Strongly Preferred

  • Domain experience in Energy Tech, BESS, Industrial IoT, Edge computing, or connected fleet platforms.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, C#/.NET, Python, modern data stacks, and REST APIs.
  • Working knowledge of IEC 62443 and cybersecurity standards for connected industrial products.
  • Experience managing high-availability operational systems and formal product lifecycle management (PLM).

How Success Is Measured You will have clear ownership backed by transparent engineering metrics, including:

  • Delivery & Reliability: Roadmap predictability, release frequency, deployment success/rollback rates, platform availability, and incident trends.
  • Code, Data & Security Health: Automated test coverage, data pipeline reliability/latency, CI/CD maturity, defect rates/MTTR, critical vulnerability remediation speed, and technical debt reduction.
  • Governance & Efficiency: Architecture documentation completeness, supplier delivery quality, and R&D resource efficiency.
  • Workload: Full-time | Level: Senior Management / Head
  • Reporting to: Executive Management (CTO / COO)

title: Head of India
descriptionHtml:
The Role

India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.

You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.

As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.

Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO

What You'll Own

  • The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.

  • Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.

  • Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.

  • The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.

  • Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.

  • The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.

  • The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

Who You Are

  • 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.

  • Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.

  • Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.

  • A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.

  • A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle.

  • Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets.

Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job.

Why This Role

India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home.

About Us

 

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

 

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

 

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

 

Here’s a little more:

  • Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more

  • Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages

  • Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

 

Taptap Values

title: Head of Recruiting / Recruiting Lead (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Jobbeschreibung

Wer sind wir

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 30 High-Performern ist innerhalb von 2 Jahren von 0 auf 1 Mio. € Monatsumsatz gewachsen. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System. Unser weiteres Wachstum hängt an einer Frage: Holen wir die richtigen Menschen schnell genug an Bord? Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Was für dich drin ist

  • Du führst die gesamte Recruiting-Abteilung und machst sie zum Wachstumsmotor des Unternehmens
  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Ein Datenpartner an deiner Seite: Unser Sales & HR Analyst liefert die Zahlen, du entscheidest, was daraus folgt
  • Direkter Impact: Jeder starke Hire in Sales und Account Management bewegt unseren Umsatz sichtbar
  • Verdienst ab 75.000 € p. a. plus leistungsbasiertem Bonus
  • Remote möglich, mit regelmäßiger Präsenz im Office in Hockenheim
  • Investition in dein Skill-Development und 4 Team Events pro Jahr

So sieht dein Job bei uns aus

Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Recruiting-Abteilung. Du führst das bestehende Team und baust Prozesse, Standards und SOPs auf. Für unsere Key-Hires in Sales und Account Management trägst du die volle Verantwortung, vom Erstkontakt bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag. Die besten Kandidaten suchen meist gar nicht, deshalb gehst du über Active Sourcing und Direktansprache selbst auf sie zu.

Du steuerst den gesamten Funnel: Kennenlerngespräch, Bewerbungsgespräch, Probetag, Referenzcheck und Angebot. Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst du die Rollenarchitektur, also Scorecards, Stellen-VSLs, Landingpages und Recruiting-Ads. Du legst fest, was im Recruiting gemessen wird, und setzt das Dashboard in Close und Recruitee so auf, dass es echte Entscheidungen ermöglicht. Mit unserem Sales & HR Analyst wertest du die Zahlen aus, erkennst Engpässe und passt Prozesse an.

Deine Recruiter führst und coachst du, und mit Call-Reviews sicherst du die Qualität ihrer Arbeit. Neue Hires übergibst du sauber an die Teamleads und ins Onboarding. Was die Probezeit zeigt, fließt bei dir zurück in den Auswahlprozess. Wenn es zählt, bist du vor Ort: bei Probetagen, Starttagen und Quarterly Meetings.

Gemessen wirst du nicht an Aktivität, sondern an Ergebnissen:

  • Time-to-Hire pro Rolle
  • Conversion zwischen den Funnel-Stufen
  • Anzahl qualifizierter Kandidaten bis zur Besetzung
  • Offer-Acceptance-Rate
  • Pipeline-Abdeckung für unsere Key-Rollen
  • Wer von deinen Hires die Probezeit besteht und nach 90 Tagen performt
  • Performance deines Teams

Nach 90 Tagen erwarten wir ein Recruiting-Dashboard, dem die Geschäftsführung vertraut, einen dokumentierten Funnel mit SOPs und die ersten Key-Hires in Sales oder Account Management.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in Recruiting oder Talent Acquisition, davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer führenden Rolle, etwa als Teamlead, Head of oder Recruiting Lead
  • Eigener Sales-Background: Du warst selbst im Closing, im Setting oder als Sales Lead aktiv. Du weißt, wie Vertriebler ticken, weil du einer bist
  • Nachweislich besetzte Sales- und Account-Management-Rollen im B2B-High-Ticket-Umfeld, etwa in Agentur, Beratung, Coaching oder Online-Business
  • Du hast ein Recruiting-System mit Funnel, Prozessen, Scorecards und Tracking aufgebaut und nicht nur darin gearbeitet
  • Echte KPI-Verantwortung: Du kennst deine Zahlen zu Time-to-Hire, Funnel-Conversion, Kandidaten pro Besetzung und Probezeit-Erfolg
  • Du hast ein Recruiting-Team aufgebaut, geführt und auf Performance gebracht, auch wenn es ein kleines war
  • Hunter-Gen: Du findest die besten Kandidaten über Active Sourcing, Direktansprache und Netzwerke, auch wenn sie gar nicht suchen
  • Treffsicheres Profiling: Du erkennst früh, ob jemand im High-Ticket-Sales liefern wird, und lässt dich von guter Selbstdarstellung nicht blenden
  • Ownership: Wenn zwei Wochen lang kein Bewerbungsgespräch zustande kommt, merkst du es selbst, findest die Ursache und handelst, bevor jemand fragt
  • Sehr starke Kommunikation: Du verkaufst unsere Vision ehrlich, selektiv und auf Augenhöhe mit A-Playern
  • Pluspunkte:
    • Du warst selbst Head of Sales, Sales Lead oder selbstständig im Vertrieb bzw. im Headhunting
    • Du hast ein Netzwerk in der Closer- und Agentur-Szene im DACH-Raum
    • Du hast hohes Hiring-Volumen mit mehreren parallel offenen Rollen gestemmt
    • Du hast Erfahrung mit Scorecards, Probetagen, Case Studies und Referenzchecks
    • Du kennst Close, Recruitee oder vergleichbare CRM- und ATS-Systeme samt Recruiting-Dashboards

Du passt eher nicht zu uns, wenn …

  • du HR-Generalist bist und vor allem Personalverwaltung, Verträge, Payroll und Feel-Good machst. Das ist eine Recruiting-Rolle, keine HR-Rolle
  • du bisher nur Stellen gepostet und Kennenlerngespräche geführt hast, ohne je ein System, ein Team oder Zahlen zu verantworten
  • du nie selbst verkauft hast und Vertriebler nur von außen kennst
  • du ein fertiges Setup, große Budgets und lange Freigabeschleifen brauchst, um zu liefern
  • du dich hervorragend präsentieren, aber nicht mit konkreten Zahlen belegen kannst, was du tatsächlich besetzt hast
  • Remote für dich Freiheit von Verbindlichkeit bedeutet
  • du lieber als externer Freelancer auf Projektbasis arbeitest, statt Teil des Teams zu sein
  • du einfach nur einen Job suchst und nicht wachsen willst

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich bei uns und werde Teil unseres Teams.

title: Head of Workplace Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Join our expanding Workplace Engineering team! We’re recruiting a Head of Workplace Engineering to run IT at M-KOPA as a product, with automation first, so 2,500+ colleagues can keep serving Africa’s Every Day Earners.

**Based in Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Ghana, Uganda, the UK or the EU, with significant travel of up to 25% at times, especially early in the role**

The Impact

Your engineering will keep a pan-African fintech running across five offices, four warehouses, 100+ retail sites and 10 call centres in six countries. We’ve now served 10 million customers, unlocked $2+ billion in credit and created income for 35,000+ agents. It’s your chance to be part of something that’s transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every device provisioned, access request automated and call-centre line kept up helps the people serving our customers.

🏆 Global recognition: Named by TIME 100 as one of the world’s most influential companies, and by the Financial Times as one of Africa’s fastest-growing for four consecutive years (2022-2025).

🚀 Scale challenges: Run IT across six countries, from call-centre agents to the executive team, using repeatable, templated builds for new sites and markets.

🌱 Environmental impact: We’re carbon-negative, with over 2 million tonnes of emissions avoided.

What You’ll Do

You’ll lead our IT function, including the Helpdesk and IT Infrastructure teams, and be accountable for the cost, security, reliability and user experience of our internal estate. We’re not hiring a traditional IT manager. We want an engineer who would rather write the automation than raise the ticket.

  • Own the IT roadmap and budget, treating internal services as products with clear users and measured adoption

  • Run the corporate Azure and Microsoft estate as code, deployed through CI/CD

  • Automate joiner/mover/leaver, device provisioning, licensing and access requests, driven from the HR system of record

  • Own identity, end-user devices, networks across all our sites, and contact-centre telephony across ~10 call centres

  • Move support from reactive tickets to self-service and automated resolution, using AI and agentic tooling where it genuinely removes work

  • Own IT security hygiene, business continuity and compliance, with audit evidence generated from systems

Your Environment 💻

  • Microsoft and cloud: Azure, Entra ID, Intune, M365

  • Infrastructure as code: Bicep and/or Terraform, Git, pull requests, CI/CD

  • Scripting: PowerShell, Python, TypeScript or similar

  • Integrations: APIs and workflow tooling across HR, identity, ITSM and finance systems

This role covers internal IT. The infrastructure behind our customer-facing products sits with Engineering.

Our Approach 🚀

  • Automation first, everything versioned and repeatable

  • Data over anecdote

  • A team that builds rather than firefights

  • Product mindset: start from the user and the business outcome, not the tool

What You Need

You also need to be good with people. Our users range from call-centre agents to the executive team, and you should be the person they want to talk to when something is broken.

  • A strong engineering background: you write code regularly and are comfortable with Git, pull requests and CI/CD

  • Deep Azure and Microsoft experience: Entra ID, Intune, M365, Azure networking and core services

  • Hands-on infrastructure as code with Bicep and/or Terraform in production

  • A track record of automating IT operations at scale, with the before and after to show for it

  • Experience leading teams, including non-engineering teams such as a service desk

  • Approachable: you explain technical trade-offs in plain language and build trust at every level

Nice to have: multi-country IT experience (ideally in high-growth or emerging markets); networking fundamentals (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, ISPs) and contact-centre telephony; vendor management; applying LLMs or agentic workflows to internal operations; relevant certifications. We care more about what you’ve built than where you learnt it.

Probably not a fit if your experience is mainly managing vendors and tickets rather than building.

Location & Benefits

  • Based in Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Ghana, Uganda, the UK or the EU, with significant travel of up to 25% at times, especially early in the role

  • Benefits package, which includes Bonus & Growth Shares

  • Work with diverse teams across the UK, Europe and Africa

  • Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected to the mobile internet

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use their M-KOPA product to generate income, and 35,000 livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided, with over 127,000 circular economy products provided

Ready to build the systems that keep a pan-African fintech running, while advancing your career in IT engineering? Apply now!

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

descriptionHtml:

title: Implementation Specialist (Aveni Assist)
descriptionHtml:
About Aveni

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows. We have been recognised as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025. Backed by leading investors including Puma Private Equity, and commercially supported by Lloyds Banking Group and Nationwide Building Society, we previously completed one of Scotland's largest Series A rounds. Since then, we've continued to grow rapidly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates, and we're now scaling our team to meet that demand.

The Role

Aveni Assist is our AI-powered platform for financial advice firms. It helps advisers and paraplanners automate documentation, improve compliance and spend more time with clients. We're looking for an Implementation Specialist to help new clients get live on Assist and make it part of how they deliver advice every day.

You'll work with firms from the moment they sign, learning how they run their advice process and configuring Assist to match: from suitability report templates to the quality assurance criteria their compliance teams rely on. If you've worked as a paraplanner or in a similar role and want to use that knowledge to shape how AI is adopted across the advice market, this role is for you.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Running discovery with clients to understand their objectives, advice processes, documentation, CRM workflows and quality assurance frameworks, and turning these into clear requirements and deliverables.

  • Creating and managing implementation plans covering milestones, responsibilities, dependencies and timescales, and acting as a primary point of contact for your clients.

  • Building, configuring and refining AI-driven document templates so outputs match each firm's structure, style, regulatory expectations and internal standards.

  • Working with clients to define quality assessment questions, scoring criteria, evidence requirements and edge cases, then coordinating testing and refining the configuration.

  • Acting as the link between clients and Aveni's Product and Engineering teams, coordinating technical readiness and helping investigate issues.

  • Supporting user onboarding with our Enablement team, coordinating go-live readiness and providing early-life support before handing over to Customer Success and Support.

  • Gathering usage data and client feedback, sharing product insights with Product and Engineering, and contributing to our implementation playbooks and the Assist roadmap.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as a Paraplanner or in a similar role within a financial planning or wealth management firm.

  • A strong understanding of suitability reports, advice processes, CRM systems, adviser-client conversations and FCA-regulated environments.

  • Experience working with clients in a SaaS or software environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with confidence leading client calls, workshops and training sessions.

  • Strong organisation and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple clients and deliverables at once.

  • Excellent attention to detail and analytical problem-solving, particularly around advice documentation, data accuracy and regulatory requirements.

  • Comfort learning and configuring software, and an adaptable approach to taking ownership in an evolving environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment.

  • Experience using AI tools or digital platforms.

  • Experience supporting client onboarding, implementation, change management or an early-stage product rollout.

  • Experience planning or supporting user acceptance testing.

  • Familiarity with software configuration, technical analysis or CRM integrations.

Why Join Aveni?

You'll take the advice-process knowledge you've built and use it to shape how AI is adopted across the UK advice market. You'll work directly with a wide range of advice firms, see the impact of your work on how advisers and paraplanners spend their time, and have a real voice in how Aveni Assist develops.

Benefits at Aveni

  • Remote-first working across the UK

  • Work abroad policy

  • Co-working spaces available

  • 34 days holiday (including flexible bank holidays) and your birthday off

  • Company-wide off-sites

  • Optional Personal Development Plan

  • Flexible benefits platform

  • Protection essentials including Life Insurance, Income Protection, Critical Illness cover, and Pension (up to 5% matched employer contribution with optional increased contributions)

  • Private health and dental care

  • Potential share options

  • Enhanced family leave

Join Us in Making a Difference

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We've built our business to ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. If you're passionate about technology and its ability to drive positive change for the future of financial services, we'd love to hear from you. Even if you don't meet 100% of requirements, we'd like to hear from you anyway if you believe you'd fit in. Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.

title: Inbound Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: IT Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Buena

Buena, finanziert von Google Ventures, macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Wir übernehmen Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln sie digital weiter.

Mit jeder Übernahme wachsen auch unsere Anforderungen an die IT: Neue Mitarbeitende, Geräte und Standorte sollen zuverlässig zusammenarbeiten. Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die unsere IT übernimmt und mit unserem Wachstum weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest zunächst die IT unserer Berliner Zentrale. Du sorgst dafür, dass Mitarbeitende arbeitsfähig sind, Zugänge sicher verwaltet werden und Geräte sowie Netzwerk zuverlässig funktionieren.

Gleichzeitig entwickelst du Standards und Abläufe, die auch bei der nächsten Hausverwaltung funktionieren. Mittelfristig begleitest du die IT-Integration unserer Tochterunternehmen und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem externen IT-Partner zusammen.

Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Product. Mit wachsender Verantwortung kannst du dich in die Rolle des Head of IT für die Buena-Gruppe entwickeln.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du hältst unsere IT in Berlin am Laufen. Du unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen vor Ort, löst technische Probleme und betreust unser UniFi-Netzwerk.

  • Du verantwortest Google Workspace. Du verwaltest Nutzer, Gruppen, Berechtigungen, Shared Drives und Lizenzen und setzt verlässliche Sicherheitseinstellungen um.

  • Du organisierst Ein- und Austritte. Neue Mitarbeitende starten mit eingerichteten Konten und Geräten. Beim Austritt kümmerst du dich um Zugriffsrechte, Datensicherung und die Rücknahme der Hardware.

  • Du verwaltest unsere Geräte. Du betreust Laptops und Mobilgeräte mit NinjaOne sowie Apple-Geräte über den Apple Business Manager und die angebundene Geräteverwaltung.

  • Du verbesserst wiederkehrende Abläufe. Du erkennst unnötige Handarbeit, automatisierst sinnvolle Schritte und dokumentierst Prozesse so, dass andere damit arbeiten können.

  • Du begleitest neue Standorte. Du verschaffst dir einen Überblick über deren IT, planst notwendige Anpassungen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Partner um. Dafür reist du gelegentlich zu unseren Hausverwaltungen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Systemadministration und kannst eine IT-Umgebung eigenständig betreuen.

  • Du kennst Google Workspace gut und hast Erfahrung mit Geräteverwaltung, beispielsweise NinjaOne, Jamf oder Intune.

  • Du bist mit macOS, iOS und dem Apple Business Manager vertraut und verfügst über solide Netzwerkgrundkenntnisse, idealerweise mit UniFi.

  • Du hast bereits einen IT-Prozess verbessert, eine neue Lösung eingeführt oder eine Systemumstellung begleitet und kannst deinen eigenen Beitrag erklären.

  • Du gehst Fehlern systematisch auf den Grund und kannst entscheiden, was zuerst gelöst werden muss.

  • Du erklärst technische Themen verständlich und arbeitest verbindlich mit Mitarbeitenden und externen Dienstleistern zusammen.

  • Du möchtest vor Ort in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg arbeiten, bist zu gelegentlichen Reisen bereit und sprichst sehr gut Deutsch sowie gut Englisch.

Eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist hilfreich. Einschlägige Praxiserfahrung zählt genauso. Führungserfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung; du solltest Lust haben, mit der Aufgabe zu wachsen und zunehmend übergreifende Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Was du bei uns bekommst

  • Verantwortung für einen Bereich, den du aktiv mitgestaltest.

  • Die Perspektive, mit Buena in eine Head-of-IT-Rolle hineinzuwachsen.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Head of Integration und kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Attraktives Gehalt und 500 € „Close-to-Office“-Bonus.

  • MacBook und Studio Display.

  • 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.

  • Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

  • Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro.

Lerne uns kennen.

Im Bewerbungsprozess sprechen wir über Aufgaben und Entscheidungen aus deiner bisherigen Arbeit. Vor Ort lösen wir gemeinsam ein praxisnahes IT-Szenario. Dabei interessiert uns, wie du Probleme eingrenzt, Prioritäten setzt und deine Überlegungen erklärst.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: IT Specialist, London
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

We are seeking a talented IT Specialist to become a key player in delivering an exceptional digital experience to all our employees. In this role, you will provide high-quality technical support across hardware, software, and collaboration tools, ensuring that every user receives fast, reliable, and friendly assistance. You will also take ownership of complex projects such as office openings, moves, and expansions across EMEA and APAC, aligning user support, IT operations, and onboarding processes.

You will troubleshoot complex issues, manage equipment and user accounts, and maintain accurate records of incidents and inventory. You will also guide and train users on best practices, contribute to improving internal IT processes, and help keep our technology environment secure, efficient, and scalable.

If you thrive on helping others, enjoy solving technical challenges, and want to make a meaningful impact in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, this role offers the opportunity to shape and elevate our daily IT excellence.

What You Will Do

User Support and Issue Resolution

  • Provide high-quality technical assistance through email, messaging tools, and in-person interactions.

  • Investigate and resolve hardware and software issues across operating systems, applications, and devices while keeping users informed at every step.

  • Log incidents in our ticketing system, ensure timely follow-ups, and deliver an exceptional support experience.

  • Deliver in-person IT onboarding sessions to ensure employees are fully equipped and ready from day one.

Equipment Setup and Technology Operations

  • Install, configure, and update computers, IT equipment, and videoconferencing systems.

  • Ensure that every team member has the right tools from day one and that our equipment lifecycle remains efficient and organized.

  • Support office openings, moves, and expansions across EMEA and APAC.

Account and License Management

  • Oversee user accounts and application licenses with precision.

  • Ensure proper access management and the consistent application of security policies across all workstations, reinforcing a safe and compliant environment for all users.

Training and Continuous Improvement

  • Train and guide users on applications, hardware, and best practices.

  • Evaluate business needs, propose improvements to IT processes, and contribute to building a smoother and more scalable internal technology ecosystem.

What We're Looking For

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related IT field.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Hands-on experience with Google Workspace administration.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across both macOS and Windows environments.

  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including Ethernet and WiFi protocols, TCP/IP, and basic corporate infrastructure troubleshooting.

  • Familiarity with videoconferencing equipment and associated services.

  • Ability to lift and handle standard IT equipment such as monitors and network devices.

  • Proven experience in a similar IT support role within a fast-paced, global organization.

  • Willingness to travel across EMEA and APAC and work flexibly to support timezone-aligned onboarding.

Bonus:

  • Experience with MDM solutions such as Kandji (Iru) or Jamf.

  • Interest or experience in automation tools such as Zapier or n8n.

title: IT Stage
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende IT-stage waarin je jouw technische kennis in de praktijk kunt brengen én jezelf verder kunt ontwikkelen? Bij Cefetra in Rotterdam hebben we vanaf februari 2027 een stageplek beschikbaar voor een enthousiaste en leergierige IT-student.

wie zijn wij?

Cefetra Group bestaat uit verschillende handelsbedrijven die actief zijn binnen de agrarische sector en de voedingsingrediëntenindustrie, waaronder toonaangevende merken binnen de ingrediëntenmarkt. Samen hebben we ongeveer 800 medewerkers, verspreid over 39 kantoren in 17 landen wereldwijd.

We werken nauw met elkaar samen om onze klanten de best mogelijke service te bieden. Samen met onze leveranciers bouwen we sterke supply chains en creëren we waarde door grondstoffen in te kopen en te leveren aan de internationale voedingsmiddelen-, diervoedings- en energiesector.

Bekijk hier onze corporate video.

De stage

Als IT Support Stagiair(e) word je onderdeel van het IT-team en ondersteun je collega’s bij hun dagelijkse IT-vragen. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor gebruikers en helpt bij het oplossen van technische problemen, zowel op afstand als op kantoor. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van hoe IT-support binnen een internationale organisatie werkt.

Tijdens je stage houd je je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het bieden van eerstelijns IT-support en oplossen van hardware-, software- en netwerkproblemen;

  • Het beheren van gebruikersaccounts, wachtwoorden, licenties en apparaten;

  • Het installeren, configureren en uitgeven van laptops en mobiele telefoons;

  • Het registreren en opvolgen van incidenten en aanvragen via het ticketsysteem.

Daarnaast werk je samen met ervaren IT-specialisten aan projecten op het gebied van infrastructuur, werkplekbeheer en procesverbetering. Hierdoor ontwikkel je niet alleen je technische vaardigheden, maar leer je ook hoe IT een belangrijke bijdrage levert aan de dagelijkse werkzaamheden binnen een internationale handelsorganisatie.

Tijdens je stage maak je ook kennis met de technologieën en systemen die binnen onze IT-omgeving worden gebruikt. Je werkt met Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Intune en Windows Server voor het beheren van gebruikers, apparaten en applicaties. Daarnaast doe je ervaring op met Cisco Meraki voor netwerkbeheer, Citrix voor virtuele werkplekken en applicaties, VMware voor gevirtualiseerde serveromgevingen en TeamViewer voor ondersteuning op afstand.

Zo krijg je een brede kijk op zowel moderne cloudoplossingen als traditionele IT-infrastructuur.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent nieuwsgierig, servicegericht en krijgt energie van het oplossen van technische uitdagingen. Je neemt initiatief, werkt graag samen met anderen en bent niet bang om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

Daarnaast beschik je over analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen, goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ben je flexibel en betrouwbaar. Idealiter herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je volgt momenteel een mbo-opleiding richting ICT, Informatica, Systeem- en Netwerkbeheer of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

  • Je hebt affiniteit met IT-support en systeembeheer;

  • Je bent leergierig en wilt graag praktijkervaring opdoen binnen een professionele IT-omgeving;

  • Je beschikt over basiskennis van Windows, Microsoft 365 en netwerken;

  • Je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken;

  • Je beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal goed.

Wat bieden wij?

Een unieke kans om ervaring op te doen binnen een snelgroeiende, internationale organisatie. Zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid staan centraal binnen onze bedrijfscultuur.

Wij bieden:

  • Een uitdagende stage binnen een internationale organisatie;

  • Begeleiding door ervaren IT-professionals;

  • Veel ruimte om te leren en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Werken met moderne technologieën en professionele IT-omgevingen;

  • Een stagevergoeding van €525 per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Deelname aan Young Cefetra-activiteiten;

  • Een prachtig kantoor in het centrum van Rotterdam, met uitzicht op de Maas en de Erasmusbrug.

Interesse?

Ben jij klaar om jouw IT-kennis in de praktijk te brengen en ervaring op te doen binnen een internationale organisatie? Solliciteer dan hieronder en we nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

Heb je vragen? Neem dan contact op met Jur Lemmers via +31 6 2520 3984 of

We waarderen de interesse, maar we werven al onze kandidaten rechtstreeks. We begrijpen dat u uw kandidaten graag voor onze interessante functies wilt voorstellen, maar dit past niet binnen de manier waarop wij ons wervingsproces hebben ingericht.

title: Laser Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Laser Engineer

This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens.

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, and Innovate UK.

Position Overview

London · Full time · On-site

Pulsed lasers are the heart of satellite laser ranging. You'll own the laser subsystem in our stations: selection, integration and reliability, plus the supply chain behind it.

What you'll do

  • Specify, select and qualify pulsed laser sources with suppliers

  • Integrate lasers into the station, including beam delivery, cooling, power, control and safety interlocks

  • Characterise laser performance, and build test rigs to track it over the station's life

  • Improve reliability so lasers run unattended at remote sites

  • Manage laser damage risk across the optical train with the optics team

  • Support laser safety cases and documentation for each site

What you'll bring

  • Experience working with short-pulse solid-state or fibre lasers, in industry or research

  • Beam characterisation skills: M², pulse width, energy and pointing stability

  • Laser safety knowledge (IEC 60825 or equivalent)

  • Confidence working with suppliers on specifications and failure investigations

Nice to have

  • Satellite laser ranging or lidar experience

  • Laser-induced damage threshold testing

  • Harmonic generation

  • Lasers deployed in the field

What We Offer

  • A high-impact role with real ownership at an early-stage, venture-backed spacetech company

  • EMI share options (UK employees)

  • 25 Days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays

  • Enhanced Parental Leave

  • Cycle to work schemes

  • Work alongside engineers and scientists across optics, lasers, software and astrodynamics

  • Offices in central London, with snacks, tea, coffee and regular socials

We actively champion underrepresented groups and seek to bridge gaps in our workforce. If you're excited by the role but don't match every point, or you’re seeking a part time role, please apply anyway and add a note into your application. Building the best team is our priority.
