title: Operations Manager, Operative Acquisition
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The role

Every parcel through our sort centres is handled by an operative. At peak, we need to hire up to 600 of them a week.

As Operations Manager, Operative Acquisition you'll own operative supply across our sortation sites: enough suitable, trained, compliant and active operatives to fill every shift. You'll build the funnel, reporting and automation that make supply repeatable rather than manual, and keep it ahead of demand as volume rises.

Volumes rise sharply into November and December. Supply, not demand, will be the constraint. This role exists to make sure it isn't.

You'll be the single owner of the operative funnel, working across acquisition (including paid channels), Live Operations, our site teams, and Product and Engineering, who build the integrations the funnel runs on. You'll write SQL, ship automation, and spend time at our sort centres seeing how new starters actually land.

What you'll do

  • Own the operative funnel end to end, from applicant attraction through qualification, training, activation and retention

  • Keep applicant supply ahead of site demand, forecasting how many applicants, training places and sessions are needed and directing spend where gaps exist

  • Improve qualification and compliance, owning Right to Work/KYC and working with Product and Engineering to reduce drop-off and speed up the process

  • Optimise training capacity and waitlists, making sure sessions are filled and candidates stay engaged

  • Get new starters onto shift quickly, supporting activation, shift fill, communications and low-fill processes

  • Reduce cancellations, no-shows and inactivity, using the root causes to improve communications, processes and policies

  • Own operative communications and compliance processes, including waitlist messaging, suspensions, strikes and shift-booking comms

  • Build clear funnel reporting and alerts, tracking volumes, conversion, time to hire and drop-off by site to identify issues early

Who Will Thrive in this role?

  • A growth or operations background. You treat supply as a daily number and act the same day it slips

  • Confident in SQL (BigQuery or similar). You build dashboards from raw data, not static trackers

  • Experience running a high-volume hiring or onboarding funnel, ideally for a frontline workforce

  • A working understanding of Right to Work checks, enough to see how checks and re-checks affect the funnel and operative status. Legal owns the detail, but this can't be a blank

  • Clear writing. You can write processes, requirements and comms that other teams rely on

  • Experience using data to identify trends and improve outcomes”.

Desirable

  • Comfortable with paid acquisition, Google Ads or similar, enough to read performance and brief changes when a site runs short

  • Experience onboarding couriers or drivers at a carrier or delivery platform

  • Experience working with Product and Engineering on integrations or APIs

  • Experience with predictive or candidate-quality modelling

  • Strong forecasting skills and an understanding of seasonality

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay's success

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you'd need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it

  • 25 days of holidays

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Hardware of your choice

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more)

  • Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

descriptionHtml:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Required: Secret clearance

In person in Ramstein, Germany

 

Why This Role Exists

As a Partner Engagement Manager at Onebrief, you're the customer's trusted technical partner. You serve as the subject-matter expert, maintaining power-user-level fluency in the platform. You stay current on product updates, translating new releases into practical impact for the specific workflows your customer relies on. You act as the primary line of communication between the customer and Onebrief — as the product evolves, you deliver ongoing, role-specific training to ensure users adopt new capabilities rather than getting stuck on outdated workflows. You bridge the technical gap between engineering and the customer, explaining product behavior in terms their staff can actually act on.

 

What You’ll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Clearly communicate user needs to the product team. Maintain a high product proficiency, and excite the customer about each product improvement.

  • Understand, request, and effectively leverage Company resources to meet the goals of the Company.

  • Lead or support exercises.

  • Use your observations of our users to recommend product improvements.

  • Identify gaps between existing directorate workflows and effective Onebrief usage, then drive adoption through hands-on configuration, user coaching, and workflow optimization.

  • When responding to incidents (product is unavailable, broken, or not delighting the customer), coordinate with the customer and our product engineering team.

  • Align your team’s efforts to deliver the best customer experience, while coordinating with fellow Partner Engagement Managers to ensure planning and workflows remain synchronized across commands.

  • Enable expansion and upsell opportunities to Allies and Partners by instilling the Onebrief value proposition.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience in leading operational planning within a military context, preferably at multi-star headquarters.

  • Exposure to large staff planning, through classical training in Professional Military Education or through service experience

  • Familiarity and experience with major military planning exercises and the protocols for software deployment on classified networks.

  • Proven ability to expand business presence within a customer location with emphasis on software or technology solutions.

  • Experience in customer support, both face-to-face and remote, and capability to respond to incidents coordinating with customers and product engineering teams.

  • Strong technical skills to master our application, troubleshoot issues and liaise with customers on technical matters.

  • Proven ability to navigate large government organizations, solve bureaucratic challenges, and deliver successful outcomes.

  • You hold a current Secret clearance with eligibility for upgrade to Top Secret and have the ability to access DOD facilities and installations.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • You’re technically adept. You don’t need to code, but you do need to be savvy. Can you become a power user of our product and talk engineering with the customer?

  • Customers trust you. You demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, develop rapport, align diverse perspectives, and communicate with clarity and influence.

  • You’re intense about our mission. It’s a core part of who you are

  • You’re proactive and adaptable. You see a problem and get to work. You’re comfortable working autonomously or in a cross-functional team, especially in a fast-paced or ambiguous setting

  • You communicate clearly, concisely, and candidly. Our Company relies on you to assess the situation within your account and effectively communicate your assessment and recommendations to inform strategic decisions.

 

Indicators of Success

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Partner Engagement Manager will:

  • Opinion and expertise are valued by the customer and company alike (rapport/trust)

  • Learns quick, identifies opportunities and drives progress within the account (Forward-leaning/ bias for action)

  • Open-minded and able to pivot when priorities shift (Adaptability/ Humility)

title: Pega Business Architect / System Architect (m/w/d) – CBA & CSA, Pega Infinity
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software- und IT-Dienstleister mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in einem Team aus Pega-Architekten und -Entwicklern bei einem großen Konzern. Das Team digitalisiert und automatisiert Geschäftsprozesse auf der Pega-Plattform, von der ersten Idee bis zum Betrieb.

  • Fachliche Workshops leiten, Anforderungen aufnehmen und strukturieren
  • Geschäftsprozesse, Workflows und Case-Management-Lösungen in Pega Infinity konzipieren und modellieren
  • Daten-, Entscheidungs- und Geschäftslogik entwerfen und in Pega umsetzen und konfigurieren

  • Pega Blueprint für Konzeption und Lösungsdesign einsetzen

Die Einsätze laufen überwiegend remote. Kundentermine sind meist in Frankfurt, an einzelnen Präsenztagen.

Wo du landest

Je nach Projekt bei Großkonzernen, im öffentlichen Sektor oder bei Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden. Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Was du mitbringst

Das erwarten wir:

  • Zertifikat Pega Certified Business Architect (CBA)
  • Zertifikat Pega Certified System Architect (CSA)
  • Mehr als fünf Jahre Projekterfahrung mit Pega Infinity 8.x oder höher
  • Mehr als drei Jahre Erfahrung als Business Architect in Pega-Projekten

Von Vorteil (kein Muss):

  • Erfahrung mit Pega Blueprint oder Pega GenAI
  • Agile Projektarbeit mit Scrum oder Kanban, Anforderungen in Jira und Confluence
  • Erfahrung als Berater in der Prozessdigitalisierung

Projektsprache ist Deutsch

Du arbeitest im Team des Kunden, überwiegend auf Deutsch. Wir erwarten Deutsch mindestens auf B2-Niveau.

Was wir bieten

  • Überwiegend remote, dazu Büro, wenn du magst
  • MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)
  • Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte
  • Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner

Bewerbung

Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

title: HR Business Partner (m/w/d)

title: People — Employment and Labor Law  (France)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

The Employment & Labour Law role 🇫🇷

Alan is growing fast: new health services, new entities, new countries, and a 2027 People agenda with social elections and many individual situations.

Each of these brings legal obligations, and today we rely mostly on external counsel. In Alan's terms, "compliance" means everything we do to follow a mandatory rule that would become a risk if we got it wrong.

The role makes sure Alan's employment practices are legally secure, pragmatic and humane. You will be our in-house expert on French employment and labour law, for both individual and collective matters. You are a People teammate first, with a strong legal foundation.

Scope

Alan operates in 8 countries.

This role is based in France and covers French employment and labour law.

It works in tandem with the People Compliance owner, who covers the other countries, and with the International Expansion hire for new country openings. Curiosity for other jurisdictions is a plus, but it is not the core of the role.

You will join the People team, work closely with the People Compliance owner, the People lead and the individual situations crew, and be mentored by Alan's Compliance Key Function on how we practise legal topics at Alan.

The People team

The People team is made up of 13 people who work in an environment shaped by Alan's Leadership Principles. Every one of them is a genuine fan of our products (Culture being one of them) and deeply committed to Alan's Prevention and Health mission.

The team covers Learning and Development, Payroll and Admin, Employee Experience and Operational Efficiency, Compliance and Employment Law, Comp and Ben, and M&A and International Expansion.

It is a generalist team: everyone shares core missions, including individual situation management and HRBP responsibilities. Then each person owns one or more cross-functional topics depending on their flavour. In your case: French employment and labour law.

Your missions

On top of the core missions shared across the People team, you will work on a diverse range of high-impact topics:

  • Employment law expertise: be the go-to person on French individual and collective employment law, with a strong focus on working time, night work and on-call rules (astreinte, rest periods), where the rules are strict and a creative, well-grounded approach makes a difference.

  • Legal watch: monitor French labour-law changes, flag what matters for Alan, and use AI agents for legal watch and ongoing compliance checks.

  • Obligations register: turn obligations into simple tools and processes, tracked in a register.

  • Health and safety at work.

  • Audits and inspections: support labour inspections, URSSAF audits and the related compliance reporting.

  • Social dialogue: support the People lead in preparing CSE information-consultations, running the 2027 social elections, and drafting and updating company agreements (working time, profit-sharing, agreements for new services).

  • Corporate structure: work through the People impact of Alan's evolving legal entities, such as which entities sit in the UES and what it means for our agreements.

  • New services: bring a risk-based view early to projects with People impact, such as new health services, and help set up processes that protect Alan while keeping the flexibility and autonomy we want Alaners to have.

  • External counsel: write clear briefs, ask sharper questions, reuse existing frameworks and challenge the advice you receive.

  • Beyond France (occasionally): contribute, when needed, to topics in other countries, alongside the People Compliance owner.

  • Raising the team's expertise: share your legal knowledge with the crew and the wider People team.

  • AI and automation: use them to multiply the impact of your work.

Outcomes within your first months in the team

By 2.5 months

  • You have contributed to a live CSE topic (e.g. preparing an information-consultation) and to at least one other live topic (e.g. working-time or on-call policy, an agreement for a new service).

  • You have shadowed and been reverse-shadowed on individual situation management.

By 5 months

  • You own CSE information-consultations end to end, and a workstream such as a company agreement, with the crew as a sounding board.

  • You are involved in preparing the 2027 social elections.

  • You handle French individual situations without supervision, including the legal analysis.

  • A first legal-watch automation is running.

  • Crew members and leads come to you as the go-to expert on French employment law.

Is this what you are looking for?

You may be a great fit for this role if:

  • You have a legal background in French employment and social law (e.g. M2 in droit social).

  • You have around 4+ years of hands-on experience applying French employment law, typically in a law firm (ideally international), or you are a lawyer who has already moved into a People role.

  • You master both individual and collective matters.

  • You are excellent in French (negotiation level) and professional in English (our internal processes and documentation are in English).

  • You put context before opinion: you understand how Alan works first, then adapt the playbook instead of applying it as is.

  • You put business value before legal reflex: you start from the outcome and creative options, tell material risk from theoretical risk, and give practical answers. You are comfortable with a scale-up's risk appetite.

  • You have a transversal mindset: a strong anchor in labour law, and real appetite to cover compliance, expansion and other topics.

  • You are autonomous: you take initiative, flag risks early and own your outputs.

  • You are rigorous: your work is precise and your writing is clear and concise.

  • You are curious and coachable: open to feedback, with a clear idea of what you want to learn.

  • You are AI-enthusiastic: you already use AI in your daily work and stay critical of the output.

  • You show judgement and discretion with confidential information and sensitive human situations.

Nice-to-have

We are not looking for all of the below. Any one of these can be a strong signal.

  • Hands-on experience with CSE meetings, information-consultations, social elections or company agreements.

  • Experience in the health sector, insurance, a regulated environment or a scale-up.

  • M&A or reorganisation experience.

  • Exposure to other jurisdictions (Belgium, Spain).

Level range

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0 - D level range.

title: People Operations Specialist
descriptionHtml:
If you've been looking to join a fast-growing startup with a bold vision, exciting challenges and the opportunity to make a genuine difference in the world, you've found the right place.

Backed by General Catalyst, the investors behind companies like Stripe and Airbnb, we're building something extraordinary.


Our Mission 🌎

At Goodstack, our mission is to revolutionize how the world does good. We envision a world where doing good is built into everything we do.

As a fast-growing, AI-native social impact startup, we're building the technology and infrastructure that connects businesses and good causes, making it easier to give, grow and create meaningful impact at scale.

We do this in two ways:

  • Goodstack for Business helps some of the world's leading companies power their social impact programmes.

  • Goodstack for Causes helps nonprofits access the funding, technology and resources they need to thrive.

And we're already making a difference:

  • $11 billion in donations facilitated since 2022.

  • Over 13 million mission-driven organisations in the world's largest verified database.

  • 500,000+ nonprofits on our platform, with thousands more joining every week.

  • Trusted by global companies including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Open AI, Canva, TikTok and Airbnb, alongside nonprofits such as the Red Cross, Cancer Research UK and Oxfam.


What We're Building Next 🚀

We're entering an exciting new chapter: evolving beyond software into an AI-native business that delivers meaningful outcomes for businesses and nonprofits worldwide.

By combining AI, automation and human expertise, we're building a future where companies can manage global giving programmes more seamlessly, and nonprofits can access funding faster and more efficiently.

Our ambition is bold, and the challenges are complex. We're looking for curious, ambitious and AI-native thinkers who take ownership, challenge assumptions and use technology creatively to solve meaningful problems.

That's where you come in 🫵

Join us as People Operations Specialist and help us build a People function that’s simple, dependable, and able to scale!

💜 We are considering applications for both permanent and contract employment 💜


We're looking for someone to join us in building the next chapter of our People function at Goodstack.

Over the past four years, we've grown more than 8x, from 22 to around 200 Goodstackers across multiple countries. It's been an incredible journey, and with that kind of growth comes a whole lot of interesting challenges.

We've built a strong foundation, but there's plenty of opportunity to make the experience of working at Goodstack even better.

We're looking for someone who enjoys People Operations, gets satisfaction from making complicated things simple, and cares just as much about the little details as the bigger picture. Someone who understands good HR practices, takes ownership, asks thoughtful questions and doesn't wait to be told what needs doing.

In this role, you'll have plenty of autonomy, the opportunity to shape how we work, and a close partnership with the Head of People as we continue scaling the function.


✍️ A note from the Head of People:

Hey, future Goodstacker! 👋

I don't expect you to know everything (who does?), but I do expect you to know your HR foundations, bring good judgement, take ownership and stay curious.

And if you're the kind of person who gets a little too excited about a beautifully organised process, I have a feeling we'll get along brilliantly!


As People Operations Specialist, your mission will be:

Making the Goodstacker experience brilliant

  • Own the end-to-end employee lifecycle, from onboarding and employment changes to offboarding, ensuring every experience is smooth, organised and thoughtful.

  • Prepare and quality-check employment contracts, amendments and other documentation, ensuring accuracy and alignment with applicable employment requirements.

  • Keep our People systems, employee records and documentation accurate, organised and up to date.

  • Be the go-to person for day-to-day People questions, providing sound HR guidance, resolving routine matters independently and escalating more complex issues.

  • Partner with Talent, Finance, IT, managers and external providers to ensure smooth coordination across teams.

Keeping global People operations running smoothly

  • Coordinate payroll inputs, deadlines, employee benefits and employment changes across our locations.

  • Manage the operational administration of our international Employer of Record (EOR) arrangements.

  • Support right-to-work checks, immigration and sponsorship administration.

  • Apply HR policies and employment best practices consistently, identifying compliance risks and escalating them early.

  • Keep on top of statutory deadlines and employment obligations, working with external specialists when needed.

Making things better as we grow

  • Coordinate the operational delivery of performance reviews, progression and compensation cycles.

  • Maintain People reporting, policies, templates and internal documentation.

  • Use your HR knowledge to identify gaps in our processes and recommend practical improvements.

  • Find opportunities to simplify workflows and use AI and automation to eliminate repetitive work.


What success looks like:

  • Every new Goodstacker has what they need before Day 1 and feels welcomed from the start.

  • Contracts, payroll inputs, employee changes and records are accurate and delivered on time.

  • Our people and managers can count on you for reliable advice, clear answers and helpful support.

  • You apply sound HR judgement, spot risks early and resolve routine matters without constant oversight.

  • Our People processes run smoothly, with fewer manual steps and less time spent chasing admin.

  • You proactively identify opportunities to strengthen compliance, consistency and the employee experience.

  • Ultimately, you're creating the operational reliability that allows us to spend more time improving the experience of working at Goodstack.


This role is a perfect match for you if you have:

  • 3+ years of hands-on People / HR Ops experience, ideally in a growing, international business.

  • A formal qualification in Human Resources Management, People-related degree, CIPD, or an equivalent recognised professional qualification.

  • A solid understanding of UK employment legislation and HR best practices, with the confidence to apply your knowledge to everyday People matters.

  • Experience preparing employment documentation, managing employee lifecycle processes and supporting payroll and benefits administration.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when handling contracts, payroll, employee data and anything where accuracy really matters.

  • Strong organisational skills and follow-through, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.

  • Experience with UK HR administration, alongside exposure to international employment or EOR arrangements.

  • Confidence working with People systems, spreadsheets and payroll processes, with a strong understanding of confidentiality and data handling.

  • Sound judgement and ownership, knowing how to solve problems independently and when to ask for support.

  • Clear, kind communication and a genuine interest in helping people.

  • An AI-native mindset, using AI, automation and technology thoughtfully to simplify work, improve accuracy and increase efficiency.


Bonus if you have:

  • Worked in a fast-growing startup and enjoy building things as you go.

  • Experience automating People Ops workflows.

  • A soft spot for a good cup of tea or smoothie 🫖.

🇬🇧 What you can expect upon joining our team

💰 Salary reviews and share options becoming an integral part of our growth and share in the company's success

💝 Goodstack’s Workplace Giving

⚕️ Vitality Plus - Private health insurance

🌞 £250 Brighten your day annual budget

📚 Goodstack library

🌯 Tasty Tuesday! Office lunch is on the company

🏃🏿‍♀️ Slow run club Wednesday

⭐️ Paid days off to volunteer for non-profit causes

🎤 Paid days to attend conferences

🏡 You're always welcome to pop in more often if you enjoy the buzz of being in the office. It's a warm, friendly space right in the heart of London

🙌 … and so much more


About us

Since 2017, Goodstack has been at the forefront of creating a future where good will be built into everything we do. From daily commutes to weekend activities or grocery shopping, we envision a world where creating positive change is seamlessly integrated into our everyday lives. In this future, the depth and breadth of impact we can make through everyday actions will expand dramatically – benefiting both businesses and the world.

Businesses are expected to deliver on both profit and purpose and those that don’t are falling behind. We’re here to make it easy for any company, anywhere in the world, to integrate good into what they do. Doing this empowers everyone – companies, employees, consumers, and communities – to contribute to positive change and take meaningful action.

Let's do this! 💜

OUR PLEDGE TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

We take pride in our diverse and growing team representing 20+ nationalities across 5 continents 🌍! Our continued expansion provides us with opportunities to embrace and celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, essential to our success. We actively seek and welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

A team that represents the world that we are trying to support is a wiser, more knowledgeable and stronger one. We’re excited for you to bring your experience, yourself and your special lemon twist to Goodstack to propel us forward in striving to create a better world for us all.

title: People Operations Working Student (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a People Operations Working Student for a 6-month contract to our People Operations team in Berlin, Germany!

This role is to join our People Operations team, dedicated to delivering an exceptional employee experience across Europe. In this role, you will contribute to meaningful People initiatives and gain valuable exposure to key HR topics(e.g. employment law and payroll). You will also gainvaluable exposure to driving efficient operations at scale. You will have the opportunity to learn and apply analytical problem-solving, a process-oriented mindset, stakeholder management and AI automation to elevate our HR systems (e.g., Personio) and workflows… all within a dynamic, international environment. Whilst you will be based in Germany, you will be working on operations across European markets.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Employee Care: Respond thoughtfully to employee queries, ensuring quick, effective resolutions and an exceptional day-to-day experience for our team.
  • Process Mindset & Execution: Ensure high accuracy and operational efficiency in core HR processes (e.g. maintaining Personio data, payroll) by following clear procedures.
  • Solution-Oriented Problem Solving: Challenge the status quo by focusing on solutions rather than getting bogged down in problems. Use data and a process mindset to proactively identify ways to optimize workflows and leverage automation to better serve our employees at scale.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You are currently enrolled in a university, your specific degree subject matter does not matter but an interest in HR, Finance and operations is a plus
  • You are available at least 15h/week (max. 20 hours)
  • A fluent communicator with C1+ level proficiency in both written and spoken German and English.
  • A Berlin-based candidate who can work on-site from our Head Office 2–3 times per week.
  • A discreet professional with a proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with high integrity.
  • A self-driven, adaptable, and collaborative team player with excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • A proactive learner passionate about employee experience, eager to develop skills in data-driven problem solving, project management, stakeholder management, and operations across Europe.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that current university enrollment and fluency in German and English (C1+) are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. title: Performance Marketing Manager - Native Ads (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

At Sunday Natural, we’re on a mission to bring premium wellness products to millions of customers across Europe. As we accelerate our growth, we are expanding our acquisition strategy and exploring new ways to connect with customers.

As our Performance Marketing Manager – Native Ads (all genders), you will help build and scale Native Advertising as a new acquisition channel, combining creative storytelling, data-driven campaign management and end-to-end funnel optimisation to drive sustainable growth.

  

Your role:

You will take ownership of our Native Advertising campaigns, from developing compelling ad creatives and advertorials to managing campaigns across platforms such as Taboola and Outbrain and Meta.

Combining creative execution with analytical excellence, you will build, test and optimise entire conversion funnels, leveraging AI-powered tools, performance tracking and continuous experimentation to turn engaging content into measurable business results.

Your mandate: Establish Native Advertising as a scalable, high-performing acquisition channel – transforming creative ideas and data-driven insights into sustainable customer growth.

  

Your Responsibilities & Impact

Native Advertising & Campaign Optimisation

  • Channel Development: Establish and scale Native Advertising as a new customer acquisition channel, identifying growth opportunities and shaping its strategy.

  • Campaign Ownership: Independently plan, launch and manage campaigns on platforms such as Taboola and Outbrain, continuously optimising targeting, placements and budgets to maximise profitability.


Creative Development & Conversion Funnels

  • Creative Strategy & Execution: Independently develop compelling ad creatives, headlines and visuals that capture attention and drive engagement.

  • Advertorial Content Creation: Create persuasive, conversion-focused advertorials, long-form articles and landing page content that turn readers into customers.

  • Funnel Optimisation & AI: Analyse and improve the entire customer journey, leveraging AI-powered tools to accelerate content creation and experimentation.

  • Responsible Communication: Ensure advertising content complies with brand standards and applicable health-claim regulations, collaborating with internal experts as needed.


Analytics, Tracking & Collaboration

  • Tracking & Attribution: Set up and optimise tracking across campaigns, advertorials and landing pages to ensure reliable performance measurement.

  • Performance Analytics & Reporting: Analyse campaign data, build dashboards and translate insights into actionable improvements using Google Analytics or comparable tools.

  • Testing & Experimentation: Develop data-driven hypotheses, run structured A/B tests and continuously optimise creatives, content and conversion journeys.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Performance Marketing, CRO and external agency partners to develop and scale successful campaigns.

What You Bring:

  • Education & Analytical Foundation: Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, developed through education and/or professional experience.

  • Industry and Channel Know-How: 2–3+ years of hands-on experience in Native Advertising / Performance Marketing, gained in an agency or in-house environment. Proven expertise in managing and optimising campaigns on platforms such as Taboola, Outbrain, Meta or comparable networks. Experience in B2C/D2C, particularly nutrition, food, supplements or wellness, is a strong plus.

  • Creative & Content Expertise: Strong copywriting and storytelling skills, with hands-on experience creating conversion-focused advertorials, ad creatives and landing page content.

  • Analytical Mindset & Reporting: You confidently analyse performance data, understand tracking and attribution, and translate insights into actionable improvements. Experience with Voluum or comparable tracking and reporting tools is a strong plus.

  • AI & Automation: You are confident using AI-powered tools to create, test and optimise advertising content and creative assets.

  • Conversion Focus: You understand how creatives, advertorials, landing pages and customer journeys influence conversion rates and campaign profitability.

  • Ownership & Initiative: You work independently, proactively identify opportunities and enjoy building and scaling new initiatives with measurable impact.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams, communicate insights clearly and manage external partners effectively.

  • Language Skills: Excellent German (C1 level), including strong copywriting skills, and strong English communication skills.

What we offer:

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

title: Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wie ontwerpt het fundament waarop soevereine cloudplatformen kunnen bouwen?

Iedere organisatie die naar schaalbare, soevereine Cloudinfrastructuur beweegt, botst vroeg of laat op dezelfde vraag: wie zorgt dat die infrastructuur betrouwbaar, reproduceerbaar en toekomstbestendig is, zonder in te leveren op controle en portabiliteit? Als Platform Engineer is dat jouw vraagstuk.

De uitdaging

Als Platform Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers zoals Defensie, KLM en ASML, aan complexe infrastructuurvraagstukken op seniorniveau. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert Cloudinfrastructuur en CI/CD-pipelines, geeft vorm aan platformarchitecturen, zoals het deployen van Mendix op Kubernetes-clusters binnen Europese cloudomgevingen, en zet Kubernetes-clusters op binnen Europese Cloudproviders als STACKIT, OVH en Scaleway of binnen private Cloudomgevingen. Met Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld Terraform, maak je infrastructuren reproduceerbaar en schaalbaar. Je werkt nauw samen met software-, data- en AI-engineers, en met klanten om infrastructuurbehoeften te vertalen naar betrouwbare oplossingen, met oog voor soevereiniteit, autonomie en portabiliteit.

Je plek: de Platform Engineering squad

Je landt in de Platform Engineering squad, waar collega's elkaar scherp houden op technische keuzes en architectuur. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag, waarop we tijd vrijmaken voor kennisdeling, leren en verbinden met de rest van LINKIT.

Lees hier meer over de Platform Engineering squad.


Wat we vragen

  • Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring in een DevOps-, Platform Engineering- of infrastructuurrol, bij voorkeur binnen de Nederlandse overheid.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met containers en orchestratieplatformen zoals Kubernetes en Docker, gecombineerd met CI/CD-tooling zoals GitHub Actions, GitLab CI of Jenkins, en Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld Terraform.

  • Ervaring met cloud-agnostisch werken binnen publieke en private cloudomgevingen, waaronder Europese providers als STACKIT, OVH en Scaleway en platformen zoals OpenStack.

  • Ervaring met automatisering en scripting, met tools en talen zoals Python, Go, Ansible en/of Chef.

  • Kennis van netwerken, beveiliging en observability binnen cloud-native en on-premise omgevingen.

  • Affiniteit met open-source tooling en moderne data-infrastructuren, zoals datapipelines, datawarehouses, lakehouses en MLOps.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt

  • Salaris tussen €4.300-€6.700 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

  • Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

  • Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

  • Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

  • Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop + telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

  • Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de 'clubdag').

  • Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten,, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

Sollicitatieprocedure

We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.

  1. Kennismaking: een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

  2. Verdiepende gesprekken: twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

  3. Aanbieding: als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

Wil je alvast meer weten? Neem gerust contact op met Tabea via

Over LINKIT

LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. title: Pricing Engine Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Akur8 is one of the leading providers of insurance pricing and rating technology. Our mission is to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk.

Our SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and rating technology to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems. Insurers use it to model and rate risk up to 10x faster while keeping transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust.

As the product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform for pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions.

Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:

  • CB Insights' Insurtech 50 (2025)

  • CNBC's InsurTech Top 150 (2025)

  • InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)

  • Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025)


Akur8 has 50+ nationalities across 8 global offices and serves 420+ clients across 4 continents. We’re an equal opportunities employer, and we value the different perspectives that help shape better products and decisions.

Deploy is Akur8’s stateless rating engine, delivering subsecond insurance premium computations across a wide range of industry use cases.

It sits at the intersection of two key functions in insurance. Actuaries extract insights from data and make the statistical decisions that shape the business. IT teams, in turn, build and maintain the reliable systems that put those decisions into production.

Today, these two worlds operate with different skills, priorities and tools, connected through slow, manual handoffs between teams.

Deploy replaces this process with a shared foundation that aligns actuarial and IT teams and reduces time-to-market. Building it requires a deep understanding of how both functions are organised, what each is trying to achieve, and the complex ecosystem behind an insurance product and its pricing. This is what makes the role both dynamic and challenging.

At Akur8, we value a builder mindset. We embrace the AI revolution by providing the right tools and removing barriers, so that everyone contributing to product development maximises their impact.

We’re looking for a Pricing Engine Product Manager to join the Deploy team, a cross-functional role focused on solving problems and rapid delivery of results to our customers.

To succeed, you’ll build a solid understanding of how the different parts of our platform interact, allow you to abstract customer problems into a clear framework, turning complex challenges into clean solutions.

We’re interested in people who are motivated by solving problems and comfortable diving deep into the details. You take innovative approaches to find intuitive solutions to seemingly complex problems.

You also share our builder mindset, and you get excited about delivering fast iterations on difficult challenges.

Main responsibilities

  • Continuously deepening your understanding of actuarial ratemaking and IT deployment challenges, including product models and Policy Admin System design.

  • Working at pace, with short iteration cycles, to shape user flows and prototypes that tackle complex API management and distil insurance complexity into clean, opinionated solutions.

  • Defining frameworks and approaches that address user pain points, prioritising what matters and setting aside what doesn’t.

  • Leading user interviews to build a thorough understanding of end users’ challenges and objectives.

For this key role within our Product Management team we’re keen to speak to applicants that meet the following criteria.

  • A Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative discipline

  • 3+ years experience in either the P&C insurance industry or with products managing, defining and orchestrating high performant API connections and integrations.

  • Excellent quantitative & analytical skills

  • Proficient in leveraging LLM tools - and with a product builder mindset focused on delivering fast paced iteration of prototypes

  • Very strong problem solving skills with a focus on providing and creating robust solutions

Research has consistently shown that one-on-one tutoring dramatically outperforms traditional classroom instruction—a finding known as Bloom's 2 Sigma Problem. Despite decades of awareness, no solution has successfully delivered personalized tutoring at scale. Until now.

At DataCamp, we seek individuals who embody our core values of data-driven decision-making, action, transparency, ownership, and customer focus. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing environment and are driven by a passion for making a meaningful impact. You're adaptable, embracing change and ambiguity with enthusiasm. Your initiative and entrepreneurial spirit push you beyond just meeting targets—you aim to understand the "why" behind our goals and take ownership to drive the business forward. You’re a collaborative team player who values transparency and always seeks to improve and innovate. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!

Responsibilities

  • Build and evolve the core AI tutoring system, including prompt architectures, agentic workflows, and real-time adaptive behaviors.

Why Datacamp? 

Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you’ll love being on our team:

Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else.

You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for.

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.

YOUR MISSION

Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll:

  • Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next

  • Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it

  • Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before

  • Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool

  • Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions

YOUR PROFILE

You'll feel at home here if:

  • You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course

  • You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself

  • Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways

  • You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through

  • You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data

  • When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it

Bonus points for:

title: Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Every business is using AI. The ones that get it right start with real people. GWI is the human intelligence underneath: verified data that helps businesses understand what moves their audience, and act on it faster. If you want your work to matter, keep reading.


What will I be doing? 

As our Product Designer you’ll design how people and AI agents get to GWI data, working in a cross-functional squad alongside Product and Engineering.

Right now our biggest need is agentic, API and MCP. Customers reach GWI through agents, integrations and workflows as well as our platform, so you’ll shape the experiences built on our MCP servers and APIs: how a developer connects to an endpoint, how an agent calls a tool and gets a trustworthy answer, and how a person stays in control when it goes wrong. That’s where you’ll start, but there’s room to work in other squads and domains as our priorities change.

A few things you’ll be responsible for:

  • Taking problems from discovery through to delivery, partnering with Product Managers, Engineers and Data teams.
  • Designing the experiences around our MCP servers and APIs (onboarding, authentication, tool and endpoint discovery, error handling, usage and permissions) and improving the workflows that take developers, analysts and AI agents to trusted data.
  • Designing for agents and machines as well as people, working with Engineering on tools, schemas, naming and error messages so the machine-facing and human-facing sides feel like one product.
  • Using AI to speed up discovery, design and delivery, and prototyping with working code and live APIs so ideas get tested early.
  • Contributing to our design system: proposing, designing and documenting components and patterns, including agentic and API-led ones, and working with Engineering to implement them consistently.
  • Contributing to developer-facing content such as documentation, quickstarts and example flows.

Working at GWI means a high tempo environment where change is common. We’re building quickly because the industry is moving quickly, and our customers rely on us to stay ahead. If you like being part of that, you’ll enjoy it here.


What do I need to bring with me? 

You’ll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires. You don’t have to tick all the boxes right away; the important thing is that you’re willing to learn.

  • Fluency with AI tools: you use them to prototype quickly, ideally against live APIs or in code, as well as to speed up research and design.
  • Strong design system knowledge: you’ve built or extended components and patterns, written usage guidance, and helped keep a product consistent.
  • Some experience with API or MCP workflows, or agentic products (or a strong appetite to learn fast), and an understanding of how APIs work (REST, authentication, rate limits, schemas, errors) and how they shape the experience.
  • A solid product design and UX foundation, with a good grasp of interaction design and usability, and comfort in complex, technical product environments.
  • Strong problem-solving and systems thinking: you break problems down, land on clear solutions, and see how a tool, an API response or an agent interaction fits into the wider journey.
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and a collaborative, proactive approach that makes the team around you better.
  • Independence within your squad, the judgement to seek input on the more ambiguous challenges, and the curiosity to pick things up quickly and adapt when priorities change.
  • Proficiency with Figma, FigJam and Jira, and experience using qualitative and quantitative insights to inform decisions.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing developer tools, API documentation or developer portals.
  • Hands-on experience building MCP servers.
  • Experience with data products, analytics or market research platforms.
  • Experience with a design system that covers non-visual patterns, such as API error messaging, agent interaction states or developer documentation.
  • A track record of introducing a new process, tool or practice that your team adopted.
  • Experience running lightweight research with technical users, such as developers and data analysts.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on a problem few teams have solved: designing how AI agents and developers get to trusted data through our MCP servers and APIs.
  • Help set the patterns. You’ll shape how agentic and API-led experiences work at GWI and contribute to our design system, so your decisions carry across the product.
  • Room to move. You’ll start in agentic, API and MCP, with the option to work in other squads and domains as our priorities change.
  • A hybrid setup, with 2 days a week in our London office.

Weekly office requirement: 2 days

Seniority level: Intermediate to Senior

As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to making adjustments throughout the hiring process—whether that's extra time, materials in advance or a different format, breaks, an adjusted interview format, assistive tools, or flexible scheduling. title: Product Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

The Role

We are hiring a Product Lead to own our Express / Mid-prime personal loan product, one of our highest-priority growth areas. This is unsecured personal lending in the higher-APR mid-prime space (30% to 50% APR), with loans typically from £2,000 to £10,000, and customers acquired primarily through price-comparison and aggregator marketplaces. Our ambition is to grow this product many times over while improving its economics, and this role owns the product that makes that happen.

This is a product role first. You will own the Express/Mid-prime proposition end to end: who we serve, how we quote and present offers on marketplaces, how the journey converts, how we price, and how the product performs once the loans are on the book. What makes it different from a typical product role is that the product is credit. The levers that drive growth, such as eligibility, pricing, offer design and underwriting, are the same levers that drive loss rates, so you need to be comfortable working with risk and data science rather than handing that part off.

We think this is a great role for someone with around four to five years of experience who has built a strong foundation in lending or fintech, has worked hands-on with data and credit decisioning, and is ready to own a product outright rather than a slice of one. You will set the direction for the segment, run the roadmap, and be accountable for the results, with the backing of experienced risk, data science and commercial leaders around you.

Our decisioning is built on Open Banking and cashflow underwriting rather than credit scores alone. For a higher-APR population acquired through marketplaces, seeing real affordability is what lets us select and price better than the market. The interesting product problem is that richer data comes at a cost to conversion, so the job is to capture that data advantage while designing a journey and offer that customers actually complete.

The defining challenge is balance: scaling volume by an order of magnitude while building a book of genuinely good credit quality. The best people in this space know that those two goals can be reconciled rather than traded off, and are curious enough to work out how.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the Express / Mid-prime product: proposition, roadmap, performance and economics, with direct accountability for the balance between growth and credit quality.

  • Lead how we quote and present offers across aggregator and price-comparison marketplaces, optimising eligibility, risk-based pricing and offer presentation to win the right customers at the point of acquisition.

  • Own conversion through the journey, from quote to disbursal, including how we ask customers for Open Banking data and how that affects drop-off and the quality of the book.

  • Understand and actively manage adverse selection in marketplace-acquired lending, shaping offer, pricing and decisioning strategy to attract the customers we want and screen out the risk we do not.

  • Work with data science to make sure our credit models are calibrated and tuned for this population rather than inherited unchanged from prime or adjacent segments, and be able to get into the data yourself when needed.

  • Use credit and commercial insight to optimise unit economics, balancing approval rates, pricing, loss rates and volume so the product scales profitably.

  • Monitor product and portfolio performance across the customer lifecycle, spotting emerging trends, risks and opportunities early.

  • Shape underwriting strategy, segmentation, credit policy and decisioning logic in partnership with risk and data science.

  • Design and evaluate experiments and strategy changes, and turn the analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Own the management information for the segment: define the metrics, monitoring and reporting that let the business make consistent decisions about the product.

  • Assess new initiatives, customer segments and product changes with both a commercial and a credit lens.

  • Present clear, structured updates on product performance to senior leadership and governance forums, and support funding and due diligence conversations where the product is in focus.

Who you are

  • A product person at heart: you care about the customer, the journey and the commercial outcome, and you want to own something end to end.

  • Quantitative and hands-on. You are comfortable in SQL and Python (or similar), you can interrogate a dataset yourself, and you can hold your own in a conversation with data scientists about model performance and calibration.

  • Credit-literate. You understand how eligibility, pricing and underwriting decisions shape the book you end up with, and you have a working understanding of adverse selection and why it matters in marketplace lending.

  • Commercially sharp, with a solid grasp of unit economics and a clear understanding that product decisions in lending have to work for both growth and portfolio performance.

  • Curious about trade-offs rather than defensive about them: alert to the fact that deeper affordability assessment can hurt conversion, and motivated by the challenge of capturing its value without sacrificing growth.

  • Able to move between detail and direction: happy getting into the data on a Tuesday and shaping the roadmap on a Wednesday.

  • Confident challenging assumptions and turning analysis into practical action, and able to explain your reasoning clearly to people who are not analysts.

  • Collaborative and credible with risk, commercial, engineering and data science teams.

  • Structured, proactive and comfortable in a scaling environment where priorities evolve quickly and ownership is expected.

Experience and background

  • Around four to five years of experience in product, credit strategy, analytics or a closely related role within consumer lending or fintech. We are deliberately targeting this level: this is a step-up role for someone ready to own a product, not a lateral move for someone who has run several.

  • Experience in unsecured consumer lending, ideally Unsecured Personal Loans (UPL), with exposure to the mechanics of acquiring customers through price-comparison or aggregator marketplaces. Direct experience in higher-APR or near-prime lending is a strong plus but not a prerequisite.

  • Hands-on data skills: SQL as a minimum, and ideally Python or R for analysis. You do not need to be a data scientist, but you need to be able to work alongside them as a peer and do your own analysis.

  • Experience working with or alongside credit decisioning, scorecards or risk models, and an understanding of how they are built, monitored and adjusted for a specific population.

  • Some experience of pricing, eligibility or offer design, and of using experiments or A/B tests to evaluate changes.

  • A track record of using analysis to influence decisions, not just to report on outcomes, in a role where you had some accountability for commercial results.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders.

  • Experience with Open Banking data or cashflow underwriting is a plus, as is experience in a fast-growing fintech.

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering
