About the Role

As a Product Manager at Reachdesk, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the Reachdesk Platform. You will be accountable for turning complex customer and business problems into software products that deliver measurable impact.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll lead product initiatives end-to-end,  from identifying and deeply understanding the right problems to solve, through discovery and delivery, to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively building context across customers, the market, internal stakeholders, data, and technology to understand what Reachdesk needs to achieve its goals. You’ll also make sound decisions when the path forward isn’t obvious.

You’ll partner closely with Engineering and Design and work across the wider business to create alignment, communicate decisions clearly, and ensure what we build is successfully launched, adopted, and delivers the outcomes we set out to achieve.

If you enjoy solving difficult problems, taking ownership, and moving comfortably between customer, technical, and business conversations, you’ll thrive in this role.

Responsibilities

  • Set product direction and priorities, bringing together company goals, internal stakeholder needs, customer insight, market context, data, and technical considerations to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Define problems and experiences before solutions, creating clear stories, journeys, and shared context so the Design and Engineering teams understand the problem and intended outcomes before determining the solution.
  • Lead product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and solution definition through delivery, rollout, and iteration, partnering with Engineering to manage scope, make pragmatic trade-offs, and deliver valuable solutions at pace.
  • Make sound product decisions and trade-offs, balancing customer and business needs, commercial impact, user experience, and technical considerations while aligning the wider business on compromises, priorities, and expectations.
  • Develop product opportunities with external partners, building relationships with technology partners to uncover mutual opportunities, shape integrations, align roadmaps, and navigate the product and commercial considerations required to bring them to market.
  • Orchestrate successful launches and adoption, working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and other teams to ensure the business is ready and customers realise value from what we build.
  • Communicate with clarity throughout, ensuring leadership and teams across Reachdesk understand product decisions, progress, risks, changes, and results.

About you

  • You have a strong track record of owning B2B SaaS products end-to-end, from identifying the right problems through delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • You’re a strong problem solver who gets to the root of complex problems, brings structure to ambiguity, and uses evidence and judgement to determine the right path forward.
  • You operate with independence and initiative: you seek out the customers, stakeholders, data, and context you need rather than waiting for direction, while staying anchored to Reachdesk’s goals and priorities.
  • You have strong business and commercial awareness and are curious about how the wider company operates, allowing you to understand competing needs and make pragmatic decisions beyond the boundaries of Product.
  • You’re technically fluent enough to work effectively with Engineering, understand systems, integrations, and constraints, ask the right questions, and contribute meaningfully to solution and scope decisions.
  • You’re an exceptional communicator, able to create clarity, influence decisions, surface difficult trade-offs, and adapt how you communicate across customers, engineers, leadership, and teams throughout the business.
  • You’re comfortable operating externally as well as internally, building productive relationships with technology partners, uncovering shared opportunities, influencing without authority, and navigating product, technical, and commercial conversations.
  • You have a strong sense of product and user experience, caring about the coherence and quality of the complete experience rather than whether individual requirements or features have simply been delivered.

The benefits

  • Competitive salary with generous stock options
  • Pension with employer contributions (NEST)
  • Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care
  • Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments
  • A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people

Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

title: Product manager - gestion des projets (CDI)
descriptionHtml:
🧱 À propos de Bricks

Chez Bricks, on construit la façon la plus simple d’investir dans l’immobilier, à partir de 10 €. 670 000+ membres, un produit régulé (PSFP) et une même exigence sur toute l’expérience : permettre d’investir simplement mais aussi de suivre son investissement dans la durée.

Bricks est une plateforme à deux faces : d’un côté les investisseurs, de l’autre les porteurs de projets immobiliers. Deux communautés à accompagner et faire grandir en parallèle.

Ce qui se passe après le financement d’un projet compte donc autant que le moment où l’on investit : qualité de l’information, transparence, suivi des projets et gestion des situations plus complexes participent directement à l’expérience des deux côtés de la plateforme.

Quelques jalons d’une aventure assez unique : passage chez Capital (M6) en 2022, Tony Parker investisseur et ambassadeur, record européen de vitesse de levée : 5 M€ en 5 secondes, 20 M€+ en 10 jours auprès de notre communauté.

Côté business : 176 M€ collectés en 2025, +90 % en un an et la rentabilité atteinte. Notre prochain enjeu : scaler à grande échelle sans perdre la vélocité qui fait aujourd’hui partie de notre manière de travailler.

Chez Bricks, on attend de chacun qu’il comprenne vraiment les problèmes avant de chercher à les résoudre. L’objectif : prendre les bonnes décisions et construire des solutions utiles.

Sur ce poste, ton travail aura un impact direct sur la qualité du suivi des projets et sur la confiance des investisseurs comme des porteurs de projets.

Vos missions

🧩 Le job

Tu rejoins la squad gestion des projets qui est en charge de tout ce qui se passe après le financement d’un projet immobilier.

Aujourd’hui, Bricks gère environ 400 projets financés simultanément. Pour chacun d’eux, il faut suivre ce qui se passe sur le terrain : récupérer les bonnes informations auprès des porteurs de projets, communiquer régulièrement avec les investisseurs et lorsque quelque chose se passe moins bien, il faut savoir gérer les impayés, les pénalités et les éventuelles procédures de contentieux.

C’est aussi ce qui fait de la gestion post-financement l’un des sujets les plus stratégiques pour Bricks. Une plateforme d’investissement ne se construit pas uniquement au moment où un utilisateur décide d’investir : elle se construit dans la durée, dans la qualité du suivi et dans la façon dont les situations plus complexes sont prises en charge.

Le challenge n’est pas simplement de “gérer 400 projets”. Il est de construire un système capable d’en gérer demain beaucoup plus sans faire grossir l’équipe au même rythme.

Une plateforme existe déjà et accompagne l’équipe au quotidien. Elle a atteint un niveau de maturité où les prochains problèmes ne se résoudront pas uniquement avec de nouvelles features : parfois la meilleure réponse sera produit, parfois process, parfois automatisation, parfois juridique.

C’est là que tu interviens.

👉 Ce que tu vas owner

  • Comprendre profondément le quotidien des utilisateurs internes en particulier celui de la personne qui opère nos projets au quotidien : observer, écouter, identifier les irritants et comprendre ce qui peut être supprimé, automatisé ou mieux structuré.
  • Faire évoluer la gestion de plusieurs centaines de projets pour qu’elle reste fluide et scalable : priorisation, automatisation, workflows, process et outils.
  • Travailler avec l’engineering pour transformer les problèmes identifiés en solutions produit lorsqu’une solution technique est pertinente.
  • Aller chercher l’information là où elle se trouve : care, juridique, marketing, métier, engineering… Tu ne travailles pas à partir d’une spec parfaite, tu reconstruis toi-même le contexte.
  • T’approprier des sujets parfois complexes ou réglementaires. Tu n’as pas besoin d’être juriste, mais un contrat de 50 pages ou une discussion sur un process de contentieux ne doit pas te faire fuir.
  • Choisir le bon levier plutôt que la feature par défaut : modifier un process peut parfois avoir plus d’impact que développer un nouvel écran.
  • Transformer chaque problème rencontré en apprentissage réutilisable : l’objectif n’est pas de traiter le problème du projet n°237, mais de faire en sorte qu’il soit mieux géré pour les centaines de projets suivants.
  • Et progressivement, prendre de plus en plus d’ownership sur la stratégie et la roadmap de la squad. Le périmètre pourra évoluer fortement selon ce que tu démontres sur le terrain.

👥 La squad

Tu travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes en charge du suivi opérationnel des projets ainsi qu’avec l'Engineering, le Product, le Growth et Marketing.

Selon les sujets, tu seras également amené à collaborer avec le Care, le juridique ou la direction. Un même problème peut avoir des conséquences très différentes selon les équipes et les utilisateurs concernés.

C’est un rôle où la collaboration compte énormément. Ton travail ne consiste pas simplement à recueillir les besoins de chacun et à les transformer en features.

Tu dois aller chercher l’information directement auprès des personnes concernées, comprendre leur réalité opérationnelle, croiser les différents points de vue et remonter à la vraie problématique derrière une demande.

Ce qu’un utilisateur te demande n’est pas toujours la solution dont il a besoin. À toi d’agréger le contexte, de challenger les demandes et de construire avec l’équipe la réponse la plus efficace qu’elle soit produit, process, technique ou juridique.

Vos compétences

🎯 Tu fitteras si

  • Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience en Product Management avec déjà une vraie autonomie sur ton périmètre.
  • Tu as déjà travaillé sur un produit ou un environnement où il fallait comprendre le métier avant de construire la solution. Tu vas spontanément parler aux utilisateurs plutôt que d’attendre qu’un besoin parfaitement formulé arrive jusqu’à toi. C’est un point particulièrement important pour ce rôle.
  • Tu es à l’aise dans des environnements mouvants. Tu peux passer plusieurs jours à creuser un problème complexe, puis devoir jongler entre plusieurs sujets dans la même journée. Tu sais récupérer rapidement le contexte, identifier ce qui compte et avancer sans te perdre dans l’information
  • Tu as un vrai mindset builder/entrepreneur : tu n’as pas besoin que tout soit déjà structuré pour commencer à avancer.
  • Tu sais travailler avec des experts sans avoir besoin de devenir toi-même expert de chaque sujet. Tu peux échanger avec un juriste, un développeur, le care ou le marketing, absorber leur contexte et transformer tout ça en décisions produit cohérentes.
  • Tu sais défendre un point de vue et challenger quand c’est nécessaire y compris face à des interlocuteurs très seniors, tout en étant capable de changer d’avis quand les arguments sont meilleurs.
  • Une expérience dans un environnement régulé ou à fortes contraintes métier : fintech, legaltech, comptabilité, RH… est un vrai plus. Ici une décision produit peut avoir des conséquences financières, juridiques ou opérationnelles réelles.
  • Tu préfères faire beaucoup avec une petite équipe plutôt que de construire du process pour construire du process

❌ Tu ne fitteras probablement pas si

  • Tu as besoin d’un framework très établi pour fonctionner.
  • Tu attends des specs détaillées avant d’aller chercher toi-même le contexte.
  • Ton premier réflexe face à un problème est systématiquement de créer une feature.
  • Tu cherches à appliquer « la bonne méthode produit » indépendamment du contexte.
  • Tu préfères passer trois semaines à cadrer parfaitement un sujet plutôt que tester rapidement une hypothèse lorsque le risque le permet.
  • Ou tu imagines le rôle de PM comme quelqu’un qui organise le travail d’une squad depuis Jira : ici le Product Manager met vraiment les mains dans le problème.

Avantages

🚀 Pourquoi ce rôle est intéressant

La squad est déjà l’une des plus matures chez Bricks mais le terrain de jeu devant elle reste énorme.

Aujourd’hui, il y a environ 400 projets. Demain, il peut y en avoir 2 000 avec de nouvelles typologies de produits, de nouveaux pays et de nouveaux enjeux réglementaires ou opérationnels. L’objectif n’est pas de construire une organisation lourde pour absorber cette croissance mais bien de trouver une meilleure façon de travailler à chaque étape.

Et à mesure que tu prends ownership du sujet, ton rôle pourra aller bien au-delà de l’exécution d’une roadmap : comprendre suffisamment bien le métier pour contribuer directement aux prochains sujets sur lesquels Bricks doit investir.

L'offre

👉 CDI, temps plein.

👉 De vrais sujets, un vrai impact : produit régulé, vraies conséquences quand on se plante.

👉 Beaucoup d’ownership : tu travailleras directement avec les personnes qui font le produit et tu auras une vraie influence sur ce qu’on construit.

👉Une boîte ambitieuse, rentable et en forte croissance : tu arrives à un moment où l’organisation Product est encore suffisamment petite pour que tu puisses réellement contribuer à la construire.

👉 Salaire compétitif, assurance santé moderne, MacBook Pro de ton choix, tout le matériel qu'il te faut.

👉 Hybride Montpellier : office-first (2j/sem de remote) ou remote-first (~2j/mois au bureau).

Déroulement des entretiens

  1. Pré-qualification téléphonique avec notre recruteuse
  2. Echange métier (1h)
  3. Entretien team-fit (1h)
  4. Rencontre avec Cédric, notre fondateur (45 min)
  5. Offre

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: PRODUCT MANAGER

We’re building a new customer platform, including AI Studio and our machine learning products, largely from scratch. These products need one person who owns what gets built, in what order, and why, and who makes sure what ships solves real problems for teams running AI and ML workloads on our GPU infrastructure. You’ll report to our Chief Product & Technology Officer and lead a team of three Product Engineers, based in London or Australia.

This is a role for someone who’s comfortable shaping loosely defined problems into clear priorities, makes trade-offs and explains them, and takes accountability for adoption and outcomes, not just a delivery plan.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:

  • Own and drive the product vision and roadmap for the new customer platform, AI Studio and ML products, prioritising ruthlessly across customer needs, commercial goals and engineering capacity.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and Security, so products are buildable, supportable, compliant and ready to sell at launch.
  • Run regular discovery with customers and prospects to understand how they build, train, fine-tune and deploy models, and turn what you learn into clear problem statements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Define what a minimum useful release looks like for each product, and sequence delivery so customers get value early rather than at the end of a long build.
  • Lead your team from idea to release: run the planning and delivery cadence, keep the backlog actionable, and remove blockers along the way.
  • Line-manage and develop three Product Engineers, and help hire and build a team that owns problems end to end.
  • Define and track adoption, activation, usage and retention metrics, and use them, alongside the competitive landscape, to decide what to do next.

ABOUT YOU

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager owning technical products end to end, ideally in cloud, developer platforms or infrastructure.
  • A track record of taking a new product from early concept through to launch and adoption.
  • Experience line-managing or directly leading a small team, including performance and development conversations.
  • Enough technical depth to work credibly with engineers on APIs, platform architecture and infrastructure trade-offs.
  • A working understanding of how AI and ML teams build, train and deploy models, and the tooling they rely on.
  • Strong discovery and prioritisation skills, with evidence of turning customer research into roadmap decisions.

Nice to Have:

  • Product experience with GPU cloud, AI/ML platforms, MLOps tooling, or model serving and fine-tuning products.
  • A hands-on technical background, such as software or ML engineering, and conceptual familiarity with Kubernetes, containers and the NVIDIA GPU ecosystem.
  • Experience with usage-based pricing models and working across distributed teams in multiple time zones.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
  • Employee wellbeing benefits
  • 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Enhanced Pension Scheme
  • Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
  • Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
  • Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
  • Clear career progression in a high-growth company
  • A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
  • The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future

WHY APPLY

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.

MORE INFORMATION

Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product owners to own product areas within Doit's AI Neobank.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Für unseren Kunden ist dies eine absolute Schlüsselrolle!

Wenn Sie Zahlen nicht nur analysieren, sondern mit Ihren Erkenntnissen die Entwicklung eines Produktionsstandorts aktiv mitgestalten möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :

  • Être Extraordinaire en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.
  • Créer un environnement Ouvert en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.
  • Diriger avec Optimisme en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.

Rôle et Impact :

En tant qu’Account Manager, vous serez responsable de l'élaboration des recommandations que ce soit avec un mode d’achat en programmatique ou en gré à gré. Il est également garant de la mise en place, du suivi, optimisations. Il encadre également un Account Executive ou alternant dans sa formation.

  • Veille marché
    • Rencontre régulière des différents partenaires (média, data, techno)
    • Assister aux product update des plateformes
  • Gestion briefs
    • Réception, analyse et compréhension des problématiques
    • Vérification de l’exhaustivité des informations
    • Echanges avec l’agence, challenge du brief et identification du rendu attendu (powerpoint, excel, mail…)
    • Annonce d’un délai de retour
  • Rédaction de recommandation
    • Elaboration des stratégies display programmatiques et/ou gré à gré selon le brief (Créations, Stratégie d’achat, inventaires, ciblages, technos…) avec le soutien de l’AMS ou du TL
    • Echanges avec les partenaires
    • Négociations des coûts d’achat si le deal n’existe pas ou pour le GàG
    • Mise en forme de la réponse en respectant les templates existants
    • Restitution de la recommandation au client
  • Tracking/Trafficking
    • Définition du plan de tracking (visite du site, pixels à poser etc…)
    • Garant de la bonne mise en place des éléments de tracking (vérification des loads dans le DSP, + vérification remontées outils tiers DAR, IAS…)
    • Vérification de la bonne mise en place de l’adverificateur selon les normes GroupM et/ou annonceur (pré bid, coordination avec adops)
    • Envoi des spec techs + tenue à jour du document
    • Réception des éléments créatifs
    • Vérification de la conformité le jour de la réception (avant envoi à l’audit)
    • Envoi à l’audit
  • Programmation des campagnes : Rigueur opérationnelle dans la programmation, le suivi et le reporting.
    • Programmatique :
      • Programmation de la campagne dans le(s) DSP choisi(s)
      • Intégration des paramètres « qualité » (visibilité, sitelist/exclusion list…)
      • Vérification du setup avec les outils internes
      • Pilotage de la campagne
    • Gré à Gré :
      • Envoi des éléments de campagnes
      • Intégration des paramètres « qualité » (visibilité, sitelist/exclusion list…)
      • Previews créations
      • Pige de mise en ligne
      • Pilotage de la campagne
  • Suivi & optimisations
    • Garant de la bonne livraison, des résultats et de la qualité des activations
    • Edition d’un reporting régulier 1 mois par semaine
    • Identification des actions à mener pour optimiser la campagne
    • Mise en place des optimisations
    • Envoi du reporting avec explication des optimisations réalisées et leur but
    • Tenue à jour du document de suivi mis en place pour chaque pôle
  • Bilan
    • Identification de la forme souhaitée (excel vs powerpoint)
    • Création du bilan final de la campagne
    • Explication des résultats et notamment de l’impact des optimisations (résultats, enseignements, savings le cas échéant, pistes de reflexion/next steps)
    • Présentation client
  • Finance
    • Assurer le suivi budgétaire de la campagne
    • Assurer le suivi des impressions data
    • En fin de campagne effectuer le bilan d’achat

  • Proximité agence
    • Point physique régulier avec ses contacts en agence
    • Space planning : si possible un jour partagé avec ses contacts agence

Expérience et Compétences :

  • Expérience Professionnelle :
  • Plus de 3 ans d'expérience significative et réussieen achat programmatique, idéalement acquise en agence média.
  • Expérience avérée dans la gestion de campagnes digitales complexes, avec une forte composante client-facing (élaboration de recommandations, présentations, suivi des relations).

  • Compétences Techniques (Hard Skills) :

  • Maîtrise approfondie des plateformes d'achat programmatique (indispensable) :DV360, The Trade Desk, Amazon Ads, Google Ads
  • Analyse de données et Reporting :Maîtrise avancée d'Excel et de Google Analytics pour analyser les performances, extraire des insights pertinents et construire des bilans clairs et stratégiques.
  • Connaissance des méthodes de Brand Safety et Ad Verification :Une familiarité avec des outils comme IAS est un plus pour garantir la qualité et la sécurité de nos diffusions.
  • Stratégie Média Digitale :Capacité à élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'achat média percutantes, notamment pour des objectifs de branding et de vidéo.

  • Compétences Comportementales (Behavioral Competencies) :

  • Autonomie & Proactivité :Vous êtes capable de gérer votre portefeuille de clients de manière indépendante, d'anticiper les besoins et de proposer des initiatives innovantes.
  • Rigueur, Organisation & Souci du Détail :Essentiels pour garantir la qualité des campagnes, le respect des budgets et l'exactitude des livrables dans un environnement exigeant.
  • Orientation Client & Excellent Sens du Service :Votre capacité à écouter, comprendre et répondre aux attentes de nos clients fait de vous un partenaire privilégié.
  • Esprit Collaboratif & Communication :Vous savez travailler en équipe, partager vos connaissances et vos feedbacks, et interagir efficacement avec des interlocuteurs variés, y compris des équipes délocalisées.
  • Capacité d'Analyse et de Résolution de Problèmes :Vous êtes capable de décortiquer des situations complexes pour identifier les leviers d'optimisation et apporter des solutions concrètes.

  • Langues :

  • Anglais courant indispensable, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, pour la gestion de comptes internationaux et la collaboration avec nos équipes globales.

La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :

Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité. Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.

Nos avantages comprennent :

  • Télétravail : Jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année.
  • Deux jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte.
  • Jours de congé additionnels par palier de 5 ans d’ancienneté.
  • 5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaborateurs souffrant d’endométriose.
  • Politique handicap : 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel, et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH.
  • Missions solidaires possibles via le programme We care and we act.

Process de recrutement :

  1. Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier entretien téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec un membre de notre équipe recrutement. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise.
  2. Entretien opérationnel : Un entretien en visioconférence avec un Lead de l'équipe et un Manager pour évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences et de votre profil.
  3. Étude de cas (Business Case) : Une étude de cas technique vous sera proposée après l'entretien opérationnel afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Vous disposerez de 10 jours pour la réaliser.
  4. Entretien Physique & Restitution du Business Case : Un entretien physique obligatoire, lors duquel vous présenterez votre Business Case et échangerez avec le manager direct et un autre Lead.

Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.

WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.

Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données politique de confidentialité.  

Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.

title: Programme Manager, Cloud Services DevOps
descriptionHtml:
Why Verifone

For more than 30 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located.

What's Exciting About the Role

Verifone is offering a unique opportunity to step into a newly created role and help shape the future of our global cloud operations. As our Programme Manager, Cloud Services DevOps, you'll oversee our enterprise-wide cloud services and infrastructure transformation initiatives. You will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy, financial planning and technical execution. You will work across cross-functional engineering teams, manage delivery and governance, and optimize our continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) and cloud hosting environments (AWS/Azure).

Key Responsibilities

Programme & Delivery Management

  • End-to-End Ownership: Take full accountability for the delivery of complex cloud, infrastructure, and automation programmes from inception to completion
  • Governance & Reporting: Implement robust project governance, track budgets, manage RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) logs, and report progress to senior stakeholders
  • Resource Allocation: Coordinate with onshore and offshore engineering teams, defining roles, workflows, and deliverables schedules
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Facilitate communication between software development, IT operations, finance, security, and external clients

Technical & DevOps Oversight 

  • Cloud Strategy: Oversee the management and scaling of multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or Private Cloud)
  • Automation & CI/CD: Ensure adherence to best practices in infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and automated deployment pipelines using tools like Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins
  • Operational Security: Embed security standards (DevSecOps), compliance requirements, and ITIL frameworks into the core delivery lifecycle
  • Performance Optimization: Monitor platform reliability, uptime targets (SLAs), and logging/monitoring frameworks

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Proven track record of managing enterprise-scale cloud transformation or DevOps programmes
  • Strong background working in Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery models within fast-paced environments
  • Budget management experience and familiarity with tracking toolsets (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira, MS Project)
  • Technical competencies
  • 3rd party vendor collaboration
  • Deep conceptual or hands-on understanding of cloud architecture (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, containerization/Kubernetes)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps)
  • Awareness of infrastructure automation and configuration management tools (Terraform, Ansible)

Soft Skills and Leadership

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills to articulate technical solutions to non-technical audiences
  • Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities to guide engineering teams through operational change

Our Commitment

Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

title: Project Manager - Facility Management
descriptionHtml:
Over CBRE Global Workplace Solutions

CBRE Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) is wereldwijd marktleider in geïntegreerd facilitair management, technisch beheer, projectmanagement en vastgoedservices. Wij ondersteunen enkele van de meest toonaangevende organisaties ter wereld bij het creëren, onderhouden en optimaliseren van hun werkomgevingen.

Als onderdeel van CBRE, met meer dan 155.000 medewerkers wereldwijd, combineren wij lokale expertise met de kracht van een toonaangevend internationaal netwerk. Onze teams leveren innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van technisch onderhoud, facility management, energiebeheer, projecten en werkplekoptimalisatie.

Bij CBRE geloven we dat onze mensen het verschil maken. Daarom investeren we in ontwikkeling, samenwerking en een veilige, inclusieve werkomgeving waarin iedereen kan groeien. CBRE wordt wereldwijd erkend als een van de meest bewonderde en ethische bedrijven in haar sector en staat bekend om haar focus op innovatie, duurzaamheid en talentontwikkeling.

Taken

WAT GA JE DOEN?
Ben jij een ervaren Project Manager met een technische achtergrond en een passie voor het succesvol realiseren van complexe projecten?

Voor ons Projects-team in Nederland zijn wij op zoek naar een Project Manager die verantwoordelijk is voor de succesvolle uitvoering en oplevering van uiteenlopende bouwkundige, technische en facilitaire projecten. Van complete kantoorinrichtingen en fit-outs tot kritische technische upgrades en de realisatie van serverruimtes: jij zorgt ervoor dat projecten veilig, op tijd, binnen budget én naar volle tevredenheid van de klant worden opgeleverd.

Je werkt nauw samen met klanten, leveranciers, onderaannemers en interne stakeholders en hebt de volledige verantwoordelijkheid voor projecten met een waarde van circa €25.000 tot €1 miljoen.

Als Project Manager ben jij de drijvende kracht achter het volledige projectproces, van initiatief en voorbereiding tot uitvoering en oplevering.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het leiden van bouwkundige, technische en facilitaire projecten van aanvraag tot oplevering
  • Het opstellen en bewaken van projectplannen, budgetten, planningen en risicoanalyses
  • Het vertalen van klantwensen naar concrete projectdoelstellingen en programma's van eisen
  • Het aansturen en coördineren van interne teams, leveranciers en onderaannemers
  • Het bewaken van kwaliteit, veiligheid, contractuele verplichtingen en commerciële doelstellingen
  • Het fungeren als belangrijkste aanspreekpunt voor klanten en stakeholders
  • Het beheren van de dagelijkse operationele aspecten van projecten, inclusief toezicht op locatie
  • Het zorgen voor volledige naleving van CBRE-processen, projectmanagementrichtlijnen en QHSE-standaarden
  • Het voorbereiden en presenteren van projectrapportages aan klanten en interne stakeholders
  • Het signaleren van nieuwe projectkansen en het opbouwen van sterke klantrelaties

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag leid je een bouwvergadering op locatie, de volgende dag presenteer je een projectupdate aan een stuurgroep of bespreek je innovatieve oplossingen met een klant.

Vereisten

WAT BRENG JE MEE?

Wij zoeken een ervaren professional die techniek, organisatie en stakeholdermanagement succesvol weet te combineren.

  • Hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in Bouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Installatietechniek, Infratechniek of een vergelijkbare richting
  • Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring met technische of bouwkundige projecten
  • Ervaring binnen de technische dienstverlening, bouw, vastgoed of facility management is een pré
  • Sterke organisatorische, commerciële en communicatieve vaardigheden
  • Ervaring met budgetbeheer, planning en contractmanagement
  • Leiderschapskwaliteiten en het vermogen om meerdere stakeholders effectief te managen
  • Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte en klantgerichte instelling
  • VCA-VOL of de bereidheid deze te behalen
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal
  • Bereidheid om te reizen naar projectlocaties binnen Nederland

Voldoe je niet volledig aan alle eisen, maar herken je jezelf in het profiel? Dan nodigen we je nadrukkelijk uit om toch te solliciteren.

Benefits

WAT BIEDEN WIJ?

Bij CBRE krijg je de kans om impactvolle projecten te realiseren binnen een internationale organisatie waar ontwikkeling, samenwerking en ondernemerschap centraal staan.

Wij bieden onder andere:

  • Een marktconform salaris dat aansluit bij jouw kennis, ervaring en de verantwoordelijkheden van de functie
  • Een bedrijfsauto inclusief tankpas
  • Flexibele werktijden en hybride werkmogelijkheden waar de functie dit toelaat
  • 8,33% vakantiegeld
  • 25 vakantiedagen en 12 ADV-dagen
  • De mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen bij te kopen
  • Een vaste pensioenregeling
  • Collectieve verzekeringsmogelijkheden
  • Een uitgebreid onboardingprogramma
  • Opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden via de GWS Academy en externe trainingen
  • Internationale doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen CBRE
  • Een professionele, informele en collegiale werkomgeving waarin jouw bijdrage zichtbaar impact maakt

KLAAR VOOR JOUW VOLGENDE UITDAGING?

Solliciteer eenvoudig online met jouw cv en relevante certificaten of diploma’s. Een motivatiebrief is niet nodig.

Vermeld hierbij jouw beschikbaarheid en salarisverwachting.

title: Projectleider Gebiedsontwikkeling
descriptionHtml:
Als projectleider gebiedsontwikkeling bij Waalpartners speel je een cruciale rol in het realiseren van de nieuwbouwopgaven van onze opdrachtgevers. Jij bewaart het overzicht, staat naast de opdrachtgever en draagt bij aan oplossingen voor de uitdagingen die woningbouw met zich meebrengt. Zo hebben we recentelijk meegedacht voor de nieuwe woonomgeving ‘Vlijweide’ in Dordrecht. Bij deze locatie ontwikkeling komt nogal wat bij elkaar. Water, bodem, ecologie, een primaire waterkering én verschillende partijen met ieder hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid en expertise. En dat alles om een toekomstbestendig nieuw woongebied te ontwikkelen.

Dit ga je doen

Met je brede kennis en jarenlange ervaring sta je stevig in een dynamische projectomgeving. Zowel in de voorbereidende als de uitvoerende fase zorg je ervoor dat het proces vloeiend blijft verlopen, ook bij langdurige integrale projecten. Je eigen netwerk zet je in om de dienstverlening van Waalpartners verder te profileren. Als projectleider ben je bovendien de spil in de ontwikkeling van zowel medewerkers als de organisatie.

Dat doe je niet alleen: samen schop je ‘t verder. Je werkt nauw samen met het management en de overige projectleiders over offertes, de bureauplanning en kansen in de markt.

Dit ben jij

Je bent open, nieuwsgierig en staat als leidinggevende stevig in je schoenen. Je omgeving ziet je als collegiaal en je neemt verantwoordelijkheid over je project en de ontwikkeling van de projectteamleden.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een salaris tussen €4.500 – €6.900 bruto o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.

  • Groeipad. Met onze Waalacademy bouw je stevig aan je eigen ontwikkeling.

  • Flexibele werktijden. Kom je liever om half 8 binnen, in plaats van half 9? Geen probleem.

  • Hybride werken. We zien je graag op kantoor, omdat we veel met elkaar en onze opdrachtgevers overleggen en samenwerken. Natuurlijk is er ook ruimte om thuis te werken, daarom mag je 2 dagen per week vanuit huis werken (o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband).

  • 27 vakantiedagen

  • Resultaatafhankelijke winstdeling. Draaien we samen een goed jaar? Dan profiteer jij daar ook van!

  • Een goede pensioenregeling onder het oude pensioenstelsel.

  • Een elektrische auto van de zaak, die je ook privé mag gebruiken

  • Plezier. We werken niet alleen aan de ontwikkeling van onze omgeving en onszelf, maar hebben ‘t ook leuk met elkaar. Onze personeelsvereniging organiseert regelmatig activiteiten, we gaan samen op citytrip of een paar kilometer hardlopen.

Dit breng jij mee

  • Je hebt de drive om een project voor alle belanghebbenden tot een goed einde te brengen.

  • Jij vindt het belangrijk om jezelf, samen met je collega’s, te blijven ontwikkelen.

  • Je hebt een civieltechnische opleiding (hbo werk- en denkniveau).

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt jezelf goed verwoorden: In gesprek en op papier.

  • Je hebt de ervaring om complexe projecten te doorzien en te begeleiden.

  • Je hebt gevoel voor thema’s als binnenstedelijke herinrichting, klimaatadaptatie of geotechniek.

Seltene Erden sind unverzichtbar für zahlreiche Zukunftstechnologien – von Elektromobilität und Windkraft bis hin zu Robotik und industriellen Anwendungen. Mit innovativen Recyclingtechnologien tragen wir dazu bei, wertvolle Rohstoffe zurückzugewinnen, natürliche Ressourcen zu schonen und unabhängige, nachhaltige Lieferketten aufzubauen.

Die Remloy GmbH ist Teil der internationalen Mkango-Gruppe und spezialisiert auf das Recycling von Seltene-Erden-Permanentmagneten sowie die Herstellung hochwertiger Neodym-Eisen-Bor-Legierungspulver (NdFeB). An unserem Standort in Bitterfeld-Wolfen betreiben wir eine moderne Produktionsanlage und arbeiten daran, unsere Technologien und Produktionskapazitäten weiter auszubauen. Für den weiteren Aufbau unseres Unternehmens suchen wir einen engagierten Prozess- und Anlageningenieur (m/w/d), der unsere Produktionsanlagen und Fertigungsprozesse betreut, optimiert und weiterentwickelt und den Produktionsleiter als technische rechte Hand in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktionsteam unterstützt.

Das können Sie bewegen:

  • Anlagenoptimierung: Analyse bestehender Produktionsanlagen, Erkennen technischer Schwachstellen sowie Entwicklung und praktische Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung von Anlagenleistung, Verfügbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Betriebssicherheit.
  • Prozessentwicklung: Analyse und Weiterentwicklung industrieller Produktions- und Schmelzprozesse zur Verbesserung von Produktqualität, Reproduzierbarkeit, Materialausbeute und Effizienz. Untersuchung der Zusammenhänge zwischen Anlagenparametern, Prozessbedingungen und Materialeigenschaften.
  • Technik & Automatisierung: Technische Anpassung von Anlagen und Komponenten sowie Optimierung von Steuerungen, Sensorik, Mess- und Regeltechnik und Prozessüberwachung. title: Quality Assurance - Senior Consultant
locations: Hybrid - Newcastle, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Leeds, Manchester, Birmingham, Bristol, London
descriptionHtml:
Ready to keep quality at the heart of projects with impact?

Do you want to make a real impact by ensuring quality in services? Are you ready to grow your skills in a supportive, knowledge-sharing community where you can achieve your potential?

We’re a growing tech consultancy that creates user-centred solutions with purpose for our clients in government, healthcare and purpose-driven businesses. As a Quality Assurance consultant, you’ll ensure that quality assurance is considered from the start through testing, questioning and improving. You’ll apply your adaptability and communication skills across a variety of projects, working with a vibrant QA community that champions learning and knowledge sharing.

The Role

You'll work on public and private sector projects. You’ll likely be working as a lead software quality engineer on internal and client-facing projects, contributing to the leadership of teams.

Leading by example and promoting the Opencast approach, you’ll support colleagues to develop knowledge and work through challenges in all testing types. You’ll decide the best thing for your team to be working on. You'll collaborate with team members, clients and users to ensure that high quality is maintained and best practices are followed throughout the project. You'll adapt to different tools and technologies, advising on the best ones to use.

You'll ensure that work is carried out in accordance with Opencast's quality, environmental, and information security policies and procedures, as well as applicable customer policies, standards, and procedures while working on client.

Requirements

This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients.

Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 

SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements.

If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying. We are recruiting for multiple positions, with opportunities available immediately and in the coming months. If you are interested in joining Opencast, we encourage you to apply.

Technical Skills

To succeed in this role, you must have experience working as a lead software tester on multiple complex projects and have a good understanding of what it means to be a senior consultant.

In your CV and at interview, you’ll need to show experience of:

  • Your working area and how you apply this to your role

  • Functional and non-functional automation testing using tools like Playwright

  • Mentoring and Coaching team members, supporting their development and progression within QA

  • Creating test documentation

  • Resolving complex issues and presenting findings to stakeholders

  • Creating tasks from high-level requirements

  • Leading and facilitating meetings, including test planning, defect triage, stand-ups and retrospectives

  • Acting as a senior point of contact for stakeholders, demonstrating leadership in both delivery and communication

You’ll need a good understanding of:

  • Basic principles of programming paradigms, such as object-orientated programming and procedural programming

  • The concepts and benefits of OAT testing.

As well as QA skills, there are essential core skills you’ll need to be a great consultant.

In the interview, we will assess how you have:

  • Demonstrated strong attention to detail and focus on high-quality outcomes

  • Took a methodical approach to resolving complex problems

  • Respectfully challenged decisions or solutions when necessary

  • Communicated effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Proactively sought solutions to mitigate risk

  • Raised risks and issues using the appropriate tools and processes

  • Built strong working relationships and successfully resolved conflicts

  • Led project meetings and actively contributed to workshops and events

Other experience

Some areas of experience are not essential but relevant to the role:

  • UK government service standards
  • Agile methodology

Salary

£56,001-£60,000

What we offer

A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from flexible working hours (aligned to client commitments), 25 days’ holiday, and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations. We also offer wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team.

Where you’ll work

This role requires regular on-site attendance across our HQ, hub offices, client sites and home. Applicants must be able to commute to offices and client sites as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential to fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

We include you

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.

Interview

Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.

title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
descriptionHtml:
At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?

As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.

This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.

Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.

What You'll Work On

You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:

  • Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events
  • Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them
  • Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading
  • Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise
  • Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible
  • Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales
  • Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models
  • Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper
  • Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems
  • Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge

No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.

What Success Looks Like

Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.

  • Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning
  • No active backlogs
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++
  • Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects
  • Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking
  • A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly

Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.

Our Culture

More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.

At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.

Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.

title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – DACH
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large DACH enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the region's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent German and based in Germany

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Experience leading and engaging a remote team across multiple cities
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

title: 3D Environment Artist & Level Designer
descriptionHtml:
3D Environment Artist & Level Designer
ScapeWorld Entertainment · Remote

  • Level: Senior to lead

  • Location: Remote, CET overlap

  • Contract: Full time, long term

About us

We are ScapeWorld Entertainment, a fully remote Swedish game studio of just over 20 people. We are building Scape, a platform of multiplayer games where a player’s identity carries across all of them. We have just launched our first game within Scape. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios and Ubisoft.

The project

Our next game is a cleaning and restoration sim set in a shared neighbourhood. Every player has a place of their own that starts buried in junk and grime, and puts it in order in full view of neighbours who are doing the same.

Cleaning games are usually played alone or in short co-op sessions. We want to make one set in a neighbourhood that players share and keep coming back to, and we want to do it well. We have a working prototype and are refining the loop now. If you play games like this and have views on what makes them satisfying, you will enjoy this.

About the role

We are looking for a senior to lead 3D environment artist who is also a level designer.

You will be the only level designer on the project. You own the game’s spaces, from first layout through to dressed and lit, and you are responsible for delivering them.

The role is split roughly evenly between environment art, mostly props and other environment 3D assets, and level design, which includes some gameplay design. On the design side you work with our Creative Director and engineering, and you bring your level and gameplay design experience into those discussions. On the art side you work with the rest of the art team.

You report to the Art Director.

What you will do

Environment art

  • Model and texture props and other environment 3D assets. Most of what we use is made in-house, and we also work with asset packs where they fit.

  • Work to our polygon, texture and material standards. Assets used in large numbers, such as foliage, are kept low poly. Most props use standard poly counts.

  • Build modular kits that can be reused across levels.

  • Dress and light levels in Unity, following the Art Director’s visual direction.

Level design

  • Design the layout of rooms and plots: how the player moves through them, what they notice first, and the order in which the space is revealed as it is cleared.

  • Greybox levels and take them through to final, checking scale, pathing and collision in engine.

  • Test levels in engine and in playtests, and make changes based on the results.

  • Help shape how spaces support the game loop and its features, and give input on pacing and progression.

  • Document your work: layout plans, kit guides and dressing guidelines.

What we are looking for

  • Senior to lead level, with several years of professional experience in game development.

  • Experience as both an environment artist and a level designer. You have done each on at least one project, shipped or not, and you have owned a game’s spaces or levels from start to finish.

  • Some gameplay design experience, for example working on game loops, features or mechanics alongside level layouts.

  • A portfolio that shows both sides: real-time environments and 3D assets you made, and levels you designed, from greybox to final.

  • Good working knowledge of Unity, including building and lighting levels. Our level tools are built inside Unity.

  • Comfortable using Blender. It is part of our production pipeline, and we have built an add-on for it.

  • Comfortable using the Substance suite for texturing and materials.

  • Comfortable giving your view in design discussions and explaining your reasoning.

  • Able to work independently from a brief, and to work closely with a small team.

  • Comfortable working in English every day, in meetings (mostly on camera) and in writing. It does not need to be perfect.

Nice to have

  • 3D character or gameplay animation.

  • 3D character modelling.

  • Technical art or VFX.

  • Experience with GitHub or Fork.

  • Experience with player-built levels, or tools for game creators.

  • Experience in a small team where you covered more than one role.

What we offer

  • A fully remote team with flexible working.

  • Trust to manage your own time. We do not use timesheets.

  • Ownership of the game’s spaces, from first layout to final.

  • A small team where people help each other.

Working setup

  • Fully remote. Your working day needs to overlap with CET.

  • Full time, on a long-term contract. It is business to business.

  • We would like you to start as soon as you are available.

What this role is not

  • Not a lead game designer role. Our Creative Director sets the direction of the game.

  • Not an art-only or design-only role. You will do both.

How to apply

Apply through the link; a few short questions are part of the application form. If we shortlist you, the next step is interviews, and for final candidates an unpaid planning task of about two hours at an agreed time, with no modelling or texturing. We reply to everyone at every step.

Disclosure

This application will be evaluated with the help of an AI tool that checks your CV and application against the criteria for this role. A human recruiter always makes the final decision. The AI does not reject or accept anyone on its own. If your application isn’t taken forward, you can ask us for an explanation of how the AI was used in that decision. title: Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Trigger.dev

Trigger.dev is an open source platform used by developers to build production-grade AI agents. It's an SDK and the infrastructure to run agents reliably at scale, so teams can focus on the product instead of the plumbing.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users' code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. With the rise of AI, being able to offload async tasks reliably is a key part of any developer's toolkit - we're building the infrastructure to make that a reality.

About the position

We're a small team shipping fast, and as we accelerate building new features and expand the team, we want to make sure the quality and polish of what we ship keeps pace. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Design Engineer to help raise the bar on UX and visual quality across our product and marketing surfaces. You'll blend design sensibility with real engineering ability, and be able to take a rough idea, a Figma file, or even just a problem statement, and turn it into a well-crafted, production-quality experience yourself, without needing a traditional design-to-dev handoff.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who cares as much about how something feels to use as they do about how it's built.

What you'll be doing

You'll do a variety of things including:

  • Designing and building high-quality, polished UI across our web app and marketing site

  • You'll work closely with the rest of the engineering team to build new features with a focus on design craft and great UX.

  • Owning design decisions end-to-end: from rough concept through to shipped, production code

  • Building and evolving our design system and component library so quality scales as the product grows

  • Improving accessibility, responsiveness, and interaction polish across existing product surfaces

  • Prototyping new ideas quickly in code as well as static mockups, so we can iterate fast

  • Helping instil a stronger design/UX sensibility across the wider engineering team

Requirements

You really need to have:

  • A strong portfolio showing both design quality and the ability to ship real, production UI yourself

  • Expertise in modern frontend engineering - React and TypeScript (we use Remix)

  • A sharp eye for visual and interaction detail - typography, spacing, motion, and the small things that make software high quality

  • Comfort working directly from a problem statement rather than a fully-specced design - you can drive design decisions yourself

  • If you are remote you must be within CET to ET timezones (GMT+1:00 to GMT-5:00). We will arrange in-person events throughout the year

You'll be an amazing fit if you:

  • Experience owning design end-to-end at a small startup, without a separate design team to hand off to

  • Worked at a developer tools company, or have strong empathy for developers as an end user

  • Experience building or evolving a design system / component library

  • A track record of shipping fast and iterating in public

  • If you're based in the UK and you are able to join the team in London

  • Contributed to open source projects

  • Previously been a venture-backed startup founder

  • Have a social media presence

About the team

  • We are a small team with a flat hierarchy

  • We encourage continuous learning and personal development

  • Everyone operates autonomously; we trust you to get the job done, but to also quickly raise your hand if you need help

  • We care about our customers and the open-source community

  • Being a start-up, the work is challenging and fast-paced, but we also understand the importance of taking time off to recharge

Working at a Commercial Open Source Software company is more than just your day job

  • We have an active community on Discord and GitHub. Everyone on the team helps customers, reviews PRs, and creates issues

  • Great documentation matters more than ever, both for humans and for the AI tools that read it. Everyone here keeps docs up to date

  • We are a product-led growth company so everyone is expected to get involved in creating content like code examples, blog articles, videos and tweets

Benefits

  • Generous, transparent compensation and equity - We hire the best talent and pay to reflect that. We also offer equity as a way to ensure everyone is invested in the success of the company.

Du bist der entscheidende Schlüssel für einen erfolgreichen Start unserer Kunden in Deutschland. Du befähigst sowohl KMUs als auch Steuerkanzleien, die Pennylane-Plattform von Tag eins an sicher, effizient und gewinnbringend in ihrem Arbeitsalltag zu nutzen.
