title: Finanz- und Digitalisierungsberatung (w/m/d) - Accounting & Taxation
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Deine Mission

Als Stimme unserer Kunden in Deutschland bist du verantwortlich für ihren Erfolg mit der Pennylane-Plattform.

Deine Kernaufgaben:

- Kunden-Onboarding: Du übernimmst die vollständige Einarbeitung (Onboarding) neuer Kunden – sowohl Unternehmen als auch Steuerberaterkanzleien – in die Pennylane-Plattform. Du stellst sicher, dass sie schnell den größtmöglichen Mehrwert aus unserer Lösung ziehen.

- Bestandskundenbetreuung: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für unsere bestehenden Kunden. Du pflegst eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung, identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale und stellst sicher, dass die Kunden Pennylane optimal nutzen, um ihre Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

  

Das bringst du mit

- Erfahrung: 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, Account Management oder einer ähnlichen kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Kanzlei-Umfeld oder alternativ im SaaS- oder Fintech-Bereich.

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Steuerberater oder Studium im Finance-Bereich

- Branchenwissen: Ein tiefes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen und/oder Steuerberatern in Bezug auf Finanzen, Rechnungsstellung und Buchhaltung ist notwendig.

- Soft Skills: Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Empathie und ein Talent dafür, komplexe Sachverhalte einfach zu erklären.

- Hands-on Mentalität: Als Teil eines Early-Stage-Teams in Deutschland bist du proaktiv, lösungsorientiert und bereit, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

- Reisebereitschaft: Für das Onboarding im Pariser HQ und für regelmäßige Besuche bei unseren Kunden innerhalb von Deutschland (ca. 1mal im Monat

- Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau oder Muttersprache) und fließende Englischkenntnisse (für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Team).

  

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. title: GTM Enablement - Sales Execution & North America Lead
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring a Sales Execution & NA Enablement Lead to raise how our enterprise sellers plan, pursue, and win complex, technical deals. This is not a traditional training role. You’ll set the standard for what great enterprise selling looks like, turn it into artifacts and operating rhythms, and make sure sellers and managers actually use it.

The role has two mandates: own key global sales execution programs, and act as the primary Enablement partner to North America sales leadership. You’ll work closely with the Global Head of Enablement, Sales Leadership, RevOps, Product Marketing, Product & Technical Enablement, and FDE.

What you’ll do

  • Own enterprise sales execution: Build and operationalize the critical artifacts that drive excellent sales execution.

  • Enable sellers to win technical enterprise deals: Coach reps to build business cases with champions, read 10-Ks, and connect ElevenLabs capabilities to measurable outcomes for technical and economic buyers.

  • Partner with NA leadership on enablement: Diagnose field gaps and adapt global programs to NA needs, including competitive positioning, developer-led motions, and vertical playbooks.

  • Facilitate globally: Lead highly engaging, practical sales execution sessions, not just build the programs behind them.

  • Manage the coaching and operating rhythm: Embed selling standards and artifacts into how managers inspect deals and coach sellers.

  • Build the foundation for a vertical selling motion: Lay the groundwork for vertical selling, which is becoming a global priority, not just an NA need.

  • Execute in an AI-native way: Use AI to scale coaching, practice, and reinforcement, going beyond general AI fluency.

Requirements

  • 10+ years experience in enterprise sales leadership and enablement experience, ideally in an AI-native or developer-focused company

  • Excellence building and operationalizing value-selling artifacts across sales org with measurable results

  • Experience with MEDDICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, or similar methodologies, and the judgment to adapt them

  • Experience enabling frontline sales managers and building strong coaching methodologies

  • AI fluency, and comfort building in a fast-growing environment where the operating model is still taking shape

  • Enough technical depth to credibly support sellers selling to developers and technical buyers

  • Proven cross-functional influence across Sales, RevOps, PMM, Product, and FDE teams

  • Bonus: Experience working in voice AI

Location

This is a remote-first role. Candidates must be based in North America.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: INTESCIA - Ingénieur systèmes et réseaux (H/F) - CDD 6 mois
descriptionHtml:
Ingénieur systèmes et réseaux (H/F)

CDD - 6 mois

Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe !

Qui sommes-nous ?
Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact.

Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business.

En tant qu’Ingénieur Systèmes & Réseaux, vous rejoignez une équipe d’experts et jouez un rôle clé dans la conception, l’évolution et la sécurisation de nos infrastructures IT. Vous participez activement à plusieurs projets structurants, notamment la modernisation de notre architecture d’identité Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID, le déploiement de Microsoft Intune pour la gestion de nos équipements Windows, macOS et iOS, ainsi que la migration de VMware vers Proxmox. Vous contribuez également à l’évolution de nos infrastructures réseau et cloud, en veillant à garantir la performance, la disponibilité et la sécurité de nos environnements techniques.

Dans le cadre de notre mission, nous recherchons une personne capable de nous venir en renfort sur les 6 prochains mois, avec pour objectif de réaliser les missions suivantes (liste non exhaustive) :

  • Administrer, maintenir et faire évoluer les infrastructures systèmes et réseaux du groupe.

  • Participer à la modernisation de notre architecture d'identité Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID, notamment la synchronisation des identités et la mise en place des configurations hybrides.

  • Déployer et administrer Microsoft Intune pour l'enrôlement et la gestion des équipements Windows, macOS et iOS (iPhone).

  • Mettre en place et maintenir les profils de configuration, les stratégies de sécurité et de conformité des équipements, ainsi que les déploiements applicatifs.

  • Concevoir, administrer et maintenir les infrastructures de virtualisation Proxmox VE.

  • Participer activement à la migration de VMware vers Proxmox, en collaboration avec nos partenaires technologiques.

  • Administrer les environnements Linux et Windows Server et assurer leur maintien en condition opérationnelle.

  • Administrer et faire évoluer les infrastructures réseau : VLAN, switching, routage, segmentation et interconnexions entre sites.

  • Administrer les pare-feu Fortinet, les VPN inter-sites et les règles de sécurité réseau.

  • Mettre en œuvre et maintenir les solutions de sauvegarde, de restauration et de continuité de service.

  • Participer à l'administration et au maintien en condition opérationnelle des ressources AWS, ainsi qu'à leur intégration dans l'infrastructure existante.

  • Assurer la supervision des infrastructures, analyser les incidents et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires.

  • Contribuer à la sécurisation des systèmes et des réseaux, à l'amélioration continue et à la documentation technique.

La rémunération fixe sur ce poste est de 48K€ annuelle.

Le profil que nous recherchons :

Nous recherchons un profil avec minimum 5 années d’expérience, mais aussi :

  • Expérience confirmée en administration systèmes et réseaux en environnement de production.

  • Expérience sur Microsoft Entra ID, la synchronisation Active Directory / Entra, les environnements hybrides et Microsoft Intune (Windows, macOS et iOS).

  • Expérience en virtualisation Proxmox VE et participation à des projets de migration depuis VMware.

  • Maîtrise de l'administration réseau et des pare-feu Fortinet.

  • Expérience en administration Windows Server et Linux, gestion des sauvegardes et supervision des infrastructures.

  • Connaissance des outils de gestion de parc informatique et de ticketing, notamment GLPI.

  • Pratique régulière d'AWS appréciée.

  • Capacité à rédiger et maintenir une documentation technique claire et à jour.

  • Poste basé à : Toulouse / Carquefou / Issy-les-Moulineaux.

title: Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d)

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we continue to grow – and we're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.

What to expect as our Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d):

You'll be our first dedicated security engineer: a senior IC with no team at the start. You join as Deputy CISO, report to our Director of Technology (currently acting CISO), and build security engineering from scratch. The baseline is already in place – ISO 27001, C5 Type II, regular penetration tests, and encryption in the product. AI is adding new surfaces: voice documentation, document generation, and agentic workflows. You build and own the security program, the tooling, and the security story we tell customers.

  • Vulnerability management – scanners and dependency updates across repos, plus the process that gets findings closed.

  • Partner to Platform – review security-sensitive infrastructure decisions and explore options like customer-managed keys or HSMs. Platform still owns architecture.

  • Certifications, technical side – control design and assessments for our ISO 27001 and C5 setup, the security case for a potential upcoming Class IIa medical device (MDR), and pentest scoping and follow-up, with regulation like the EU Cyber Resilience Act on the horizon. This is roughly a quarter to a third of the role, and we say it openly: for the right person in healthcare security, it's a draw, not a chore.

  • Customer security – reusable docs, evidence, and AI-assisted questionnaires, so the tenth enterprise deal costs a fraction of the first. You join the call when a hospital CISO asks something new about our AI architecture.

  • Incident response – process, runbooks, and escalation, and you lead when it's real. We're too small for a SOC, so you design on-call that fits a company our size. Product incidents and platform bugs have their own owners in engineering.

  • Company-wide security – watch the threat landscape, turn this week's supply-chain mess into concrete actions, and set the baselines IT applies to devices and accounts.

How we work:

  • AI-native – our engineers use coding agents every day. Security should too: scanning, evidence, questionnaires.

  • AI is also our attack surface – agent sandboxing, prompt injection, voice data, computer-use automation inside hospitals. We deal with security questions most companies will only meet in a few years.

  • Human-in-the-loop by default – this is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control.

  • Ship and observe – we ship continuously and debug from telemetry, including in the open when that's the fastest path.


Here's how we picture you as our Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d):

  • You're a hands-on security engineer with 6+ years across software and security engineering, and you can point to a security program (or a big part of one) you've owned.

  • You've been the technical counterpart through at least one ISO 27001, C5, or SOC 2 certification cycle: you've designed controls, faced an auditor, and written the technical side of a Statement of Applicability. This is a hard requirement.

  • You've run vulnerability management somewhere real: scanners, dependency bots, triage, and the follow-through that gets things fixed.

  • You follow the security scene closely (podcasts, advisories, incident write-ups) and usually have an opinion on this week's incident before it reaches the news.

  • You're genuinely curious about AI security – both securing AI systems (agents, sandboxing, data flows) and using AI tooling to work at leverage.

  • You can talk to engineers, auditors, and hospital security teams in English without a slide deck translating for you.

Nice to have:

  • German language skills, since our customers and the C5 world are German-speaking.

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated domain.

  • Offensive security experience.

  • Security certifications such as OSCP, CISSP, or similar.

Unsere Mission: Wir verbinden alle Mitarbeitenden mit allem, was sie brauchen – mit einem Touch.

Willst du verstehen, wie ein schnell wachsendes KI-Unternehmen seine größten Deals gewinnt – und dabei selbst eine entscheidende Rolle spielen? In deinem Pre-Sales-Praktikum arbeitest du direkt mit unserem Solution Engineering Team zusammen: der Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb und Beratung. Du analysierst Unternehmen, baust Business Cases und hilfst dabei, komplexe Kundensituationen in überzeugende Lösungen zu übersetzen.

Kein Tag sieht gleich aus. Mal bereitest du eine Kundenpräsentation vor, mal analysierst du, warum ein Wettbewerber in einem Deal verloren hat – und mal entwickelst du das Argument, das einen Deal gewinnt.

Das erwartet dich

  • Kundenrecherche & Vorbereitung: Du analysierst Zielunternehmen – Branche, Struktur, Herausforderungen. Dabei stellst du dir Fragen wie: Wie arbeiten die Menschen in den Fabriken oder Filialen dort? Welche Probleme haben sie im Alltag? Du arbeitest genau heraus, wie Flip AI als maßgeschneiderte Lösung diesen Mitarbeitenden eine Stimme geben kann, und hilfst unserem Team so, mit den richtigen Fragen und Hypothesen in die Kundengespräche zu gehen. Das Beste daran: Du bist bei den Kundenterminen live dabei, erlebst den Pre-Sales-Prozess hautnah und siehst direkt, wie deine Recherche den Deal voranbringt.

  • Business Cases entwickeln: Du hilfst dabei, für jeden Kunden ein überzeugendes Argument zu bauen – warum Flip AI, warum jetzt, warum es passt. Das kann ein Zahlenmodell sein, eine strategische Einordnung oder beides.

Du hast erste Programmiererfahrung oder weißt, wie Software grundsätzlich funktioniert – das hilft dir, technische Zusammenhänge schnell zu erfassen und mit IT-Ansprechpartnern auf Augenhöhe zu sprechen.

Das bringst du mit

Das bieten wir dir

Je nach Rolle bist du gelegentlich bei Team-Events, Workshops oder Meetings in unseren Büros in Berlin oder Stuttgart dabei – immer mit genug Vorlauf. Die genaue Balance besprechen wir im Interview.

title: Sales Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious (Senior) Robotic Sales Engineer (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

Your mission

As a Robotic Sales Engineer (RSE), you are RobCo’s technical face to the customer and the technical lead on every deal you own, from the first customer call to a handover-ready solution. You work as a team with our Account Executives, and every technical question on the deal runs through you. You carry a quota together with your AE, and you win deals as a team.

Your job is to understand the customer’s process better than anyone else in the room, decide early what is feasible and what is not, and turn a real production problem into a clear, qualified automation case. You recommend the right automation approach and hand it over to our Solutions Development team without late surprises.

You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help bring physical AI from the lab into real production. You show customers what robots that perceive, learn and adapt can do in their plant today. You have direct access to the engineers, product managers and data behind our robots, and you help shape what we build next.

What you will do

  • Qualify – Join discovery calls and site visits with your AE. Assess use cases early for technical fit, business value and risk, and say no when a deal does not fit.

  • Run requirement workshops – Lead structured on-site workshops with production, engineering and operations teams. Capture parts, processes, cycle times, layout, interfaces, safety and acceptance criteria.

  • Check feasibility – Make the first technical call on reach, payload, cycle time, gripping and vision. Use quick layouts, simulations and tests to back it up, and pull in Product or Solutions Development where needed.

  • Drive the concept – Turn workshop results into clear requirements and recommend the right automation approach. You own the collaboration with Solutions Development and Product until a complete, buildable concept is in place.

  • Be the technical face to the customer – Explain our robots and solutions to plant managers, engineers and executives in plain language. Run demos and support business cases and RaaS pricing inputs.

  • Close the loop – Feed field insights back to Product, so what customers need shapes what we build.

What you bring

  • 3+ years where automation meets the customer: technical pre-sales, application engineering or automation projects

  • You want to be measured by results: you share a quota with your AE and push deals over the line

  • You have had your hands on robot cells, from grippers and vision to feeders, conveyors and safety, and you know what makes them run on the shop floor

  • You walk through a plant, watch a process for ten minutes and see where automation pays off

  • You lead conversations with confidence, whether with an operator on the line or the plant manager signing off the investment

  • You think in structure: after your workshop, the team can build on what you captured

  • You can sketch a layout or check reach in CAD or simulation (e.g. Autodesk Fusion, Visual Components)

  • You speak German and English fluently and enjoy being on the road, around 30% of the time

  • Experience in physical AI (AI-based perception, learning-based manipulation, autonomous robots) is a plus

  • Know-how in machine tending, palletizing, assembly or pick-and-place is a plus

  • Robot programming or system integrator experience is a plus

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

title: Research Engineer, Foundation Model (Multimodal Fusion & Distillation)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will build the parts of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world, where field data is the input. LEA takes in cameras, infrared, thermal, lidar and robot state natively, around the clock, on real security sites. We stand on the best open models for the encoders and the reasoning head and do not pretrain from scratch. Your work goes where nobody else can do it: fusing every sensor into one stream, teaching an open vision-language model to reason over that stream, and distilling a fast model that sees every frame.

This is the first engineer dedicated to the model track, so you will also set how we train, evaluate and ship models. You will work with our Command Centre and Robot Autonomy teams to get what you train running on site appliances and robots, and you will see it tested at 03:00 in the rain.

What You'll Work On

  • Native encoders: adapt the best open vision and point-cloud foundation models to RGB, IR, thermal and lidar, one encoder per sensor, raw stream in.

  • Fusion: build the layer that aligns every sensor in time and space into one token stream, trained on time-aligned multi-sensor field data that exists nowhere else.

  • Slow head: fine-tune an open frontier vision-language model to reason over fused sensor tokens instead of pictures.

  • Fast head: distil a small model from the slow head's calls on our own events, so every frame is seen and only hard cases escalate.

  • Evaluation: held-out sites, night and thermal slices, regression gates. A model that is worse anywhere does not ship.

  • Training machinery: multi-GPU training, data loaders for multi-sensor clips, experiment tracking and reproducible runs.

Who We're Looking For

A research engineer who has shipped multimodal models, not only published them. You know when an open model is good enough and when to build, you measure on the slice that matters before claiming a number, and you care whether the model works on a real site, not only on a benchmark.

Your Background

  • 4+ years training and fine-tuning large vision or multimodal models, or a PhD plus industry experience.

  • Strong PyTorch, comfortable with multi-GPU and multi-node training.

  • Hands-on fine-tuning of vision-language models (instruction tuning, parameter-efficient methods, full fine-tunes).

  • Experience with knowledge distillation or model compression for deployment.

  • Work with video or non-RGB sensors: thermal, infrared, lidar or radar.

  • Evaluation discipline and solid software engineering hygiene.

Nice to Have

  • Point-cloud or 3D foundation models.

  • Self-supervised and latent-prediction methods (JEPA-style).

  • Edge deployment with TensorRT or similar.

  • Robotics or field data collection.

  • Publications at top ML, vision or robotics venues.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

About Niantic Spatial

We are building for the >80% of economic activity that happens beyond the reach of screens. AI has learned from the text, images and video online, but it still lacks an accurate understanding of physical space.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations - Remote
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.


The Role

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

  • Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

  • Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

  • Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

  • Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives.   

  • Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations.

The Challenge

We are seeking researchers who:

  • See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches

  • Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months

  • Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x

  • Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact

If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative.


It's Important to Us That You Have

  • Strong mathematical foundation in statistical learning theory, particularly in areas relevant to self-supervised and multimodal learning

  • Deep expertise in foundation model architectures, with an understanding of how to scale training across multiple modalities

  • Proven ability to bridge theory and practice—someone who can both derive novel mathematical formulations and implement them efficiently

  • Demonstrated ability to build data pipelines that can process and curate massive datasets while maintaining quality and diversity

  • Track record of designing controlled experiments that isolate the impact of architectural innovations and validate theoretical insights

  • Experience optimizing models for real-world deployment, including knowledge of hardware constraints and efficiency techniques

  • History of open-source contributions or research publications that have advanced the state of the art in speech/language AI


Ideal Researcher Profile

An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.



1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations

Mastery of Core Concepts

Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse.

Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways

Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights.

Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing

Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses.


2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation

Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks

Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts.

Turning Theory into Practice

Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential.

Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source

Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress.


3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems

Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines

Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models.

Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training

A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.


4. Hardware & Systems Understanding

Efficient Implementations at Scale

Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.

Real-Time & On-Device Constraints

SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness.

Architectural & Optimization Details

Papers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency.


5. Rigorous Experimental Design

Controlled Comparisons & Ablations

Nearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter.

Multifold Evaluation Metrics

From MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics.

Stress Tests & Edge Cases

Whisper's out-of-distribution speech benchmarks, SoundStream's evaluation on speech + music, or Mamba-2's performance on multi-query associative recall demonstrate the importance of specialized challenge sets. Researchers who craft or adopt rigorous benchmarks and "red-team" their models (as in phi-3 safety alignment) are better prepared to address real-world complexities.



Summary

Overall, an ideal researcher in deep learning consistently demonstrates:

  • A solid grounding in theoretical and statistical principles

  • A talent for proposing and validating new algorithmic solutions

  • The capacity to orchestrate data pipelines that scale and reflect real-world diversity

  • Awareness of hardware constraints and system-level trade-offs for efficiency

  • Thorough and transparent experimental practices

These qualities surface across research on speech (Whisper, BASE TTS), language modeling (Scaling Laws, phi-3), specialized hardware (TPU, Transformers are SSMs), and new representation methods (VQ-VAE, FSQ, SoundStream). By balancing these attributes—rigorous math, innovative algorithms, large-scale data engineering, hardware-savvy optimizations, and reproducible experimentation—researchers can produce impactful, trustworthy advancements in foundational deep learning.

title: Sales Development Representative - German Speaking (Relocation to Barcelona)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help us accelerate our growth across the DACH market.

Reporting to the SDR Team Lead, you will play a critical role in generating a qualified sales pipeline by engaging with prospective clients. Joining a high-performing sales team, you’ll sell a disruptive corporate travel and spend platform, learn from experienced industry leaders, and build a foundation for rapid career progression within Perk.

 

What You'll Do

  • Multichannel Outreach: Execute targeted outreach campaigns using phone, email, and LinkedIn/social touches to engage target prospects.

  • Lead Qualification: Conduct discovery calls with key decision-makers—such as CFOs, Travel Managers, and Office Managers—to assess fit and schedule qualified meetings for Account Executives.

  • Value Articulation: Clearly communicate Perk’s value proposition and build immediate credibility with prospective clients.

  • CRM Hygiene: Maintain accurate prospect data and activity tracking within Salesforce.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Marketing to refine target accounts, test new messaging, and optimize the lead-qualification process.

  • Product Mastery: Stay expert-level on Perk’s product offerings and industry trends.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Languages: Native or near-native fluency in German with professional fluency in English.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication, with strong phone-based rapport-building skills.

  • Sales Acumen: Familiarity with B2B SaaS sales processes or outbound prospect outreach.

  • Process & Execution: High organizational skills, comfort working with CRMs (Salesforce preferred), and a focus on hitting output metrics.

 

What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Consistent Pipeline Generation: You hit and exceed your monthly targets for qualified meetings booked and opportunities created.

  • High Outreach Discipline: You maintain steady, structured daily outreach activity (calls, emails, social touches) using Salesforce and modern sales tools.

  • Value-Driven Discovery: You master Perk’s value proposition early, allowing you to ask smart discovery questions and handle client objections with confidence.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: You collaborate seamlessly with Account Executives to ensure smooth handover of leads and high show-up rates for meetings.

  • Growth Mindset: You actively apply feedback from coaching sessions, continuously refining your messaging and cold-calling techniques.

 

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screen: 30-minute virtual chat with Talent Acquisition.

  2. Role Assessment: 60-minute in-person interview & practical exercise.

  3. Values & Culture Fit: 30-minute virtual interview.

 

What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan

  • Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Nurture your language skills with in real-life English, Spanish, and Catalan lessons

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

 

Want to Learn More Before You Apply?

Join our DACH team for The SDR Diaries: DACH Edition to hear directly from our current SDRs about life at Perk! We’ll cover day-to-day responsibilities, live objection handling, real experiences relocating to Barcelona, and tips for navigating our interview process.

 

🔗 Register for the event here: https://luma.com/kztwu46o

How We Set You Up to Succeed (Work Schedule)

  • First 6 Months (Onboarding & Probation): 5 days a week in our Barcelona office. This gives you hands-on coaching, real-time feedback on live calls, and direct access to your manager while you master the role.

  • Post-Probation Schedule: Standard hybrid model, 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) - Saas Santé
descriptionHtml:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe Sales Public

L’équipe Sales Public accompagne les établissements de santé dans l’adoption des solutions Lifen, principalement autour de la gestion des documents de santé. Elle compte aujourd’hui 8 Sales Account Executive qui travaillent sur l’ensemble du territoire.

Les Sales concentrent aujourd’hui leur temps sur les plus grands établissements et groupements hospitaliers. À côté, il existe un vivier d’environ 800 structures de santé de plus petite taille.

Nous créons donc notre premier poste de SDR Public. Ton rôle sera de construire ce périmètre : mieux connaître ces structures, trouver les personnes à contacter, qualifier les opportunités et transmettre aux Sales des rendez-vous réellement exploitables. Tu travailleras principalement sur nos offres Lifen Documents et Curecall by Lifen.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Prioriser un portefeuille d’environ 800 petites structures de santé déjà cartographiée.

  • Entrer en contact avec les prospects, comprendre leur contexte et qualifier les opportunités avant de proposer un échange avec un ou une Sales Account Executive.

  • Générer des rendez-vous qualifiés pour l’équipe Sales, en transmettant les informations utiles pour permettre une prise de relais efficace.

  • Mettre à jour le CRM avec rigueur : contacts, informations sur les structures, niveau de maturité des opportunités et prochaines étapes.

  • Faire progresser les méthodes de prospection sur ce nouveau périmètre : messages, séquences, critères de qualification et priorisation des comptes.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Une première expérience de cold call intensive (Stage, Alternance ou CDI), idéalement d’un à deux ans en startup, en SDR, Inside Sales, prospection B2B ou relation client.

  • Une vraie appétence pour la prospection : prendre contact, obtenir les bonnes informations, relancer et transformer une approche en rendez-vous qualifié.

  • La capacité à organiser un volume important de comptes, à prioriser et à tenir un suivi précis dans un CRM.

  • Une communication orale et écrite claire, adaptée à des interlocuteurs de direction de structures de santé.

Nice-to-have

  • Une expérience dans la santé ou auprès de professionnels et d’établissements de santé.

  • La pratique d’outils de CRM et de prospection.

Soft skills

Tu es énergique et tu aimes avancer sur un périmètre à construire. Tu communiques simplement, tu écoutes avant de proposer un rendez-vous et tu acceptes les retours pour ajuster ta manière de faire. L’humilité compte : tu travailleras avec une équipe Sales expérimentée et tu sauras apprendre à ses côtés tout en apportant tes propres observations du terrain.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity. Tu avances dans un secteur de santé complexe et sur un portefeuille encore peu structuré, en transformant progressivement des informations éparses en opportunités qualifiées.

Bienveillance. Tu collabores étroitement avec les Sales, dans une équipe où l’entraide et le partage d’informations font partie du quotidien.

Real Impact. Chaque rendez-vous qualifié peut contribuer à équiper davantage de structures de santé avec des outils qui simplifient la circulation des documents.

👥 Process de recrutement

Le process est volontairement court et se déroulera principalement en visio.

  1. TAM Screening avec l’équipe recrutement - Environ 30 minutes. L’objectif est de comprendre ton parcours, ta motivation pour le poste et d’évaluer les fondamentaux attendus : communication, énergie, organisation et posture commerciale.

  2. Case study avec l’équipe Sales - Un entretien en visio d’1h comprenant la restitution de deux exercices préparés à l’avance et la réalisation de deux exercices en direct. Le cas sera envoyé environ deux jours avant l’échange et demandera environ 1h de préparation. Il permettra d’évaluer ta capacité à prioriser, à structurer une approche de prospection et à communiquer avec clarté.

  3. Final Interview - Un entretien avec un Manager de l’équipe Sales pour valider l’alignement culturel.

Nous nous engageons à te donner de la visibilité tout au long du process et à revenir vers toi sous 72h après chaque étape. Des prises de références pourront être demandées en fin de process, avec ton accord.

Soigner mieux en soignant ensemble, c'est aussi agir avec bienveillance. À l'image du secteur dans lequel nous évoluons, nous favorisons la diversité, l'inclusion et l'équité. Nous mettons en valeur vos compétences et votre savoir-faire, et bannissons toute forme de discrimination, qu'elle soit sexuelle, religieuse ou politique.

Compensation: €35K • €0 – €10.5K Commission

title: Sales Team Lead (Small / Mid-market)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Sales Team Lead (Small or mid-market) ⭐

We're opening Sales Team Lead roles in France to lead some of our growing crews of Sales:

  • Mid-market teams, covering companies with 30–300 employees.

  • A very small businesses team, covering companies with fewer than 10 employees, run fully inbound.

In this role, you will own acquisition on one of the Small / Mid-Market segments in France and run the business end-to-end. You'll be hands-on in the field while coaching and scaling a crew of Sales to win the associated market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition. We have just passed the one million member milestone, and this is only the beginning. We're accelerating acquisition in France, and Mid-Market is one of the core pillars of that plan.

Why mid-market is exciting at Alan:

  • A large market with real momentum. You'll lead growth on a big B2B segment where our offer is already winning. We have strong references to build on.

  • Faster cycles, real stakes. Deals typically involve HR, Finance and the CEO, and sometimes a broker. Cycles are shorter than in Enterprise, so you see the results of your decisions quickly.

  • A strong product story. Companies in this range want a modern, digital health experience with fair pricing. They also want simple HR administration. This is where Alan stands out against traditional insurers and brokers.

  • Attractive economics. The segment has solid margins and is a key pillar of Alan's path to profitability in France.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of one of the Small / Mid-Market crews in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and building the machine. More precisely, you will:

  • Own the associated Mid-Market acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go-to-market strategy for 30–300 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets.

  • Lead a team of Sales:

    • Drive hiring, onboarding and career development as we scale the crew.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow-up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution and pipeline management.

    • Be in the field with the team: joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the crew. Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: a strong feedback culture, clear ownership and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers. Surface customer expectations, patterns and blockers. Make sure they're addressed through the right plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? You may be a great fit at Alan if you... ⭐

  • Have at least 6 years of experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and an advanced level of English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands-on mentality: you love being in the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to small or mid-market companies (30–300 employees) in multi-stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data-driven and analytical: you know how to use KPIs to drive performance, run analyses and make decisions

  • Have strong cross-functional collaboration skills and an appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Nantes, Biarritz or Annecy

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience selling to HR, Finance and C-level stakeholders

  • Having already opened or scaled a new segment or market in a fast-growing company

  • Experience selling insurance, benefits, HR tech or SaaS

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

title: Senior Account Executive, Hotels - France & Netherlands (12M FTC)
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping independent, boutique hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.

The Difference You Will Make

As a Senior Account Executive, you will be responsible for converting leads into net‑new supply to support new-market launches and at pace to hit quarterly goals. Working the full sales funnel, you will proactively turn cold leads into warm sales opportunities helping to build the Hotels category’s market presence in the process through collaboration with other teams. This includes partnering, strategizing, and running daily operations directly with independent, boutique hotels , and ensuring that Airbnb sources  the best hotel inventory available to our guests.

This role is based in Paris (hybrid, 2 days a week in the office).  It will start off as a 12-month FTC with the potential for conversion depending on individual performance. 

A Typical Day

  • Meet and exceed KPIs by owning the performance and success of assigned region
  • Prospect new potential hotels through external research, networking, and use of Airbnb tools.
  • Securing new hotels involves targeted sales strategies and negotiating and closing the deals
  • Develops acquisition strategies and scalable, localised supply strategies for established and emerging markets
  • Expertly position and communicate Airbnb’s value proposition to new partners via phone, email, and in-person
  • Add net new hotels by qualifying and moving leads through the funnel as quickly as possible, achieving defined quarterly goals
  • Find supply in and launch new markets: Own market launches including supporting lead generation and coordinating cross functionally
  • Support hotel onboarding as needed from won sales opportunities
  • Effectively promote and build strong relationships with hotels by demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of our platforms and confidently pitching their value

Your Expertise

  • 8+ years of professional experience, preferably in a fast growing startup tech or hospitality company working in sales and/or account management
  • Previous hospitality experience is a plus
  • Proficiency in both English and French.
  • CRM required; Proficiency in Salesforce, Gong and other scalable AI Sales prospecting tools is a plus.
  • The ability to get things done with constantly changing priorities, projects and deadlines
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and analytical skills, detail-oriented but moves fast
  • Ability to establish strong relationships with and influence partners 
  • Capacity to balance day-to-day responsibilities with longer-term strategic execution
  • You’re a quick learner and you’re fearless about doing whatever it takes to get the job done, even if it means making mistakes along the way
  • Able to travel up to 25-30% of the time
  • Passion for Airbnb and travel

How We’ll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for variable incentive pay, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

The On-Target Earnings (“OTE”) range for this role is €98,000 to €115,000 gross per year, which includes a split of 80% (base pay) / 20% (variable incentive). Of this OTE amount, the annual gross base salary range is €78,400 to €92,000. 

The OTE reflected on this job posting is the target cash compensation a candidate could earn in a year if they achieve 100% of their performance or sales goals. The variable incentive is not guaranteed and is governed by the terms of Airbnb’s Hotels Variable Compensation Plan (the “Plan”). The actual payouts depend on performance against targets set under the “Plan” and may be higher or lower than the range listed on this job posting.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.
