title: Senior Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Tracksuit exists to help marketers prove their brand building is working. We give teams the data they need to make smarter decisions, convince stakeholders, defend budgets, and track their progress. The brand tracking industry is dominated by 100-page reports, static data and big price-tags. We're doing things differently by being built for the modern marketer: always-on, accessible, and approachable.

We're now tracking more than 16,000 brands across 25 countries globally. With offices in Auckland, Sydney, London and New York City, we're scaling fast with a brilliant team of collaborative and ambitious humans. Our culture is defined by "high care, high performance". We strive to be the best and look after each other while we do it.

Are you our next Senior Account Executive in London?

Brand matters. Most marketers know that already. The hard part is proving it to a CFO. That's where Tracksuit comes in, and it's where you come in too.

We're growing our London sales team, and we're hiring several Senior Account Executives to start together in the new year. You'll own new business across the UK and Europe. You'll run the whole sales cycle with some of the world's most exciting consumer brands, and help shape how we win in one of our fastest-growing markets. You'll also be joining just as we reveal the next chapter of brand tracking in January 2027, so there's a lot to talk about.

What you'll do

  • Own a new business target and run the whole sales cycle, from first conversation to signed deal

  • Work leads that come in to us, meetings our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) book for you, and opportunities you create yourself, mostly with mid-sized consumer brands

  • Sell alongside our Partnerships team on deals that agencies bring us

  • Run deals that cover several UK and European markets at once

  • Run sharp, story-led demos that show each brand what its own data can do for it

  • Work with Marketing, Events and Partnerships to build pipeline, because nobody here hits their number alone

  • Be a face of Tracksuit at London events and dinners

What you'll bring

  • A record of hitting your own revenue target. You've built your own pipeline and closed deals against it. We're hiring at more than one level, so we'd love to hear from you whether you've carried a number for 4 years or 8.

  • You create your own opportunities. You don't wait for leads to come in.

  • Experience selling to mid-sized companies. Some larger enterprise deals are a bonus.

  • Drive that holds up after a "no". You stay organised and focused on your goals, and you see a lost deal as something to learn from.

  • You want to be coached. You ask for feedback and use it quickly. (Fair warning: you'll get to show us this in the interview.)

  • You like being out and about. Networking, events, and being a face of a fast-growing company.

Bonus points if you love brands, or know marketing or marketing technology.

An SDR background is welcome. This role does need someone who has already been responsible for closing deals.

Why you'll like it here

  • You'll start with a cohort. You'll join alongside other new starters, so you'll learn and ramp up together, not on your own.

  • Time together in the office. With the team in 3 to 4 days a week, you'll pick things up faster: sitting alongside people who've done it before, getting feedback in the moment, and celebrating the wins together.

  • A product with a point of view. Brand tracking has long meant 100-page reports and big price tags. We do it differently, and you'll be selling to the people who care most about brand.

  • Room to make your mark. Our London team is still small and growing fast, so your ideas will shape how we sell.

  • A team that wins together. High care, high performance. We're competitive, but we're not jerks about it.

Salary

Our pay range is fixed, so what you see is what we offer.

  • Senior Account Executive: £70,000 to £85,000 base salary, with OTE of £140,000 to £170,000

OTE is your base salary plus commission when you hit 100% of your target. Commission depends on performance and isn't guaranteed.

The details

  • Location. London, our Clerkenwell office. We're office-first, so you'll be in with the team 3 to 4 days each week.

  • Start date. Offers by the first week of January, with hires starting from mid-January into February.

How our process works

We want to get to know more of the people who apply, not just the ones whose CV tells the whole story. So instead of shortlisting on CVs alone, we'll invite more applicants into the first stage of our process.

That first stage happens in your own time. You'll record a short video interview and complete any other quick online steps, whenever suits you over a few days. It's your chance to show us how you think and what drives you. AI tools help us review these, and a real person makes every decision.

Once we've reviewed the video interviews, shortlisted candidates get a chance to speak with our Talent team about the role and their application in more detail. Then you'll come into our office to interview with the team. We'll let you know exactly what to expect, and anything to prepare, when we invite you.

Key dates

  • From Monday 23 November: invitations to record your video interview, sent as applications come in

  • Sunday 29 November: applications close

  • Once we've reviewed the video interviews: if you're shortlisted, a chance to talk with our Talent team about the role and your application in more detail

  • Monday 14 to Wednesday 16 December: interviews in our office. That's our goal, though some interviews may take place the following week

  • By the first week of January: outcomes and offers, once we're back from the Christmas break

  • From mid-January into February: new hires start!

You'll hear from us either way.

Sound like you? Hit apply before Midnight Sunday 29 November. We’d love to hear from you.

Du arbeitest fachlich direkt mit unseren Steuerberater:innen, Tax-Operations-Kolleg:innen und Softwareentwickler:innen zusammen. Was du im Alltag lernst und gestaltest, fließt direkt in unsere Prozesse zurück und trägt mit unseren Agenten wesentlich zum Erfolg der Firma bei. Du führst kein Team, du trainierst Agenten: Jede Prüfregel, die du definierst, läuft über alle Mandate. Dein Hebel ist das System, nicht die Teamgröße.

DEINE AUFGABEN

LAUFENDE BUCHHALTUNG & ABSCHLÜSSE

  • Du verantwortest Qualität und Abschlussreife eines Mandantenportfolios: FiBu, HGB-Abschlüsse, USt-Meldungen. Der Agent bucht, du entscheidest fachlich die Grenzfälle.

  • Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB: Abgrenzungen, Rückstellungen, Anlagevermögen, Abstimmungen. Du prüfst, entscheidest und bringst sie bis zur Abschlussreife für unsere Steuerberater.

  • Umsatzsteuer: UStVA und ZM validieren, Sonderfälle wie Reverse Charge, OSS und Drittland entscheiden und als Regel festhalten.

PROZESSE, DATEN & AUTOMATISIERUNG

  • Validierung automatisierter Buchungen und Meldungen: Du definierst Prüfregeln, misst Fehlerquoten und verbesserst Regeln und Prompts laufend.

  • Du findest, wo Zeit verloren geht, und baust mit unseren Engineers die Automatisierung.

TEAM & MANDANTEN

  • Vertretung unserer Leads für Jahresabschluss und Finanzbuchhaltung, inklusive Freigaben

  • Du verantwortest die Mandantenbeziehung zu Buchhaltungs- und Abschlussthemen, vorbereitet und unterstützt durch KI

  • Steuerliche Fragen erkennst du früh und gibst sie buchhalterisch aufgearbeitet an unsere Steuerberater: Sachverhalt, Zahlen, deine Einschätzung

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • 6–10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Buchhaltung, davon mindestens 3 Jahre mit Verantwortung für die Buchhaltung in einem Start-up oder Scale-up, idealerweise in mehr als einem Unternehmen

  • Sicherheit in Monats- und Quartalsabschlüssen sowie in der Jahresabschlussvorbereitung nach HGB

  • Sehr gute Steuerkenntnisse, vor allem in Umsatzsteuer (inkl. internationaler Sachverhalte), mit Grundlagen in Ertragsteuern im Abschlusskontext und im Verständnis von Lohnbuchungen

  • Du hast Buchhaltungsprozesse selbst umgebaut: Systemwechsel, Schnittstellen (Bank, Payment, ERP) nach DATEV oder manuelle Schritte automatisiert. Du kennst DATEV und andere Buchhaltungs-Tools und weißt, wo Daten brechen.

  • KI im Alltag: Du nutzt Tools wie Claude täglich, hast Buchhaltungsvorgänge automatisiert und formulierst Anforderungen so, dass Engineers sie bauen können.

  • Die Fähigkeit, Buchhaltung für Nicht-Buchhalter:innen verständlich zu erklären

  • Ausbildung oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen oder Steuern

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und gutes Englisch (Unternehmenssprache)

  • Mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche im Münchner Office, für schnellere Abstimmung und Dynamik im Team

VON VORTEIL

  • Berufsexamen (Steuerberater:in, Bilanzbuchhalter:in IHK, Steuerfachwirt:in) ist ein Plus. Was zählt, ist dein fachliches Urteil, nicht der Titel.

  • Kanzlei- oder WP-Erfahrung, IFRS oder Konzernbilanzierung

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • AI-natives Setup: Du baust den Buchhalter-Job der Zukunft. Die Agenten, die du heute trainierst, machen morgen die Routine. Du entscheidest, was sie lernen.

  • Das Tooling, das du brauchst: Was fehlt, beschaffen wir oder unsere Softwareentwickler:innen bauen es mit dir

  • Kurze Wege: Verbesserungen setzen wir schnell um, oft noch am selben Tag

  • Klarer Karrierepfad mit transparenten Kriterien und Gehaltsentwicklung

  • 28 Urlaubstage

WIR BAUEN DIE STEUERKANZLEI DER ZUKUNFT

Radikal einfach. Hochautomatisiert. 100% mandantenfokussiert.

Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfach, schnell und transparent für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam. Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen und langen Wartezeiten kämpfen, bauen wir ein digitales, proaktives, KI-gestütztes Erlebnis. Repetitive Aufgaben laufen weitgehend von selbst, und es bleibt Zeit für Beratung, Sonderfälle und smarte Lösungen.

Der Unterschied zu anderen „Digitalkanzleien“: Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler:innen. Deine Kolleg:innen bauen die Tools, die dir im Alltag helfen, für deine Probleme und nicht von der Stange.

Wir sind ein erfahrenes Team aus Steuerberatern, Buchhaltern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €, finanziert mit 12 Mio. € von führenden Investoren. Mit dir gemeinsam wollen wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.

title: Senior Accountant, General Ledger
descriptionHtml:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

Our Finance team plays a critical role in ensuring accurate financial reporting and supporting the business across our nine legal entities. The team manages the full spectrum of general ledger activities, working closely with Tax, external stakeholders, and colleagues across Finance to ensure a smooth and reliable month-end close. We value collaboration, accountability, and analytical thinking, with a shared curiosity to understand the story behind the numbers.

Your responsibilities

Month-End Closing (9 entities)

  • Own the month-end close for your assigned tasks, from posting to review, in line with the closing calendar

  • Prepare and book prepaid expenses and accruals, and maintain the supporting schedules

  • Prepare and book the CIT accrual

  • supporting of posting and reconcile bank transactions, and clear open items

  • Perform FX revaluation and currency translation, and prepare data for consolidation

  • Prepare and post manual journal entries in line with the approval process

  • Support IFRS-related postings (e.g. IFRS 15) in line with group accounting policies

  • Support local GAAP adjustments (e.g. HGB) where required for statutory reporting

  • Support the Tax team with VAT reconciliations

  • Perform balance sheet reconciliations and investigate variances

  • Run analyses of P&L and balance sheet movements, and explain variances to stakeholders

Year-End Closing & Audit

  • Support the year-end close and the preparation of statutory and group reporting

  • Support the group audit by preparing schedules and providing documentation and explanations to auditors

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Work closely with Controlling/FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement and the AP and Revenue teams to ensure accurate and timely closing inputs

  • Act as a point of contact for complex GL topics and share knowledge through documentation and onboarding of new colleagues

  • Review the work of more junior team members and provide guidance where needed

Process & Controls

  • Ensure compliance with internal controls and accounting policies

  • Keep documentation audit-ready and maintain closing checklists

Systems, Automation & Process Improvement

  • Work with our current ERP system and contribute to the implementation of our new ERP system (e.g. process design, testing, data validation, user feedback)

  • Use AI tools to make accounting work more efficient, for example for analysis, reconciliations and documentation

  • Identify and drive automation and improvement opportunities in the closing process

Qualities we look for

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools in your daily work

  • Tech-savvy, with an interest in digital tools and process automation

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • Several years of experience in general ledger accounting, ideally in an international, multi-entity environment

  • Solid knowledge of accrual accounting, reconciliations, fixed assets, intercompany accounting and foreign currency accounting

  • Experience with NetSuite ERP and advanced proficiency in Google sheets skills

  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and a structured way of working

  • Ability to manage several entities and deadlines at once and to prioritize under time pressure

  • Proactive, communicative and comfortable working in an international team

  • Willingness to share knowledge and support colleagues

  • Fluent English

Nice-to-have

  • Knowledge of IFRS, particularly IFRS 15, 16, 9 and 2

  • Knowledge of local GAAP (e.g. HGB)

  • Experience with an ERP implementation or migration

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

title: Senior Accountant (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
**This position is based in Germany with remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaos’ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Senior Accountant owns the end-to-end accounting for Chaos’s German entity, which is the main distributor of Chaos products worldwide. The role ensures full statutory compliance and timely financial reporting, and works closely with finance colleagues across the global business, combining technical accounting rigour with a process-improvement mindset so the business can move fast and operate at scale. This role requires an accountant with strong German GAAP and tax knowledge and experience in an international group.

Main Responsibilities

  • Own the full accounting cycle for Chaos Software GmbH, including general ledger, fixed assets, payroll postings, reconciliations, and monthly, quarterly and annual close, in line with German GAAP and group reporting requirements.

  • Act as the primary contact for external auditors, tax advisors and statutory filings.

  • Manage local treasury activity and payment cycles in coordination with the group finance team.

  • Prepare and submit all VAT returns and filings.

  • Define and maintain global standards for AP processes with teams across Chaos’s international entities, harmonising workflows, closing process gaps and driving automation in NetSuite and connected finance tools.

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate workflows, supporting the Accounting Director in building a culture of continuous improvement across finance.

  • Support accounting activities across the wider international group, including ad hoc projects as required.



  • 5 years of experience in financial accounting within an international corporate environment, ideally in a technology, software or SaaS business.

  • Experience working within an international group structure.

  • Experience with German statutory requirements and German GAAP (HGB), including preparing annual financial statements, balance sheet reconciliations and note disclosures.

  • Good understanding of German tax law, including corporate tax, trade tax, VAT declarations and withholding taxes.

  • Experience driving process improvement projects across finance.

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP, and familiarity with finance tooling in a software product environment.

  • Degree in Finance, Accounting or a comparable field.

  • Experience with IFRS is an advantage.

  • Experience with intercompany transactions and transfer pricing is an advantage.

  • A professional qualification (e.g. ACCA, CIMA) is an advantage and is not required where offset by strong practical experience.

Required Skills

  • Applies mastery of German accounting principles to prepare accurate, compliant statutory financial statements.

  • Works confidently across multicultural, multi-timezone teams.

  • Steps back from operational tasks to spot inefficiencies and builds scalable solutions that work across the group.

  • Fluent German and English, written and spoken, are required. Additional languages are an advantage.

We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.

title: Senior adviseur geotechniek
descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Jij zorgt met jouw geotechnisch advies dat civiele projecten veilig, uitvoerbaar en toekomstbestendig gerealiseerd kunnen worden.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Je werkt aan geotechnische analyses, adviezen en ontwerpen voor civiele en infrastructurele projecten.

  • Je pakt, afhankelijk van je ervaring, projecten zelfstandig op, van vraagstelling tot advies en ontwerp.

  • Je bent sparringpartner voor collega’s en opdrachtgevers bij complexe geotechnische vraagstukken.

Als senior adviseur geotechniek werk je aan uiteenlopende civiele en infrastructurele projecten, van spoor- en railinfrastructuur tot civiele constructies en waterbouwkundige werken. Je combineert technische analyses met advies en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar veilige, uitvoerbare en duurzame oplossingen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met opdrachtgevers en collega's. Binnen het team deel je jouw expertise en begeleid je, afhankelijk van je ervaring, ook junior adviseurs inhoudelijk.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je bent een ervaren geotechnisch adviseur die verder kijkt dan zijn eigen berekening. Je overziet het geheel, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en weet collega’s daarin mee te nemen. Je vindt het leuk om kennis te delen en bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van collega’s en het team.

Werk je nu bij een gespecialiseerd bureau en mis je de breedte van projecten, de invloed op inhoudelijke keuzes of de ruimte om collega’s te begeleiden? Of wil je jouw geotechnische expertise inzetten in projecten met grote maatschappelijke impact? Dan past deze rol goed bij jou.

Dit breng je ook mee:

  • meerdere jaren ervaring binnen de geotechniek, passend bij een medior- of seniorrol;

  • ervaring met Deltares-software (D-serie); ervaring met Plaxis is een pre, net zoals affiniteit met lijninfrastructuur;

  • sterke schriftelijke en mondelinge vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als Engels.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen.

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

  • een salaris tussen € 4.650 en € 7.580 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

  • een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt;

  • een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting.

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

  • flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

  • De mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

  • 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

  • met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld;

  • € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten;

  • € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

  • ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

  • leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied.

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

  • je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

  • een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je brutojaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

  • en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom-aandelen.

Jouw team bij Movares

Je werkt samen met een hechte groep geotechnische adviseurs die elkaar makkelijk weten te vinden. Eén dag per week – op woensdag – werken jullie sowieso samen op kantoor in Utrecht. Daarnaast is twee dagen per week op kantoor gangbaar, maar stemmen we locatie en werktijden flexibel af. Er is altijd iemand aanwezig en de lijnen zijn kort.

De sfeer in het team is open en gelijkwaardig. Er is weinig hiërarchie: senioriteit gaat hier niet over ‘boven iemand staan’, maar over kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Collega’s kunnen goed met elkaar opschieten, schakelen snel en staan voor elkaar klaar. Samenwerken doen we bewust, omdat we geloven dat je daar betere oplossingen van maakt.

descriptionHtml:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity? 

It’s an exciting time at Intercom — especially within our Deployment Services team. We’re helping some of the world’s most innovative companies transform how they support their customers through AI-powered customer service.

As a Senior AI Deployment Consultant, you’ll lead our largest and most complex customer deployments, combining world-class project management with hands-on technical configuration of Intercom’s platform — including our agent Fin. You’ll be the trusted advisor who ensures our customers achieve value quickly and at scale, guiding them not only to do the foundations, but set a direction on how they measure their impact with AI.

You’ll partner with a dedicated team of engineers for complex technical work while managing the overall project strategy, timeline, and delivery. This is a perfect role for someone who thrives at the intersection of technology, customer success, and execution excellence.

What will I be doing? 

  • Lead end-to-end deployment programs for our largest customers, ensuring successful and timely implementation to Intercom and Fin.
  • Define project scope, success criteria, and timelines that align with each customer’s unique goals and support model.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers throughout implementation, managing communication, alignment, and expectations.

  • Collaborate with our Product and R&D teams to surface feedback, identify improvements, and help shape future innovations.
  • Contribute to the evolution of our Deployment Services methodology, templates, and best practices.

What skills do I need? 

  • 6+ years of experience in customer-facing implementation, deployment, or professional services roles, ideally within SaaS or AI technology companies
  • Proven success managing large, complex projects with multiple stakeholders and workstreams.
  • Strong technical aptitude — comfortable configuring software platforms and discussing integrations, APIs, and data flows.
  • Excellent project management skills with a structured, proactive, and detail-oriented approach.
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, capable of influencing both executives and technical stakeholders.
  • Experience implementing or configuring platforms like Intercom, Zendesk, Salesforce, or similar customer experience tools is a plus.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving, prioritisation, and decision-making skills.
  • Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Passion for technology, AI, and helping customers succeed.

How will I be measured?

  • Automation Rate - Are you driving your customers to achieve high adoption of Fin?
  • Customer Satisfaction - Do customers receive a delightful and thorough experience as they begin their journey with Fin?
  • Timeliness — Are your projects on-schedule against the dedicated timelines?

#LI-Hybrid

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.  

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What you'll do

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

  • Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.

  • Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.

  • Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.

  • Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.

  • Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

  • Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

  • Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.

  • Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.

  • Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.

  • Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Bachelors degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs.

  • 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions.

  • Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught.

  • Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one.

  • Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops.

  • Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak.

  • Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in.

  • Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear.

  • Clear written communication. Mapbox is distributed across time zones and we make most decisions in documents and Slack.

Nice to have traits for this role

  • Geospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources.

  • Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to.

  • Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports.

  • Experience running evals in CI, with a commercial harness or one you built.

  • Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience.

  • Voice pipeline experience: streaming ASR, TTS, barge-in, endpointing, wake word.

  • Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity.

  • Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

 

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

We are expanding our R&D team with a Senior AI/ML Engineer who combines strong mathematical foundations with applied machine learning expertise to enhance the next generation of intelligent acoustic sensing solutions.

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will apply machine learning to real-world underwater acoustic sensing challenges using Optics11’s fiber-optic technology platforms. You will work closely with acoustics engineers, signal-processing specialists, and embedded/software teams to develop robust ML components that integrate seamlessly into operational systems.

This role requires a strong foundation in signal processing, applied mathematics, and statistics, and the ability to combine physics-based acoustic algorithms with data-driven ML methods.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement machine learning solutions for underwater acoustic sensing use cases, including detection, classification, localization and anomaly monitoring within fiber-optic sensing systems.

title: Senior AI Researcher- Pre-training (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring a Senior AI Researcher to join our Pre-training team and to advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about designing inference-efficient architectures, optimizing training recipes that scale reliably, and training models on a large scale cluster (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture

We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organisational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues.

About the Role

As a Senior AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will own the critical technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the high-leverage intersection of research and engineering, you will translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions - from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs.

We are looking for an expert who can combine rigorous experimental design with high-quality production code, directly influencing model quality, run reliability, and the efficiency of the models we ship.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Optimization: Own core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization) and design PyTorch-based architectural improvements to maximize convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Strategy & Predictability: Develop hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methodologies, using small-scale proxy experiments to reliably predict multi-thousand-GPU behavior and de-risk major training decisions.

  • Stability, Diagnostics & Debugging: Investigate complex convergence issues (loss spikes, divergence) and resolve hard-to-reproduce distributed system failures like communication bottlenecks, race conditions, and synchronization errors.

  • System-Model Co-Design: Partner with Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to align the model lifecycle with hardware constraints, memory bandwidth, and communication topologies.

Core Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and deeply familiar with PyTorch-based training workflows.

  • You have a strong track record in machine learning research and software engineering, demonstrated through shipped models, impactful open-source contributions, or published research.

  • You have a strong mathematical foundation and are comfortable reasoning formally about optimisation, scaling behaviour, and training dynamics.

  • You deeply understand transformer training dynamics, optimisation, and the behaviour of large distributed training jobs.

  • You can design rigorous experiments, reason clearly from noisy results, and translate empirical observations into robust training decisions.

  • Hands-on experience pre-training large models (e.g., 7B+ parameters) on substantial infrastructure (e.g., 100+ GPU clusters).

  • You apply strong software engineering practices, including writing maintainable, well-tested code and supporting reproducible experimentation workflows.

  • You are able to implement complex model architectures efficiently and reliably and to debug complex issues across model code, training dynamics, and distributed systems.

  • You collaborate effectively within a research and engineering team and communicate clearly about your work across Pre-training and the broader AAR/AA organization.

  • You are able to work in Germany and collaborate regularly on site in Heidelberg as part of the Pre-training team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Large-Scale Training: Hands-on experience training LLMs or multimodal models on large GPU clusters using distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan).

  • Predictive Scaling: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer, or methods for predicting large-scale training behavior from smaller proxy runs.

  • Stability & Performance: Experience profiling distributed jobs and diagnosing training anomalies like loss spikes, numerical instability, or optimizer pathologies.

  • Advanced Architectures: Exposure to sparse training approaches (e.g., Mixture-of-Experts) and an understanding of their routing and systems trade-offs.

  • Track Record of Impact: Demonstrated research excellence through top-tier publications (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR), impactful open-source contributions, or significant shipped technical work.

  • Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

Along with expanding into new markets and handling an increasing volume of transactions, Mollie has recently introduced exciting new products to broaden our offering. Mollie Capital offers easy access to flexible financing, providing funding to support growth and cash flow management. title: Senior Associate, Dasher & Logistics - Strategy & Operations EMEA (L3)
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Role outline

Proposed title: Senior Associate, Dasher & Logistics - Strategy & Operations

Location: London Head Office (The River Building) - Hybrid working (60% in Head Office)

Mission: Ensure a reliable and scalable courier network across EMEA markets by continuously optimising the end-to-end lifecycle experience. You will translate data-driven insights into practical actions that strengthen engagement, performance, and long-term participation. Your role is to maintain the right balance of supply to meet changing operational and customer demand across markets.

Core interfaces: EMEA Dasher & Logistics Operations (Regional Operations, Planning & Performance, Content & Engagement), Product, Data Science, Analytics Engineering as needed.

Job Description (ready to paste into Greenhouse)

The team

The EMEA Strategy & Operations team is responsible for ensuring our Dasher network remains stable, engaged, and responsive across multiple markets. We oversee the processes behind courier onboarding and activation, focusing on enabling new couriers to get started successfully and supporting ongoing participation over time.

Our mission is to maintain a reliable and adaptable supply base that can flex in line with changing customer and operational demand. We combine data insights, operational strategy, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure our network remains healthy, resilient, and ready to scale.

The role

As a Senior Associate, you will play a key role in shaping the performance and stability of our courier network across multiple markets. You will focus on supporting the teams responsible for onboarding and activation through data driven insights.

This is a fast-paced and high-impact role, centred on understanding network dynamics, identifying emerging risks or opportunities, and implementing effective operational responses. You will be accountable for maintaining a healthy and responsive supply base throughout the lifecycle, ensuring it aligns with business and customer needs.

You will operate as a hands-on operator, executing upon team initiatives and driving continuous improvement. Working closely with cross-functional partners across operations, product, analytics, and other central teams, you will translate data and insights into scalable processes and frameworks.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience delivering operational improvements through complex data analysis and modelling in fast-paced environments. You have a track record of identifying gaps or opportunities and working across teams to build scalable solutions.
  • Strong analytical capability. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, structuring problems clearly and using data to inform decisions and prioritisation.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and confidence working with large datasets. You can use data to answer business questions and track performance, combining strong logical thinking with the ability to learn quickly. Experience building dashboards or automating reporting is a plus.
  • Confidence using AI tools to improve how work gets done. You can integrate AI into existing processes to improve efficiency and the quality of outputs, applying sound judgement to validate results.
  • A strong bias for outcomes. You focus on delivering impact, measuring results, and iterating based on evidence and learning.

Preferred, but not required

  • Familiarity with experimentation, measurement design, and operational change management.
  • You have experience using basic automation tools (like Zapier, smart spreadsheets, or basic scripts) to automate repetitive tasks and build simple systems that handle high-volume operations.
  • Experience with courier, logistics, or gig economy operations.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to be the definitive food company. We are transforming the way the world eats by making food more convenient and accessible. We are a technology-driven company working at pace, with the autonomy to build, test, and ship. If you enjoy solving messy problems and turning them into scalable systems, you will find plenty to do here.

Location and working pattern

This role is based in our London Head Office (The River Building) and follows our hybrid working approach, with an expectation of around 60% of your time in the office. We aim to be flexible where possible, balancing individual needs with collaboration, stakeholder engagement, and delivery.

Benefits and diversity

At Deliveroo, people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. We offer a wide range of competitive benefits across health, family, finance, community, growth, and time away.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. We welcome people from all backgrounds and identities. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of building one of the fastest growing technology businesses in an exciting space.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Backend Platform (PHP and Python)
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Want to own how the backend works for everyone, not just one corner of it?

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who works across PHP and Python and wants a say in the bigger picture. You’ll lead company-level projects like our Auth Service: one authorization layer for PHP and Python, so Python products can handle their traffic directly instead of going through PHP. When things are unclear, you’ll research first, weigh the trade-offs and write them down. Then you’ll ship in small, safe steps. You’ll also decide where code should live based on what’s best for the system, not on which language you know best.

Product teams will come to you for advice, reviews, and a way through when they're stuck. The team is still taking shape, so you'll also help define ownership, standards, and how we work. If that mix of deep technical work and influence across teams sounds like you, keep reading.

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the Backend Platform team:

We're a small team of engineers from core PHP, Infra, and AI backgrounds. We lead technical initiatives across the whole backend and own its health. Product teams build and run their own components, and we give them the tools, standards, and expertise to do it well. Each of us leads our own project, from planning to agreeing with other teams to production. We work in weekly cycles and write our decisions down. Right now we're bringing PHP and Python platform work together into one common backend platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

  • Lead company-level technical projects end to end, from design and planning to rollout and support, such as completing our Auth Service development and shaping authorization as a separate layer for PHP and Python.

  • Shape the shared PHP and Python platform, and decide where each module should live based on the needs of the whole system.

  • Build the foundations that let new Python products launch and scale without being wired through PHP each time.

  • Define clear ownership of technical components across the backend, including who owns monitoring and knowledge for each.

  • Improve how we spot and handle problems: bug and incident management, less noise in alerts and error tracking, and Grafana Cloud dashboards for how services interact.

  • Find root causes across PHP and Python services using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

  • Make performance part of everyday work, not something we fix after incidents: clear performance metrics, tools that show where things slow down, and analysis of unusual user behavior that causes degradation.

  • Make architecture decisions with high load in mind, working with databases, servers, proxies, and DNS alongside the Infra team.

  • Work with the Security team to fix vulnerabilities, build in security practices, and keep libraries and dependencies up to date.

  • Improve developer experience: dev environment, CI/CD, routine automation, one documentation approach for PHP and Python, and tools for AI coding assistants.

  • Turn product teams' requests into solutions: find what really hurts, propose the best fix, and support them with architecture advice and reviews in shared components.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • Production backend experience in PHP or Python, and the ability to read and work with the other. You'll write production code in both.

  • Experience with high-load production systems and improving their performance.

  • Experience designing multi-component systems with clear boundaries, planning for failures, rollout, and rollback, with security in mind.

  • Experience comparing technical options, naming the trade-offs, and explaining your choice in writing (ADRs, Design Docs).

  • Hands-on observability experience: metrics, dashboards, alerts, logs, and distributed tracing, and using them to find root causes.

  • Experience leading a project that spans several teams: breaking it into small, testable steps, getting other teams on board, and taking it to production.

  • A track record of improving engineering quality beyond your own tasks, for example setting up error monitoring, or a new process when things kept breaking.

  • Enough infrastructure knowledge (databases, servers, proxies, DNS) to work well with Infra and see how your changes affect them.

  • Clear communication: you explain your point of view, find the real problem behind a request, and flag risks early.

  • Experience leading work independently while supporting your team: taking feedback, helping colleagues grow, and changing your mind when the arguments are good.

It would be great if you have:

  • Experience on a Platform or Core team.

  • Strong production experience in both PHP and Python.

  • Experience with authentication and authorization systems (for example, JWT or Ory Oathkeeper).

  • Experience defining SLOs and building symptom-based alerts.

  • Experience running incidents and blameless post-mortems.

  • Experience with Grafana Cloud, Rollbar, or similar tools.

  • Experience building developer tooling, CI/CD, or tools for AI coding assistants.

  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading knowledge sharing across teams.

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

  • 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family.

  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family.

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.

  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office.

  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota.

  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.

  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.

  • 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster.

Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. If you have individual needs that may require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application. We will do our best to provide assistance throughout your interview process to ensure you’re set up for success.

title: Senior Business Analist / Product Owner E-health
descriptionHtml:
Met je hoofd in de ICT, je hart bij de zorg en oog voor de mogelijkheden van AI.

Over PharmaPartners en eHealth

PharmaPartners ontwikkelt en beheert zorgsystemen voor de geïntegreerde eerstelijnszorg. Wij zijn een organisatie met een uitgesproken visie én aanpak op continue vernieuwing met de focus op groei. Daar kan jij een bijdrage aan leveren.

De business unit eHealth levert vernieuwende producten aan huisartsen en apotheken ter ondersteuning van hun patiënten. Met ons online portaal en onze app kunnen patiënten communiceren met hun huisarts en apotheek en onder andere hun medisch dossier inzien. Ruim 8 miljoen patiënten maken gebruik van ons portaal. Daarmee zijn we een van de grootste spelers op het gebied van e-health in de Nederlandse eerstelijnszorg.


Binnen Research & Development zetten we volop in op AI en agentic development. AI wordt steeds meer onderdeel van de manier waarop we analyseren, ontwerpen, ontwikkelen, testen en documenteren. Als Business Analist / Product Owner speel je hierin een actieve rol: je benut de mogelijkheden van AI, houdt regie op de inhoud en bewaakt samen met het team de kwaliteit, veiligheid en toepasbaarheid van de resultaten.

Jouw rol

Als Senior Business Analist / Product Owner ben je de brug tussen de business, klanten, gebruikers en development, met een leidende rol in de productontwikkeling. Je draagt bij aan de productvisie en roadmap en vertaalt die naar heldere prioriteiten voor de teams. Je begrijpt de behoeften van gebruikers en vertaalt deze naar functionele vereisten, technische specificaties en concrete ontwikkelvoorstellen.

Je werkt in een complexe en veranderende omgeving en houdt overzicht wanneer er veel tegelijk speelt. Je kijkt niet alleen naar wat vandaag nodig is, maar vooral naar wat morgen waarde levert: nieuwe marktontwikkelingen, innovatiekansen en de mogelijkheden van AI. Je neemt eigenaarschap over de volledige levenscyclus van je producten en je coacht collega’s in het vak. Je helpt het team om AI en agentic development verantwoord en effectief in te zetten binnen het ontwikkelproces.


Daarnaast vind jij het leuk om:

  • De behoeften van verschillende belanghebbenden, waaronder onze klanten en gebruikers, in kaart te brengen, documenteren en met elkaar in overeenstemming te brengen;

  • Eén of meer of meerdere scrum teams aan te sturen, die je begeleid in het ontwikkelproces volgens de SCRUM methodiek (planning, retrospective, refinements, e.d.);

  • De kwaliteit van de producten te waarborgen en continu te verbeteren door afstemming met de ontwikkelteams en alle betrokken stakeholders;

  • De schakel te zijn tussen klant en organisatie, waarbij je de klantwensen vertaalt naar concrete voorstellen en deze prioriteert op een product backlog;

  • AI in te zetten ter ondersteuning van bijvoorbeeld analyse, requirements, prototyping, documentatie en voorbereiding van refinements (natuurlijk zorg je ook voor een grondige controle, review en validatie op de output van AI;

  • De kwaliteit van producten bewaken en borgen dat deze voldoen aan de kwaliteits-, product- en informatiebeveiligingsnormen, in afstemming met ontwikkelteams en stakeholders;

  • De product backlog creëren, prioriteren en onderhouden, zodat het developmentteam aan de juiste ontwikkelingen werkt.

Werken met AI en agentic development

AI verandert de manier waarop software wordt ontwikkeld. Binnen PharmaPartners werken R&D-teams toe naar een gedeelde agentic way of working. De mens blijft verantwoordelijk voor keuzes en resultaten, terwijl AI ondersteunt bij onderdelen van het werk. Daarom zoeken we iemand die kansen ziet, kritisch blijft en nieuwe werkwijzen snel eigen maakt.

Heb je al ervaring met AI-tools, AI-agents, skills, prompten of agentic development? Dan is dat een duidelijke pré. Heb je die ervaring nog niet, maar ben je nieuwsgierig, leergierig en bereid je hierin actief onder te dompelen? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je werkt in een enthousiast Portfolio- en R&D-team en rapporteert aan de Teamlead Portfolio. Je levert een zichtbare bijdrage aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste eHealth-platformen van Nederland en hebt als senior invloed op de koers van het product en de werkwijze van het team. Dat doe je samen met open, eerlijke, en behulpzame collega’s in een hechte en informele organisatie.


Herken jij je hierin?

  • Jij hebt minimaal HBO+ werk- en denkniveau in de richting van bedrijfskunde, IT, zorgtechnologie of iets soortgelijks;

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in de zorg-ICT, in een rol als business analist of product owner;

  • Jouw kennis van de Nederlandse taal zit op minimaal C2-niveau. Ook in het Engels kun jij je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken;

title: Senior Content Manager
descriptionHtml:
PolyAI is the Agentic Dialog Platform for building the conversational enterprise, used to build, run, govern, and improve dialog agents at scale. Powered by Raven, a proprietary dialog model trained on more than a billion enterprise conversations, PolyAI agents are built for complexity, open at every layer, and sovereign by design. PolyAI serves hundreds of enterprises across 75 languages and 25 countries, including Metro Bank, Marriott, PG&E, and UniCredit.

PolyAI is hiring a Senior Content Manager to own what we publish and how people find it. You will set the content strategy and write a good share of it yourself. You will also build the systems that let a small team publish at the pace of a much larger one. You will write for three readers: enterprise CX leaders choosing a voice AI partner, developers building agents on our platform and APIs, and the technical audience that follows our models and research.

Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews which voice AI vendors to evaluate, often before they visit a vendor's website. Your job is to get PolyAI into those answers with an accurate description, then turn the visits that follow into sign-ups and sales conversations.

This role suits a writer who builds. You will use Claude Code, AI skills, Git repos and our CMS to turn one strong brief into dozens of strong pages, and you will have the editorial judgment to hold back a page that isn't ready. You won't start from zero: we already have early skills for use-case pages and content review, and a backlog of drafts waiting for an editor.

What you'll own and be measured on

  • The content strategy and editorial calendar across the website, blog, resource hub and video, agreed with Product Marketing and Demand Generation
  • Non-brand organic traffic, visibility and citation share in AI answers, and the sign-ups and pipeline that come from both
  • SEO from start to finish: topic and keyword strategy, on-page optimization, internal linking, and technical fixes with the web team (structured data, crawlability, site architecture, llms.txt)
  • AEO and GEO: the list of questions buyers ask AI assistants, each mapped to the page that should win it; content structured so assistants can quote it; and our presence on the review sites, communities, YouTube channels and roundups that assistants cite
  • Content engineering: the skills, templates, repos and automated checks that let us publish use-case, industry, comparison, developer and glossary pages at volume while keeping them accurate
  • Web copy for product and solution pages, in the house voice and true to what the product does today
  • Thought leadership: long-form pieces on where conversational AI is heading, including articles under our executives' names
  • Video scripts for product films, launch videos, explainers and short social cuts, written with Design and our video partners
  • Pages shipped per month, accuracy against our product facts, and how each piece performs after launch

What you'll influence, working with other teams

  • Model and research launches (with Research and Product Marketing): launch posts, model pages, and benchmarks explained for people who don't read papers
  • Developer content (with Product and Developer Relations): quickstarts, API guides, tutorials and comparison pages for people building voice agents
  • CX content (with Product Marketing and Customer Success): customer stories, industry use cases, buyer guides and ROI material
  • Brand voice and house style (with Brand and Design)
  • Sales and partner content (with Demand Generation and Partnerships)

Your first six months

  • In your first 30 days, audit what we have, learn the product from the people who build it, and ship your first pages
  • By 90 days, have a content strategy and calendar the marketing team works from, a tracked list of priority AI prompts, and a working content pipeline in a repo
  • By six months, show measurable growth in non-brand traffic and AI citations, and a publishing pace the team can keep up without you writing every word

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years in B2B content, including time at a technical, developer-focused or AI company, and a portfolio we can read
  • A record of growing organic traffic or pipeline through content, with numbers you can walk us through
  • Hands-on AEO/GEO experience: you have tested how AI assistants find and cite sources and can show what changed as a result
  • Working technical SEO knowledge (crawling, indexing, structured data, site architecture), and comfort shipping changes in a CMS or alongside engineers
  • Daily AI building habits: prompts, skills, scripts, small tools or workflows you can show us. You are at home in a terminal and in Git, using Claude Code, Cursor or similar
  • Range as a writer. You can write a developer quickstart, a buyer guide for a head of customer service, an executive op-ed and a 30-second video script
  • Enough technical depth to explain speech and language AI (latency, speech recognition, LLMs, evaluations) accurately, and the habit of checking claims with the people who built the thing
  • Editorial judgment and speed: you know when to ship and when a draft needs another pass
  • Experience with Google Search Console and Ahrefs or Semrush; experience with a headless CMS (we use Sanity) is a plus

Nice to have

  • Experience in contact center or conversational AI
  • Experience writing for model or research launches
  • Hands-on video production or editing
  • Experience managing freelancers or agencies

We offer competitive compensation based on experience, expertise, and the level of responsibility. This role also includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business. The listed expectations reflect what we're hiring for, so we encourage you to review the job description carefully.

title: (Senior) Controller (m/f/d) – Financial Reporting, Planning & BI
descriptionHtml:
Join our team!

We’re not looking for an all-around talent who simply fills out spreadsheets, but rather a meticulous numbers whiz (m/f/x) who doesn’t just report figures—but explains them: with a solid understanding of balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow, as well as a passion for preparing data in modern BI tools so that our management can use it to make forward-looking decisions.
You’ll work closely with senior management, the accounting department, and our interdisciplinary teams, actively driving the transformation of our reporting from traditional Excel analyses to automated, interactive dashboards.


Your Tasks

  • Impactful Reporting: You are responsible for monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting - including target/actual comparisons and variance analyses—and use these to derive clear, strategic recommendations for management.

  • Integrated Financial Planning: You will manage planning, budgeting, and forecasting based on integrated financial models in which the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement are consistently linked, and you will continuously refine these models.

  • Financial Analysis & Treasury: You will analyze and comment on the balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement, and you will be responsible for liquidity planning and working capital management.

  • BI Pioneering: You will build modern BI dashboards and data models (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik), define relevant KPIs, and establish a “single source of truth.”

  • Future Finance & Automation: You automate our controlling processes, integrate ERP, accounting, and operational data sources, and evaluate the use of AI tools (e.g., for smart annotations, predictive forecasts, or anomaly detection).

  • Financial Statement Support: You’ll support the team with monthly and annual financial statements in close, collaborative coordination with our accounting department.

  • Business Partnering: As a peer and trusted advisor, you’ll advise business units on investment decisions, profitability analyses, and ad hoc analyses.


Your Profile
  • Your Background: A successfully completed degree in economics, business informatics, or a comparable qualification (e.g., accountant with a strong focus on controlling).

  • Your Experience: Several years of solid experience in auditing (ideally at a Big 4 firm in the audit/assurance division) or in operational/strategic controlling.
  • Understanding of financials: A deep understanding of balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements, as well as how they interact (HGB required; IFRS a plus).

  • Modeling skills: You know the “three-pillar model” of integrated financial planning inside and out and understand exactly how operational assumptions (e.g., payment terms, investments, depreciation) impact all financial projections.

  • Tech & BI Affinity: Practical experience in data modeling with at least one common BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar)—knowledge of DAX, SQL, or Python is a strong plus.

  • Innovative Spirit: You’re open to modern tools and, ideally, have some initial experience with AI applications (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) for process optimization and data analysis.

  • System & Language Skills: Proficiency in Excel and ERP systems (e.g., DATEV, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics). You communicate at a business-level proficiency in German and are fluent in English.

Why us?
  • Scope for creativity: You will play a key role in helping to develop the BI-supported controlling function and will receive targeted training to this end
  • Direct collaboration with senior management and short decision-making processes
  • Part-time working arrangements tailored to your needs: available
  • Flexible and predictable working hours with no busy season or travel requirements; choice of working days and the option to work remotely
  • Further training in BI, AI, finance and controlling (e.g. certifications, specialist conferences)
