title: Senior Counsel, Privacy & Product (Hybrid)
descriptionHtml:
Location: London, UK – Hybrid (2 days per week in office)

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team that includes and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the jobOpenTable is looking for a highly motivated, practical, and business-oriented Senior Counsel, Privacy & Product to join our Legal team. You will serve as a trusted advisor to OpenTable’s Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial, Partnerships, and Marketing teams, providing strategic and practical counsel across product development, privacy and data protection, artificial intelligence, information security, consumer protection, and related regulatory matters. You will also serve as OpenTable’s Deputy Privacy Officer, helping lead and operationalize OpenTable’s global privacy program and serving as a key liaison with Booking Holdings, Inc. (BHI) on privacy and data protection matters. This role is ideal for a lawyer who enjoys working closely with commercial, product and technical teams, navigating emerging areas of law, and developing practical solutions that enable responsible innovation at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a primary legal partner to OpenTable’s Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial, Partnerships, and Marketing teams, providing end-to-end counseling on new products, features, data uses, integrations, consumer experiences, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Serve as Deputy Privacy Officer for OpenTable, helping lead and operationalize OpenTable’s global privacy program and serving as a key liaison with BHI on privacy strategy, governance, regulatory developments, and group-wide privacy initiatives.
  • Advise on global privacy and data protection requirements and embed privacy-by-design principles into OpenTable’s products and operations, including counseling on data collection, use, sharing, retention, consent, personalization, and consumer rights.
  • Provide strategic legal guidance on the development, deployment, procurement, and use of artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, including generative AI and AI-powered product features, and help develop scalable AI governance frameworks as the regulatory landscape evolves.
  • Provide strategic legal advice and guidance to Product teams regarding product development, launch, and sunsetting, with strong focus on legal risks related to data privacy, cybersecurity, data usage and ownership, consumer protection, and marketing. 
  • Partner closely with OpenTable’s Information Security team on cybersecurity and data security matters, including product and vendor security risk, security requirements, incident response, potential data breaches, regulatory obligations, and remediation.
  • Identify and address emerging product, privacy, AI, security, consumer protection, and regulatory risks; draft and negotiate related agreements and terms; and develop scalable legal processes, policies, playbooks, and disclosures that enable the business to innovate responsibly.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of relevant legal experience, including significant experience advising on privacy, data protection, technology, and product matters, preferably in-house at a technology, consumer, marketplace, or other high-growth company.
  • J.D. from an accredited U.S. law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar, or equivalent legal qualification and authorization to practice law in the United Kingdom.
  • Deep knowledge of U.S. and global privacy and data protection laws, including GDPR and U.S. state privacy laws, as well as global consumer protection laws, with demonstrated experience translating complex legal and regulatory requirements into practical product and business guidance.
  • Significant experience providing product counseling, including partnering directly with Product and Engineering teams on new products, features, data uses, and technology initiatives from development through launch.

Senior Data Protection Engineer (Backup & Cyber Resilience)

Location: Windsor, UK

Introduction

We’re hiring a Senior Data Protection Engineer to join a global hosting and managed services team. The team runs business-critical, highly regulated systems for organisations around the world, many of them in healthcare, where losing data or failing to recover it is not an option.

This is a senior role with real influence. You’ll own the enterprise backup and recovery platform across all regions. You’ll set the standards for how data is protected, retained and restored, and you’ll show, with evidence, that recovery targets are met. You’ll also help shape where data protection services go next, at a time when cyber resilience matters more than ever.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Run the platform globally. Lead the engineering, administration and continuous improvement of an enterprise Rubrik environment. This covers configuration, upgrades, capacity planning, health monitoring, security hardening and lifecycle management.

  • Set the rules. Design and enforce global protection policies, including SLA tiers, retention, archiving, replication, immutability, encryption and access controls.

  • Turn requirements into protection. Convert business, regulatory, contractual and risk needs into clear protection tiers, RPO and RTO targets, and practical operating procedures.

  • Keep coverage complete. Bring new workloads into the service and keep protection accurate across on-premises, cloud, virtualised, database and application environments.

  • Keep operations healthy. Monitor backup, replication, archiving and restore activity. Fix failed jobs, capacity pressure, performance issues and policy exceptions before they become risks.

  • Prove that recovery works. Plan and run restore tests, disaster recovery exercises and readiness reviews, and keep the evidence that recovery targets and controls are met.

  • Strengthen cyber resilience. Work with security and incident response teams on ransomware readiness, anomaly investigations, clean-recovery planning and privileged-access controls.

  • Build strong governance. Write the runbooks, standards and procedures that define good practice, and help regions and technology teams adopt them consistently.

  • Lead when it counts. Take technical ownership during incidents and service disruptions, and drive root cause analysis and lasting corrective actions.

  • Automate. Use APIs, scripting and orchestration tools to automate routine operations, compliance checks, reporting and workflows.

  • Report clearly. Give regular insight into protection coverage, recoverability, compliance, capacity, platform risk and operational performance.

  • Work across teams. Partner closely with infrastructure, cloud, database, application, security, risk and business continuity colleagues, and take part in a shared on-call rota for critical production services.

Requirements & Qualifications

Essential:

  • A solid track record of engineering and running enterprise-scale backup, recovery and data protection services

  • Extensive hands-on production experience with Rubrik

  • A current Rubrik Certified System Administrator (RCSA) certification

  • Experience designing and rolling out data protection policies, standards and operating models across multiple regions

  • A strong grasp of retention, immutability, encryption, access control, RPO and RTO, and recovery validation

  • Hands-on involvement in disaster recovery, cyber recovery or ransomware-resilience initiatives

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, and familiarity with incident, change and problem management processes

  • Experience supporting production services in a 24x7 or on-call environment

Benefits & Culture

  • Global reach and visible impact: Your work will directly protect critical services, including healthcare systems that clinicians and care providers rely on every day.

  • Real ownership: You’ll have a strong voice in policy design, retention strategy, cyber resilience, automation and the long-term direction of the service.

  • Growth and development: You’ll keep developing your skills on an enterprise-grade platform, with support for certifications and continuous learning.

We're looking for a Senior Data Science Manager to shape data science strategy across a broad area of our Logistics organisation. You'll combine strong people leadership, technical judgement and commercial thinking to help our teams make better decisions and deliver measurable business impact.

About The Logistics Team

Logistics makes our marketplace work in the real world: connecting riders with orders and helping deliveries happen efficiently and reliably. The organisation works on problems such as predicting demand, improving delivery-time estimates, and matching orders with riders, all in an efficient way to ensure we can offer the most affordable pricing to our customers.

These are interconnected challenges. Decisions about supply, incentives and network efficiency can affect consumers, riders and restaurant and retail partners at the same time. Data Science helps us understand those relationships, test new approaches and balance delivery reliability, rider experience and sustainable business economics.

It's an environment where rigorous experimentation meets real-world complexity, and where your team's work can shape both everyday operational decisions and longer-term product strategy.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll own the data science direction and measurable impact of a broad Logistics problem space spanning multiple cross-functional teams. You'll:

  • Set strategy and priorities with Product, Engineering and Operations leaders, focusing investment on the highest-impact opportunities across immediate needs and longer-term goals.
  • Build and develop a high-performing, inclusive team through hiring, coaching and performance management, growing leaders who can deliver independently.
  • Guide solutions to complex marketplace challenges, from balancing supply and demand to evaluating incentives and improving delivery performance and economics.
  • Set the technical bar for experimentation, causal inference and analysis, staying close enough to challenge approaches and ensure decisions reflect real marketplace effects.
  • Influence senior stakeholders and align teams around shared outcomes, resolving competing priorities and turning evidence into product and operational decisions.
  • Directly lead projects that resolve highly complex challenges, which often span across multiple parts of the business and unlock new vectors of impact, boosting company-level goals.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring:

title: Senior Decision Scientist, Sales
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again.

That is harder for us than for most, because what a client is worth depends on how their parcels flow through a network that's still growing. Engineering and analytics engineering build what you design.

Sales Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what a client or shop is worth and which signings sales should chase. The sales lead acts on your calls.

  • What is a new client or a new shop worth, when its value depends on where it sits in a network that changes every month? What would you build so sales knows before it signs?

  • Which signings become partners who do well with us, and what does that tell sales to look for?

  • The quarter's target is set. What has to close by when for it to hold, and what would tell you early that it won't?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide how sales values what it wins, and the result shows in what we sign next.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Decision Scientist, Sales at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Sales problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Sales decides: which signals count, what a client or shop is worth, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the sales lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the numbers and the street disagree: a new shop, a client's parcels at the sort centre.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, sales chooses what to go after on measures you built, and can see whether the quarter will land before it ends.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned B2B pricing or commercial decisions and their number, rather than maintaining sales dashboards.

  • Have built, hands on, the first version of how a company values a customer or a deal: unit economics, lifetime value, or what it costs to win one.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or sales went after different deals because of it.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Can say early whether a quarter will land, and what would tell you it won't.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer, Marketing Website
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on our Website team, you'll be a co-owner of the platform behind synthesia.io: the component library, content model and rendering stack that every page on our marketing site is built from. You'll shape direction and make key technical decisions with the team, likely with a focus area of your own but context across the whole system. This is a hands-on engineering role, and your primary output is high-quality component and schema code, plus the tooling that lets others build with it.

Millions of people visit synthesia.io every month, and it is one of the main ways we win new customers. That comes with real responsibility. The decisions you make are seen at scale, and we set the quality bar accordingly.

The defining challenge of this role is composability: a marketing site that marketers, and increasingly AI agents, can build pages with, without breaking design, performance or SEO.

What You'll Do

  • Build, scale and evolve our section library: the Astro components, Sanity schemas and design tokens that let us compose marketing pages consistently and accessibly.

  • Own the content model. Design schemas that resist misuse, so an editor, or an agent, can build a page that is correct by construction rather than correct by review.

  • Take Figma component specs all the way to production: responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop, accessible by default, matching design intent precisely.

  • Extend the platform for AI-assisted development, so coding agents can generate on-brand, on-spec sections from a design spec as reliably as a person can.

  • Own SEO integrity as a first-class engineering concern: canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, redirects, and no traffic cliffs on launch.

  • Raise the bar on engineering standards across the website surface: thorough code review, patterns others can follow, and tests around the parts that actually break.

  • Maintain and extend localisation across nine locales and a translation pipeline, so the system works for a global audience.

  • Shape the technical direction of the website platform over the next 6 to 12 months, and champion its adoption with the people who publish on it.

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • At least five (5+) years as a software engineer, including three (3) at senior level, building front end for content-driven or marketing platforms.

  • Real ownership of a content model in Sanity. You've designed schemas other people had to live with, and you have opinions about references vs. embedded objects, when a variant belongs in the schema versus at runtime, and how to stop a section library sprawling. GROQ and Portable Text are familiar territory.

  • Deep front-end expertise: expert HTML, CSS and TypeScript, with a strong command of component API design and the developer experience of a shared library.

  • You can work end to end. Comfortable owning the server side as well as the front end: SSR, serverless and edge runtimes, API routes, a SQL database, secrets and CI. You should be able to take a feature from schema to component to the route that serves it without handing off, and be happy debugging something that only reproduces in production.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility and web performance, and comfortable building to WCAG 2.2 AA. Accessibility is part of your definition of done, not a separate pass.

  • You care that marketing sites are measured, on performance, SEO, analytics events and conversion, and you're happy being accountable to those numbers.

  • A strong sense of craft and attention to detail, and the judgement to balance design intent against engineering constraints.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills. You explain your reasoning, review generously, and treat levelling up the people around you as part of the job.

We’d be particularly excited if

  • Prior experience working on a large SaaS marketing website, at real traffic and with real stakes attached.

  • Astro, or another islands or static-site framework.

  • Cloudflare Workers, or another edge or serverless platform.

  • Experience with AWS Lambda.

  • Tailwind CSS v4, and experience working from a token-based design system.

  • Experience, or strong interest, in making component libraries and content models consumable by AI agents.

  • A strong design sensibility: an eye for visual detail and the judgement to push back on and improve design decisions, not just build them.

  • Experience with localisation and internationalisation at scale for a global audience.

  • Analytics and tag management implementation: dataLayer events, server-side tagging, getting attribution right without hurting performance.

Location
Our preference is for this role to be based hybrid out of our London, UK office. We can also accommodate remote workers elsewhere in Europe subject to compliance and right to work checks.

title: Senior GRC Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

Come help us build the world's most trusted on-demand logistics engine for delivery! We're building a team of great minds to help us secure and maintain a 24x7, no-downtime, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash’s multi-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and drivers.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior GRC Engineer to help take DoorDash's compliance program from something people run to something the platform runs on its own. Reporting to the Security Compliance Manager, you'll take primary ownership of how regulatory and framework change gets tracked, interpreted, and turned into real controls - one part of a broader GRC function that spans audit, policy, and risk. Day to day, that means less time updating spreadsheets and more time writing the automation, integrations, and control logic that let audit evidence collect itself. You'll also lead major external audits from start to finish and help shape the policies and control standards the rest of the program is built on.This is a hands-on role for someone who already has deep audit and assurance experience, wants to spend more time building than briefing and can move a program forward, and change how people work, without needing the title to make it happen.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Build the regulatory and framework change-management process that keeps DoorDash ahead of new obligations, instead of reacting to them.
  • Move manual, point-in-time compliance work onto Compliance-as-Code foundations: policy-as-code, automated control testing, and continuous evidence collection wired into CI/CD, so audit readiness holds up between audits, not just during them.
  • Design and run agentic workflows for evidence analysis, control testing, and audit response preparation, with a human in the loop where assurance demands it.
  • Partner directly with engineering and architecture teams to design controls into new systems at build time and translate that technical work into the narratives auditors actually need.
  • Partner with the Security Compliance Manager to shape and mature the global compliance program. 
  • Design, implement and validate security controls relevant to DoorDash’s regulatory environment, not just document them.
  • Support development and refinement of security policies, standards, and guidance. 
  • Mentor other members of the compliance team and help set the technical bar the rest of the function grows into.
  • Ensure policies are actionable, testable, and aligned to real-world controls. 

We’re excited about you because you have…

  • 5+ years of experience in security compliance, GRC or technology risk, with a strong track record in high-growth, technology-driven and regulated environments. 
  • Hands-on experience building large language models and agent workflows with daily use of AI in your own work, grounded judgment on what to delegate to agents versus what needs a human, and the ability to evidence both to an auditor. DoorDash is an AI-forward organization and the ability to optimize efficiency using AI is crucial in this role.
  • The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with frameworks such as DORA, the EU AI Act, NIS2 and CRA. 
  • Real, hands-on experience implementing and assessing controls against frameworks like PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001 - not just reading them.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify control gaps, assess risk and drive remediation in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. 
  • Experience developing, implementing and improving security policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring they are operational and effective.
  • Strong understanding of compliance metrics and reporting, with the ability to track control effectiveness, audit outcomes, and risk exposure. 
  • Ability to influence and drive accountability across technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex audit and compliance requirements into clear, actionable guidance. 
  • Comfort owning compliance metrics and reporting - you can show, not just assert, that a program is working.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Senior Group Treasury Systems Manager
descriptionHtml:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

We're looking for an experienced Treasury Systems leader to shape and deliver the future of Treasury technology at WPP.

Reporting into Group Treasury, you'll lead the management, optimisation and transformation of our global treasury systems landscape, supporting the delivery of Elevate28, WPP's strategic transformation programme. You'll work across Treasury, Finance, Technology, regional teams and external partners to drive automation, improve controls, enhance reporting, and deliver major system initiatives.

The role will oversee cross-regional transformation projects, ensuring successful delivery of complex system and process changes while managing risks, dependencies, resources, and key stakeholder decisions. You will also play a pivotal role in Treasury Systems governance, leading change request management, supporting Steering Committee activities, and helping shape the future operating model of the Treasury function.

This is a high-impact role with the opportunity to influence the future operating model of Treasury Systems at a global scale while leading a team based in Bengaluru.

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the Treasury Systems strategy, roadmap, and transformation agenda, driving the optimisation and enhancement of Treasury technology across a global organisation.
  • Deliver large-scale transformation initiatives, including system upgrades, automation, integrations, data governance, and process standardisation.
  • Oversee the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design through to testing, implementation, governance, and post-go-live support.
  • Partner closely with Treasury, Finance, IT, banking partners, and external vendors to ensure successful delivery of strategic initiatives.
  • Act as the key liaison between Treasury and technology teams, translating business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
  • Manage Treasury systems governance, service delivery, vendor relationships, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Maintain a robust control environment, ensuring systems, processes, and data align with governance and risk management requirements.
  • Champion innovation by leveraging automation, analytics, and AI-driven solutions to enhance treasury processes and decision-making.
  • Drive improvements in data quality, reporting accuracy, operational efficiency, and business insight.
  • Support strategic cash management, liquidity, and treasury transformation initiatives on a global scale.
  • Develop and embed scalable support models, processes, and best practices to enable efficient and effective Treasury operations worldwide.
  • Monitor emerging technologies and industry trends, identifying opportunities to improve Treasury capabilities and operational performance.

Key Systems Expertise

  • Strong experience with Treasury Management Systems, ideally ION IT2.
  • Expertise in treasury technology, banking connectivity, and system integrations, including SWIFT, APIs, and host-to-host solutions.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future Treasury technology landscape within a global organisation, driving strategic change while delivering tangible business value.

What you'll need:

  • Proven experience implementing, managing, or supporting Treasury Management Systems within a corporate or financial services environment.
  • Strong understanding of UK and international treasury operations, including cash management, liquidity, financial instruments, and regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrated project management expertise, with a track record of delivering complex transformation and systems initiatives on time and within budget.
  • Advanced analytical skills, including strong proficiency in Excel, reporting tools, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Experience integrating treasury platforms with ERPs, banking systems, and payment networks is highly advantageous.
  • A proactive problem solver with a strong focus on process optimisation, controls, and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively at all levels.
  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a global, fast-paced team environment.
  • An appreciation of emerging technologies, including the application of AI to enhance treasury operations, insights, and decision-making.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Senior Infrastructure Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Coda Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.

With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia.

We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay, Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud, enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you.


The Opportunity
We’re looking for an experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong AWS and cloud security expertise to join our global Infrastructure Operations team. You’ll architect, build, secure and maintain the cloud infrastructure behind Coda’s platforms. Beyond daily operations, you’ll help us manage infrastructure better at scale, strengthen our AWS security and make changes safer and simpler for engineering teams. You’ll work closely with engineers across the company to solve infrastructure challenges, improve reliability and cut down manual work through automation.
What You'll Do
  • Design, build and maintain secure, scalable and highly available AWS infrastructure across multiple accounts and regions
  • Manage infrastructure as code and improve our CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments
    Strengthen AWS security with controls and policies across the organization, plus well designed IAM and network security rules
  • Spot and fix security risks, misconfigurations and vulnerabilities, working closely with our Security team on reviews, investigations and remediation
  • Improve monitoring, logging and alerting so teams can catch and resolve issues faster
  • Automate repetitive tasks and make it easier for developers to self serve their infrastructure needs
  • Keep our platforms reliable, performant and cost efficient, including taking part in on call rotations, troubleshooting production incidents and preventing them from happening again
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams, share what you know and help shape technical decisions

    • What You'll Bring
  • 5+ years in infrastructure operations, cloud, platform engineering or DevOps, with at least 3 of those years working on AWS
  • Hands on experience with core AWS services like EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS, VPC, Route 53 and CloudFront, including managing multiple accounts through AWS Organizations
  • Confident with Terraform or a similar Infrastructure as Code tool, plus building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong grasp of AWS security, including IAM, access across accounts, SCPs, RCPs and network security, along with auditing tools like CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty or Security Hub
  • Solid networking knowledge, including VPC, routing, firewalls, VPN and private connectivity
  • Comfortable with Linux, scripting in Python or Bash, and containers using Docker, ECS or Kubernetes
  • Familiar with monitoring tools like Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus or OpenTelemetry, with strong troubleshooting skills and a collaborative way of working across engineering teams
  • It’s a plus if you’ve worked with security automation tools like Cloud Custodian, Checkov or Trivy, know standards such as PCI DSS or the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark, have experience with high traffic distributed systems or payment platforms, or hold an AWS certification like Security Specialty, Solutions Architect or Advanced Networking

title: Senior Kreditorenbuchhalter (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Bei Statista dreht sich alles um Daten und Fakten, denn wir sind die weltweit führende Business Data Plattform. Durch die Bereitstellung verlässlicher und einfach nutzbarer Daten sowie verschiedener Datenanalyseprodukte und -dienstleistungen unterstützen wir Menschen weltweit, faktenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

2007 in Hamburg gegründet, haben wir uns schnell zu einem globalen Unternehmen mit Büros in Metropolen wie London, New York und Tokio entwickelt. Und wir haben auch weiterhin viel vor. Unser stetiges Wachstum ist nicht nur Beweis für unseren Erfolg, sondern schafft auch immer neue Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen.

Wir schätzen und feiern unsere vielfältige Kultur. Hier bist Du willkommen, egal, wer Du bist, woher Du kommst, wie Du aussiehst oder welche Graphen und Diagramme Du bevorzugst. Deine Geschichte ist wichtig – schreibe sie weiterhin als Teil unseres Teams. Überzeuge dich selbst und werde Teil unseres Teams!

Dein Job

'• Kreditorenbuchhaltung im Tagesgeschäft: Du bearbeitest Eingangsrechnungen und klärst Abweichungen und offene Posten eigenständig. Auch bei hohem Volumen sorgst du für zügige Bearbeitung und verlässlich hohe Qualität.

• Verantwortung für den Prozess: Du behältst den gesamten Purchase-to-Pay-Prozess (P2P) im Blick – von Bestellung über Wareneingang und Rechnungsprüfung bis zur Zahlung – und arbeitest eng mit den beteiligten Teams zusammen.

• Abschlüsse und Abstimmungen: Du stimmst Kreditorenkonten ab, bearbeitest Klärfälle und lieferst belastbare Beiträge zu den Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen.

• Prozessverbesserung und Projekte: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe über Teamgrenzen hinweg, identifizierst Engpässe und setzt Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen um.

• Automatisierung und KI: Du prüfst, wo Automatisierung und KI die Bearbeitung sinnvoll unterstützen können, und gestaltest Lösungen mit, die Effizienz und Qualität verbessern – mit angemessenen Kontrollen und fachlicher Prüfung.

Dein Profil

title: Senior Localisation Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role overview

We are seeking a Senior Localisation Quality Engineer, a highly skilled and innovative individual who brings together design-phase product thinking, software engineering expertise, localisation awareness, and technical problem solving.

The role builds on the core responsibilities of a Senior Localisation QA Engineer, combining strong localization quality expertise with software engineering, automation, and earlier involvement in the product design and development lifecycle.

This role is ideal for someone who has worked closely with design teams in Figma, has experience reviewing and validating designs before implementation, understands how localisation impacts product and UI design, and can build scalable technical solutions to improve quality across the product lifecycle. You will partner with design, engineering, product, and localisation teams to identify risks early, improve design quality and localisation readiness, and create tools, systems, and solutions that enable faster and smarter delivery.

Rather than focusing only on post-implementation testing, this role emphasises early engagement in the design phase, including reviewing Figma files, prototypes, design systems, user flows, and content structures to ensure they are scalable, testable, and ready for localisation across languages and regions. You will also contribute as a hands-on engineer, building software, automation, integrations, and AI-driven solutions such as agents, assistants, or plugins that improve workflows, validation, and quality decision-making.

The ideal candidate combines strong software development skills, experience working with design systems and Figma-based workflows, practical understanding of localisation and internationalisation, and hands-on interest in engineering solutions to product and quality challenges.

Responsibilities

Design Systems, Figma & Early Product Quality

- Partner with designers, product managers, engineers, and the wider Localisation team to help identify localisation risks early in the design phase.
- Support the Localisation team by reviewing Figma designs and providing technical and design expertise to improve localisation readiness before implementation.
- Help the Localisation team identify and address design risks such as text expansion, truncation, layout issues, bidirectional languages, locale-aware components, and cross-market scalability.
- .Build and improve tools, automation, and processes that enable Localisation QA to identify issues earlier and at scale, including automated design and content validation, screenshot capture, localisation readiness checks, and quality validation across languages and regions.
- Work with the wider Localisation team to define best practices and guidance that help designers and engineers create products that are ready for localisation from the start.
- Collaborate with design teams on design systems, UI patterns, and content structures to improve quality and reduce downstream issues before code is written.
- Help define quality expectations, localisation considerations, and implementation guidance directly from design artefacts and product requirements.

Localisation Quality & Testing

- Perform hands-on Localisation QA testing across multiple languages, platforms, products, and regions, including linguistic, functional, visual, and internationalisation testing.
- Lead and support complex localisation quality initiatives, while contributing directly to day-to-day testing when needed.
- Develop and improve localisation test strategies covering linguistic, functional, visual, and internationalisation quality.
- Investigate complex localisation and internationalisation issues and work with engineering, design, product, and localisation teams to identify root causes and appropriate solutions.
- Help define localisation quality standards and ensure localisation considerations are integrated throughout the product development lifecycle, from design through implementation and release.

Software Engineering & Technical Solutions

- Design and develop software, internal tools, automation, and reusable services that improve product quality, design validation, and workflow efficiency.
- Build scalable software solutions that support validation of product experiences across design, development, and release stages.
- Contribute to codebases, frameworks, and technical infrastructure that improve quality signals, design consistency, and localisation support.
- Partner with software engineers to improve feature readiness, system testability, and quality-by-design practices.
- Integrate validation and quality workflows into modern development environments and CI/CD pipelines where appropriate.

Automation, Tooling & Process Improvement

- Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve localisation and product quality across design, engineering, and localisation workflows.
- Design and build tools, automation, integrations, or other technical solutions that help teams review designs, validate content, detect issues, and improve workflows.
- Choose the right technical approach for each problem, which may include traditional automation, scripts, plugins, APIs, AI/LLMs, or existing internal tools.
- Develop solutions that help identify localisation and quality issues earlier in the product lifecycle and provide faster feedback to teams.
- Prototype and test new approaches, measure their value, and develop successful solutions so they can be used by the wider Localisation team and potentially other teams.

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Act as a bridge across design, engineering, product, and localisation teams, helping align quality, scalability, and user experience goals.
- Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex issues into actionable recommendations.
- Influence teams toward a shift-left, design-led quality approach.
- Contribute to planning, design reviews, implementation discussions, and release readiness with a focus on preventing issues early.
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to members of the Localisation team, sharing engineering, automation, localisation, and quality best practices.
- Promote a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Education

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, Design Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in software engineering, design technology, quality engineering, localisation engineering, or related product development roles.
- Strong hands-on experience in software development, with the ability to build tools, systems, integrations, or automation that solve real product challenges.
- Experience working closely with design teams and Figma workflows, including reviewing designs, prototypes, component systems, and user journeys before implementation.
- Experience validating or testing Figma designs for quality, scalability, localisation readiness, and implementation feasibility.
- Practical understanding of localisation and internationalisation principles in digital products.
- Experience with localisation quality or testing across multilingual products, platforms, or regions.
- Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Java.
- Hands-on experience building or experimenting with AI agents, plugins, copilots, or intelligent workflow tools.
- Experience with APIs, structured data, system integrations, and modern software development practices.
- Familiarity with developer collaboration tools such as GitHub, JIRA, and Confluence.
- Strong understanding of product development lifecycle, Agile methodologies, and cross-functional delivery models.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong product thinking and problem-solving ability.
  • Comfortable operating across design, engineering, product, and localisation domains.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and effective in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organisational and stakeholder management skills.

Desired qualifications

  • Experience with Figma design systems, component libraries, and design-to-development workflows.
  • Experience creating or contributing to Figma plugins, design validation tools, or workflow extensions.
  • Experience building AI agents, assistants, or plugins for design, engineering, content, or localisation use cases.
  • Experience influencing product quality earlier in the lifecycle through design review and engineering collaboration.
  • Familiarity with multilingual product development, translation workflows, or international launch readiness.
  • Experience in video games, consumer technology, digital entertainment, or large-scale product environments.
  • Fluency in one or more non-English languages is a plus.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to shape next-generation quality, localisation, and design-to-development practices.
  • A dynamic and inclusive workplace where technical excellence, collaboration, and global impact thrive.
  • Competitive compensation, performance bonuses, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Career growth opportunities in a forward-looking engineering environment focused on quality, localisation, automation, intelligent systems, and early product excellence.

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

title: Senior logistiek medewerker Meppel
descriptionHtml:
Werk jij graag in de logistiek en neem je makkelijk het voortouw? Dan zoeken wij jou. Je werkt actief mee op de werkvloer, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat onze operatie veilig en efficiënt verloopt.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je komt te werken in ons depot in Meppel. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat duizenden pakketten iedere dag op tijd worden verwerkt. Je werkt in een vast rooster met wisselende diensten:

  • 01:00 - 09:30 uur (nacht/ochtend);

  • 13:30 - 22:00 uur (middag/avond).

Je bent bereid beide diensten te werken volgens een vooraf vastgesteld rooster.


Wat ga je doen?

Als senior logistiek medewerker begeleid je collega's op de werkvloer en ondersteun je de Teamleader Operations bij de dagelijkse operatie.

  • Laden, lossen, sorteren en scannen van pakketten.

  • Bewaken van de voortgang, kwaliteit en veiligheid.

  • Collega's ondersteunen en begeleiden.

  • Knelpunten signaleren en helpen oplossen.

  • Aanspreekpunt zijn tijdens de dienst.

  • De Teamleader Operations ondersteunen of vervangen.

  • Meedenken over verbeteringen in het proces.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris tussen € 2.501,82 en € 3.574,03 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een functie 38,75 (1 fte) uur per week.

  • Een gunstige ORT (onregelmatigheidstoeslag)

    • 30% tussen 20:00 uur en 24:00 uur;

    • 45% tussen 00:00 uur 06:00 uur;

    • 50% op zaterdagen en zondagen;

    • 100% op feestdagen;

  • Opleidingskansen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en onbeperkt toegang tot onze Studyhub.

  • 28 vakantiedagen (+ optie tot bijkoop) en reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Veel extra’s, zoals een collectieve zorgverzekering en een aantrekkelijk pensioen.


Wat neem je mee?

  • Mbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Ervaring in logistiek, productie of operations.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van collega's is een pre.

  • Kennis van Excel.

  • Je communiceert makkelijk en neemt initiatief.

  • Je houdt overzicht en hebt oog voor mensen én processen.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

Solliciteren

Solliciteer eenvoudig via onderstaande sollicitatiebutton. Wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan zetten we samen de volgende stappen in de sollicitatieprocedure.

  1. Kennismaking: we leren elkaar beter kennen tijdens een eerste gesprek.

  2. Assessment: je maakt een online assessment thuis.

  3. Tweede gesprek: we bespreken de resultaten en gaan verder in op de functie.

  4. Aanbod: is er een match? Dan doen we je een aanbod.

Vragen? Neem gerust contact op met onze corporate recruiter, Donne van der Wal via +31 6 29 989 532.

Klik hier voor een uitgebreidere uitleg over ons sollicitatieproces.

title: Senior Manager, Data Platform
descriptionHtml:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Data Platform to lead our UK data engineering organisation and drive the development of a scalable, standardised data foundation across our international markets.

In this role, you will lead a lean, multidisciplinary technical team spanning Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Machine Learning Engineering, growing the team to  6+ people by the end of 2027. You will be responsible for the technical direction, operational resilience, and delivery effectiveness of the platform, ensuring that engineering resources are sharply directed toward the highest-value commercial, product, and technical priorities.

You will partner closely with Product, Commercial, Clinical, and Operations leaders in the UK, as well as Data and Technology leadership in Australia, to align regional architecture with our broader international data strategy.

This is a critical transformation phase: over the next year, your team will enable the launch of three to five new markets and execute the migration of two international businesses onto our shared data infrastructure, including complex transitions from Databricks and Redshift to Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

This is a senior leadership role requiring a balance of strong architectural judgement, technical credibility, and the ability to operate fluidly across strategic planning, people leadership, and hands-on platform transformation.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary UK data platform team across Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Data Science/MLE.
  • Define the roadmap, technical priorities, and operating model for the data platform, ensuring engineering investments are effectively aligned to key business initiatives.
  • Oversee and execute the migration of international data ecosystems onto a shared GCP infrastructure (specifically driving the transition from Databricks and Redshift).
  • Collaborate globally with Data and Technology leadership to architect a consistent, highly scalable, and internationally aligned data infrastructure.
  • Partner with UK Product, Commercial, Analytics, and Operations leaders to shape and deliver a resilient international data roadmap.
  • Drive the core data platform execution and scaling required to seamlessly support the launch of new markets and brands.
  • Provide authoritative technical leadership and sound architectural judgement across data pipelines, ML infrastructure, and overall cloud platform decisions.
  • Cultivate a high-performing, accountable engineering environment with strong technical standards, clear ownership, and sustainable software delivery practices.

About You

  • 8+ years of technical experience encompassing data engineering, platform engineering, machine learning operations, or core data science.
  • 3+ years of management experience, successfully leading and developing multidisciplinary technical teams.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating a modern, scalable cloud data platform.
  • Strong foundation in data or platform engineering, with the hands-on credibility to guide architecture, code standards, and infrastructure decisions.
  • Exceptional product judgement with the ability to connect underlying technical investments directly to tangible business outcomes.
  • Proven ability to prioritise ruthlessly, manage competing operational demands, and create clarity in dynamic or ambiguous environments.
  • Strong influencing and translation skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical engineering teams and senior business stakeholders.
  • Ideally, you bring a track record of leading complex platform migrations (especially into GCP environments), supporting international market expansions, or driving large-scale technology transformations.

title: Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you’ll manage and grow a large portfolio of fleet business, using data and AI to assess risk and tailor cover to each client. You’ll help us move into new segments, including emerging mobility, as we build one of the UK’s largest fleet MGAs. You’ll report to our Head of Motor Underwriting.

You’ll work closely with brokers, mentor junior underwriters and help shape our products, wording and processes. AI is part of the underwriting process itself: you’ll use it to pull risk data out of submissions and triage cases faster, leaving your time for the judgement calls that need an experienced underwriter.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Manage and develop a large portfolio of motor fleet business and contribute strongly to team targets.

  • Build strong, supportive relationships with brokers.

  • Help unlock growth in new market segments, including emerging mobility.

  • Collate and analyse portfolio data so our Head of Motor Underwriting can track performance.

  • Improve how we gather risk information from clients, so quoting and onboarding run smoothly for clients and brokers.

  • Spot where our policy wording and cover can improve, and raise it with our Head of Motor Underwriting.

  • Train and develop people in the Underwriting and Operations teams, and spread underwriting knowledge across Flock.

  • Use AI to extract and check risk information and speed up quoting, keeping your own judgement on every decision.

 

What you’ll need

  • Extensive experience underwriting motor fleet insurance.

  • A track record of building strong broker relationships.

  • Confidence working with data to monitor and analyse a portfolio.

  • Up-to-date knowledge of the motor fleet market and the curiosity to keep up as it changes.

  • Experience training or mentoring others.

  • Comfortable using AI in your underwriting work, and curious about where else it can help.

Nice to have: experience with large corporate customers, ACII (qualified or working towards it), or working with product teams to get process and customer journey improvements onto the roadmap.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. This role is expected to be field based rather than office based, so visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

title: Senior People Advisor
descriptionHtml:
About us

We love pets - which is why we’re on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents.  We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We’ve helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.  Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.  Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.  Want to join our pack?  Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

Role and purpose mandate

ManyPets is continuing to evolve as it scales, with increasing organisational complexity and a need for strong People partnership that enables leaders to build high-performing, engaged and effective teams.

The Senior People Advisor plays a critical role in aligning people priorities with business goals, partnering with senior leaders to shape organisational capability, improve performance, strengthen manager capability and support sustainable growth.

This role combines advisory partnership with practical delivery across organisational effectiveness, employee relations, workforce planning, leadership capability, engagement, wellbeing and data-led decision making.

You will partner closely with designated senior leaders and management teams to deliver effective people plans and solutions, ensuring they land well, are embedded within the teams you support, and contribute directly to business performance, employee experience and our values-led culture.

A day in the life

  • Accountable for providing employee relations advise to designated business areas, supporting leaders with organisational design, workforce planning, performance, engagement and complex people matters.
  • Provide hands-on support, coaching leaders through ambiguity and ensuring People activity is commercially grounded, legally sound and aligned to company priorities.
  • Support People Advisors, ensuring consistent, high-quality advice and operational delivery across the employee lifecycle.

Your responsibilities

People Partnership

  • Partner with senior leaders to translate business priorities into clear, practical and measurable people plans.
  • Provide trusted advice on organisational change, leadership effectiveness, team health, engagement, performance and culture.
  • Use people data, engagement insight and employee relations trends to identify risks, opportunities and areas for action.
  • Coach leaders to make balanced, inclusive and commercially grounded people decisions.
  • Ensure a values-led People experience is felt by teams and delivered in line with business priorities.

Change Management & Engagement

  • Diagnose and lead the People elements of change projects that improve business performance and align with strategic goals.
  • Partner with leaders and managers to ensure change is understood, communicated effectively and embedded well.
  • Support change initiatives including organisational design, redeployment, ways-of-working changes and team restructures, ensuring risks are identified and mitigated.
  • Work with senior leaders on timely communication and engagement plans for upcoming change.
  • Help managers and teams understand engagement results, identify themes and agree practical actions to improve future engagement.

Employee Relations, Risk & Performance

  • Lead on complex employee relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, legally sound and values-led outcomes.
  • Advise on performance, conduct, absence, grievance, disciplinary and change-related matters.
  • Identify people risk and escalate appropriately, balancing employee experience, policy, legal requirements and business need.
  • Build manager capability to handle people matters confidently, consistently and with awareness of the impact on individuals, teams and the business.
  • Maintain a proactive focus on wellbeing risks, including mental health, and ensure inclusion and wellbeing principles are considered across the employee journey.
  • Support positive employee relations, helping to maintain a healthy working environment, morale and regrettable turnover.

Data, Reward & Governance

  • Draw insight from people metrics to inform and advise stakeholders.
  • Use data-driven insight to continuously improve people strategies, processes and interventions.
  • Provide insight and support on reward processes, including benchmarking where required.
  • Ensure people data, reward activity and related processes are accurate, well managed and compliant.
  • Maintain awareness of GDPR, data protection requirements and relevant internal policies and procedures.
  • Support a regulated business environment by balancing innovation, fairness, employee experience and appropriate governance.

People Advisor Support & Operational Excellence

  • Support People Advisors, providing direction, coaching and development.
  • Oversee the quality and consistency of advice provided to managers and employees.
  • Prioritise and allocate casework, ensuring effective workload management and timely resolution.
  • Identify opportunities to improve people processes, guidance, templates and manager self-service.
  • Ensure People activity is delivered consistently, accurately and in line with policy, employment law and company values.

Measures of success

  • Business leaders receive proactive, commercially grounded and trusted people partnership.
  • People plans support organisational priorities, performance and capability needs.
  • Change activity lands well, is clearly communicated and is embedded effectively.
  • Employee relations matters are managed fairly, consistently and with appropriate risk mitigation.
  • Manager capability improves, particularly in performance, engagement, change and employee relations.
  • People risks and wellbeing themes are identified early and addressed pragmatically.
  • People Advisors are well supported, effective and delivering high-quality advice.
  • People data and insight are used to inform better decisions and improve outcomes.

Why this role matters

  • Strengthens the connection between business strategy and people priorities, helping leaders build effective teams and make better people decisions.
  • Improves organisational effectiveness, manager capability and employee experience through consistent, high-quality People partnership.

About you

  • Proven experience as a People Advisor, ideally in a fast-paced, scaling, operational or customer-service-led environment.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders and managers through periods of change, transformation or organisational complexity.
  • Strong employee relations expertise and a deep understanding of UK employment law and best practice.
  • Commercially minded, delivery-focused and able to balance business priorities with fairness, empathy and sound judgement.
  • Confident using people data and insight to diagnose issues, influence decisions and improve outcomes.
  • Comfortable working with reporting, Excel and larger data sets.
  • Able to influence senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and coach leaders effectively.
  • Experience managing, coaching or developing People Advisors or HR colleagues.
  • Strong attention to detail, high standards of accuracy and a commitment to quality.
  • Curious, pragmatic and able to translate complex people matters into clear, practical advice.
  • CIPD qualified or able to demonstrate equivalent experience.
  • Experience in a regulated financial services environment is essential, with a good understanding of SM&CR or similar regulatory expectations.
Salary range:£60,000—£70,000 GBP

Ways of working

On a typical day you’ll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset.  You’ll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we’d expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day.  We’d ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively.  We’ll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.

Inclusion at ManyPets

We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won’t discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback.  If you'd like to read more about this, please download our Approach to Inclusion policy. 

Reasonable adjustments and support

If you need any help, support, or advice at any point during the hiring process please email
