title: Senior People Operations Generalist (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Senior People Operations Generalist (m/f/d)
Standort: München

Bei der Viessmann Generations Group sind unsere Mitarbeitenden die Grundlage unseres Erfolgs. Als Senior People Operations Generalist (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group verbindest du operative HR-Expertise mit Freude an Prozessverbesserung und Automatisierung. Du sorgst dafür, dass People Operations heute verlässlich funktioniert und morgen noch besser wird. So schaffst du die Grundlage dafür, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden in jeder Phase ihrer Zusammenarbeit mit uns gut begleitet werden.

Über uns

Viessmann wurde 1917 gegründet und ist seit über einem Jahrhundert ein führendes Industrieunternehmen im Bereich Klimatechnologien. 2024 brachte das Familienunternehmen sein Climate Solutions Geschäft mit Carrier Global zusammen, um eine transatlantische Partnerschaft mit weltweit einzigartiger industrieller Reichweite zu schaffen.

Die Viessmann Generations Group verkörpert seitdem die Weiterentwicklung hin zu einem globalen Ökosystem mit dem gemeinsamen Leitbild: Lebensräume für zukünftige Generationen zu gestalten.

Durch strategische Investments, Partnerschaften und philanthropisches Engagement unterstützt die Viessmann Generations Group Unternehmer:innen und Initiativen, die sich den zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit stellen. Die thematischen Investitionsfelder reichen von der Vermeidung, Reduktion und Speicherung von Treibhausgasen über die Verbesserung von Luft- und Wasserqualität und Ernährungssicherheit bis hin zur Förderung von Gesundheit, Bildung, Wissenschaft und dem Schutz demokratischer Werten.

Der Viessmann Way beschreibt, wie wir arbeiten, führen und gemeinsam Wert schaffen – ob als Teammitglied, Unternehmer oder Partner in unserem Ökosystem. Der Viessmann Way ist kein Regelwerk, sondern ein Kompass: ein lebendiges Set an Prinzipien, geformt durch unternehmerisches Handeln und ausgerichtet auf unser langfristiges Leitbild.

Deine Chance

Als Senior People Operations Generalist (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group bringst du deine operative HR-Expertise in ein werteorientiertes Umfeld mit klarer Mission ein. Als Teil unseres People Operations Teams übernimmst du Verantwortung für zentrale People-Prozesse und entwickelst sie weiter – vom Vertragsmanagement über Payroll und HRIS-Datenverwaltung bis zu Prüfungen und internem HR-Controlling.

Du verbindest Sorgfalt, Diskretion und Verlässlichkeit mit einem vorausschauenden Blick auf Systeme und Automatisierung. Damit gestaltest du eine positive Employee Experience und eine People-Funktion, die technologische Kompetenz mit einem klaren Blick für die Bedürfnisse unserer Mitarbeitenden verbindet.

Dich erwartet ein kollaboratives Team, das Vertrauen, Fairness und hohe Qualität schätzt. Wenn du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Abläufe für Menschen einfacher und besser machst, findest du bei uns den passenden Gestaltungsspielraum.

People-Prozesse optimieren & automatisieren

  • Du betreust das HRIS-System (HiBob) und stellst eine reibungslose Automatisierung der People Operations sicher.

  • Du förderst die Automatisierung durch den Einsatz der Google Suite einschließlich Apps Script, AI Studio, NotebookLM und weiteren KI-Lösungen.

  • Du steigerst Effizienz und Compliance durch datenbasierte Verbesserungen der People-Prozesse.

Operative Exzellenz & Compliance sicherstellen

  • Du stellst sicher, dass alle People-Prozesse mit dem deutschen Arbeits-, Steuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht, unseren Compliance-Vorgaben und branchenüblichen Best Practices im Einklang stehen.

  • Du verantwortest das Vertragsmanagement, Vertragsänderungen und die Mitarbeiterdokumentation.

  • Du stellst gemeinsam mit unserem externen Payroll-Dienstleister regelkonforme und korrekte reguläre und außerplanmäßige Gehaltsabrechnungen sowie die damit verbundenen Aufgaben sicher.

Employee Journey gestalten

  • Du betreust den gesamten Employee Lifecycle – vom Onboarding bis zum Austritt.

  • Du bist eine vertrauensvolle Ansprechperson für People-Richtlinien, Mitarbeitendenbelange und Compliance-Fragen.

  • Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich einzelne Sonderprojekte entlang des Employee Lifecycle.

Beziehungen & HR Leadership stärken

  • Du arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, darunter Führungskräfte, Mitarbeitende und externe Partner.

  • Du unterstützt Führungskräfte dabei, durch bewährte People-Praktiken eine leistungsstarke Unternehmenskultur aufzubauen.

Warum wir?

Bei uns trifft die langfristige Perspektive eines Familienunternehmens auf den Gestaltungsspielraum einer Organisation im Wandel. Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen, moderne HR-Systeme und KI-Anwendungen im Alltag nutzen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer People Operations aktiv mitgestalten. Dabei siehst du unmittelbar, wie dein Beitrag den Arbeitsalltag unserer Mitarbeitenden verbessert. Dich erwarten kurze Entscheidungswege, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und ein Team, das Wissen teilt und sich unterstützt.

Dein Profil

  • Relevante Erfahrung: Du bringst mindestens vier Jahre Erfahrung in People Operations oder HR-Administration mit, insbesondere in vorbereitender Payroll, Vertragsmanagement und Employee-Lifecycle-Prozessen.

  • Fundiertes Fachwissen: Du bist versiert im deutschen Arbeitsrecht und mit angrenzendem Steuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht vertraut, insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit Payroll. Die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Payroll-Dienstleistern, Krankenkassen und Behörden gehört zu deiner täglichen Praxis.

  • System- und Prozessverständnis: Du hast Erfahrung mit HRIS-Systemen und bereits erfolgreich Prozesse optimiert und Automatisierungen umgesetzt. Erfahrung mit HiBob und Google Workspace sowie ein gutes Verständnis weiterer People-IT-Systeme und KI-Anwendungen sind ein starkes Plus.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Daten und Office-Anwendungen: Du beherrschst insbesondere Excel und Word und arbeitest sicher mit Formeln, Vorlagen, Auswertungen und strukturierter Dokumentation.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Sorgfalt: Du arbeitest proaktiv, präzise und zuverlässig. Du beherrschst wiederkehrende, standardisierte Abläufe und hast zugleich den Anspruch, sie weiterzuentwickeln. Diskretion und ein verantwortungsvoller Umgang mit vertraulichen Informationen sind für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau.

  • Führungserfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Freude an Zusammenarbeit: Du kommunizierst klar und empathisch, handelst pragmatisch und verbindest effiziente Prozesse mit einem Blick für die Bedürfnisse der Mitarbeitenden. Du arbeitest selbstständig, bringst dich aber auch gerne in ein Team ein, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, und bereicherst jedes Meeting nicht nur fachlich, sondern auch durch deinen persönlichen Humor!

title: Senior People Partner
descriptionHtml:
Senior People Partner

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) | 💰 £55,000 - £70,000

Street Group is a fast moving B2B SaaS business - grown in Manchester but on a UK wide mission to make moving house as easy as buying a car. We’ve recently raised strategic growth investment, and are scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan - and we’re looking for a Senior People Partner to ensure we get there.

Over the past 6 years, our People team has designed, built, and implemented the people processes that have scaled Street Group from 30 - 230 people. But we know that systems that work at 200 people can break when growth accelerates - and we want to get ahead of that.

This is an opportunity for someone who has been through that scaling journey before to have an oversized impact on a small but ambitious People team to become best in class.

If you know what can impact culture both positively and negatively as a company grows; have experience building or supporting systems that both set people up to do their best work AND that scale alongside the business; and embrace AI and the positive impact it can have on employee experience - we think you might do great work here.

Why this role exists now

Our People team is lean - and as we mature as a business, there’s limited capacity to ensure we’re constantly innovating and improving the mechanisms that enable people to do their best work. We have ambitious goals to achieve - now is the time to fine-tune our People function to ensure the business hits those goals.

The role

In 2026, over half of the business told us they don't know what excellence looks like in their role, or how excellence is rewarded. This is the crux of this role; to build the systems, processes and reward that sets people up for success and ensure we reward and retain our best people.

Over the next 12–18 months, you’ll work with our Head of People and People Partner to embed our excellence standard across the business, coach senior managers and leaders, and build manager capability at scale. You’ll also help roll out our levels framework and approach to reward, bringing them to life with managers.

Who we're looking for

  • A Senior People Partner with experience operating at this level: you’ve designed, implemented or worked within people systems built for growth, coached senior managers and leaders, are curious about how technology and innovation is changing the People landscape, and are constantly looking for more impactful ways to support the business.

  • A commercial mindset - e.g. you measure your results on impact on business and team performance rather than work shipped or eNPS.

  • An AI-native mindset (or curiosity): you treat AI as leverage and are keen to learn from our team, and share what’s been working for you - but understand the nuances of where AI can never replace genuine People Partnering.

  • The credibility and communication skills to bring busy managers on the journey with you.

  • Someone who makes the team better on purpose, not by accident: you share what you know and help develop the people around you.

Why you might not want to apply

We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won’t be for everyone.

  • If you want to move into people management. This is a senior IC role. You'll coach, share knowledge, and set standards, but you won't have direct reports. If a management title is what you're chasing now or in the imminent future, this isn’t the job for you.

  • If you haven't been through a similar scaling journey in tech or SaaS businesses before. Our People team is home grown; we're specifically looking for the experience and knowledge that comes from having been through a scaling journey 300 people up, and can prevent us from making common scaling mistakes.

  • If AI feels like a threat rather than a tool. We love Claude Cowork, and have both built and used multiple other tools to improve and speed up our ways of working. We have a company-wide expectation that AI is utilised, so it will be a large part of this role.

  • If you want a role where you'll be spending a lot of time on pastoral employee interactions. This isn't going to be the main part of this role - you'll be spending most of your time building a culture of excellence.

If that list sounds like your kind of role, please apply and let us know why!

We recognise that women and people from underrepresented groups often apply for jobs only when they meet every single requirement listed. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

Who are Street Group?

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

Our products, Street.co.uk, Spectre & Cortex form a powerful trio, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week
🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)
💪 Structured career growth and ongoing professional development
📚 £500 yearly L&D budget
🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away
🙋 ‘Give something back’ - 2 paid days volunteering on us
👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay
🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured
🧘 Regular well-being initiatives
🚂 Public transport season ticket loans
🌷 Paid menopause leave
🌞 Holiday buying scheme
🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition
👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day
👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology
🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!
🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon
🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours
🚴 Cycle to work scheme
🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme
🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

Salary

£55,000 - £70,000, depending on experience. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place, and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

 

Interview Process

3 stages = 60-minute video call with our Head of People > In-person interview with two members of the People team > Final interview with two members of our SLT.

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

 

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. title: Senior Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Infrastructure Engineering and Tooling Team 👋

The Infrastructure Engineering and Tooling team, also known as Atlas, owns the ecosystem we use to deploy, run and manage services across the Trainline platform. Our work helps engineering teams across the business ship changes safely and confidently, so millions of travellers can rely on Trainline every day.

You'll join a collaborative team of software and platform engineers at all levels of experience. We work across Terraform, AWS, Node.js, C# and Python, and we don't expect you to know it all from day one. You'll work closely with engineers, Tech Leads, Engineering Managers, a Senior Principal Engineer and the Head of Engineering to improve our platform, shape delivery and deliver meaningful infrastructure change.

In this role as the Senior Platform Engineer, you will...🚄

  • Deliver complex improvements to Trainline's engineering platforms, building scalable, reliable and secure infrastructure that supports teams across the business.

  • Implement and evolve infrastructure with Terraform, following existing module patterns while spotting opportunities to improve quality, maintainability and automation.

  • Apply least-privilege and secure-by-default principles consistently across our AWS accounts, ensuring our infrastructure meets Trainline's standards for security and operational excellence.

  • Build and improve automation, services and tooling in Node.js or Python to make delivery faster, safer and more repeatable.

  • Support and review the work of other engineers, sharing context and giving constructive feedback so they can deliver with confidence.

  • Work with Tech Leads, Delivery Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to shape delivery plans, meet milestones and manage dependencies.

  • Raise risks, blockers and quality concerns early, helping to remove obstacles for the team and keep delivery moving at a sustainable pace.

  • Test, validate and deploy infrastructure changes through CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery) pipelines, making sure everything is robust, well documented and ready for production.

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • Substantial professional experience as a software engineer, writing code in Python, Node.js, C# or a similar programming language.

  • A solid knowledge of software engineering best practice, with a focus on writing clean, maintainable and testable code.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, CloudFront, IAM and S3, applying operational and security best practice.

  • A history of delivering infrastructure with Terraform or another infrastructure as code tool.

  • A confident understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD, for example using GitHub Actions.

  • Experience using AI tooling in your day-to-day work, for example for coding, code review, research and productivity.

  • Experience of delivering results in agile, delivery-focused teams, and ideally of supporting colleagues through reviews and feedback.

  • A curious mindset and the ability to pick up new technologies quickly and apply them effectively.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor!

title: Senior Product Manager (Enterprise)
descriptionHtml:

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to empower n8n enterprise users to treat automation as software, enabling them to develop, deploy, and scale mission-critical workflows with absolute confidence.

To do so, you’ll own product strategy and execution for n8n’s Enterprise team, focused on application lifecycle management, developer tools, and production-grade workflow operations:

WORKFLOW LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT

  • Define how teams move workflows from development to production with clear environment separation and promotion paths.

  • Shape capabilities for workflow version history, rollback, branching, and conflict resolution.

  • Build product experiences that help engineering teams safely manage changes across mission-critical automations.

ENTERPRISE DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE

  • Own Git-based source control workflows that make n8n fit naturally into modern software development practices.

  • Work closely with Engineering and Design to deliver powerful yet intuitive tools for technical teams.

  • Translate complex developer workflows into product experiences that feel reliable, scalable, and easy to adopt.

PRODUCTION OPERATIONS AND OBSERVABILITY

  • Build visibility into workflow performance, usage, and reliability across environments and instances.

  • Define how enterprise teams manage external secrets, variables, and configuration across deployments.

  • Help customers operate n8n at scale through multi-instance management and cross-instance visibility.

PRODUCT DISCOVERY AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP

  • Deeply engage with enterprise customers, engineering leaders, admins, and developers to understand their software delivery needs.

  • Prioritize ruthlessly across technical depth, usability, enterprise readiness, and long-term platform leverage.

  • Align Engineering, Design, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and leadership through clear strategy, specs, and communication.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Proven product management experience: You’ve shipped complex technical products in enterprise environments and can point to lessons learned that shaped your craft.

  • Strong developer empathy: You understand how engineering teams build, test, version, deploy, and operate software in production.

  • Thrive in ambiguity: You bring structure to fuzzy technical problems and prioritize clearly across many possible directions.

  • Exceptional product sense: You anticipate edge cases, second-order effects, and enterprise-grade reliability needs without needing perfect information.

  • Ownership and bias for action: You fix what’s broken, ship, learn, and iterate rather than over-plan.

  • Influence without authority: You align engineering, design, data, sales, solutions engineering, customer success, and docs through clarity and trust.

  • Technical product judgment: You’re comfortable making tradeoffs across usability, scalability, security, reliability, and implementation complexity.

Nice-to-haves

  • Git and source control experience: You’ve worked on or closely with products involving Git, branching, versioning, pull requests, or conflict resolution.

  • Enterprise security experience: You understand secrets management, environment variables, access control, or secure configuration patterns.

  • Observability experience: You’ve worked on products involving monitoring, usage insights, performance visibility, or operational dashboards.

  • Coding or SQL skills: You can code, write SQL, or go deep enough technically to partner effectively with engineers on architecture-level discussions.

  • Remote work experience: You’re familiar with remote-first work environments and can collaborate effectively across time zones.

  • Entrepreneurial or early-stage experience: You’ve worn many hats and can navigate in many areas at once.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won’t disappear into a slide deck. You’ll shape how engineering teams build, version, deploy, and operate mission-critical automations at scale — turning n8n into the platform where automation is treated with the same rigor as software. title: Senior Product Manager (Retail Media)
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE OPPORTUNITY

Millions of people come to Carwow when they are ready to change their car. That is some of the highest-intent automotive audience in the UK, and it makes Carwow one of the most valuable places for dealers and manufacturers to reach buyers at the moment of decision. Retail media is how we turn that intent into revenue, for our partners and for the business.

We have built the foundations: sponsored placements across the buying journey, a growing media and audience offering, and commercial products for dealers and manufacturers. Demand is ahead of what we can currently serve. If we can make our advertising products smarter, more relevant and easier to buy, we grow revenue for partners while keeping the experience useful for the consumer. That balance is the job.

This role is the product voice for retail media: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with engineering, design, data and commercial teams to build it.

This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Advertisers want smarter targeting, better recommendations on where to spend, and proof of what worked. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.

If you know retail media inside out, want to shape a fast-growing revenue line, and build things with a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Set the product direction for Carwow's retail media products, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery with advertisers and internal teams: interviews, campaign data and marketplace analysis, to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value

    • Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into our advertising products: smarter targeting, relevancy and recommendations that actually change results Work in partnership with the Technical Engineering Manager and Designer, and collaborate with the engineers in your team, to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives revenue, advertiser performance and consumer relevance, not just activity

  • Technical & Data Partnership:

    • Work closely with engineers on how ads are served, targeted, priced and measured, and make sound trade-offs between build, buy and integrate

    • Own measurement: run controlled tests so every new placement or format proves its revenue impact without harming the consumer experience

    • Use data directly, interrogating campaign and marketplace performance to guide decisions

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, commercial, campaign operations and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Support the commercial team in partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Proven retail media experience is a prerequisite: you have built or owned sponsored ads, onsite media or audience products at a marketplace, retailer or ad tech business, and you know how the industry works

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with evidence of growing advertising revenue or advertiser performance

  • Technically strong: you understand ad serving, targeting, auction and pricing mechanics, APIs and tracking, and can hold a credible conversation with engineers about architecture and trade-offs

  • Comfortable with data: you interrogate performance data yourself, design your own tests, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for analysis to land in your inbox

  • Great stakeholder skills: you build trust with commercial teams, technical partners, advertisers and senior leaders, push back when needed, and come with solutions rather than problems

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in automotive, marketplace or two-sided products

  • Hands-on use ofAI tools in your own work, and experience shipping AI-powered features

OUR MISSION

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Used cars are the biggest part of the UK car market, and Carwow is going all in. We already sit at the start of the used journey: through Sell My Car, dealers buy cars from Carwow sellers every day. But today that car leaves our platform the moment it's bought. The dealer preps it, prices it and lists it somewhere else, and the buyer finds it somewhere else too.

We want to close that loop. If every car a dealer buys can go live on Carwow in hours, priced to sell and matched to the buyers who want it, we become the place dealers source, retail and sell their used stock. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for a vertical we are fully investing in, and working day to day with design and engineering to build it.

AI changes what's possible here. A dealer shouldn't have to work out what a car is worth, write the advert or chase the buyer; the product should do it for them. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that looks like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to separate real dealer value from noise.

title: Senior Project Manager Creative
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Important: For this position, it is essential that you have a good command of the Dutch language, both written and spoken.

WPP Media

WPP Media is het wereldwijde mediacollectief van WPP, volledig gebouwd voor het AI-tijdperk. We bundelen het beste platform, de meest getalenteerde mensen en de sterkste partners om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren. Ons doel? Merken elke dag ongeëvenaarde groei bieden. Dit fundament vinden we in onze gedeelde kernwaarden:

  • We’re Extraordinary: We verleggen grenzen, dagen het gewone denken uit en doorbreken de status-quo in ons streven naar innovatie en groei.
  • We’re Open: We bouwen vertrouwen en begrip door naadloos samen te werken – met onze teams, klanten en partners.
  • We’re Optimistic: Een 'growth mindset' zit in ons DNA. We omarmen verandering als dé manier om het beste uit onszelf te halen.

Binnen WPP Media zijn wij het creatie team dat digitale campagnes nét dat beetje extra geeft. We mixen media, creativiteit en technologie om ideeën te maken die opvallen, raken en blijven hangen. Geen standaard banners of vluchtige clicks, maar slimme, opvallende en vaak verrassende creaties die écht aandacht trekken. Van interactieve formats tot dynamische campagnes: we zorgen dat merken niet alleen zichtbaar zijn, maar ook een glimlach, klik of wow-moment verdienen. Kortom – wij maken digitale media leuker, slimmer en effectiever.

Senior Project Manager
Bij ons draait alles om creatieve impact. En om dat vlekkeloos te laten verlopen, zoeken we een Senior Project Manager die energie krijgt van regelen, structureren én inspireren. Iemand die het creatieve proces strak organiseert, maar ook snapt dat de mooiste ideeën juist ontstaan als er ruimte is om te spelen.

Als Senior Project Manager Creative ben jij de spil tussen klant, jouw eigen creatie team en mediaspecialisten. Voor jouw klanten ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt: je denkt mee, geeft advies en zorgt dat ideeën werkelijkheid worden.

Wat ga je concreet doen?

  • Je organiseert en bewaakt het projectplan van A tot Z, inclusief scope, deadlines en deliverables.
  • Je zorgt voor heldere projectstructuren en planning voor alle disciplines.
  • Je bent hét centrale aanspreekpunt voor klanten, interne teams en externe partners.
  • Je vertaalt creatieve en commerciële briefing naar uitvoerbare plannen en bewaakt verwachtingen.
  • Je identificeert risico’s vroegtijdig en zorgt dat issues worden opgelost voordat ze impact hebben.
  • Je bewaakt scopes, kwaliteitscriteria en KPI’s, en rapporteert hierover.
  • Je draagt bij aan verbeterde workflows, tools en werkwijzen zodat het team nog efficiënter werkt.
  • Je fungeert als brug tussen creatie, media en operations.

Wie ben jij?

  • Sterke projectmanager met min. 5+ jaar ervaring in rollen die draaien om planning, coördinatie, organisatie en procesoptimalisatie.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het managen van complexe projecten (in agencies, techteams, productteams of andere uitvoerende omgevingen).
  • Je bent een pro in overzicht houden, risico’s inschatten en structureel werken — en je weet dit zelfverzekerd te vertalen naar teams en klanten.
  • Je hebt geen creatieve productie-achtergrond nodig (zoals design of copywriting); wat telt is jouw vermogen om projecten tot een goed einde te brengen.
  • Voorkeur voor ervaring met middelenbegrotingen, resource-planning en KPI-gestuurde workflows.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Salaris: €3000 – 4250 bruto per maand (op basis van 38,75 uur per week) afhankelijk van ervaring, leeftijd en senioriteit.
  • Flexibiliteit: Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken, flexibele werktijden én zelfs voor een tijdje in het buitenland (EU).
  • Vrijheid: Veel eigen verantwoordelijk om je eigen rol en werkdag in te vullen.
  • Werkomgeving: werken in een goed georganiseerde creatieve omgeving met een enthousiast team van creatieven, projectmanagers en mediaspecialisten.
  • Klanten: Werken voor A merken van Nederland en internationaal op projecten waar je écht trots op kunt zijn en die zichtbaar impact maken.
  • Groeikansen: Volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling in een innovatief en dynamisch team, met een focus op AI-transformatie.
  • Toegang tot M Academy: Voor uitgebreide trainingen en workshops in zowel hard als soft skills, inclusief specifieke AI-trainingen.
  • Reiskostenvergoeding: Reiskosten worden volledig vergoed.
  • 8% vakantiegeld en 26 vakantiedagen per jaar (plus 9 extra bij te kopen!).
  • Hybrid Working allowance: €30 netto per maand bij fulltime.
  • Bring Your Own Device (BYOD): Je ontvangt een maandelijkse telefoonvergoeding van €57,50 netto.
  • Lunchfaciliteiten: Voordelige lunch in de kantine en een barista voor verse koffie.
  • Zorgverzekering: Profiteer van onze collectieve zorgverzekering.

Geen dag is hier hetzelfde! Het ene moment duik je in een briefing met een klant, het volgende moment ben je met een creative bezig om een campagne pixel-perfect te krijgen. Je werkt met verschillende disciplines, klanten en uitdagingen, waardoor je continu leert en groeit. En jij bent degene die ervoor zorgt dat alles klopt.

Enthousiast? Laat van je horen en vertel ons waarom jij de Project Manager Creative bent die wij zoeken.

descriptionHtml:
About the role

At 7Learnings, we help e-commerce businesses make smarter pricing decisions through AI-powered price optimization. As we continue to grow and expand internationally, building scalable and efficient revenue operations is essential to our success.

As our Senior RevOps Manager, you will play a key role in building and scaling 7Learnings' revenue engine. Sitting within the Marketing team, you will work closely with our C-level, Marketing, Sales and Finance teams to create the processes, systems and data infrastructure that enable sustainable growth.

You will take ownership of our Revenue Operations strategy and roadmap, ensuring that our Go-to-Market teams are aligned, efficient and equipped with the right tools and insights to succeed. From optimizing our HubSpot setup and automating workflows to building reliable reporting and forecasting structures, you will have the autonomy to shape how we operate across Germany, the UK and the US.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership and visibility across the company. You will have the opportunity to build scalable processes, identify opportunities for improvement and directly influence 7Learnings' commercial performance.


Your mission

Your mission is to build a scalable, data-driven revenue engine that connects Marketing, Sales and Finance and enables our international growth.

In particular, you will:

  • Own the RevOps strategy: Develop and drive our Revenue Operations strategy and roadmap in alignment with the C-level and leadership team.
  • Optimize the revenue process: Design and manage the end-to-end revenue process, including lead routing, lifecycle and pipeline stages, and handovers between Marketing and Sales.
  • Drive data-driven decisions: Own pipeline reporting and forecasting, building the KPIs and dashboards leadership and the board rely on, including ARR, pipeline coverage, conversion rates, win rates and sales cycle metrics.
  • Own our GTM tech stack: Manage and continuously improve our Go-to-Market tools, including HubSpot, Apollo, n8n and Clay. Evaluate new tools, manage integrations and automations, and oversee the related budget.
  • Ensure data quality: Establish and maintain data governance standards to ensure accurate and consistent CRM and billing data in close collaboration with Finance.
  • Enable sales planning: Partner with Finance and Sales leadership on territory planning, capacity planning, quotas and commission structures.
  • Manage commission calculations: Take ownership of quarterly sales commission calculations, ensuring accuracy based on CRM data and agreed commission plans.
  • Scale internationally: Build and standardize revenue processes that support our growing teams across Germany, the UK and the US.
  • Drive continuous improvement: Proactively identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in our revenue engine and develop actionable improvement proposals.
  • Enable our teams: Create clear documentation, onboarding materials and regular training to empower our Go-to-Market teams.
  • Deliver with accountability: Run RevOps as a service, with clearly defined scopes, committed delivery dates and transparent tracking of requests and projects.

Your profile

You are a structured, analytical and proactive RevOps professional who enjoys turning complex processes and messy data into scalable systems. You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mentality and take ownership from identifying a problem to delivering a solution.

Ideally, you bring:

  • 3+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or a similar role, preferably in a B2B SaaS scale-up.
  • Hands-on experience administering HubSpot, including workflows, properties, reporting and integrations.
  • Experience with Apollo, n8n and Clay is a strong plus.
  • Strong analytical skills and confidence working with complex or imperfect datasets. SQL or advanced spreadsheet skills are an advantage.
  • A structured, pragmatic and results-oriented mindset. You know how to scope projects, set realistic timelines and deliver on your commitments.
  • The ability to independently identify inefficiencies and proactively propose solutions rather than simply flagging problems.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical systems and processes to non-technical audiences.
  • An autonomous and proactive working style, combined with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Excellent English skills (C1–C2 level). German is a plus.

What we offer?

  • Real Flexibility: A beautiful office in Berlin-Mitte (with an in-house gym!) and a hybrid setup that actually respects work-life balance

  • High-End Tech: Sell a product at the cutting edge of AI and Predictive Analytics

  • Culture & Perks: Regular team off-sites, and a high-trust environment where feedback is a gift, not a chore

  • Real Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation per year to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance
  • Culture of Trust: Work in a high-trust environment where open communication and constructive feedback are part of everyday life
  • Ownership & Autonomy: Take responsibility, make an impact, and enjoy a high degree of personal ownership in your role

title: Senior Scientist, Small Molecules
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As a Scientist in Small Molecules, you will own the computational chemistry and molecular data analysis behind our small-molecule work, for partners' discovery programs and our own models. Good models start with well-understood data, and this role decides what our small-molecule models learn from and how we judge them.

You will work closely with external pharma and biotech partners, ML Research, and our Senior Scientist, ADME/DMPK.

This role is ideal for a computational chemist who builds their own tools, enjoys exploratory science, and wants analyses to change both research roadmaps and real discovery decisions.

What you'll do

  • Apply Boltz models on partner programs and help partners prepare, analyze and interpret their molecular and experimental data.

  • Standardize and integrate structures, protein–ligand complexes, binding and screening measurements into scientifically meaningful training and evaluation datasets.

  • Investigate open questions: map library diversity, cluster millions of generated compounds, compare performance across protein families or chemical series, find train–test leakage.

  • Build the scientific tooling these analyses need, in clean, reusable Python.

  • Diagnose where and why our models fail, and turn the findings into guidance for ML Research and our roadmap.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • PhD or equivalent experience in computational chemistry, cheminformatics, chemical biology, structural bioinformatics or a closely related field.

  • Strong Python and RDKit (or similar), with practical experience in fingerprints, similarity search, clustering, scaffold analysis, dimensionality reduction and chemical-space visualization.

  • Deep understanding of small-molecule chemistry (series, stereochemistry, protonation and tautomers, scaffolds) and comfort with protein–ligand structural data.

  • Solid grasp of binding and screening data (KD, Ki, IC50, EC50), including assay context, uncertainty, censoring and comparability.

  • Clear communication of complex analyses to partners, ML researchers and chemists.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience on real discovery programs: virtual screening, hit discovery, hit-to-lead or lead optimization; molecular ML such as affinity or property prediction.

  • Experience with large chemical libraries or model-generated compound sets, or pharma partnerships.

  • Experience using Boltz models, or open-source scientific software contributions.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Ownership of the datasets and analyses our small-molecule models depend on, used by leading discovery teams.

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • 25 days plus bank holidays a year

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

    • Pension program

    • Paid parental leave

    • Wellhub gym membership

    • Free lunch every day

    • Travel expenses

How we hire

  1. Initial screen with a member of the Talent team

  2. Technical interview

  3. Onsite in London with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us and we'll make it work.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

What you'll be doing
This role does the hands-on architecture work. You design the secure patterns engineering builds against, review hard problems in depth, and help make secure-by-design real across the Hyperblock and Polaris platform and the AI product surface. You work closely with the Principal Security Architect, who sets the technical bar. You own significant areas of that work and deliver them end to end. Engineers adopt good architecture because it is the better path. You will build that kind of architecture, working on problems that carry real risk.

Anaplan is not a simple SaaS application. The platform performs highly dimensional, enterprise-scale modelling with responsive recalculation and strong correctness expectations. The technical surface includes the legacy Hyperblock engine, the newer Polaris engine, and a growing set of AI products. These include CoModeler for AI-assisted model building and CoPlanner for conversational planning support.

Enterprise customers in regulated industries increasingly ask a hard question: if Anaplan is breached, can Anaplan staff or an attacker read their data? Answering it takes rigorous architecture work. We are commissioning an independent Trail of Bits assessment of exactly this. It covers end-to-end tenant isolation, the proposed BYOK design, and internal infrastructure boundaries. You will help turn findings like these into concrete design changes. That includes moving key management from legacy HSM-based designs to Vault, and extending encryption coverage to storage and data paths that lack an agreed architecture today.

What you'll do
• Produce reference architectures: design and maintain security patterns for platform and AI components, working to the standards set by the Principal.
• Contribute to identity and authorisation design: including tenant isolation, service-to-service trust, and authorisation for AI agents and analyst-style workflows.
• Apply cryptography and key management: work on encryption, BYOK and key custody. Be clear about where data is plaintext, who can use keys, and what each control protects against.
• Design AI guardrails: input and output controls, tool and authorisation boundaries, and prompt-injection and abuse defences. Draw on MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP LLM Top 10.
• Run threat models: lead them on high-risk systems, working with engineers to trace trust boundaries and compromise paths. Turn the findings into prioritised, actionable design changes.
• Support external assessments: prepare architecture evidence, join discovery sessions with engineering, and check that what is built matches what is documented.
• Improve the supply chain and attack surface: build integrity and provenance, hardened images, and less exposed surface.
• Stay hands-on: write and review designs and prototypes, and test your own work.
• Grow the practice: mentor engineers, contribute to standards, and help turn design decisions into enforceable guidance.

What we're looking for
• Solid experience in secure software architecture, with depth in at least two of: cryptography and key management, identity and authorisation, tenant isolation, and threat modelling.
• A working understanding of AI and ML security, and of how LLM-driven features change identity, authorisation, supply chain, and verification.
• The ability to design and review real systems, and to defend your decisions to strong engineers.
• A record of influencing engineers without formal authority, including when risk and delivery pressure conflict.
• Experience with enterprise-scale SaaS or cloud-first systems, ideally multi-tenant.
• Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain architecture honestly to engineers, leadership, and customers.

Nice to have
• Experience with Vault, KMS/HSM, or BYOK/HYOK designs.
• Experience designing for regulated environments, such as FedRAMP.
• Contributions to NIST, ISO, or OWASP, or talks and published research.
• An offensive grounding that you use to pressure-test designs.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer

Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:

  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

title: Senior Sensor Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of Schunk, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As a Senior Sensor Engineer (Tactile & Proprioception) at TACTILIA Robotics, you will build the neural architecture of physical touch and spatial awareness that gives our robotic hands human-like dexterity.

You will own the complete sensing architecture—from evaluating tactile technologies and proprioceptive layouts to designing readout electronics, calibration matrix algorithms, and real-time sensor pipelines.

Fitting high-density sensing skins, force feedback, and position tracking into a tight hand envelope means balancing signal integrity, low latency, and mechanical durability under high cyclic wear. You will work closely with Mechanics, Electronics, and Software to turn raw physical contact into clean, reliable data for real-time robotic control.

What you will do:

  • Own the sensing architecture. Lead the evaluation, selection, and overall design of tactile and proprioceptive sensing systems across fingers, palm, and joints—built for modularity across product variants, not a one-off prototype.

  • Develop tactile array hardware. Design and prototype high-resolution tactile sensors (optical, capacitive, piezoresistive, or magnetic) tailored for space-constrained, contact-rich finger pads and palm surfaces.

  • Engineer proprioceptive feedback. Implement joint- and drive-level feedback mechanisms, including high-precision position/angle sensing, strain gauge force bridges, load cells, and tendinous tension tracking.

  • Design readout electronics & AFEs. Build low-noise analog front-ends (AFEs), signal conditioning circuits, and local readout hardware optimized for minimal latency, wide dynamic range, and high immunity to electromagnetic interference (EMI).

  • Build calibration & processing pipelines. Implement automated calibration protocols, thermal/drift compensation matrix algorithms, and feature extraction (e.g., slip detection, contact point estimation) to feed clean telemetry to the software stack.

  • Characterize & validate on real hardware. Own sensor testing on custom rigs—evaluating dynamic response, force linearity, hysteresis, spatial resolution, and long-term mechanical wear over hundreds of thousands of cycles.

  • Drive sensor manufacturing & yield. Partner with specialized suppliers on Design for Manufacturing (DFM) for flexible/rigid-flex PCBs, molded tactile skins, and elastomeric components, ensuring high assembly yield and second-sourcing.

  • Work across the whole team. Tight loop with Mechanics (for load paths and physical packaging), Electronics (for board interfaces), and Software (for state estimation and closed-loop grasp control).

What you bring:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, Sensorics, Robotics, or a related field.

  • 5–10 years of experience developing sensor hardware, mechatronic instrumentation, or sensor fusion systems, including at least one product taken into series production.

  • Deep domain expertise in tactile sensing modalities (e.g., optical tactile/GelSight style, piezoresistive, capacitive) or high-density proprioceptive feedback (encoders, strain gauges, load cells).

  • Proven experience in analog circuit design, signal conditioning (AFE), active filtering, and high-SNR data acquisition for physical sensors.

  • Hands-on experience with sensor calibration techniques, thermal/hysteresis modeling, signal processing, and standard communication buses (SPI, I2C, CAN).

  • Practical experience designing or integrating flexible PCBs, molded elastomers, or miniaturized mechatronic assemblies into tight physical envelopes.

  • A strong hardware mindset: you enjoy lab bring-up, sensor characterization on test rigs, and tracing physics-to-signal anomalies with scopes and logic analyzers.

  • Fluent in English; German is a plus, not a requirement.

Bonus:

  • Background in real-time embedded C/C++ firmware or ROS/ROS2 for sensor data processing and filtering.

  • Experience with tactile algorithms for slip prediction, texture recognition, or contact shape estimation.

  • Experience with soft robotics, stretchable electronics, or conductive polymers.

  • Knowledge of Machinery Regulation, ISO/TS 15066, and sensor design for collaborative applications.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open.

That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems to join our Platform Team. Our interceptors fly autonomous missions from launch to intercept. Before a software change flies in the air, we want to see it fly on the bench: the real mission computer and flight controller, flying a full simulated mission in real time against simulated physics, sensors and targets. We are taking our hardware-in-the-loop testing to full closed-loop missions, and you lead that build.

You are a builder, not a test author. You design the rigs, couple the simulation to the hardware, and build the framework so that our autonomy and perception engineers write and run their own HIL scenarios on every change.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • The closed loop: Couple real-time physics, sensor and target simulation to real flight hardware. title: Senior Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

Senior Solutions Architect

Our biggest deals rarely end with the standard product. Prospects want Staffbase to fit into their system landscape, their processes, and their way of working, and that is where deals are won or lost. As a Solutions Architect, you are the technical authority behind these deals in Europe. You understand the customer’s processes and the value they want to achieve, validate what is feasible, design the architecture, and prove it with a working showcase. Then you hand it over to our Build team so it becomes a production solution. You'll work closely with Solutions Engineers, Account Executives, and Build, and you'll have a direct impact on how we win our most complex opportunities.

What you'll be doing

  • Join strategic and technically complex opportunities in Europe early in the sales cycle, and support Solutions Engineers and Account Executives with solutioning, positioning, and technical credibility at executive and IT level
  • Analyze and validate integration and customization requirements of prospects, from custom widgets and plugins to scripts, API integrations, SSO setups, and AI/agent use cases
  • Design the technical side of operational and frontline use cases, such as task management, HR self-service, shift planning or IT service requests, by connecting Staffbase to the systems employees work with every day
  • Understand the customer’s operational processes and workflows, advise on how Staffbase fits into them, and build the value case together with the Solutions Engineer and Account Executive: what improves, for whom, and how it is measured
  • Translate customer requirements into a clear solution architecture and a realistic scope, including effort, risks, and dependencies, so we only commit to what we can deliver
  • Build proofs of concept and demo mock-ups, including through vibe-coding, that show prospects what their customized Staffbase experience will look like
  • Work with our APIs, webhooks, extension points, and AI capabilities (including MCP and A2A) to show what's possible on the platform and where its boundaries are
  • Act as the link between the field and our Staffbase Build team (our Forward Deployed Engineers and developers): prepare clean handovers with documented requirements, architecture, and working prototypes, and give early feedback on feasibility and effort
  • Advise on the technical parts of RFPs and security or architecture questionnaires for complex deals
  • Build and maintain reusable assets, reference architectures, and best practices for customizations that make the European Solutions Engineering team faster, and coach Solutions Engineers on deeper technical topics
  • Bring field learnings to Product and Build in a structured way, especially on recurring gaps in APIs, webhooks, and the plugin/widget framework, and help prioritize the improvements that directly win deals
  • Share successful solution patterns with Solutions Engineering colleagues in other regions and pick up proven approaches from them
  • In your first months, own a share of opportunities yourself as a Solutions Engineer (around a third of your time) to build deep product knowledge and get to know our customers and the team

What you need to be successful

  • Degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5-8 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, forward deployed engineering, or technical consulting, ideally in a SaaS or enterprise software environment
  • Proven track record of supporting complex, high-value enterprise deals, from requirements validation and architecture to scoping and handover
  • Strong developer background: you can build working prototypes in JavaScript/TypeScript (React or similar), Node.js, or comparable languages, and you know HTML/CSS well
  • Deep understanding of integration architecture: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication and identity concepts (OAuth, SAML, SSO, SCIM), and designing and debugging integrations in enterprise landscapes
  • Solid knowledge of cloud technologies and SaaS architecture, including security and data protection requirements of large European enterprises
  • Experience with AI-assisted development and vibe-coding tools, and the judgment to know when a prototype is good enough to show and what it takes to make it production-ready
  • Ability to turn vague customer asks into a concrete, scoped solution, and to explain trade-offs to developers, IT leaders, and business stakeholders alike
  • Experience in value consulting or process consulting: you understand operational processes and workflows and can build a business case that links a solution to measurable outcomes
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the confidence to lead technical conversations with CIOs, enterprise architects, and communications leaders
  • Fluent German and English (C1 or higher), with the ability to hold customer conversations in both languages
  • Additional languages, especially French or Spanish, are a plus
  • Collaborative, proactive mindset: you work well with sales and engineering teams, take pride in a clean handover, and are comfortable traveling within Europe when needed
  • Experience with enterprise systems and integration landscapes is a plus: Microsoft 365, SharePoint, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, Jira, Entra ID/Active Directory, etc.
  • Experience with AI agent architectures (MCP, A2A) is a plus
  • Experience with employee communications, intranet platforms, or low-code/no-code platforms is a plus

What you'll get 

  • Competitive Compensation - we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit-based Long Term Incentive Plan)
  • Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of €1560
  • Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August
  • Support-we offer offering a company pension scheme
  • Volunteers Day- you’ll get one day off per year for supporting a social project

title: Senior/Staff Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


We're looking for seasoned Product Designers who thrive in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope.

You'll be embedded in a product squad alongside a product manager and around three to five engineers, owning the user experience for your area end to end. Our design team is small but growing, so you'll shape the craft bar and the culture, not inherit them.

We're hiring designers across the following teams:

  • Enterprise (two roles - Governance & Observability, and Licence & Billing): You've worked on technical B2B platforms. You've designed for scale, governance, and collaboration across teams, including permissions, environments, observability, and failure modes included and you're comfortable making deeply complex systems feel coherent and simple.

  • Adore - Adoption & Retention: You have exceptional product sense and can connect disparate elements into a coherent whole. You'll take something complex, with many moving parts, and make it make sense - shaping what the visual layer of n8n becomes next. Experience with data visualisation is welcome; deep technical expertise isn't required.

  • n8n Labs: As a Product Designer, you'll own discovery end-to-end, spotting the riskiest assumptions, running the research, and turning findings into decisions without waiting on a brief. You move fast, cut scope without losing what matters, and you're hands-on enough to build and ship your own prototypes, including using AI tools to get there quicker. You've got product and business judgment, not just craft; you can spot an opportunity and make the case for it. Founder or co-founder experience is a helpful signal but not a requirement.

Team assignment is confirmed at the offer stage and may be subject to change as the team structure evolves.

🎯 Regardless of the team, your main goal will be to lead end-to-end product design on complex workflows that elevate n8n's user experience, ship measurable outcomes, and raise the quality bar across our platform. To do so, here are your responsibilities:

End-to-end product design

  • Lead the full design process for your team, from discovery to polished delivery, collaborating closely with PMs and engineers.

  • Consistently ship high-quality, visually cohesive designs that improve the overall UX at every release.

  • Work effectively on complex features and understand the underlying technology.

  • Take ownership of complex, multi-faceted problems and drive them to completion with initiative and autonomy.

Research, feedback, and UX quality

  • Own the direction of research for your team, decide when it's needed, choose the right methodology, and take the initiative without waiting to be told.

  • Champion the user by running interviews, usability tests, and research to inform critical product and business decisions.

  • Master the feedback loop by gathering, synthesizing, and acting on input while giving actionable critique to elevate teammates' work.

  • Balance speed and quality in an MVP-driven environment, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high bar.

Systems thinking and platform coherence

  • Design in systems, integrating solutions into the broader n8n platform and safeguarding the product's big picture.

  • Account for edge cases, constraints, and interaction details so users never end up in impossible states.

  • Collaborate across teams and designers to ensure consistency and quality across shared patterns and components.

Strategy, impact, and innovation

  • Shape team strategy by influencing planning, prioritization, and scope with a strong design perspective tied to KPIs.

  • Explore and adopt AI and automation tools to push the boundaries of design practice and AI-powered workflows.

Senior or Staff?

We're open at both levels, and we'll calibrate with you during the process. At Senior, you own your squad's design end-to-end and ship work that raises the bar for your area. At Staff, you do that, and your influence reaches beyond your own squad - you shape patterns other designers build on, and you take on the problems that span teams. Both are hands-on: this is not a step away from the craft.


REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🎨 Product design excellence: You're proficient across product design, UX, UI, and qualitative research, delivering polished, detail-oriented work.

  • 🧠 Technical mindset: You collaborate effectively with engineers and understand how software is built, including common web technologies. You don't need to write code, but you do need genuine curiosity about what's happening underneath - APIs, webhooks, data structures and how workflows actually execute.

  • 🧭 Ownership & delivery: You've shipped end-to-end features in smaller teams or startups and can drive complex problems to measurable outcomes.

  • ⚡ Fast, focused execution: You operate at high speed in an MVP-driven environment, balancing quality and velocity amid ambiguity.

  • 📈 Outcome orientation: You use research and metrics to inform decisions and consistently deliver solutions that enable team KPIs.

  • 🤝 Feedback & collaboration: You're open and non-defensive in critique and provide actionable feedback that raises the team's bar.

  • 🧪 Curiosity for AI: You're enthusiastic about AI and innovation, actively exploring new tools and approaches to advance the craft.

  • 📅 Experience level: You have 5+ years in product design with demonstrable impact on shipped products.


Nice-to-haves

  • 💻 Front-end fluency: You can prototype using HTML/CSS/JavaScript, with or without AI coding tools, and can collaborate effectively with engineers on the result.

  • 🧩 AI & automation domain: You've designed AI or automation products; familiarity with n8n is a plus.

  • 🔁 Process improvement: You proactively refine team rituals and workflows to increase effectiveness.

  • 📚 Continuous growth: You invest in your craft and are motivated by creating tangible product and company impact.

  • 🔎 Discovery frameworks: You know methodologies like Continuous Discovery or Shape Up.

  • 📊 Data-informed design: You're comfortable with metrics, A/B testing, or SQL to guide decisions.

  • 🚀 Entrepreneurial drive: You've built startups or side projects that show initiative and creative problem-solving.


Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a slide deck. You'll lead high-impact design across core product surfaces, shaping AI-powered workflows, enterprise governance and billing, and how people discover and adopt n8n, from discovery to delivery. You'll join a fast-growing, Europe remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, partnering closely with PMs and engineers to ship real outcomes to a passionate global community.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now and help us build the future of automation.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.
