title: System Architect
descriptionHtml:
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a System Architect, you will be responsible for our solid-state transformer as a complete system. You will connect the work of our power electronics, magnetics, and mechanical and thermal engineering teams into one coherent system, and ensure it meets the requirements of hyperscale data center customers.

Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production.

This role is for you if…
you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down.

This role isn’t for you if…
you’ve spent your career going deep on a single component or subsystem, or you manage projects without making the technical decisions yourself. It’s also not a fit if you need a fixed specification and established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture of the SST and its key performance metrics, including efficiency, power density, cost, thermal performance, reliability, manufacturability and control performance.

  • Coordinate the subsystems of the SST (AC/DC, DC/DC, magnetics, mechanical and thermal) and their interfaces, ensuring the work of each team is compatible and consistent with the system design.

  • Lead system-level trade-off decisions and set technical priorities across teams.

  • Define and maintain system requirements, interface specifications and change management, ensuring design changes are assessed for their impact across the system.

  • Translate the requirements of data center operators and hyperscalers into system specifications, and track how they evolve.

  • Explore and compare different system architectures and their integration in the datacenter power supply chain

  • Drive standardization and design for manufacturing across subsystems in preparation for series production.

  • Work with the compliance and certification team to define a feasible certification path for the system.

  • Identify technical risks at system level early and propose mitigations.

Qualifications

  • MSc or a higher degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

  • 8+ years of industry experience in developing complex power electronic systems.

  • Proven responsibility at system or platform level, e.g. as system engineer, system architect, technical lead or team lead.

  • Track record of taking power electronic systems from development to series product.

  • Experience with high-power systems such as EV charging, electric drivetrains, rail traction, industrial drives, renewable energy converters or robotics.

  • Broad understanding of the electrical, magnetic, thermal, mechanical and control aspects of power electronic systems, and how they interact.

  • Working knowledge of cooling concepts and the mechanical integration of high-power electronics.

  • Experience with standards, norms and certification processes for power electronic products.

  • Strong communication and decision-making skills; able to align experts across disciplines and drive decisions.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving requirements.

The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with medium-voltage converter systems or solid-state transformers.

  • Knowledge of data center power architectures.

  • Experience in design for manufacturing and cost engineering.

  • Experience establishing systems engineering processes in a growing organization.

Benefits

  • Equity + competitive salary.

  • Unique technology and market opportunity – shape the architecture of a new product category for the energy transition.

  • Hybrid work with flexible working times.

title: Team Lead Functional Analyst (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 173 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.

Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

Team Lead Functional Analyst (all genders)

Your Role & Impact

We are seeking a strategic, people-focused Team Lead Functional Analyst to head our Functional Analysis & Process Design chapter within the Enterprise Applications & Integrations department. As tonies undergoes a company-wide transformation from a distributed landscape to a harmonized, global operating model powered by SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, our IT and business functions are moving toward a product-oriented organization.

In this pivotal role, you will provide horizontal leadership to our team of Functional Analysts -the vital translation bridge between our business value streams (Operations, Finance, Sales) and our technical delivery teams. The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of end-to-end business processes with a strong mentoring mindset, setting methodology standards and empowering the team to translate operational needs into scalable, standard-first enterprise solutions.

What you'll do

As Team Lead Functional Analyst, you will act as the Chapter Lead for Functional Analysis, providing both disciplinary leadership and methodological governance for your team.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Team Leadership & Development: Providing horizontal leadership to the Functional Analyst team, overseeing personal skill development, coaching, and managing capacity allocation across various value streams.

  • Methodology & Standards: Setting and enforcing best-practice methodology standards for the chapter, including process modeling (BPMN 2.0), agile requirements engineering, user story writing (Jira/Confluence), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) protocols.

  • Strategic Governance: Empowering your team to act as "The Bridge" that effectively translates business pain points into structured functional specification documents (FSDs) while strictly enforcing Fit-to-Standard and Clean Core principles to prevent unnecessary custom complexity.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnering seamlessly with Business Product Owners (who prioritize the "WHAT & WHY"), SAP Consultants (The Solution), Solution Architects (The Gatekeepers), and App Engineers (The Build) to ensure a unified end-to-end delivery lifecycle.

  • Process Integrity: Ensuring your team upholds strict Segregation of Duties (SoD) guidelines and four-pillar controls during process design (e.g., keeping functional analysis strictly separated from system configuration, master data creation, and security mapping).

  • Transformation Stewardship: Driving the organizational shift from reactive project delivery toward proactive product ownership, helping the business eliminate shadow processes and friction points across boundaries like Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report.

What You Bring

You combine a deep understanding of process modeling and enterprise platforms with a consultative leadership mindset, and you enjoy empowering teams in complex transformation initiatives.

You bring:

  • Several years of experience in functional analysis, business process design, or requirements engineering within modern enterprise suites (e.g., SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Salesforce, Microsoft Business Central).

  • Proven experience in a leadership or chapter lead role, with a strong passion for mentoring, team development, and resource management.

  • Deep methodological expertise in BPMN 2.0, Design Thinking, process decomposition, and defining end-to-end test scenarios.

  • Advanced tooling proficiency in Jira, Confluence, Signavio/Lucidchart/Miro, and UAT management platforms.

  • A solid understanding of core business domains such as accounting, supply chain, procurement, or digital retail.

  • Exceptional diplomatic and analytical facilitation skills; the confidence to constructively challenge business requests and guide stakeholders toward standard solutions.

  • A structured, independent, and solution-oriented way of working with a clear understanding of cross-system architecture boundaries.

  • Fluent English; German is a plus.

Why Join Us?

  • Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders. You’ll be part of a truly international community where every voice is heard.

  • Come as you are: This applies to the dress code and everything else. We believe you give your best when you feel truly comfortable being yourself.

  • Collaboration & Community: We’re big on "we." You’ll join a team that values connection and celebrates wins together, no matter the time zone.

  • Continuous Learning: Benefit from internal/external training and an individual learning budget to keep your skills as sharp as a Tonie’s ears.

  • Tonie Discounts: Enjoy attractive discounts on our entire range of products. You’ll quickly become the favorite guest at every birthday party!

  • Rest & Recharge: Great work requires a clear head. You’ll enjoy generous paid time off to ensure you have plenty of time for your own stories.

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Tech Lead - Solutions
descriptionHtml:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

Pelico's customers feel one pain above all: missing parts that block delivery. The Solution squads are where we turn Pelico's platform into a product that fixes it. Each squad owns one solution surface — Material Coverage & inventory, Quality, Supplier & customer Collaboration / AI Buyer, MRO & Aftermarket, Program Management, or Strategic Account Support — composing our platform's building blocks into workflows that work across many customers. You'll lead one surface end to end: ship it fast, keep it configuration-first, and feed real customer patterns back into the platform — while our Regional Solution Engineering pods carry the day-to-day customer relationship.

What You'll Do

You'll own a solution surface — and build it yourself:

  • Ship the surface. Compose configuration, compute, widgets, connectors, and agents into customer-facing workflows that pass a real acid test on real customers.

  • Stay configuration-first. Solve in Phoenix YAML wherever you can, reach for code only when it's worth it, and never let the surface fragment into per-customer forks.

  • Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and put eval and review gates on anything AI-assisted that touches a customer.

  • Harvest the field. Spot the patterns that recur across accounts and turn them into platform capabilities, so the next customer is faster.

  • Lead by example. Write the code, pair with your squad and the engineers deploying at customer sites, raise the bar, and grow the team as the impact you ship earns it.

Your impact: Customers buy outcomes — shortages caught, deliveries recovered, quality exceptions resolved. Your squad is where the platform becomes those outcomes. Own a surface well and you make Pelico's revenue engine both faster and more defensible — and you keep it from collapsing into bespoke work that can't scale.

About You

This is a lead-by-example role for a senior full-stack engineer with real product and customer judgment. You're energized by shipping outcomes under real constraints, you decide what not to build, and you lead by being in the code with your team.

You'll need:

  • A track record of shipping customer-facing product software end to end, full-stack, under real delivery pressure

  • Strong, current hands-on coding — we build in Kotlin / Java 25 (backend) and TypeScript / React (frontend); strong in one and credible across, or a fast learner

  • Product and customer judgment — scope to outcomes, cut to MVP under deadline, decide what not to build

  • A configuration-first, anti-bespoke instinct — you build for many customers, not one fork at a time

  • A track record of leading engineers by example, not by leaving the keyboard

  • You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work — curious about what's possible and quick to adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows — whether for writing, research, analysis, coding, or productivity — and a genuine interest in staying at the frontier of what these tools can do.

Nice to have:

  • Aerospace / defense / supply-chain / discrete-manufacturing context (MRP, BoM, coverage, MRO/TAT, program management, procurement)

  • Forward-deployed / solutions-engineering / customer-embedded experience, feeding learnings back into a platform

  • Configuration- or low-code-driven product experience (YAML/DSL, composable UI, workflow authoring)

  • AI-native ways of working (agentic workflows, eval on AI output, spec-driven development)

  • French is a plus, not a requirement

If you bring the essentials and a strong mix of the rest, we want to hear from you — we're hiring the person who'll make this real, not a checklist.

Why Pelico

We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

  • Meaningful equity — you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

  • Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

  • Flexible, hybrid work model — we care about output, not face time

You will work closely with 600+ engineers across 70+ teams, owning the vision and strategy for data management products that form the foundation of everything we build.

Working in the product team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We operate in feature teams within an agile environment, collaborating closely with engineering, design, and business teams.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own and align the 2-year vision for data storage at Doctolib, defining which datastore products we build, which we source off the shelf, and how they serve both the monolith and the growing ecosystem of services around it

  • Define the product strategy and roadmap for data management products used by 600+ engineers, spanning multiple datastores (PostgreSQL/Aurora, Kafka, Debezium, Couchbase), file storage, data access, and data lifecycle solutions

  • Drive reliability, recoverability, and cost transparency across teams, including SLOs, alert ownership, backup and restore testing, and per-team cost visibility

  • Define the experience for managing production data for services outside the monolith and for new AI product storage needs

  • Partner with Staff and Senior Staff Engineers to assess the impact of complex architectural decisions, facilitate consensus across diverse viewpoints, and align stakeholders on contested trade-offs

  • Measure and improve engineer satisfaction with data management products, leading projects end-to-end, from problem definition and specs writing to development validation, rollout, and impact follow-up

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in Product Management with direct product ownership, working with developers, leading rituals, and writing specifications

  • Have extensive experience with technical products and platforms, and a passion for solving complex, large-scale infrastructure challenges

  • Can drive change across large engineering organizations, you're comfortable influencing 600+ engineers across more than 70 teams

  • Have proven experience building and launching products in a large-scale, international B2B environment, where moving fast without slowing down feature development is a constant challenge

  • Are fluent in both English and French (C1 level minimum) and are comfortable working in an international environment

  • Have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ambition to transform healthcare

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • Hiring Manager Interview (60m) - w Loïc 

  • Live-case Interview (90m)

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

title: Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. Rigorous testing is what turns a promising prototype into a product our customers can trust – and what gets us from validated prototype to Alpha customer readiness to volume shipments.

As Test Engineer, you will design and execute test plans for our power conversion systems – from functional and target-parameter verification through stability, endurance and load testing. You will build and maintain the test setups that validate our hardware and firmware, and work closely with Power Electronics, Firmware, EMC/Compliance and Mechanical engineers to track down and resolve issues.

It is a unique opportunity to shape the test strategy of a breakthrough power electronics platform from an early stage – with direct visibility to the CTO and engineering leadership.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and execute test plans for our AC/DC and DC/DC power conversion systems – functional tests, stability tests, endurance (soak) tests, and load tests.

• Build and maintain test setups for prototype, pilot and production units, including medium-voltage test benches.

• Support prototype validation and target-parameter verification (form factor, efficiency, stability) for our Prototype milestone.

• Support qualification testing for Alpha customer deployments – full target-parameter verification, certification test support, and release tests for volume delivery.

• Develop test automation scripts and tools to increase test coverage and reduce manual test effort.

• Collaborate with the Power Electronics, Firmware, EMC/Compliance and Mechanical teams to diagnose and root-cause test failures.

• Document test procedures, results and reports; maintain traceability for certification and quality purposes.

• Support the definition and specification of end-of-line (EOL) test equipment for volume production, working with our EOL test equipment vendor.

• Support field testing and diagnostics for units deployed at customer sites as needed.

Qualifications

• BSc / MSc in electrical engineering, electronics engineer (Elektroniker EFZ), automation engineer (Automatiker EFZ) or comparable education.

• 3+ years of experience in test engineering, ideally for power electronics or medium-voltage systems.

• Experience with medium-voltage high-power test setups and lab safety protocols and practices.

• Familiarity with test automation and scripting (e.g. Python, LabVIEW or similar).

• Understanding of power electronics test methods (efficiency, thermal, load and stability testing).

• Strong documentation and analytical skills.

• Team player, comfortable working hands-on in the lab with cross-functional teams.

• Language skills: fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory.

• The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Benefits

• Equity + competitive salary.

• Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments.

• Hybrid work with flexible working times.

title: Testingenieur*in Elektromechanik / Hardware Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wie wäre es, wenn deine Tests nicht das Ende der Entwicklung wären – sondern der Anfang? Mit Methodik, Präzision und der Freiheit, Schwachstellen aufzudecken, bevor sie zum Problem werden.

Wir bei TWK entwickeln und produzieren seit über 60 Jahren im Wachstumsmarkt der Mess- und Automatisierungstechnik kundenspezifische Sensoren für den Anlagen- und Maschinenbau. Funktionale Sicherheit für Mensch und Maschine ist unser Anspruch- oberflächliche Tests oder fehlende statistische Absicherung werden dem nicht gerecht. Deshalb legen wir Wert auf eine methodische und nachvollziehbare Testdurchführung und entwickeln diesen Bereich gezielt weiter.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams am Standort Düsseldorf suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Vollzeit als Spezifikations- und Testingenieur*in.

Aufgaben

In vielen Unternehmen wird Testing als Anhängsel der Entwicklung angesehen oder man glaubt, KI könne alles ersetzen, statt erst einmal die richtigen Probleme zu identifizieren. Bei uns ist das anders: Du wirst frühzeitig in die Produktentwicklung eingebunden und begleitest den gesamten Prozess – von Spezifikationen und Anforderungen über Tests und Verifikation bis zur Zertifizierung. Dabei trägst du Verantwortung für die Zuverlässigkeit und Leistungsfähigkeit unserer elektromechanischen Komponenten. Du stimmst dich eng mit den Entwicklungsingenieuren ab, verfeinerst gemeinsam Spezifikationen und bringst deine Ergebnisse direkt in Produktentscheidungen ein. Analytisch, pragmatisch und auf Augenhöhe – wer eine bessere Lösung sieht, spricht sie an.

So sieht deine Arbeit konkret aus:

  • Spezifikation und Pflege von Anforderungen, Testfällen und Testplänen nach geltenden Normen und Produktanforderungen
  • Durchführung von Tests sowie Analyse und Dokumentation der Ergebnisse – beispielsweise Integrations-, Funktions-, Grenz-, Fehlerfall- und Klimatests
  • Entwicklung von Testaufbauten und Testautomatisierungen zur Sicherstellung effizienter Testabläufe
  • Durchführung von Hardware- und Softwaretests, insbesondere Unit- oder Modultests

Qualifikation

Wir suchen keine Checklisten-Erfüller, sondern Menschen, die Verantwortung für Qualität übernehmen wollen und mit analytischem Denken echte Schwachstellen aufdecken. Wenn du dich hier wiedererkennst, passt du zu uns:

Was du mitbringst:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Maschinenbau oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Datenblättern, Schaltplänen und technischen Handbüchern
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit gängigen Mess- und Prüfgeräten wie Oszilloskop, Logic Analyzer, Multimeter und Signalgenerator
  • Grundlegende Erfahrung im Bereich Scripting oder Programmierung (z. B. Python, C oder vergleichbar)
  • Kenntnisse in Embedded-Software, elektrischen Schaltungen und deren Integration

Von Vorteil:

  • Erfahrung mit Versionsverwaltungssystemen wie Git oder SVN
  • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit industriellen Feldbussystemen wie PROFINET, EtherCAT, BiSS oder CANopen
  • Erfahrung mit Tools im Entwicklungsumfeld, z. B. Jira oder Confluence
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Spezifikation von Tests für elektromechanische Komponenten und Systemen

Benefits

Warum TWK? Weil hier mehr zählt als Obstkorb und Parkplatz.

Ja, wir haben Deutschlandticket, Dienstrad und Wellhub – aber dafür wechselst du nicht den Job, oder? Das hier macht den Unterschied:

Familienunternehmen mit Biss.
Langjährig geführt, aber mit einer jungen Geschäftsleitung, die gestalten will statt verwalten. Das merkst du im ersten Gespräch.

Wir investieren. Richtig.
In moderne Arbeitsplätze, neue Software, Weiterentwicklung. Und in dich, wenn du den Willen hast, etwas zu bewegen.

Deine Ideen werden umgesetzt.
Kurze Wege, offene Türen, echte Mitsprache. Wenn deine Idee gut ist, machen wir sie möglich – nicht in drei Monaten, sondern jetzt. Und mit der nötigen Nähe zur Produktion.

title: Trainee Content Creation (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Miss Germany ist kein Schönheitswettbewerb, sondern eine Plattform für Frauen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas bewegen wollen. Wir machen keinen Social-Media-Content von der Stange. Wir erzählen ihre Geschichten, Persönlichkeiten und Momente dort, wo sie gesehen werden: auf YouTube Shorts, Instagram und TikTok.

Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Short-Form nicht nur schaut, sondern versteht. Jemanden, der in den ersten zwei Sekunden eine Hook setzt, im Rhythmus schneidet und weiß, warum ein Reel durch die Decke geht – und ein anderes nicht.

Als Trainee Content Creation bei Miss Germany Studios schneidest du Short-Form-Content aus unserer YouTube-Serie und Produktionen – und aus Ideen, die du selbst mitbringst. Und wenn es passt, stehst du auch mal selbst vor der Kamera. Dabei lernst du Short-Form von Grund auf in der Praxis und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung.

Was du bei uns machst:

Schnitt: Du schneidest Shorts, Reels und TikToks – schnell, plattformgerecht und mit starken Hooks. Aus langen YouTube-Folgen, Event-Material und Behind-the-Scenes machst du Clips, die für sich allein funktionieren.

Trends & Formate: Du weißt, was auf den Plattformen gerade läuft, und bringst eigene Formatideen ein.

Vor der Kamera: Du drehst (dich) auch mal selbst.

Learnings: Du schaust dir an, was performt, und lässt das in die nächsten Videos einfließen.

Wir haben ein Match, wenn Folgendes auf dich zutrifft:

Du lebst Short-Form. Du scrollst nicht einfach – du analysierst ganz automatisch, warum dich ein Video nach zwei Sekunden hat.

Du kannst schneiden. Premiere Pro oder CapCut – Hauptsache, du bist schnell und hast ein Gefühl für Timing, Pacing und Sound.

Du bringst Social-Erfahrung mit. Idealerweise hast du schon Social-Media-Kanäle betreut oder eigenen Content veröffentlicht – für ein Unternehmen, eine Agentur oder deinen eigenen Kanal.

Du hast Creator-Energie. Du wartest nicht auf Briefings, sondern kommst mit Ideen.

Kamera ist kein Problem. Du hast keine Scheu, auch mal selbst vor der Linse zu stehen – musst aber nicht.

Du übernimmst Ownership. Du hältst Deadlines, denkst mit und gehst einen Schritt weiter, statt auf Antworten zu warten.

Du willst durchstarten. Du hast dein Studium oder deine Ausbildung abgeschlossen – idealerweise in Medien, Kommunikation oder Film – oder bringst vergleichbare Erfahrung mit,
z. B. durch eigene Kanäle. Ab dem 15. Januar 2027 bist du mit 40 Stunden pro Woche dabei.

Du möchtest etwas aufbauen. Nicht verwalten, sondern gestalten.

Was wir bieten:

Build Something Big: 2027 wird Miss Germany 100 Jahre alt. Du gestaltest unseren Short-Form-Auftritt in genau dieser Phase aktiv mit.

Impact Driven: Wir unterstützen mit Herzblut Frauen bei ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und tragen zu einer vielfältigeren und gleichberechtigteren Gesellschaft bei.

Creator Playground: Wir geben dir den Freiraum, Formate auszuprobieren und gemeinsam mit uns herauszufinden, was Menschen wirklich bewegt.

Ownership statt Micromanagement: Viel Vertrauen, kurze Entscheidungswege und echte Verantwortung statt endloser Abstimmungsschleifen.

Base Köln/Düsseldorf: Du arbeitest von Köln oder Düsseldorf aus – remote oder im Co-Working-Space. Ein festes Muster gibt es nicht, wir schauen gemeinsam, was passt. Für dein Onboarding sowie regelmäßige Team- und Produktionstage kommst du nach Oldenburg in unser Head Office.

Work with Inspiring People: Du arbeitest mit beeindruckenden Frauen, spannenden Persönlichkeiten, Partnern und einem Netzwerk, das weit über Miss Germany hinausgeht.

Learn Fast: Schnitt, Storytelling, Plattformen, Community, Personal Brands und Medien – du wirst in kurzer Zeit unglaublich viel lernen.

Top Gear: Neueste Hardware (Apple) und moderne Tools für deine tägliche Arbeit.

Ab dem ersten Tag steht dir ein erfahrener Mentor zur Seite, der dich fachlich begleitet und individuell unterstützt. Freue dich auf ein dynamisches Team, das dich von Beginn an bei deinem Einstieg mit viel Engagement und positiver Energie unterstützt.

Unternehmensprofil

Du wirst Teil eines international führenden Unternehmens im Bereich maritimer Verteidigungs- und Sicherheitstechnologien. Als Spezialist für hochkomplexe Sensor-, Führungs- und Waffeneinsatzsysteme arbeitet das High-Tech-Unternehmen weltweit mit Marinekunden und Industriepartnern zusammen.

title: Trainee Programme
descriptionHtml:
About us
Every large organisation runs on a web of legal entities, and the data behind them is scattered across in-house teams, law firms and accountants in PDFs, spreadsheets and slide decks. Jigsaw brings it into one place.
We started by giving lawyers and accountants a faster way to model client structures, and became the category leader doing it. Today 240+ organisations use Jigsaw, including all 10 of the world’s top 10 accountancy firms. Now we’re building Entity Lifecycle Management: one live record for every entity, from formation to dissolution.
Founded by former lawyer and repeat founder Stephen Scanlan, and backed by Exor Ventures.

Why join us:
You’ll help define a new software category with the backing of a loyal, global customer base. We hire people with high ownership and a bias for action, then trust them to do their best work.

The opportunity

We're looking for three Trainees to join Jigsaw in January 2027 on a 12-month rotational programme. It's an entry-level, generalist scheme: you'll work across the three core functions of Jigsaw, Client, Build and Ops, seeing how most of the business runs, and working out where your strengths really lie.

You don't need a degree, and you don't need to have done this kind of work before. We don’t care about a polished CV, we want someone with the right attitude, energy, and a curiosity to try out a range of different roles. At the end of the year there's the potential for a permanent role.

Is this for you?

This programme is for people who don't yet know exactly what they want to do next, and see that as a reason to explore rather than a problem to fix. You might be leaving school, college or university, or returning to work after a career change and happy to start at square one.

It's not for you if you already know the career you're chasing. If you want to become a software engineer, a lawyer or a specialist in one field, a dedicated graduate or apprenticeship scheme will serve you better. Here you'll move teams every few months, switch between very different kinds of work, and won't be specialising in any one craft.

How the year works

You'll report to our COO, who has helped build several successful startups. Each rotation gives you real work to own, with people in the team to learn from along the way.

Onboarding and Product Success (first six weeks)

You'll start together as a cohort. You'll spend time with our Product Marketing team learning about the product and who our clients are, then join Product Success. There you'll see the end-to-end cycle of what we build, how clients use it and how it gets implemented, and you'll start working with clients yourself. From there, each of you moves into a different area and you rotate through the rest of the year.

Client

You'll learn how we identify what a client needs and how we pitch Jigsaw. In prospecting, you'll get to know our ideal customer profiles, reach out to and build relationships with potential clients, and report on sales results. In Customer Success, you'll support existing clients, shadow client calls, organise training sessions on behalf of a Customer Success Manager, help shape retention strategies and find ways the team can work more efficiently with AI. You may also help with marketing and social content.

Build

You’ll get involved in the day-to-day operations of how a technology company plans and manages their work. You'll see how a product gets built in an AI-native company, and how that changes the way the work is done. You'll follow the journey from an idea to the roadmap to a shipped feature.

Ops

You'll learn what it takes to scale a business of any kind. In RevOps, you'll help organise the sales tools we use, such as HubSpot and Jiminny, shape the playbook the sales team runs on, and build the content and emails we use for outreach. Across Ops, you'll develop strategic thinking, project management and commercial awareness, and may take on AI project work.

You'll thrive if

  • You'd rather explore and find the right thing than follow a set path

  • It genuinely bugs you when something isn't working as well as it could, and you want to fix it

  • You're curious, get stuck in and enjoy solving problems you haven't seen before

  • You communicate well, get on with all kinds of people and can think on your feet

  • You adapt quickly and bounce back when things don't go to plan

  • You can point to goals you've set yourself and hit, whether in study, work, sport, a hobby or a side project

  • You're low-ego, coachable and take ownership of the outcome

What you'll get

A year that gives you a genuine head start, wherever you go next:

  • A view of the whole business. Few early-career roles let you see how a growing software company wins clients, builds product and scales its operations, all in one year

  • Real work from the start. Each rotation comes with work you own and deliver, not just tasks to shadow, and you'll work directly with clients at some of the world's leading law firms and financial institutions

  • Support around you. You'll join as a cohort of three, report to our COO and have people in each team to learn from, with regular check-ins and reviews throughout each rotation

  • Skills that travel. You'll build communication, problem-solving, project management and commercial skills, and learn how an AI-native company works day to day

  • Clarity on what's next. By the end of the year you'll know where your strengths lie, with the potential to move into a permanent role at Jigsaw

What to expect

  • A video screening call: An intro call with a member of the people team to learn more about you, and what you’re looking to get out of this programme

  • A video hiring manager call: Meet with the COO who will want to understand more about your ways of working and how you tackle challenges

  • An on-site interview day: If selected, you’ll join us in our London office on November 27th. You’ll complete a group task, meet with some of our managers, and stay for Friday drinks to get to know the rest of the team

As this programme is based out of our London office, you’ll need to be able to commit to our hybrid 3-days in office arrangement, and hold full UK working rights. Unfortunately, we’re unable to provide sponsorship for this programme.

title: Treasury Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

Our vision is that our Finance team plays a central part of the business, somewhere the Board can rely on to support strategic planning. In this our treasury team keeps us safely funded and liquid and gives the Board and ALCO numbers they can trust. As we add products and markets, the team is growing. As second hire to the team, you’ll report directly to our Treasurer, sitting at the heart of how we capture, report, analyse and manage risk to support how we optimise Griffin’s balance sheet.

The opportunity

Treasury at a fintech bank is different. You’ll see real-time payment flows and deposit behaviour that a conventional bank never sees. You’ll work directly with our Treasurer to build our treasury processes, reporting and systems rather than inherit them. You’ll contribute to management of liquidity as a Direct FPS participant, use of facilities within the Bank of England’s Sterling Monetary Framework (SMF), card issuing and stablecoin infrastructure.

What success looks like

By month 3, you’ll understand our business and processes, run daily reporting with Michael’s review and handle daily cash positioning, including our Bank of England reserve account. By month 6, you’ll own daily and monthly reporting and run intraday cash management independently, including testing the SMF. You’ll have drafted ALCO papers and credit reviews, delivered your first automation improvements and contributed to the impact assessment for Direct FPS or a similar product launch.

To do this you’ll own

  • Daily and intraday reporting on liquidity, capital, interest rate risk, funding capacity and asset encumbrance, with every output sense-checked before it goes out

  • Risk monitoring against our risk appetite: limits, triggers and early warning indicators, forecast-versus-actual reviews, and stress tests you design with the Treasurer

  • Intraday cash management and liquidity forecasting: cash positioning, payments and transfers, depositor behaviour and outflow assumptions

  • Monthly management reporting, including interest income, margin and customer profitability, the ALCO pack, inputs to regulatory returns, and contributions to the ILAAP and ICAAP

  • Dealing operations: pre- and post-trade checks, confirmations, settlements and collateral movements, plus credit analysis on counterparties and issuers. You’ll also cover for the Treasurer with brokers, treasury bill auctions and SMF drawdowns

  • Automating manual steps, closing control gaps, and documenting procedures that mean knowledge never sits with just two people

  • Maintaining our treasury bank and broker mandates

We expect you to shape this role

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

To succeed in the role, we're looking for people who have:

  • 5+ years in a bank treasury function (e.g. middle-office, ALM or balance sheet management), measuring and reporting liquidity and capital from economic and regulatory perspectives. You will have produced reports hands-on rather than reviewed them

  • Strong prudential knowledge across liquidity, capital and leverage (e.g. CRR, Basel III, LCR, NSFR, IRRBB, ILAAP, ICAAP), and hands-on exposure to the dealing lifecycle: pre- and post-trade checks, confirmations and settlements

  • Advanced Excel skills (e.g. data tables, scenario analysis, VBA), plus the attention to detail and reconciliation discipline to sense-check everything you produce

  • An analytical, inquisitive mindset, with a habit of automating what’s manual

  • The organisation and drive to work autonomously, remotely and asynchronously, and the appetite for the breadth and ambiguity of building in an early-stage bank

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write )

Ideally, you would also:

  • Hold a treasury or accountancy qualification (ACT, CertBALM, FRM, CFA, ACA, ACCA or CIMA)

  • Bring Python, SQL, Power BI or AI skills

  • Knowledge of Direct FPS and Bank of England SMF facilities

  • Experience implementing or using treasury or ALM systems

What can we offer you?

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 28 days’ holiday + bank holidays

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks.

How long will the process take?

We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other.

  • Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience.

  • Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements.

  • Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin.

  • Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview.

  • Step 5: Culture and Founder interview: Learn more about this here.

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We don’t work with recruitment agencies, so please don’t send us speculative CVs.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

title: Treasury Manager (Liquidity)
descriptionHtml:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth.

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.

Role Overview

title: Venture Develoment Intern (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity

At Taxfix, we have made tax filing simpler for millions of people. Now, we are looking to build our next major growth engine.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Venture Development Intern to join the Office of the COO. You will work directly with our Chief Operating Officer to explore, validate and build a new product proposition from the ground up.

Think of this as a founder’s associate role for an internal startup: you will turn an ambiguous opportunity into actionable hypotheses, run experiments and help build the business case for launch. At Taxfix, AI is part of how we work and build—not just something we talk about. You will use AI tools hands-on to move faster from idea to evidence and from evidence to action.

Duration: Fixed-term, full-time internship for a minimum of 3 months and up to 6 months.

What you will do

  • Discover and validate: Research markets and competitors, speak with potential customers and design experiments to test customer needs, demand and key assumptions.

  • Build the business case: Develop pricing and unit-economics models, assess commercial viability and map the operational requirements for launch and scale.

  • Turn ideas into tangible experiments: Use AI-native and no-code tools to create early prototypes, landing pages or other practical tests. Learn from the results and iterate with the COO and relevant teams.

  • Shape the go-to-market plan: Explore positioning, distribution, regulatory considerations and how to build on Taxfix’s brand and capabilities.

  • Communicate for decisions: Combine research, data and insights into clear recommendations, concise memos and presentations for the COO, Leadership Team and Board.

  • Work AI-first and responsibly: Use approved AI tools to support research, analysis, prototyping and everyday workflows. Check outputs and sources critically, protect sensitive information and involve the right colleagues when needed.

Academic collaboration

If you are completing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, we encourage you to explore combining the internship with your thesis. Your work could inform real strategic decisions, with access to C-level perspectives and relevant company insights, subject to confidentiality and data-protection requirements.

Who you are

  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on: You are excited by building something from zero to one, comfortable with ambiguity and ready to take ownership rather than wait for a playbook.

  • AI-native builder mindset: You are familiar with generative AI tools and use them—or are keen to use them—to research, analyze, prototype and automate. You enjoy turning ideas into tangible outputs; you do not need to be a software engineer.

  • Critical thinker: You know that AI can accelerate your work but does not replace judgment. You question assumptions, verify outputs and can explain your reasoning.

  • Structured and analytical: You can break down a broad question into hypotheses and practical workstreams. You are comfortable using Excel for analysis and modelling and PowerPoint to communicate a clear story.

  • Curious and commercially minded: You enjoy understanding customers and connecting their needs to pricing, economics and a viable business model.

  • Strong communicator: You can share ideas clearly and confidently with colleagues and senior stakeholders in German and English.

  • Eager to learn: You are pursuing or have recently pursued a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, ideally in business or a related field, and are motivated to learn quickly in a fast-moving environment.

What we offer

  • C-level mentorship: Work closely with the COO and gain first-hand exposure to executive decision-making.

  • Real ownership: Contribute to building a new proposition, not just supporting a predefined process.

  • Accelerated learning: Gain experience across strategy, product, commercial, operations and venture building.

  • A strong network: Collaborate with Taxfix leaders and connect with our network of founders and investors.

  • An international environment: Join a dynamic team in Berlin with a flexible hybrid setup.

If you are excited to combine structured thinking, AI tools and a founder’s mindset to help build what comes next at Taxfix, we would love to hear from you.

Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

title: Video Education Manager (Remote)
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Softr is the first AI-native platform for building business apps such as internal tools and client portals, without any code.

If you're interested in being on the cutting edge of technology and advancing your career at a fast-growing, lean, impact-driven company, then read on…

We launched Softr in 2020 with a single vision: to give 1 billion business users the ability to build the tools they need — without relying on developers, without learning to code.

Softr is now powering over 1 million builders worldwide - including companies like Netflix, Google, Stripe, UPS, and Clay, who build and run the systems that power their business operations.

We're a fully remote, distributed, and diverse team of curious, ambitious, and driven individuals.

Role Overview

Softr is on a mission to give a billion people the power to build without code — but that power only matters if people know how to use it. We're looking for a Video Education Manager who will become the face of Softr's education efforts, translating complex app-building and database concepts into video content that takes users from "what is Softr?" to "I just shipped a client portal." This isn't a talking-head content role or a webinar-hosting role — it's a technical teaching role for someone who genuinely understands how to structure data, connect logic, and build real business apps, and who can produce tight, well-edited, presenter-led videos that make that knowledge stick.

This role reports to the Head of Growth and will work closely with Product, Support, and Marketing to make sure every tutorial, workshop, and academy track reflects what's actually shipping in the product and what users are actually getting stuck on.

Tasks

Responsibilities

  • Own the Softr Academy end-to-end: Build and maintain our video library and academy curriculum, designing learning tracks that take users from 0-1 and eventually into advanced, database-driven app building.
  • Script and produce polished educational videos: Write scripts and produce tightly edited, presenter-led videos covering Softr fundamentals, no-code database design, integrations, and real customer case study walkthroughs — not raw screen-recordings or webinar replays.
  • Be the face of Softr education: Represent Softr on camera across tutorials and product education content, building trust with users as a knowledgeable, technical guide.
  • Design progressive learning paths: Develop a full suite of guided courses and segments tailored to where a user is in their Softr journey, from first-time builder to power user.
  • Plan production and editing workflows: Manage the full video production process — scripting, shooting, editing, and publishing — to a consistently high bar of quality and pacing.
  • Partner cross-functionally: Work with Product to stay ahead of new features and with Support to identify the topics and gaps users most need explained.

Requirements

  • Technical no-code fluency: You deeply understand how to build with no-code tools — relational databases, logic, workflows, and integrations — not just the surface-level UI.
  • Produced video experience, not just live formats: You have a strong track record of scripting, shooting, and editing polished educational or product videos — think structured, presenter-led explainer content, not screen-share webinars or unscripted live streams.
  • On-camera presence: You're comfortable and confident on camera as a forward-facing representative of the brand.
  • Clear communicator: You can break down technical, database-driven concepts into simple, digestible language — in both written and verbal English.
  • Editing and production know-how: You understand pacing, structure, and visual storytelling well enough to either edit yourself or brief an editor effectively.
  • Curriculum design instincts: You think in terms of learning journeys and progressions, not one-off videos.
  • Self-starter: You can take full ownership of a content library with minimal oversight and a get-things-done mindset.
  • Genuine passion for no-code: You're excited by what no-code and AI-native tools make possible, and you want users to feel that excitement too.

Please include examples of produced videos you've written, shot, and/or edited when applying. For reference, here's an example of the style we're looking for: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oKHI2jSPWgo — think polished, scripted, presenter-led educational content, not webinars or screen-share recordings.

Benefits

Why is Softr the best place to work?

  • Fast-growing company and opportunity to make an impact on a large scale.
  • Competitive salary and equity options.
  • Fully remote and flexible work schedule.
  • Build the Academy from scratch: You'll have the rare chance to design an entire education function from the ground up, shaping how over 1 million builders learn Softr.
  • Annual company retreat and team gatherings.
  • Opportunity to build up sales motion from the ground up and have an outsized impact on the company’s trajectory.
  • Direct impact and visibility: As the face of Softr education, your work will be seen daily by users worldwide and you'll work closely with founders and leadership on what to teach next.
  • Our customers love Softr (1M+ users and growing)! A daily dose of customer love and positive feedback that rewards your work.
  • Backed by the best - we are well-resourced, profitable, and backed by best investors, like FirstMark Capital and the world’s best angel investors like Gokul Rajaram, Scott Belsky, Brian Balfour, Cristina Cordova and 40+ (check out the full list here).

Please include examples of produced videos you've written, shot, and/or edited when applying. title: VP Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

Context

You'll join a small, high-ownership engineering team (software, AI, data) building production systems that serve millions of users. We care deeply about code quality and clean architecture, and we intend to keep it that way as we scale.

Lemrock is accelerating and the team is about to grow. As our VP Engineering, you own how engineering runs: the team, the way we deliver, and the technical roadmap. You report to our CTO, who keeps the product and technical vision.

Your mission

Team & hiring

  • Grow the engineering team: build the hiring plan with the founders, run the process and hold the bar

  • Manage the engineers day to day: 1:1s, feedback, career paths, then the first layer of leads as the team grows

  • Keep a culture where ownership, code quality and speed go together

Delivery & process

  • Take the product inputs, prioritise with the CTO, staff each project and commit to dates you hold

  • Set up the process the team needs at its size, no more: planning, rituals, code review, incident handling

  • Make capacity and trade-offs visible to the founders, early

Technical direction

  • Own the technical roadmap and turn new product bets into scoped, staffed projects

  • Make the architecture, infrastructure and tooling calls with the CTO and the senior engineers

  • Own reliability, security and infrastructure costs as traffic and integrations grow

  • Stay close to the code: design reviews, code reviews, and shipping yourself when it unblocks the team

AI-native engineering

  • Scale the way the team builds with AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor): shared practices and tooling, so we go faster without lowering the quality bar

After 6 months

  • The team has grown with engineers who raise the bar, and everyone ships every week

  • Delivery is predictable: the founders know what lands when, and it lands

  • The technical roadmap runs through you, and the CTO is back on product and vision

Candidate profile

  • 10+ years of software engineering, including 3+ years managing engineers

  • Has grown an engineering team at an early-stage startup (seed to Series B): hiring, structuring and delivering through the growth

  • Strong technical background: has built and owned production backend systems, and can challenge an architecture choice on the merits

  • Has run delivery hand in hand with product: priorities, planning, trade-offs

  • Uses AI coding tools every day and has brought a team along

  • Ex-CTO, ex-founder or first engineering leader of a startup: a strong fit

  • Professional proficiency in French & English

Tech stack

TypeScript, NestJS, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, BigQuery), Terraform, LLM integrations. A similar stack is a plus, not a requirement.

Why join us

  • Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth

  • Work directly with an experienced team: two repeat YC founders who've scaled product & tech before, a former strategy/innovation director (10 years in the sector), and ex-strategy consultants (McKinsey QuantumBlack, BCG)

  • Be part of the next structural shift of the web: agentic interfaces

  • Own mission-critical topics, grow fast, and shape the company's future trajectory

Package

Competitive salary + equity, disclosed during the interview process.

title: Working Student - Data Science (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions

As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second, we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time.

Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake, providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange.

Engineered for performance, our stack leverages PyTorch for model training, NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference. We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem.

The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day, 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines, and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For

  • Quantitative Academic Foundation: You are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. You are available to contribute up to 20 hours per week during the semester.

We are looking for solid Python skills and hands-on familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, and gradient boosting libraries (LightGBM/CatBoost/XGBoost) to prototype new algorithms.

We need someone who can rigorously evaluate models through offline experiments and A/B tests before they hit our 100,000+ predictions-per-second production environment.

  • Plus: ML Infrastructure Exposure: Any prior exposure to the systems that run our real-time scale—AWS, workflow orchestration (Airflow), containerization (Docker), or basic model deployment workflows—will accelerate your impact.

title: Working Student, Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

This working student position is designed for individuals who are interested in applying technology to solve real customer challenges while growing into customer-facing technical professionals. Working alongside our Solutions Architects, you will support the discovery, design, piloting, and delivery of geospatial solutions by combining your technical background with Planet’s products and platforms. You will collaborate directly with customers, engineers, and cross-functional teams, progressively developing the technical and consulting skills required to become a trusted technical advisor.

This is a part-time (20 hours/week), hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office approximately 2 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Support Solutions Architects in customer discovery, solution design, pilot delivery, and customer adoption.
  • Participate in customer workshops by gathering requirements, documenting outcomes, coordinating follow-up actions, and supporting Agile solution delivery.
  • Act as the technical communication bridge for Russian-speaking customers throughout workshops, pilots, and ongoing engagements.
  • Prepare customer datasets, subscriptions, collections, and Planet platform resources for demonstrations and pilot projects.
  • Support engineers and architects with solution validation, testing, technical troubleshooting, and customer onboarding.
  • Contribute to pre-sales activities, customer demonstrations, technical training, and regional onsite engagements.

What You Bring:

  • Currently enrolled full-time at an accredited university in GIS, Computer Science, Remote Sensing, Geography, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with GIS software such as QGIS, ArcGIS, GDAL, ENVI, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Experience supporting customer workshops, gathering requirements, and working directly with end users.
  • Experience using AI tools for productivity, coding, and rapid prototyping.
  • Solid communication skills with the ability to collaborate directly with customers and technical teams.
  • Fluent written and spoken Russian and English.
  • A proactive, curious, and customer-oriented mindset.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • A background in remote sensing, geoscience, or geoinformatics.
  • Practical experience with Python for geospatial applications, data processing, or automation.
  • Experience designing geospatial solutions or supporting solution architecture.
  • Experience with Agile software development and cross-functional product delivery.
  • Experience with machine learning, modern cloud technologies, CI/CD, or geospatial web applications.
  • Familiarity with Planet products or Earth observation technologies.

We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.
